We derive a closed-form expression for this adversarial perturbation, bypassing adversarial training entirely and enabling linear-time evaluation in the state dimension. We show that this expression approximates the true worst-case adversarial perturbation with second-order accuracy. We further bound the safety performance gap between clean and corrupted observations, showing that it degrades at most linearly with the corruption probability under Kullback-Leibler regularization. Finally, we integrate the closed-form adversarial policy into a MARL policy gradient algorithm to obtain a robust counter-policy for the agents. In a high-density sUAS simulation, we observe near-zero collision rates under corruption levels up to 35%, outperforming a baseline policy trained without adversarial perturbations.
tldr: This paper uses Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) to develop robust collision avoidance for small drones under GPS spoofing, deriving a closed-form adversarial perturbation to enhance safety without adversarial training.
tldr_zh: 该论文利用多智能体强化学习（MARL）为小型无人机在GPS欺骗下开发鲁棒的防撞系统，推导出封闭形式的对抗性扰动以增强安全性，无需对抗训练。
summary_zh: 本文针对小型无人机系统在GPS信号衰减与欺骗干扰下的鲁棒间隔保障问题，提出基于多智能体强化学习的解决方案。在协同监视场景中，每架无人机（即智能体）需广播其GPS定位数据；当此类定位广播信息被篡改时，整个观测到的空中交通状态将失去可靠性。我们将这种状态观测干扰建模为智能体与对抗方之间的零和博弈：对抗方以概率R扰动观测状态，旨在最大化降低各智能体的安全性能。通过推导出对抗扰动的闭式表达式，我们完全规避了对抗训练过程，实现了状态维度上的线性时间评估。研究表明，该表达式能以二阶精度逼近真实最坏情况下的对抗扰动。我们进一步界定了洁净观测与受污染观测之间的安全性能差距，证明在Kullback-Leibler正则化条件下，该性能差距随污染概率的增长至多呈线性退化。最后，我们将闭式对抗策略集成至多智能体强化学习的策略梯度算法中，为智能体构建出鲁棒的反制策略。在高密度小型无人机仿真环境中，即使在污染水平高达35%的条件下，该方案仍能实现接近零的碰撞率，显著优于未经过对抗扰动训练的基线策略。

title: A Semantic Observer Layer for Autonomous Vehicles: Pre-Deployment Feasibility Study of VLMs for Low-Latency Anomaly Detection
summary: Semantic anomalies-context-dependent hazards that pixel-level detectors cannot reason about-pose a critical safety risk in autonomous driving. We propose a \emph{semantic observer layer}: a quantized vision-language model (VLM) running at 1--2\,Hz alongside the primary AV control loop, monitoring for semantic edge cases, and triggering fail-safe handoffs when detected. Using Nvidia Cosmos-Reason1-7B with NVFP4 quantization and FlashAttention2, we achieve ~500 ms inference a ~50x speedup over the unoptimized FP16 baseline (no quantization, standard PyTorch attention) on the same hardware--satisfying the observer timing budget. We benchmark accuracy, latency, and quantization behavior in static and video conditions, identify NF4 recall collapse (10.6%) as a hard deployment constraint, and a hazard analysis mapping performance metrics to safety goals. The results establish a pre-deployment feasibility case for the semantic observer architecture on embodied-AI AV platforms.
tldr: The paper proposes a low-latency, quantized vision-language model for semantic anomaly detection in autonomous vehicles, achieving speedups for real-time safety monitoring.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于自动驾驶汽车的低延迟、量化视觉语言模型，用于语义异常检测，以实现实时安全监控的加速。
summary_zh: 语义异常——即像素级检测器无法推理的上下文依赖危险——在自动驾驶中构成了关键的安全风险。我们提出了一种**语义观察层**：一个量化视觉语言模型（VLM），以1-2 Hz的频率与主自动驾驶控制循环并行运行，监测语义边缘案例，并在检测到异常时触发故障安全切换机制。通过使用Nvidia Cosmos-Reason1-7B模型结合NVFP4量化与FlashAttention2技术，我们在相同硬件上实现了约500毫秒的推理速度，相较于未优化的FP16基线（无量化、标准PyTorch注意力机制）实现了约50倍的加速，满足了观察层的时序预算要求。我们在静态和视频场景下对模型精度、延迟及量化行为进行了基准测试，发现NF4量化导致的召回率骤降（10.6%）是硬性部署约束，并基于性能指标与安全目标的映射关系进行了危害分析。研究结果为具身人工智能自动驾驶平台上的语义观察层架构提供了部署前可行性验证。

title: Scalable AI-assisted Workflow Management for Detector Design Optimization Using Distributed Computing
summary:
The Production and Distributed Analysis (PanDA) system, originally developed for the ATLAS experiment at the CERN Large Hadron Collider (LHC), has evolved into a robust platform for orchestrating large-scale workflows across distributed computing resources. Coupled with its intelligent Distributed Dispatch and Scheduling (iDDS) component, PanDA supports AI/ML-driven workflows through a scalable and flexible workflow engine.
  We present an AI-assisted framework for detector design optimization that integrates multi-objective Bayesian optimization with the PanDA--iDDS workflow engine to coordinate iterative simulations across heterogeneous resources. The framework addresses the challenge of exploring high-dimensional parameter spaces inherent in modern detector design.
  We demonstrate the framework using benchmark problems and realistic studies of the ePIC and dRICH detectors for the Electron-Ion Collider (EIC). Results show improved automation, scalability, and efficiency in multi-objective optimization. This work establishes a flexible and extensible paradigm for AI-driven detector design and other computationally intensive scientific applications.
tldr: This paper presents an AI-assisted framework integrating Bayesian optimization with a distributed workflow engine for automating detector design optimization in particle physics, demonstrating improved scalability and efficiency in high-dimensional parameter exploration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个AI辅助框架，将贝叶斯优化与分布式工作流引擎相结合，用于自动化粒子物理探测器的设计优化，在高维参数探索中展示了更高的可扩展性和效率。
summary_zh:
生产与分布式分析（PanDA）系统最初是为欧洲核子研究中心大型强子对撞机（LHC）上的ATLAS实验开发的，现已演变为一个跨分布式计算资源协调大规模工作流程的稳健平台。结合其智能分布式调度与分发（iDDS）组件，PanDA通过可扩展且灵活的工作流引擎支持人工智能/机器学习驱动的工作流程。

我们提出了一种用于探测器设计优化的AI辅助框架，该框架将多目标贝叶斯优化与PanDA--iDDS工作流引擎集成，以协调跨异构资源的迭代模拟。该框架解决了现代探测器设计中固有的高维参数空间探索难题。

我们通过在电子离子对撞机（EIC）的ePIC和dRICH探测器的基准问题与真实场景研究中展示了该框架的性能。结果表明，该框架在多目标优化中实现了更高的自动化水平、可扩展性和效率。此项工作为AI驱动的探测器设计及其他计算密集型科学应用建立了一个灵活且可扩展的范式。

title: Phyelds: A Pythonic Framework for Aggregate Computing
summary: Aggregate programming is a field-based coordination paradigm with over a decade of exploration and successful applications across domains including sensor networks, robotics, and IoT, with implementations in various programming languages, such as Protelis, ScaFi (Scala), and FCPP (C++). A recent research direction integrates machine learning with aggregate computing, aiming to support large-scale distributed learning and provide new abstractions for implementing learning algorithms. However, existing implementations do not target data science practitioners, who predominantly work in Python--the de facto language for data science and machine learning, with a rich and mature ecosystem. Python also offers advantages for other use cases, such as education and robotics (e.g., via ROS). To address this gap, we present Phyelds, a Python library for aggregate programming. Phyelds offers a fully featured yet lightweight implementation of the field calculus model of computation, featuring a Pythonic API and an architecture designed for seamless integration with Python's machine learning ecosystem. We describe the design and implementation of Phyelds and illustrate its versatility across domains, from well-known aggregate computing patterns to federated learning coordination and integration with a widely used multi-agent reinforcement learning simulator.
tldr: Presents Phyelds, a Python library for aggregate programming (a field-based coordination paradigm), designed to integrate with Python's machine learning ecosystem and demonstrated in domains including multi-agent reinforcement learning simulation.
tldr_zh: 提出了Phyelds，一个用于聚合编程的Python库，旨在与Python的机器学习生态系统集成，并在多智能体强化学习模拟等领域展示了其应用。
summary_zh: 聚合编程是一种基于场的协调范式，经过十余年的探索，已在传感器网络、机器人技术和物联网等多个领域成功应用，并出现了多种编程语言的实现，如Protelis、ScaFi（Scala）和FCPP（C++）。近期的研究方向将机器学习与聚合计算相融合，旨在支持大规模分布式学习，并为实现学习算法提供新的抽象层。然而，现有的实现并未针对数据科学从业者——他们主要使用Python，这一数据科学和机器学习领域的事实标准语言，拥有丰富且成熟的生态系统。Python在其他应用场景中同样具有优势，例如教育和机器人技术（如通过ROS）。为填补这一空白，我们提出了Phyelds，一个用于聚合编程的Python库。Phyelds完整实现了场演算模型的计算功能，同时保持轻量级设计，提供符合Python风格的API和架构，以实现与Python机器学习生态系统的无缝集成。本文描述了Phyelds的设计与实现，并通过从经典聚合计算模式到联邦学习协调、再到与广泛使用的多智能体强化学习模拟器的集成，展示了其在多个领域的通用性。

title: Extending MONA in Camera Dropbox: Reproduction, Learned Approval, and Design Implications for Reward-Hacking Mitigation
summary: Myopic Optimization with Non-myopic Approval (MONA) mitigates multi-step reward hacking by restricting the agent's planning horizon while supplying far-sighted approval as a training signal~\cite{farquhar2025mona}. The original paper identifies a critical open question: how the method of constructing approval -- particularly the degree to which approval depends on achieved outcomes -- affects whether MONA's safety guarantees hold. We present a reproduction-first extension of the public MONA Camera Dropbox environment that (i)~repackages the released codebase as a standard Python project with scripted PPO training, (ii)~confirms the published contrast between ordinary RL (91.5\% reward-hacking rate) and oracle MONA (0.0\% hacking rate) using the released reference arrays, and (iii)~introduces a modular learned-approval suite spanning oracle, noisy, misspecified, learned, and calibrated approval mechanisms. In reduced-budget pilot sweeps across approval methods, horizons, dataset sizes, and calibration strategies, the best calibrated learned-overseer run achieves zero observed reward hacking but substantially lower intended-behavior rates than oracle MONA (11.9\% vs.\ 99.9\%), consistent with under-optimization rather than re-emergent hacking. These results operationalize the MONA paper's approval-spectrum conjecture as a runnable experimental object and suggest that the central engineering challenge shifts from proving MONA's concept to building learned approval models that preserve sufficient foresight without reopening reward-hacking channels. Code, configurations, and reproduction commands are publicly available. https://github.com/codernate92/mona-camera-dropbox-repro
tldr: This paper is a reproduction and extension of the MONA method for mitigating reward hacking in RL agents, using the Camera Dropbox environment. It focuses on the impact of different approval mechanisms on safety guarantees and performance, rather than direct robotic applications.
tldr_zh: 本文是对MONA方法的复现和扩展，用于减轻RL智能体中的奖励攻击问题，使用了Camera Dropbox环境。研究重点是不同批准机制对安全保证和性能的影响，而非直接应用于机器人领域。
summary_zh: 近视优化与非近视认可（MONA）通过限制智能体的规划视野，同时提供远见卓识的认可作为训练信号，缓解了多步奖励黑客问题~\cite{farquhar2025mona}。原论文指出了一个关键开放问题：构建认可的方法——特别是认可对已实现结果的依赖程度——如何影响MONA安全保证的成立。本文提出了一种基于复现优先的扩展方法，对公开的MONA Camera Dropbox环境进行重构：（i）将已发布的代码库重新打包为带有脚本化PPO训练的标准Python项目，（ii）使用已发布的参考数组验证了普通强化学习（91.5\%奖励黑客率）与理想MONA（0.0\%黑客率）之间的对比结果，以及（iii）引入模块化的学习型认可套件，涵盖理想、含噪声、错误设定、学习型及校准型认可机制。在认可方法、规划视野、数据集规模和校准策略的小规模试点实验中，表现最佳的学习型校准监督器运行结果实现了零观测奖励黑客率，但预期行为率显著低于理想MONA（11.9\%对比99.9\%），这表明问题在于优化不足而非黑客行为重现。这些结果将MONA论文中关于认可谱系的猜想转化为可运行的实验对象，并表明核心工程挑战已从验证MONA概念转向构建能够保持足够远见且不重新开放奖励黑客通道的学习型认可模型。代码、配置与复现命令已公开：https://github.com/codernate92/mona-camera-dropbox-repro。

title: ATP-Bench: Towards Agentic Tool Planning for MLLM Interleaved Generation
summary: Interleaved text-and-image generation represents a significant frontier for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), offering a more intuitive way to convey complex information. Current paradigms rely on either image generation or retrieval augmentation, yet they typically treat the two as mutually exclusive paths, failing to unify factuality with creativity. We argue that the next milestone in this field is Agentic Tool Planning, where the model serves as a central controller that autonomously determines when, where, and which tools to invoke to produce interleaved responses for visual-critical queries. To systematically evaluate this paradigm, we introduce ATP-Bench, a novel benchmark comprising 7,702 QA pairs (including 1,592 VQA pairs) across eight categories and 25 visual-critical intents, featuring human-verified queries and ground truths. Furthermore, to evaluate agentic planning independent of end-to-end execution and changing tool backends, we propose a Multi-Agent MLLM-as-a-Judge (MAM) system. MAM evaluates tool-call precision, identifies missed opportunities for tool use, and assesses overall response quality without requiring ground-truth references. Our extensive experiments on 10 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal that models struggle with coherent interleaved planning and exhibit significant variations in tool-use behavior, highlighting substantial room for improvement and providing actionable guidance for advancing interleaved generation. Dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/ATP-Bench.
tldr: Introduces ATP-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating agentic tool planning by Multimodal LLMs for interleaved text-and-image generation, and a Multi-Agent MLLM-as-a-Judge evaluation system.
tldr_zh: 提出了ATP-Bench，一个用于评估多模态大模型在图文交错生成中作为智能体进行工具规划的基准，以及一个多智能体MLLM作为评判者的评估系统。
summary_zh: 交错式图文生成是多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的重要前沿方向，它提供了一种更直观传达复杂信息的方式。当前范式主要依赖图像生成或检索增强，但通常将两者视为互斥路径，未能实现事实性与创造性的统一。我们认为该领域的下一个里程碑是智能体工具规划范式，即模型作为核心控制器，自主决定何时、何处以及调用何种工具，以针对视觉关键性查询生成交错式响应。为系统评估这一范式，我们提出了ATP-Bench——一个包含7,702个问答对（含1,592个视觉问答对）的新型基准测试，覆盖八大类别和25种视觉关键意图，所有查询与参考答案均经过人工验证。此外，为在独立于端到端执行和动态工具后端的情况下评估智能体规划能力，我们提出了多智能体MLLM即评判系统（MAM）。该系统可评估工具调用精度、识别工具使用的遗漏机会，并在无需参考答案的情况下评估整体响应质量。通过对10个前沿MLLM进行大量实验，我们发现现有模型在连贯的交错式规划方面存在困难，且工具使用行为存在显著差异，这表明该领域仍有巨大改进空间，并为推进交错式生成研究提供了具体可行的指导方向。数据集与代码公开于：https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/ATP-Bench。

title: From Density Matrices to Phase Transitions in Deep Learning: Spectral Early Warnings and Interpretability
summary: A key problem in the modern study of AI is predicting and understanding emergent capabilities in models during training. Inspired by methods for studying reactions in quantum chemistry, we present the ``2-datapoint reduced density matrix". We show that this object provides a computationally efficient, unified observable of phase transitions during training. By tracking the eigenvalue statistics of the 2RDM over a sliding window, we derive two complementary signals: the spectral heat capacity, which we prove provides early warning of second-order phase transitions via critical slowing down, and the participation ratio, which reveals the dimensionality of the underlying reorganization. Remarkably, the top eigenvectors of the 2RDM are directly interpretable making it straightforward to study the nature of the transitions. We validate across four distinct settings: deep linear networks, induction head formation, grokking, and emergent misalignment. We then discuss directions for future work using the 2RDM.
tldr: The paper introduces a '2-datapoint reduced density matrix' (2RDM) as a method to analyze and predict phase transitions during neural network training, offering early warning signals and interpretability for phenomena like grokking and emergent misalignment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种'2-数据点约化密度矩阵'（2RDM），用于分析和预测神经网络训练过程中的相变，为理解涌现能力（如grokking和错位）提供了早期预警和可解释性。
summary_zh: 现代人工智能研究中的一个关键问题是在训练过程中预测和理解模型涌现的能力。受量子化学反应研究方法的启发，我们提出了"双数据点约化密度矩阵（2RDM）"。我们证明，该矩阵为训练过程中的相变提供了一个计算效率高、统一的观测指标。通过追踪滑动窗口上2RDM的特征值统计特性，我们推导出两个互补信号：谱热容（我们证明其能通过临界慢化现象为二阶相变提供早期预警）和参与度比（可揭示底层重组的维度）。值得注意的是，2RDM的顶部特征向量具有直接可解释性，使研究人员能够直观地分析相变的本质。我们在四个不同场景中验证了该方法的有效性：深度线性网络、归纳头形成机制、顿悟现象以及涌现性错位。最后，我们探讨了未来基于2RDM的研究方向。

title: Reasoning-Driven Synthetic Data Generation and Evaluation
summary: Although many AI applications of interest require specialized multi-modal models, relevant data to train such models is inherently scarce or inaccessible. Filling these gaps with human annotators is prohibitively expensive, error-prone, and time-consuming, leading model builders to increasingly consider synthetic data as a scalable alternative. However, existing synthetic data generation methods often rely on manual prompts, evolutionary algorithms, or extensive seed data from the target distribution - limiting their scalability, explainability, and control. In this paper, we introduce Simula: a novel reasoning-driven framework for data generation and evaluation. It employs a seedless, agentic approach to generate synthetic datasets at scale, allowing users to define desired dataset characteristics through an explainable and controllable process that enables fine-grained resource allocation. We show the efficacy of our approach on a variety of datasets, rigorously testing both intrinsic and downstream properties. Our work (1) offers guidelines for synthetic data mechanism design, (2) provides insights into generating and evaluating synthetic data at scale, and (3) unlocks new opportunities for developing and deploying AI in domains where data scarcity or privacy concerns are paramount.
tldr: The paper introduces Simula, a reasoning-driven framework for generating and evaluating synthetic datasets at scale, without requiring seed data, to address data scarcity and privacy concerns in AI applications.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Simula，一个基于推理的、无需种子数据的、可扩展的合成数据生成和评估框架，旨在解决AI应用中的数据稀缺和隐私问题。
summary_zh: 尽管许多受关注的AI应用需要专门的多模态模型，但训练此类模型所需的相关数据本身稀缺或难以获取。通过人工标注填补这些空白成本高昂、易出错且耗时，导致模型构建者日益将合成数据视为可扩展的替代方案。然而，现有合成数据生成方法常依赖人工提示、进化算法或来自目标分布的大量种子数据，这限制了其可扩展性、可解释性与可控性。本文提出Simula：一种新颖的推理驱动数据生成与评估框架。它采用无种子的智能体方法大规模生成合成数据集，允许用户通过可解释且可控的过程定义所需数据集特性，从而实现细粒度资源分配。我们在多种数据集上验证了该方法的有效性，并对其内在特性与下游性能进行了严格测试。本工作（1）为合成数据机制设计提供了指导原则；（2）为大规模生成与评估合成数据提供了新见解；（3）为在数据稀缺或隐私敏感领域开发与部署AI开辟了新机遇。

title: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation
summary: There has been growing interest in building agents that can interact with digital platforms to execute meaningful enterprise tasks autonomously. Among the approaches explored are tool-augmented agents built on abstractions such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and web agents that operate through graphical interfaces. Yet, it remains unclear whether such complex agentic systems are necessary given their cost and operational overhead. We argue that a coding agent equipped only with a terminal and a filesystem can solve many enterprise tasks more effectively by interacting directly with platform APIs. We evaluate this hypothesis across diverse real-world systems and show that these low-level terminal agents match or outperform more complex agent architectures. Our findings suggest that simple programmatic interfaces, combined with strong foundation models, are sufficient for practical enterprise automation.
tldr: This paper argues that coding agents using only a terminal and filesystem to interact with APIs can match or outperform more complex agent architectures for enterprise automation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文认为，对于企业自动化任务，仅使用终端和文件系统与API交互的编码智能体，其性能可匹配或超越更复杂的智能体架构。
summary_zh: 近年来，如何构建能够与数字平台交互以自主执行重要企业任务的智能体日益受到关注。目前探索的方法包括基于模型上下文协议（MCP）等抽象框架构建的工具增强型智能体，以及通过图形界面操作的网页智能体。然而，考虑到其成本与运维负担，此类复杂智能体系统是否必要尚未明确。我们认为，仅配备终端和文件系统的编程智能体可通过直接调用平台API更有效地解决众多企业任务。我们在多种实际系统中验证了这一假设，并证明此类底层终端智能体的性能可媲美或超越更复杂的智能体架构。研究结果表明，简单的程序化接口与强大的基础模型相结合，足以实现实际的企业自动化需求。

title: TSHA: A Benchmark for Visual Language Models in Trustworthy Safety Hazard Assessment Scenarios
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have accelerated their application to indoor safety hazards assessment. However, existing benchmarks suffer from three fundamental limitations: (1) heavy reliance on synthetic datasets constructed via simulation software, creating a significant domain gap with real-world environments; (2) oversimplified safety tasks with artificial constraints on hazard and scene types, thereby limiting model generalization; and (3) absence of rigorous evaluation protocols to thoroughly assess model capabilities in complex home safety scenarios. To address these challenges, we introduce TSHA (\textbf{T}rustworthy \textbf{S}afety \textbf{H}azards \textbf{A}ssessment), a comprehensive benchmark comprising 81,809 carefully curated training samples drawn from four complementary sources: existing indoor datasets, internet images, AIGC images, and newly captured images. This benchmark set also includes a highly challenging test set with 1707 samples, comprising not only a carefully selected subset from the training distribution but also newly added videos and panoramic images containing multiple safety hazards, used to evaluate the model's robustness in complex safety scenarios. Extensive experiments on 23 popular VLMs demonstrate that current VLMs lack robust capabilities for safety hazard assessment. Importantly, models trained on the TSHA training set not only achieve a significant performance improvement of up to +18.3 points on the TSHA test set but also exhibit enhanced generalizability across other benchmarks, underscoring the substantial contribution and importance of the TSHA benchmark.
tldr: Presents TSHA, a benchmark for Vision-Language Models focused on indoor safety hazard assessment, using a diverse dataset to highlight model deficiencies and improve performance.
tldr_zh: 提出TSHA基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在室内安全隐患评估中的能力，通过多样化数据集揭示模型不足并提升其性能。
summary_zh: 近期，视觉语言模型在室内安全隐患评估中的应用得到快速推进。然而，现有基准测试存在三个根本性局限：（1）过度依赖通过仿真软件构建的合成数据集，导致与现实环境存在显著领域差异；（2）安全任务设计过于简化，对危险类型和场景类型施加了人为约束，限制了模型泛化能力；（3）缺乏严谨的评估机制，难以全面衡量模型在复杂家居安全场景中的实际能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出TSHA（可信安全隐患评估）基准，该综合性基准包含81,809个经精心筛选的训练样本，采集自四个互补来源：现有室内数据集、网络图像、AIGC生成图像及新采集图像。该基准测试集还包含1,707个高难度测试样本，不仅涵盖训练分布中精心选取的子集，还新增包含多重安全隐患的视频与全景图像，用于评估模型在复杂安全场景中的鲁棒性。通过对23个主流视觉语言模型的广泛实验表明，当前模型在安全隐患评估方面仍缺乏鲁棒能力。值得注意的是，在TSHA训练集上微调的模型不仅在TSHA测试集上实现了最高达+18.3分的性能提升，在其他基准测试中也展现出更强的泛化能力，这充分证明了TSHA基准的重要贡献与价值。

title: CausalPulse: An Industrial-Grade Neurosymbolic Multi-Agent Copilot for Causal Diagnostics in Smart Manufacturing
summary: Modern manufacturing environments demand real-time, trustworthy, and interpretable root-cause insights to sustain productivity and quality. Traditional analytics pipelines often treat anomaly detection, causal inference, and root-cause analysis as isolated stages, limiting scalability and explainability. In this work, we present CausalPulse, an industry-grade multi-agent copilot that automates causal diagnostics in smart manufacturing. It unifies anomaly detection, causal discovery, and reasoning through a neurosymbolic architecture built on standardized agentic protocols. CausalPulse is being deployed in a Robert Bosch manufacturing plant, integrating seamlessly with existing monitoring workflows and supporting real-time operation at production scale. Evaluations on both public (Future Factories) and proprietary (Planar Sensor Element) datasets show high reliability, achieving overall success rates of 98.0% and 98.73%. Per-criterion success rates reached 98.75% for planning and tool use, 97.3% for self-reflection, and 99.2% for collaboration. Runtime experiments report end-to-end latency of 50-60s per diagnostic workflow with near-linear scalability (R^2=0.97), confirming real-time readiness. Comparison with existing industrial copilots highlights distinct advantages in modularity, extensibility, and deployment maturity. These results demonstrate how CausalPulse's modular, human-in-the-loop design enables reliable, interpretable, and production-ready automation for next-generation manufacturing.
tldr: The paper presents a neurosymbolic multi-agent copilot for automated causal diagnostics in smart manufacturing, demonstrating high success rates and real-time performance in a Bosch plant deployment.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于智能制造中自动因果诊断的神经符号多智能体协导系统，在博世工厂部署中展示了高成功率与实时性能。
summary_zh: 现代制造环境需要实时、可靠且可解释的根源洞察来维持生产力和质量。传统的分析流程通常将异常检测、因果推断和根源分析视为独立阶段，限制了可扩展性和可解释性。本研究提出CausalPulse——一个工业级多智能体协操作系统，用于实现智能制造中的自动化因果诊断。该系统通过基于标准化智能体协议构建的神经符号架构，将异常检测、因果发现和推理过程相统一。CausalPulse正在罗伯特·博世制造工厂中部署，能够无缝集成现有监控工作流，并支持生产规模的实时运行。在公开数据集（Future Factories）和专有数据集（平面传感器元件）上的评估表明系统具有高可靠性，整体成功率分别达到98.0%和98.73%。分项成功率分别为：规划与工具使用98.75%，自我反思97.3%，协同能力99.2%。运行时实验显示每个诊断工作流的端到端延迟为50-60秒，并具备接近线性的扩展性（R^2=0.97），证实了实时运行能力。与现有工业协操作系统的对比突显了其在模块化、可扩展性和部署成熟度方面的显著优势。这些结果表明，CausalPulse采用模块化、人机协同的设计理念，能够为下一代制造业提供可靠、可解释且可直接投入生产的自动化解决方案。

title: BotVerse: Real-Time Event-Driven Simulation of Social Agents
summary: BotVerse is a scalable, event-driven framework for high-fidelity social simulation using LLM-based agents. It addresses the ethical risks of studying autonomous agents on live networks by isolating interactions within a controlled environment while grounding them in real-time content streams from the Bluesky ecosystem. The system features an asynchronous orchestration API and a simulation engine that emulates human-like temporal patterns and cognitive memory. Through the Synthetic Social Observatory, researchers can deploy customizable personas and observe multimodal interactions at scale. We demonstrate BotVersevia a coordinated disinformation scenario, providing a safe, experimental framework for red-teaming and computational social scientists. A video demonstration of the framework is available at https://youtu.be/eZSzO5Jarqk.
tldr: BotVerse is a real-time, event-driven simulation framework for LLM-based social agents, using Bluesky data for realistic interactions in a controlled environment, demonstrated via a disinformation scenario.
tldr_zh: BotVerse是一个用于LLM社交代理的实时、事件驱动的模拟框架，使用Bluesky数据进行真实交互，并通过虚假信息场景进行了演示。
summary_zh: BotVerse是一种可扩展的事件驱动框架，用于基于大语言模型智能体进行高保真社会模拟。该框架通过将交互隔离在受控环境中，同时将其锚定于Bluesky生态系统的实时内容流，从而解决了在实时网络中研究自主智能体所面临的伦理风险。该系统配备异步编排API和模拟引擎，能够模拟类人时间模式与认知记忆功能。通过合成社会观测站，研究人员可部署可定制虚拟角色，并大规模观察多模态交互行为。我们通过协调式虚假信息传播场景展示了BotVerse，为红队演练与计算社会科学研究提供了安全的实验框架。该框架的视频演示详见：https://youtu.be/eZSzO5Jarqk。

title: Beyond the Steeper Curve: AI-Mediated Metacognitive Decoupling and the Limits of the Dunning-Kruger Metaphor
summary: The common claim that generative AI simply amplifies the Dunning-Kruger effect is too coarse to capture the available evidence. The clearest findings instead suggest that large language model (LLM) use can improve observable output and short-term task performance while degrading metacognitive accuracy and flattening the classic competence-confidence gradient across skill groups. This paper synthesizes evidence from human-AI interaction, learning research, and model evaluation, and proposes the working model of AI-mediated metacognitive decoupling: a widening gap among produced output, underlying understanding, calibration accuracy, and self-assessed ability. This four-variable account better explains overconfidence, over- and under-reliance, crutch effects, and weak transfer than the simpler metaphor of a uniformly steeper Dunning-Kruger curve. The paper concludes with implications for tool design, assessment, and knowledge work.
tldr: This paper argues that the common analogy of AI amplifying the Dunning-Kruger effect is inaccurate, proposing instead a model of AI-mediated metacognitive decoupling to explain the gap between performance and self-assessment when using LLMs.
tldr_zh: 本文认为AI放大邓宁-克鲁格效应的常见类比不准确，提出了一个AI介导的元认知解耦模型，以解释使用大语言模型时表现与自我评估之间的差距。
summary_zh: 常见的观点认为生成式人工智能只是简单放大了邓宁-克鲁格效应，这种论断过于笼统，难以解释现有证据。更清晰的研究发现表明，大语言模型的使用虽然能提升可观测产出和短期任务表现，却会降低元认知准确性，并拉平不同技能群体间经典的能力-信心梯度曲线。本文综合了人机交互、学习研究和模型评估领域的证据，提出人工智能介导的元认知解耦工作模型：即产出成果、底层理解、校准准确性和自我评估能力四者之间日益扩大的鸿沟。相较于简单比喻为邓宁-克鲁格曲线整体变陡的模型，这种四变量模型能更好地解释过度自信、过度/低度依赖、拐杖效应及弱迁移现象。本文最后探讨了该模型对工具设计、评估及知识工作领域的启示。

title: View-oriented Conversation Compiler for Agent Trace Analysis
summary: Agent traces carry increasing analytical value in agentic systems and context engineering, yet most prior work treats conversation format as a trivial implementation detail. Modern agent conversations, however, contain deeply structured content, including nested tool calls and results, chain-of-thought reasoning blocks, sub-agent invocations, context-window compaction boundaries, and harness-injected system directives, whose complexity far exceeds that of simple user-assistant exchanges. Feeding such traces to a reflector or other analytical mechanism in plain text, JSON, YAML, or via grep can materially degrade analysis quality. This paper presents VCC (View-oriented Conversation Compiler), a compiler (lex, parse, IR, lower, emit) that transforms raw agent JSONL logs into a family of structured views: a full view (lossless transcript serving as the canonical line-number coordinate system), a user-interface (UI) view (reconstructing the interaction as the user actually perceived it), and an adaptive view (a structure-preserving projection governed by a relevance predicate). In a context-engineering experiment on AppWorld, replacing only the reflector's input format, from raw JSONL to VCC-compiled views, leads to higher pass rates across all three model configurations tested, while cutting reflector token consumption by half to two-thirds and producing more concise learned memory. These results suggest that message format functions as infrastructure for context engineering, not as an incidental implementation choice.
tldr: This paper introduces VCC, a compiler that transforms raw agent conversation logs into structured views to improve the analysis and efficiency of agentic systems, focusing on context engineering rather than robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了VCC，一种将原始代理对话日志编译成结构化视图的编译器，旨在提升代理系统的分析效率，其核心是上下文工程，而非机器人技术。
summary_zh: 在智能体系统与语境工程领域，智能体轨迹的分析价值日益凸显，然而以往研究大多将会话格式视为无关紧要的实现细节。现代智能体会话包含高度结构化的内容——嵌套工具调用与结果、思维链推理模块、子智能体调用、上下文窗口压缩边界以及框架注入的系统指令，其复杂程度远超简单的用户-助手交互模式。若将此类轨迹以纯文本、JSON、YAML格式或通过grep工具直接输入反思器或其他分析机制，会实质性地降低分析质量。本文提出VCC（面向视图的会话编译器），该编译器通过词法分析、语法解析、中间表示、代码优化与输出生成的全流程，将原始智能体JSONL日志转化为结构化视图家族：完整视图（作为标准行号坐标系的无损转录本）、用户界面视图（还原用户实际感知的交互过程）以及自适应视图（由相关性谓词控制的结构保持投影）。在AppWorld平台的语境工程实验中，仅将反思器输入格式从原始JSONL替换为VCC编译视图，即可使测试的三种模型配置通过率全面提升，同时将反思器令牌消耗量削减至三分之一到二分之一，并生成更精简的学习记忆。这些结果表明，消息格式应被视为语境工程的基础设施，而非偶然的实现选择。

title: 6GAgentGym: Tool Use, Data Synthesis, and Agentic Learning for Network Management
summary: Autonomous 6G network management requires agents that can execute tools, observe the resulting state changes, and adapt their decisions accordingly. Existing benchmarks based on static questions or scripted episode replay, however, do not support such closed-loop interaction, limiting agents to passive evaluation without the ability to learn from environmental feedback. This paper presents 6GAgentGym to provide closed-loop capability. The framework provides an interactive environment with 42 typed tools whose effect classification distinguishes read-only observation from state-mutating configuration, backed by a learned Experiment Model calibrated on NS-3 simulation data. 6G-Forge bootstraps closed-loop training trajectories from NS-3 seeds via iterative Self-Instruct generation with execution verification against the Experiment Model. Supervised fine-tuning on the resulting corpus followed by reinforcement learning with online closed-loop interaction enables an 8B open-source model to achieve comparable overall success rate to GPT-5 on the accompanying 6GAgentBench, with stronger performance on long-horizon tasks. Together, these components provide a viable path toward autonomous, closed-loop network management.
tldr: This paper introduces a framework for autonomous 6G network management, focusing on tool-use agents, environment synthesis, and closed-loop agent learning, with no direct connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于自主6G网络管理的框架，专注于工具使用代理、环境合成和闭环代理学习，与机器人或具身AI没有直接联系。
summary_zh:
摘要：
自主6G网络管理需要能够执行工具、观察由此产生的状态变化并相应调整决策的智能体。然而，现有基于静态问题或脚本化情境回放的基准测试不支持此类闭环交互，将智能体局限于被动评估而无法从环境反馈中学习。本文提出6GAgentGym框架以提供闭环能力。该框架构建了一个包含42种类型工具的交互环境，其效果分类能区分只读观察与状态变更配置，并依托基于NS-3仿真数据校准的学习型实验模型提供支持。6G-Forge通过基于NS-3种子的迭代式自指令生成技术，结合实验模型的执行验证，实现了闭环训练轨迹的自主构建。通过对生成数据集的监督微调及在线闭环交互的强化学习，一个80亿参数的开源模型在配套的6GAgentBench基准测试中达到了与GPT-5相当的整体成功率，且在长周期任务上表现更优。这些组件共同为自主闭环网络管理提供了可行路径。

title: Concept frustration: Aligning human concepts and machine representations
summary: Aligning human-interpretable concepts with the internal representations learned by modern machine learning systems remains a central challenge for interpretable AI. We introduce a geometric framework for comparing supervised human concepts with unsupervised intermediate representations extracted from foundation model embeddings. Motivated by the role of conceptual leaps in scientific discovery, we formalise the notion of concept frustration: a contradiction that arises when an unobserved concept induces relationships between known concepts that cannot be made consistent within an existing ontology. We develop task-aligned similarity measures that detect concept frustration between supervised concept-based models and unsupervised representations derived from foundation models, and show that the phenomenon is detectable in task-aligned geometry while conventional Euclidean comparisons fail. Under a linear-Gaussian generative model we derive a closed-form expression for Bayes-optimal concept-based classifier accuracy, decomposing predictive signal into known-known, known-unknown and unknown-unknown contributions and identifying analytically where frustration affects performance. Experiments on synthetic data and real language and vision tasks demonstrate that frustration can be detected in foundation model representations and that incorporating a frustrating concept into an interpretable model reorganises the geometry of learned concept representations, to better align human and machine reasoning. These results suggest a principled framework for diagnosing incomplete concept ontologies and aligning human and machine conceptual reasoning, with implications for the development and validation of safe interpretable AI for high-risk applications.
tldr: This paper introduces a geometric framework for comparing human-interpretable concepts with unsupervised machine representations from foundation models, formalizing a 'concept frustration' phenomenon and providing a diagnostic tool for aligning human and machine reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文引入了一个几何框架，用于比较人类可解释概念与基础模型中的无监督机器表示，形式化了'概念挫折'现象，为对齐人类和机器推理提供了诊断工具。
summary_zh: 将人类可解释概念与现代机器学习系统内部表征进行对齐，仍是可解释性人工智能面临的核心挑战。本文提出了一种几何框架，用于比较监督式人类概念与从基础模型嵌入中提取的无监督中间表征。受科学发现中概念跃迁机制的启发，我们形式化了"概念挫折"的定义：当未被观测到的概念在已知概念间诱导出无法在现有本体论中保持一致的关系时，就会产生矛盾冲突。我们开发了任务对齐的相似性度量方法，用以检测基于监督概念模型与基础模型无监督表征之间的概念挫折现象，并证明该现象在任务对齐的几何空间中可被检测，而传统欧氏空间比较方法则无法实现。基于线性高斯生成模型，我们推导出贝叶斯最优概念分类器准确率的闭式解，将预测信号分解为已知-已知、已知-未知与未知-未知三个组成部分，并通过解析方法确定挫折效应影响性能的具体环节。在合成数据及真实语言与视觉任务上的实验表明：基础模型表征中可检测到挫折现象，而将挫折概念纳入可解释模型后，能够重构学习到的概念表征几何结构，从而更好地实现人类与机器推理的对齐。这些研究结果为诊断不完备概念本体论、对齐人类与机器概念推理提供了理论框架，对高风险应用场景下安全可解释人工智能的开发与验证具有重要启示。

title: ASI-Evolve: AI Accelerates AI
summary: Can AI accelerate the development of AI itself? While recent agentic systems have shown strong performance on well-scoped tasks with rapid feedback, it remains unclear whether they can tackle the costly, long-horizon, and weakly supervised research loops that drive real AI progress. We present ASI-Evolve, an agentic framework for AI-for-AI research that closes this loop through a learn-design-experiment-analyze cycle. ASI-Evolve augments standard evolutionary agents with two key components: a cognition base that injects accumulated human priors into each round of exploration, and a dedicated analyzer that distills complex experimental outcomes into reusable insights for future iterations. To our knowledge, ASI-Evolve is the first unified framework to demonstrate AI-driven discovery across three central components of AI development: data, architectures, and learning algorithms. In neural architecture design, it discovered 105 SOTA linear attention architectures, with the best discovered model surpassing DeltaNet by +0.97 points, nearly 3x the gain of recent human-designed improvements. In pretraining data curation, the evolved pipeline improves average benchmark performance by +3.96 points, with gains exceeding 18 points on MMLU. In reinforcement learning algorithm design, discovered algorithms outperform GRPO by up to +12.5 points on AMC32, +11.67 points on AIME24, and +5.04 points on OlympiadBench. We further provide initial evidence that this AI-for-AI paradigm can transfer beyond the AI stack through experiments in mathematics and biomedicine. Together, these results suggest that ASI-Evolve represents a promising step toward enabling AI to accelerate AI across the foundational stages of development, offering early evidence for the feasibility of closed-loop AI research.
tldr: ASI-Evolve is an AI-for-AI research framework that uses a learn-design-experiment-analyze loop to autonomously discover improvements in data, architectures, and learning algorithms, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: ASI-Evolve 是一个用于AI研究的AI驱动框架，它通过一个学习-设计-实验-分析的闭环，自主发现数据、架构和学习算法方面的改进，并取得了最先进的成果。
summary_zh: 人工智能能否加速其自身的发展？近期代理系统已在反馈迅速的明确任务中展现出强大性能，但尚不清楚它们能否应对成本高昂、周期漫长且监督薄弱的研究闭环——这正是推动人工智能实际进步的关键。我们提出ASI-Evolve，这是一个面向AI自我研究的代理框架，通过"学习-设计-实验-分析"的循环实现闭环研究。该框架在标准进化代理基础上融入两大核心组件：一是为每轮探索注入人类先验知识的认知库，二是将复杂实验结果提炼为可复用洞察的专用分析器。据我们所知，ASI-Evolve是首个在AI开发的三大核心领域——数据、架构与学习算法——均实现AI驱动发现的一体化框架。在神经架构设计方面，该框架发现了105个SOTA线性注意力架构，其中最优模型超越DeltaNet达0.97个百分点，增益达到近期人工设计改进的近3倍。在预训练数据筛选任务中，进化后的数据流程将基准性能平均提升3.96个百分点，在MMLU数据集上的增益超过18分。在强化学习算法设计领域，发现的算法在AMC32上超越GRPO算法12.5分，在AIME24上领先11.67分，在OlympiadBench上提升5.04分。我们进一步通过数学与生物医学实验提供初步证据，表明这种AI自我研究范式可迁移至AI技术栈之外。这些结果共同表明，ASI-Evolve在实现人工智能自主加速其基础阶段发展方面迈出了重要一步，为闭环AI研究的可行性提供了早期实证。

title: Temporal Memory for Resource-Constrained Agents: Continual Learning via Stochastic Compress-Add-Smooth
summary:
An agent that operates sequentially must incorporate new experience without forgetting old experience, under a fixed memory budget. We propose a framework in which memory is not a parameter vector but a stochastic process: a Bridge Diffusion on a replay interval $[0,1]$, whose terminal marginal encodes the present and whose intermediate marginals encode the past. New experience is incorporated via a three-step \emph{Compress--Add--Smooth} (CAS) recursion. We test the framework on the class of models with marginal probability densities modeled via Gaussian mixtures of fixed number of components~$K$ in $d$ dimensions; temporal complexity is controlled by a fixed number~$L$ of piecewise-linear protocol segments whose nodes store Gaussian-mixture states. The entire recursion costs $O(LKd^2)$ flops per day -- no backpropagation, no stored data, no neural networks -- making it viable for controller-light hardware.
  Forgetting in this framework arises not from parameter interference but from lossy temporal compression: the re-approximation of a finer protocol by a coarser one under a fixed segment budget. We find that the retention half-life scales linearly as $a_{1/2}\approx c\,L$ with a constant $c>1$ that depends on the dynamics but not on the mixture complexity~$K$, the dimension~$d$, or the geometry of the target family. The constant~$c$ admits an information-theoretic interpretation analogous to the Shannon channel capacity. The stochastic process underlying the bridge provides temporally coherent ``movie'' replay -- compressed narratives of the agent's history, demonstrated visually on an MNIST latent-space illustration. The framework provides a fully analytical ``Ising model'' of continual learning in which the mechanism, rate, and form of forgetting can be studied with mathematical precision.
tldr: A framework for continual learning in resource-constrained agents using a stochastic process for memory, with forgetting from lossy compression rather than parameter interference, but is not explicitly applied to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 为资源受限的智能体提出了一个持续学习框架，使用随机过程作为记忆，遗忘源于有损压缩而非参数干扰，但未明确应用于机器人或具身AI领域。
summary_zh:
一个顺序操作的智能体必须在固定内存预算下，既能吸收新经验又不遗忘旧经验。本文提出一种框架，将记忆视为随机过程而非参数向量：在回放区间$[0,1]$上的桥扩散过程，其终端边缘分布编码当前状态，中间边缘分布编码历史经验。新经验通过**压缩-添加-平滑**（CAS）三步递归进行整合。我们在高斯混合模型类中测试该框架：边际概率密度用$d$维空间中固定分量数$K$的高斯混合建模；时间复杂性由分段线性协议段的固定数量$L$控制，其节点存储高斯混合状态。整个递归每日仅需$O(LKd^2)$次浮点运算——无需反向传播、数据存储或神经网络——使其适用于控制器轻量化硬件。

该框架中的遗忘并非源于参数干扰，而是来自有损时间压缩：在固定分段预算下，通过更粗糙的协议重新逼近精细协议。我们发现保留半衰期呈线性缩放：$a_{1/2}\approx c\,L$，常数$c>1$取决于动态特性，而与混合复杂度$K$、维度$d$或目标族几何结构无关。该常数$c$具有类似于香农信道容量的信息论解释。桥扩散的随机过程可提供时间连贯的“电影式”回放——智能体历史的压缩叙事，这在MNIST潜在空间示例中通过可视化得到验证。该框架建立了持续学习的完全解析“伊辛模型”，可通过数学精度研究遗忘的机制、速率与形式。

title: MacTok: Robust Continuous Tokenization for Image Generation
summary: Continuous image tokenizers enable efficient visual generation, and those based on variational frameworks can learn smooth, structured latent representations through KL regularization. Yet this often leads to posterior collapse when using fewer tokens, where the encoder fails to encode informative features into the compressed latent space. To address this, we introduce \textbf{MacTok}, a \textbf{M}asked \textbf{A}ugmenting 1D \textbf{C}ontinuous \textbf{Tok}enizer that leverages image masking and representation alignment to prevent collapse while learning compact and robust representations. MacTok applies both random masking to regularize latent learning and DINO-guided semantic masking to emphasize informative regions in images, forcing the model to encode robust semantics from incomplete visual evidence. Combined with global and local representation alignment, MacTok preserves rich discriminative information in a highly compressed 1D latent space, requiring only 64 or 128 tokens. On ImageNet, MacTok achieves a competitive gFID of 1.44 at 256$\times$256 and a state-of-the-art 1.52 at 512$\times$512 with SiT-XL, while reducing token usage by up to 64$\times$. These results confirm that masking and semantic guidance together prevent posterior collapse and achieve efficient, high-fidelity tokenization.
tldr: A novel continuous image tokenizer for image generation using masking and representation alignment to prevent posterior collapse, achieving high-fidelity results with far fewer tokens.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于图像生成的新型连续图像分词器，通过掩码和表示对齐防止后验坍缩，能以极少的token实现高保真度结果。
summary_zh: 连续图像分词器能够实现高效的视觉生成，而基于变分框架的分词器通过KL正则化可以学习平滑、结构化的潜在表征。然而，在使用较少分词时，这往往导致后验崩塌——编码器无法将有信息量的特征编码到压缩后的潜在空间中。为解决这一问题，我们提出了**MacTok**，一种**基于掩码增强的一维连续分词器**，它利用图像掩码和表征对齐技术，在学习紧凑且鲁棒的表征时防止崩塌。MacTok同时应用随机掩码来正则化潜在学习，并采用DINO引导的语义掩码来强调图像中的信息丰富区域，迫使模型从不完整的视觉证据中编码出鲁棒的语义信息。结合全局与局部的表征对齐机制，MacTok能在高度压缩的一维潜在空间中保留丰富的判别性信息，仅需64或128个分词即可实现。在ImageNet数据集上，MacTok配合SiT-XL模型在256×256分辨率下取得了1.44的竞争性gFID分数，在512×512分辨率下更以1.52的成绩达到当前最优水平，同时将分词使用量降低了最高64倍。这些结果证实，掩码与语义引导的协同作用能够有效防止后验崩塌，并实现高效、高保真的分词表示。

title: Convergent Representations of Linguistic Constructions in Human and Artificial Neural Systems
summary: Understanding how the brain processes linguistic constructions is a central challenge in cognitive neuroscience and linguistics. Recent computational studies show that artificial neural language models spontaneously develop differentiated representations of Argument Structure Constructions (ASCs), generating predictions about when and how construction-level information emerges during processing. The present study tests these predictions in human neural activity using electroencephalography (EEG). Ten native English speakers listened to 200 synthetically generated sentences across four construction types (transitive, ditransitive, caused-motion, resultative) while neural responses were recorded. Analyses using time-frequency methods, feature extraction, and machine learning classification revealed construction-specific neural signatures emerging primarily at sentence-final positions, where argument structure becomes fully disambiguated, and most prominently in the alpha band. Pairwise classification showed reliable differentiation, especially between ditransitive and resultative constructions, while other pairs overlapped. Crucially, the temporal emergence and similarity structure of these effects mirror patterns in recurrent and transformer-based language models, where constructional representations arise during integrative processing stages. These findings support the view that linguistic constructions are neurally encoded as distinct form-meaning mappings, in line with Construction Grammar, and suggest convergence between biological and artificial systems on similar representational solutions. More broadly, this convergence is consistent with the idea that learning systems discover stable regions within an underlying representational landscape - recently termed a Platonic representational space - that constrains the emergence of efficient linguistic abstractions.
tldr: This paper compares neural representations of linguistic constructions in human brain activity and artificial language models, finding convergent representational patterns, but does not involve robotics or embodied agents.
tldr_zh: 本研究比较了人类大脑活动和人工语言模型中对语言构式的神经表征，发现了趋同的表征模式，但未涉及机器人或具身智能体。
summary_zh: 理解大脑如何处理语言构式是认知神经科学和语言学领域的核心挑战。近期计算研究表明，人工神经语言模型能够自发形成对论元结构构式的差异化表征，并预测了构式层级信息在加工过程中何时及如何浮现。本研究通过脑电图技术，在人类神经活动中验证了这些预测。十名英语母语者聆听了按四种构式类型（及物、双及物、致使移动、结果构式）合成的200个句子，同时记录其神经响应。通过时频分析、特征提取和机器学习分类方法，研究发现构式特异的神经信号主要出现在句末位置——此处论元结构完全解歧——且以α波段最为显著。配对分类分析显示构式间存在可靠区分，尤以双及物构式与结果构式的差异最为明显，而其他构式对存在重叠。关键发现是，这些神经效应的时间浮现模式与相似性结构，与基于循环神经网络和Transformer的语言模型中的模式高度吻合，即构式表征均产生于整合加工阶段。这些发现支持了语言构式在神经层面被编码为独立形式-意义映射的观点，符合构式语法理论，并表明生物系统与人工系统在表征解决方案上趋于一致。更广泛而言，这种趋同性印证了学习系统会在底层表征空间中发现稳定区域的理论——该空间近期被称为"柏拉图表征空间"——它制约着高效语言抽象结构的浮现。

title: Generating Key Postures of Bharatanatyam Adavus with Pose Estimation
summary: Preserving intangible cultural dances rooted in centuries of tradition and governed by strict structural and symbolic rules presents unique challenges in the digital era. Among these, Bharatanatyam, a classical Indian dance form, stands out for its emphasis on codified adavus and precise key postures. Accurately generating these postures is crucial not only for maintaining anatomical and stylistic integrity, but also for enabling effective documentation, analysis, and transmission to broader global audiences through digital means. We propose a pose-aware generative framework integrated with a pose estimation module, guided by keypoint-based loss and pose consistency constraints. These supervisory signals ensure anatomical accuracy and stylistic integrity in the synthesized outputs. We evaluate four configurations: standard conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN), cGAN with pose supervision, conditional diffusion, and conditional diffusion with pose supervision. Each model is conditioned on key posture class labels and optimized to maintain geometric structure. In both cGAN and conditional diffusion settings, the integrated pose guidance aligns generated poses with ground-truth keypoint structures, promoting cultural fidelity. Our results demonstrate that incorporating pose supervision significantly enhances the quality, realism, and authenticity of generated Bharatanatyam postures. This framework provides a scalable approach for the digital preservation, education, and dissemination of traditional dance forms, enabling high-fidelity generation without compromising cultural precision. Code is available at https://github.com/jagidsh/Generating-Key-Postures-of-Bharatanatyam-Adavus-with-Pose-Estimation.
tldr: The paper proposes a pose-aware generative framework using pose estimation to generate key postures for the Bharatanatyam dance form, with evaluations showing that pose supervision improves the quality and authenticity of the generated postures.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种结合姿态估计的生成框架，用于生成婆罗多舞的关键姿势，评估表明姿态监督能显著提高生成姿势的质量和真实性。
summary_zh: 在数字化时代，如何保存那些根植于数百年传统、受严格结构和符号规则约束的非物质文化遗产舞蹈，面临着独特挑战。其中，印度古典舞蹈形式婆罗多舞以其强调程式化的阿达武步法和精确的关键姿态而尤为突出。准确生成这些姿态不仅对维持其解剖学与风格完整性至关重要，还能通过数字化手段实现有效记录、分析，并向更广泛的全球观众传播。我们提出一种结合姿态估计模块的姿势感知生成框架，该框架通过基于关键点的损失函数和姿态一致性约束进行引导。这些监督信号确保了合成输出在解剖学上的准确性和风格完整性。我们评估了四种配置：标准条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）、带姿态监督的cGAN、条件扩散模型，以及带姿态监督的条件扩散模型。每种模型均以关键姿态类别标签为条件输入，并优化以保持几何结构。无论在cGAN还是条件扩散设置中，集成的姿态引导都能使生成姿态与真实关键点结构对齐，从而提升文化保真度。实验结果表明，引入姿态监督显著提高了生成的婆罗多舞姿态的质量、真实感与 authenticity。该框架为传统舞蹈形式的数字化保存、教育与传播提供了可扩展的解决方案，能够在确保文化精确性的同时实现高保真生成。代码发布于 https://github.com/jagidsh/Generating-Key-Postures-of-Bharatanatyam-Adavus-with-Pose-Estimation。

title: FlowPIE: Test-Time Scientific Idea Evolution with Flow-Guided Literature Exploration
summary: Scientific idea generation (SIG) is critical to AI-driven autonomous research, yet existing approaches are often constrained by a static retrieval-then-generation paradigm, leading to homogeneous and insufficiently divergent ideas. In this work, we propose FlowPIE, a tightly coupled retrieval-generation framework that treats literature exploration and idea generation as a co-evolving process. FlowPIE expands literature trajectories via a flow-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) inspired by GFlowNets, using the quality of current ideas assessed by an LLM-based generative reward model (GRM) as a supervised signal to guide adaptive retrieval and construct a diverse, high-quality initial population. Based on this population, FlowPIE models idea generation as a test-time idea evolution process, applying selection, crossover, and mutation with the isolation island paradigm and GRM-based fitness computation to incorporate cross-domain knowledge. It effectively mitigates the information cocoons arising from over-reliance on parametric knowledge and static literature. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FlowPIE consistently produces ideas with higher novelty, feasibility and diversity compared to strong LLM-based and agent-based frameworks, while enabling reward scaling during test time.
tldr: FlowPIE is a framework for scientific idea generation that uses a flow-guided MCTS and test-time idea evolution to produce diverse and high-quality ideas, with no direct connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: FlowPIE 是一个用于科学想法生成的框架，它使用流引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索和测试时想法演化来产生多样化和高质量的想法，与机器人或具身AI没有直接联系。
summary_zh: 科学构思生成是人工智能驱动自主研究的关键环节，但现有方法通常受限于静态的“检索-生成”范式，导致构思同质化且缺乏发散性。本研究提出FlowPIE框架，通过紧密耦合检索与生成机制，将文献探索与构思生成处理为协同演化的动态过程。FlowPIE采用受GFlowNets启发的流引导蒙特卡洛树搜索扩展文献轨迹，借助基于大语言模型的生成式奖励模型对当前构思质量的评估作为监督信号，指导自适应检索并构建多样化、高质量的初始种群。在此基础上，FlowPIE将构思生成建模为测试阶段的构思演化过程，结合隔离岛范式与基于生成式奖励模型的适应度计算，实施选择、交叉和变异操作，有效融合跨领域知识。该方法显著缓解了因过度依赖参数化知识与静态文献所形成的信息茧房效应。大量实验评估表明，相较于现有基于大语言模型与智能体框架的强基线方法，FlowPIE能持续生成具有更高新颖性、可行性与多样性的构思，并能在测试阶段实现奖励信号的有效扩展。

title: Target-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Many reinforcement learning algorithms rely on target networks - lagged copies of the online network - to stabilize training. While effective, this mechanism introduces a fundamental stability-recency tradeoff: slower target updates improve stability but reduce the recency of learning signals, hindering convergence speed. We propose Target-Aligned Reinforcement Learning (TARL), a framework that emphasizes transitions for which the target and online network estimates are highly aligned. By focusing updates on well-aligned targets, TARL mitigates the adverse effects of stale target estimates while retaining the stabilizing benefits of target networks. We provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating that target alignment correction accelerates convergence, and empirically demonstrate consistent improvements over standard reinforcement learning algorithms across various benchmark environments.
tldr: A framework (TARL) for reinforcement learning that improves training stability and convergence speed by focusing updates on transitions where target and online network estimates are aligned.
tldr_zh: 一种强化学习框架（TARL），通过关注目标网络与在线网络估计一致的转移样本来改进训练稳定性与收敛速度。
summary_zh: 许多强化学习算法依赖目标网络（在线网络的滞后副本）来稳定训练过程。这一机制虽有效，却引入了稳定性与即时性的本质权衡：较慢的目标更新能提升稳定性，但会降低学习信号的即时性，从而影响收敛速度。我们提出目标对齐强化学习框架，该框架强调目标网络与在线网络估值高度对齐的过渡状态。通过聚焦于对齐良好的目标进行更新，TARL在保留目标网络稳定优势的同时，有效缓解了陈旧目标估值带来的负面影响。我们通过理论分析证明目标对齐校正能加速收敛过程，并在多个基准测试环境中通过实证研究展示了该方法相较于标准强化学习算法的持续改进效果。

title: M-MiniGPT4: Multilingual VLLM Alignment via Translated Data
summary: This paper presents a Multilingual Vision Large Language Model, named M-MiniGPT4. Our model exhibits strong vision-language understanding (VLU) capabilities across 11 languages. We utilize a mixture of native multilingual and translated data to push the multilingual VLU performance of the MiniGPT4 architecture. In addition, we propose a multilingual alignment training stage that uses parallel text corpora to further enhance the multilingual capabilities of our model. M-MiniGPT4 achieves 36% accuracy on the multilingual MMMU benchmark, outperforming state-of-the-art models in the same weight class, including foundation models released after the majority of this work was completed. We open-source our models, code, and translated datasets to facilitate future research in low-resource and multilingual settings.
tldr: This paper introduces M-MiniGPT4, a multilingual vision-language model with enhanced capabilities across 11 languages, using translated data and parallel text alignment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了M-MiniGPT4，一个多语言视觉语言模型，通过翻译数据和并行文本对齐增强了11种语言的能力。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种多语言视觉大语言模型，命名为M-MiniGPT4。该模型在11种语言中展现出强大的视觉语言理解能力。我们采用原生多语言数据与翻译数据相结合的方法，以提升MiniGPT4架构的多语言视觉语言理解性能。此外，我们提出了一种多语言对齐训练阶段，利用平行文本语料库进一步增强模型的多语言能力。在跨语言MMMU基准测试中，M-MiniGPT4取得了36%的准确率，其性能优于同参数规模下的现有先进模型，包括在本研究主体工作完成后发布的基础模型。为促进低资源与多语言环境下的未来研究，我们开源了模型、代码及翻译数据集。

title: An Isotropic Approach to Efficient Uncertainty Quantification with Gradient Norms
summary: Existing methods for quantifying predictive uncertainty in neural networks are either computationally intractable for large language models or require access to training data that is typically unavailable. We derive a lightweight alternative through two approximations: a first-order Taylor expansion that expresses uncertainty in terms of the gradient of the prediction and the parameter covariance, and an isotropy assumption on the parameter covariance. Together, these yield epistemic uncertainty as the squared gradient norm and aleatoric uncertainty as the Bernoulli variance of the point prediction, from a single forward-backward pass through an unmodified pretrained model. We justify the isotropy assumption by showing that covariance estimates built from non-training data introduce structured distortions that isotropic covariance avoids, and that theoretical results on the spectral properties of large networks support the approximation at scale. Validation against reference Markov Chain Monte Carlo estimates on synthetic problems shows strong correspondence that improves with model size. We then use the estimates to investigate when each uncertainty type carries useful signal for predicting answer correctness in question answering with large language models, revealing a benchmark-dependent divergence: the combined estimate achieves the highest mean AUROC on TruthfulQA, where questions involve genuine conflict between plausible answers, but falls to near chance on TriviaQA's factual recall, suggesting that parameter-level uncertainty captures a fundamentally different signal than self-assessment methods.
tldr: This paper presents a lightweight method for uncertainty quantification in neural networks using gradient norms and an isotropy assumption, enabling efficient epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty estimation from a single forward-backward pass without modifying pretrained models. It validates the method on synthetic data and investigates its utility for predicting answer correctness in LLMs on question-answering benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于梯度范数和各向同性假设的轻量级神经网络不确定性量化方法，可在单个前向-反向传播中高效估计认知和随机不确定性，无需修改预训练模型。方法在合成数据上得到验证，并用于探究大语言模型在问答任务中预测答案正确性的有效性。
summary_zh: 现有用于量化神经网络预测不确定性的方法，要么对大型语言模型计算复杂度过高，要么依赖于通常无法获取的训练数据。我们通过两种近似推导出一种轻量级替代方案：利用一阶泰勒展开将不确定性表示为预测梯度与参数协方差的函数，并结合参数协方差的各向同性假设。这两项共同使得仅需对未经修改的预训练模型进行单次前向-反向传播，即可将认知不确定性表达为梯度范数的平方，将偶然不确定性表达为点预测的伯努利方差。我们通过以下发现证明各向同性假设的合理性：基于非训练数据构建的协方差估计会引入结构化失真，而各向同性协方差可避免该问题；同时大型网络谱特性的理论结果支持该近似在大规模模型中的适用性。在合成问题上与马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛基准估计的对比验证表明，二者存在高度一致性，且该一致性随模型规模增大而增强。随后我们运用该估计方法，探究在大型语言模型问答任务中，何时各类不确定性能够为答案正确性预测提供有效信号。结果显示存在基准依赖性差异：在涉及合理答案间真实冲突的TruthfulQA任务中，组合估计取得了最高的平均AUROC值；而在TriviaQA事实检索任务中，其表现近乎随机。这表明参数层面的不确定性捕获了与自评估方法本质上不同的信号。

title: Adversarial Prompt Injection Attack on Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, their instruction-following behavior leaves them vulnerable to prompt injection attacks. Existing prompt injection methods predominantly rely on textual prompts or perceptible visual prompts that are observable by human users. In this work, we study imperceptible visual prompt injection against powerful closed-source MLLMs, where adversarial instructions are embedded in the visual modality. Our method adaptively embeds the malicious prompt into the input image via a bounded text overlay to provide semantic guidance. Meanwhile, the imperceptible visual perturbation is iteratively optimized to align the feature representation of the attacked image with those of the malicious visual and textual targets at both coarse- and fine-grained levels. Specifically, the visual target is instantiated as a text-rendered image and progressively refined during optimization to more faithfully represent the desired semantics and improve transferability. Extensive experiments on two multimodal understanding tasks across multiple closed-source MLLMs demonstrate the superior performance of our approach compared to existing methods.
tldr: This paper studies imperceptible visual prompt injection attacks on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), embedding malicious instructions into images to manipulate model behavior, and demonstrates its effectiveness on closed-source MLLMs.
tldr_zh: 本文研究针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的不可见视觉提示注入攻击，通过将恶意指令嵌入图像来操纵模型行为，并在多个闭源MLLMs上证明了其有效性。
summary_zh: 尽管多模态大语言模型越来越多地被部署于实际应用中，但其指令遵循行为使其易受提示注入攻击的威胁。现有的提示注入方法主要依赖于人类用户可察觉的文本提示或视觉提示。本研究针对强大的闭源多模态大语言模型，探索了不可感知的视觉提示注入方法，将对抗性指令嵌入到视觉模态中。我们的方法通过有界文本覆盖自适应地将恶意提示嵌入输入图像，以提供语义引导；同时，通过迭代优化不可感知的视觉扰动，使受攻击图像的特征表示在粗粒度和细粒度上与恶意视觉及文本目标对齐。具体而言，视觉目标被实例化为文本渲染图像，并在优化过程中逐步细化，以更忠实地呈现预期语义并提升迁移能力。在多个闭源多模态大语言模型上开展的两类多模态理解任务实验表明，相较于现有方法，本方法展现出优越的性能。

title: AGFT: Alignment-Guided Fine-Tuning for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models
summary: Pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Existing classification-guided adversarial fine-tuning methods often disrupt pre-trained cross-modal alignment, weakening visual-textual correspondence and degrading zero-shot performance. In this paper, we propose an Alignment-Guided Fine-Tuning (AGFT) framework that enhances zero-shot adversarial robustness while preserving the cross-modal semantic structure. Unlike label-based methods that rely on hard labels and fail to maintain the relative relationships between image and text, AGFT leverages the probabilistic predictions of the original model for text-guided adversarial training, which aligns adversarial visual features with textual embeddings via soft alignment distributions, improving zero-shot adversarial robustness. To address structural discrepancies introduced by fine-tuning, we introduce a distribution consistency calibration mechanism that adjusts the robust model output to match a temperature-scaled version of the pre-trained model predictions. Extensive experiments across multiple zero-shot benchmarks demonstrate that AGFT outperforms state-of-the-art methods while significantly improving zero-shot adversarial robustness.
tldr: AGFT is a fine-tuning method for vision-language models that aims to improve zero-shot adversarial robustness while preserving cross-modal alignment, using soft alignment distributions and a distribution consistency calibration mechanism.
tldr_zh: AGFT是一种针对视觉-语言模型的微调方法，旨在通过软对齐分布和分布一致性校准机制，在保持跨模态对齐的同时提升零样本对抗鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 预训练的视觉语言模型（VLMs）展现出强大的零样本泛化能力，但仍容易受到对抗性扰动的影响。现有的基于分类引导的对抗性微调方法往往会破坏预训练的跨模态对齐，削弱视觉与文本的对应关系，并降低零样本性能。本文提出了一种对齐引导的微调框架，该框架在增强零样本对抗鲁棒性的同时，保持了跨模态的语义结构。不同于依赖硬标签且难以维持图像与文本相对关系的基于标签的方法，AGFT利用原始模型的概率预测进行文本引导的对抗性训练，通过软对齐分布将对抗性视觉特征与文本嵌入对齐，从而提升零样本对抗鲁棒性。为解决微调引入的结构差异，我们引入了一种分布一致性校准机制，调整鲁棒模型的输出以匹配预训练模型预测的温度缩放版本。在多个零样本基准测试上的广泛实验表明，AGFT优于现有先进方法，同时显著提升了零样本对抗鲁棒性。

title: Hallucination-aware intermediate representation edit in large vision-language models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models have demonstrated exceptional performance in multimodal reasoning and complex scene understanding. However, these models still face significant hallucination issues, where outputs contradict visual facts. Recent research on hallucination mitigation has focused on retraining methods and Contrastive Decoding (CD) methods. While both methods perform well, retraining methods require substantial training resources, and CD methods introduce dual inference overhead. These factors hinder their practical applicability. To address the above issue, we propose a framework for dynamically detecting hallucination representations and performing hallucination-eliminating edits on these representations. With minimal additional computational cost, we achieve state-of-the-art performance on existing benchmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, highlighting its efficient and robust hallucination elimination capability and its powerful controllability over hallucinations. Code is available at https://github.com/ASGO-MM/HIRE
tldr: Proposes a method to detect and edit hallucinatory intermediate representations in Large Vision-Language Models, reducing the need for retraining and mitigating dual inference overhead.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种在大型视觉语言模型中检测和编辑幻觉中间表示的方法，减少了对重新训练的需求，并降低了双推理开销。
summary_zh: 大型视觉语言模型在多模态推理和复杂场景理解方面展现出卓越性能，然而这些模型仍面临显著的幻觉问题，即输出内容与视觉事实相矛盾。当前针对幻觉缓解的研究主要集中于重训练方法和对比解码方法。虽然两类方法均表现良好，但重训练方法需要大量训练资源，而对比解码方法则会引入双重推理开销，这些因素限制了其实际应用。为解决上述问题，我们提出一种动态检测幻觉表征并对其执行幻觉消除编辑的框架。在仅需极少量额外计算成本的前提下，该框架在现有基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。大量实验证明了我们方法的有效性，凸显了其高效稳健的幻觉消除能力以及对幻觉的强可控性。代码已发布于https://github.com/ASGO-MM/HIRE。

title: Security in LLM-as-a-Judge: A Comprehensive SoK
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge (LaaJ) is a novel paradigm in which powerful language models are used to assess the quality, safety, or correctness of generated outputs. While this paradigm has significantly improved the scalability and efficiency of evaluation processes, it also introduces novel security risks and reliability concerns that remain largely unexplored. In particular, LLM-based judges can become both targets of adversarial manipulation and instruments through which attacks are conducted, potentially compromising the trustworthiness of evaluation pipelines. In this paper, we present the first Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) focusing on the security aspects of LLM-as-a-Judge systems. We perform a comprehensive literature review across major academic databases, analyzing 863 works and selecting 45 relevant studies published between 2020 and 2026. Based on this study, we propose a taxonomy that organizes recent research according to the role played by LLM-as-a-Judge in the security landscape, distinguishing between attacks targeting LaaJ systems, attacks performed through LaaJ, defenses leveraging LaaJ for security purposes, and applications where LaaJ is used as an evaluation strategy in security-related domains. We further provide a comparative analysis of existing approaches, highlighting current limitations, emerging threats, and open research challenges. Our findings reveal significant vulnerabilities in LLM-based evaluation frameworks, as well as promising directions for improving their robustness and reliability. Finally, we outline key research opportunities that can guide the development of more secure and trustworthy LLM-as-a-Judge systems.
tldr: This paper is a Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) on the security of LLM-as-a-Judge systems, focusing on vulnerabilities, attacks, defenses, and related research challenges. It is a comprehensive survey categorizing the role of LLM-as-a-Judge in the security landscape, based on a review of 45 relevant studies.
tldr_zh: 本文是关于LLM-as-a-Judge系统安全性的知识体系化综述，重点关注其脆弱性、攻击方式、防御措施及相关研究挑战。这是一项基于对45篇相关研究的回顾，对LLM-as-a-Judge在安全领域中的角色进行分类的综合性调查。
summary_zh: LLM即评判（LLM-as-a-Judge）是一种新兴范式，它利用强大的语言模型来评估生成内容的质量、安全性或正确性。这一范式虽显著提升了评估过程的可扩展性和效率，但也引入了尚未被充分探索的新型安全风险与可靠性问题。特别地，基于LLM的评判者既可能成为对抗性操纵的目标，也可能成为实施攻击的工具，进而可能破坏评估流程的可信度。本文首次围绕LLM即评判系统的安全性问题进行了知识体系化梳理。我们通过对主流学术数据库的全面文献调研，分析了863项研究成果，并筛选出2020年至2026年间发表的45项相关研究。基于此分析，我们提出了一个分类框架，依据LLM即评判在安全领域中的作用对近期研究进行系统归纳，区分了针对LLM即评判系统的攻击、通过LLM即评判实施的攻击、利用LLM即评判进行安全防御的机制，以及将LLM即评判作为安全相关领域评估策略的应用场景。我们进一步对现有方法进行了比较分析，指出现有局限、新兴威胁及开放的研究挑战。研究发现表明，基于LLM的评估框架存在显著脆弱性，同时也为提升其鲁棒性与可靠性指出了可行方向。最后，我们勾勒出关键的研究机遇，以指导构建更安全可信的LLM即评判系统。

title: Extend3D: Town-Scale 3D Generation
summary: In this paper, we propose Extend3D, a training-free pipeline for 3D scene generation from a single image, built upon an object-centric 3D generative model. To overcome the limitations of fixed-size latent spaces in object-centric models for representing wide scenes, we extend the latent space in the $x$ and $y$ directions. Then, by dividing the extended latent space into overlapping patches, we apply the object-centric 3D generative model to each patch and couple them at each time step. Since patch-wise 3D generation with image conditioning requires strict spatial alignment between image and latent patches, we initialize the scene using a point cloud prior from a monocular depth estimator and iteratively refine occluded regions through SDEdit. We discovered that treating the incompleteness of 3D structure as noise during 3D refinement enables 3D completion via a concept, which we term under-noising. Furthermore, to address the sub-optimality of object-centric models for sub-scene generation, we optimize the extended latent during denoising, ensuring that the denoising trajectories remain consistent with the sub-scene dynamics. To this end, we introduce 3D-aware optimization objectives for improved geometric structure and texture fidelity. We demonstrate that our method yields better results than prior methods, as evidenced by human preference and quantitative experiments.
tldr: Extend3D is a training-free pipeline for generating wide-scale 3D scenes from a single image by extending the latent space of an object-centric 3D generative model, using patch-wise generation and 3D-aware optimization.
tldr_zh: Extend3D 是一种免训练的流水线，通过扩展以物体为中心的3D生成模型的潜在空间，并采用分块生成和3D感知优化，实现从单张图像生成大规模3D场景。
summary_zh: 本文提出Extend3D，一种基于物体中心三维生成模型的单图像三维场景生成免训练流程。为克服物体中心模型固定尺寸潜在空间在宽场景表示上的局限性，我们沿$x$和$y$方向扩展了潜在空间。随后，通过将扩展后的潜在空间划分为重叠区块，我们将物体中心三维生成模型应用于每个区块，并在每个时间步进行耦合。由于基于图像条件的区块化三维生成需要图像与潜在区块之间的严格空间对齐，我们使用单目深度估计器提供的点云先验初始化场景，并通过SDEdit迭代优化遮挡区域。研究发现，在三维优化过程中将三维结构的不完整性视为噪声，能够通过“欠噪化”这一概念实现三维补全。此外，为解决物体中心模型在子场景生成中的次优问题，我们在去噪过程中对扩展潜在空间进行优化，确保去噪轨迹与子场景动态保持一致。为此，我们引入三维感知优化目标以提升几何结构质量和纹理保真度。实验表明，通过人工偏好评估与定量实验验证，本方法相较于现有方法取得了更优的结果。

title: MELT: Improve Composed Image Retrieval via the Modification Frequentation-Rarity Balance Network
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) uses a reference image and a modification text as a query to retrieve a target image satisfying the requirement of ``modifying the reference image according to the text instructions''. However, existing CIR methods face two limitations: (1) frequency bias leading to ``Rare Sample Neglect'', and (2) susceptibility of similarity scores to interference from hard negative samples and noise. To address these limitations, we confront two key challenges: asymmetric rare semantic localization and robust similarity estimation under hard negative samples. To solve these challenges, we propose the Modification frEquentation-rarity baLance neTwork MELT. MELT assigns increased attention to rare modification semantics in multimodal contexts while applying diffusion-based denoising to hard negative samples with high similarity scores, enhancing multimodal fusion and matching. Extensive experiments on two CIR benchmarks validate the superior performance of MELT. Codes are available at https://github.com/luckylittlezhi/MELT.
tldr: The paper proposes a method (MELT) to improve Composed Image Retrieval by addressing frequency bias and robust similarity estimation, but it is not directly about robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过平衡修改频率-稀有度来改进组合图像检索的方法，但与机器人或具身AI无直接关联。
summary_zh: 组合图像检索（CIR）以参考图像和修改文本作为查询条件，旨在检索出满足“依据文本指令修改参考图像”要求的目标图像。然而，现有CIR方法面临两个局限：（1）频率偏差导致“罕见样本忽略”，以及（2）相似度得分易受困难负样本和噪声干扰。为应对这些局限，我们需解决两个关键挑战：非对称罕见语义定位与困难负样本下的鲁棒相似度估计。针对这些挑战，我们提出基于修改频率-稀有度平衡的网络MELT。该网络在多模态语境中增强对罕见修改语义的关注，同时对具有高相似度得分的困难负样本施加基于扩散的去噪处理，从而强化多模态融合与匹配能力。在两个CIR基准数据集上的大量实验验证了MELT的优越性能。代码已开源：https://github.com/luckylittlezhi/MELT。

title: Scaling the Long Video Understanding of Multimodal Large Language Models via Visual Memory Mechanism
summary: Long video understanding is a key challenge that plagues the advancement of \emph{Multimodal Large language Models} (MLLMs). In this paper, we study this problem from the perspective of visual memory mechanism, and proposed a novel and training-free approach, termed \emph{Flexible Memory} (\textbf{FlexMem}). In principle, FlexMem aims to mimic human behavior of video watching, \emph{i.e.}, continually watching video content and recalling the most relevant memory fragments to answer the question. In this way, FlexMem can help MLLMs achieve video understanding of infinite lengths, unlike previous methods that process all video information at once and have input upper-limit. Concretely, FlexMem first consider the visual KV caches as the memory sources, and realize the effective memory transfer and writing via a dual-pathway compression design. Afterwards, FlexMem also explores different memory reading strategies for the diverse video understanding tasks, including the popular streaming one. To validate FlexMem, we apply it to two popular video-MLLMs, and conduct extensive experiments on five long video and one streaming video task. The experimental results show that on \textbf{a single 3090 GPU}, our FlexMem can achieve obvious improvements than existing efficient video understanding methods and process more than \textbf{1k frames}, which also helps the base MLLMs achieve comparable or even better performance than SOTA MLLMs on some benchmarks, \emph{e.g.} , GPT-4o and Gemini-1.5 Pro.
tldr: The paper proposes a training-free approach called FlexMem for enabling MLLMs to process infinite-length videos by mimicking human memory mechanisms, with state-of-the-art performance on long video understanding tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的方法FlexMem，通过模仿人类记忆机制，使多模态大语言模型能够处理无限长度的视频，并在长视频理解任务上取得了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 长视频理解是困扰多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）发展的关键挑战。本文从视觉记忆机制的角度出发，研究该问题并提出了一种无需训练的新方法——柔性记忆（FlexMem）。其原理在于模拟人类观看视频的行为，即持续观看视频内容，并回忆最相关的记忆片段来回答问题。通过这种方式，FlexMem能够帮助MLLMs实现对无限长度视频的理解，与以往一次性处理所有视频信息且存在输入上限的方法不同。具体而言，FlexMem首先将视觉KV缓存视为记忆源，通过双路径压缩设计实现高效记忆传递与写入。随后，FlexMem针对不同视频理解任务（包括流行的流式视频任务）探索了多种记忆读取策略。为验证FlexMem的效果，我们将其应用于两种主流视频MLLMs，并在五个长视频任务和一个流式视频任务上进行了广泛实验。结果表明，在单张3090 GPU上，FlexMem相较现有高效视频理解方法取得显著提升，并能处理超过1k帧的视频；这还帮助基础MLLMs在部分基准测试（如GPT-4o和Gemini-1.5 Pro）中达到甚至超越了当前最优模型（SOTA）的性能水平。

title: Long-Document QA with Chain-of-Structured-Thought and Fine-Tuned SLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely applied to data analytics over documents, yet direct reasoning over long, noisy documents remains brittle and error-prone. Hence, we study document question answering (QA) that consolidates dispersed evidence into a structured output (e.g., a table, graph, or chunks) to support reliable, verifiable QA. We propose a two-pillar framework, LiteCoST, to achieve both high accuracy and low latency with small language models (SLMs). Pillar 1: Chain-of-Structured-Thought (CoST). We introduce a CoST template, a schema-aware instruction that guides a strong LLM to produce both a step-wise CoST trace and the corresponding structured output. The process induces a minimal structure, normalizes entities/units, aligns records, serializes the output, and verifies/refines it, yielding auditable supervision. Pillar 2: SLM fine-tuning. The compact models are trained on LLM-generated CoST data in two stages: Supervised Fine-Tuning for structural alignment, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) incorporating triple rewards for answer/format quality and process consistency. By distilling structure-first behavior into SLMs, this approach achieves LLM-comparable quality on multi-domain long-document QA using 3B/7B SLMs, while delivering 2-4x lower latency than GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1 (671B). The code is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/LiteCoST.
tldr: A framework for long-document question answering that uses a Chain-of-Structured-Thought prompting technique and fine-tuned small language models to generate structured, verifiable outputs like tables or graphs.
tldr_zh: 一个用于长文档问答的框架，采用结构化思维链提示技术和对小型语言模型进行微调，以生成表格或图表等可验证的结构化输出。
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已被广泛应用于文档数据分析，但直接对长且杂乱的文档进行推理仍存在脆弱性和易出错问题。为此，我们研究一种文档问答（QA）方法，将分散的证据整合为结构化输出（如表格、图表或文本块），以支持可靠、可验证的QA。我们提出一个双支柱框架LiteCoST，旨在通过小语言模型（SLM）同时实现高精度与低延迟。支柱一：结构化思维链（CoST）。我们引入一种CoST模板——一种模式感知的指令，用于引导强LLM生成逐步的CoST轨迹及相应的结构化输出。该过程通过最小化结构、规范化实体/单位、对齐记录、序列化输出，并进行验证与优化，形成可审计的监督机制。支柱二：SLM微调。紧凑模型在LLM生成的CoST数据上进行两阶段训练：首先通过监督微调实现结构对齐，随后采用结合答案/格式质量与过程一致性三重奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO）。通过将结构优先的行为蒸馏至SLM，该方法使用3B/7B的SLM在多领域长文档QA中达到与LLM相当的质量，同时实现比GPT-4o和DeepSeek-R1（671B）低2-4倍的延迟。相关代码已发布于https://github.com/HKUSTDial/LiteCoST。

title: Beyond pass@1: A Reliability Science Framework for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary:
Existing benchmarks measure capability -- whether a model succeeds on a single attempt -- but production deployments
  require reliability -- consistent success across repeated attempts on tasks of varying duration. We show these
  properties diverge systematically as task duration grows, and that pass@1 on short tasks is structurally blind to
  this divergence.
  We introduce a reliability science framework for long-horizon LLM agents with four metrics: Reliability Decay Curve
  (RDC), Variance Amplification Factor (VAF), Graceful Degradation Score (GDS), and Meltdown Onset Point (MOP). We
  evaluate 10 models across 23,392 episodes on a 396-task benchmark spanning four duration buckets and three domains.
  Key findings: (1) reliability decay is domain-stratified -- SE GDS drops from 0.90 to 0.44 while document processing
  is nearly flat (0.74 to 0.71); (2) VAF bifurcates by capability tier -- high VAF is a capability signature, not an
  instability signal; (3) capability and reliability rankings diverge substantially, with multi-rank inversions at long
  horizons; (4) frontier models have the highest meltdown rates (up to 19%) because they attempt ambitious multi-step
  strategies that sometimes spiral; and (5) memory scaffolds universally hurt long-horizon performance across all 10
  models. These results motivate reliability as a first-class evaluation dimension alongside capability.
tldr: Proposes a reliability science framework for evaluating long-horizon LLM agents, demonstrating that capability and reliability metrics diverge with task duration.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个用于评估长程LLM智能体的可靠性科学框架，证明任务能力与可靠性指标在任务时长增加时会发生背离。
summary_zh:
现有基准测试衡量的是能力——即模型能否在单次尝试中成功——但生产部署需要的是可靠性，即在不同时长的任务中反复尝试均能保持一致的稳定表现。我们发现，随着任务时长的增加，这两种特性会呈现系统性分化，而短期任务上的单次成功率（pass@1）在结构上无法捕捉这种分化。

为此，我们提出了一个面向长时程大语言模型智能体的可靠性科学框架，包含四项核心指标：可靠性衰减曲线（RDC）、方差放大因子（VAF）、性能平缓衰减评分（GDS）和失效起始点（MOP）。我们基于覆盖四个时长区间与三个领域的396项任务基准，对10个模型进行了23,392轮测试。主要发现包括：（1）可靠性衰减呈现领域分层现象——软件工程领域的GDS从0.90降至0.44，而文档处理领域几乎保持稳定（0.74至0.71）；（2）VAF根据能力层级呈现两极分化——高VAF是能力的标志，而非不稳定的信号；（3）能力排名与可靠性排名存在显著差异，在长时程任务中出现多重排序反转；（4）前沿模型因常采用激进的多步策略，其失效发生率最高（可达19%），有时甚至引发连锁崩溃；（5）记忆支架在所有10个模型中均对长时程表现产生负面影响。这些结果表明，可靠性应作为与能力同等重要的一级评估维度。

title: Derived Fields Preserve Fine-Scale Detail in Budgeted Neural Simulators
summary: Fine-scale-faithful neural simulation under fixed storage budgets remains challenging. Many existing methods reduce high-frequency error by improving architectures, training objectives, or rollout strategies. However, under budgeted coarsen-quantize-decode pipelines, fine detail can already be lost when the carried state is constructed. In the canonical periodic incompressible Navier-Stokes setting, we show that primitive and derived fields undergo systematically different retained-band distortions under the same operator. Motivated by this observation, we formulate Derived-Field Optimization (DerivOpt), a general state-design framework that chooses which physical fields are carried and how storage budget is allocated across them under a calibrated channel model. Across the full time-dependent forward subset of PDEBench, DerivOpt not only improves pooled mean rollout nRMSE, but also delivers a decisive advantage in fine-scale fidelity over a broad set of strong baselines. More importantly, the gains are already visible at input time, before rollout learning begins. This indicates that the carried state is often the dominant bottleneck under tight storage budgets. These results suggest a broader conclusion: in budgeted neural simulation, carried-state design should be treated as a first-class design axis alongside architecture, loss, and rollout strategy.
tldr: Proposes Derived-Field Optimization (DerivOpt), a state-design framework for budgeted neural PDE solvers, showing that careful selection of the physical fields to carry in compressed memory can significantly improve fine-scale fidelity in simulations.
tldr_zh: 针对有限存储预算的神经PDE求解器，提出了一种名为派生场优化（DerivOpt）的状态设计框架，证明在压缩存储中谨慎选择携带的物理场能显著提升模拟的精细尺度保真度。
summary_zh: 摘要：在固定存储预算下实现精细尺度保真的神经模拟仍面临挑战。现有方法多通过改进架构、训练目标或推演策略来降低高频误差。然而，在预算限制下的粗化-量化-解码流程中，精细细节往往在构建承载状态时便已丢失。本文以经典周期性不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程为背景，研究表明原始场与派生场在相同算子作用下会呈现系统性的带限失真差异。基于此发现，我们提出派生场优化框架——一种通用的状态设计方法，通过校准通道模型确定承载的物理场类型及各场间的存储预算分配。在PDEBench全时序前向子集上的实验表明，该框架不仅显著提升平均推演归一化均方根误差，更在精细尺度保真度上全面超越多种强基线模型。更重要的是，这些优势在推演学习开始前的输入阶段即已显现，表明承载状态设计常是严格存储预算下的主要瓶颈。这些结果揭示了更广泛的结论：在预算约束的神经模拟中，承载状态设计应与架构设计、损失函数和推演策略共同作为核心设计维度。

title: SyriSign: A Parallel Corpus for Arabic Text to Syrian Arabic Sign Language Translation
summary: Sign language is the primary approach of communication for the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) community. While there are numerous benchmarks for high-resource sign languages, low-resource languages like Arabic remain underrepresented. Currently, there is no publicly available dataset for Syrian Arabic Sign Language (SyArSL). To overcome this gap, we introduce SyriSign, a dataset comprising 1500 video samples across 150 unique lexical signs, designed for text-to-SyArSL translation tasks. This work aims to reduce communication barriers in Syria, as most news are delivered in spoken or written Arabic, which is often inaccessible to the deaf community. We evaluated SyriSign using three deep learning architectures: MotionCLIP for semantic motion generation, T2M-GPT for text-conditioned motion synthesis, and SignCLIP for bilingual embedding alignment. Experimental results indicate that while generative approaches show strong potential for sign representation, the limited dataset size constrains generalization performance. We will release SyriSign publicly, hoping it serves as an initial benchmark.
tldr: Introduces SyriSign, a dataset of 1500 video samples for Syrian Arabic Sign Language translation, evaluating generative models for sign generation.
tldr_zh: 介绍SyriSign数据集，包含1500个叙利亚阿拉伯手语翻译视频样本，评估了生成模型在手语生成中的表现。
summary_zh: 手语是聋人及听力障碍群体沟通的主要方式。尽管已有大量针对高资源手语的数据集，但如阿拉伯语手语等低资源语言仍缺乏充分研究。目前，叙利亚阿拉伯语手语尚未有公开可用的数据集。为填补这一空白，我们推出了SyriSign数据集，该数据集包含150个独立词汇手势的1500个视频样本，专为文本到叙利亚手语的翻译任务设计。本研究旨在降低叙利亚的沟通障碍，因为当地新闻多以口语或书面阿拉伯语传播，聋人群体往往难以获取信息。我们通过三种深度学习架构对SyriSign进行评估：用于语义动作生成的MotionCLIP、用于文本条件动作合成的T2M-GPT以及用于双语嵌入对齐的SignCLIP。实验结果表明，尽管生成式方法在手语表征方面展现出潜力，但有限的数据集规模限制了模型的泛化性能。我们将公开SyriSign数据集，期待其能成为该领域研究的初步基准。

title: Xuanwu: Evolving General Multimodal Models into an Industrial-Grade Foundation for Content Ecosystems
summary: In recent years, multimodal large models have continued to improve on general benchmarks. However, in real-world content moderation and adversarial settings, mainstream models still suffer from degraded generalization and catastrophic forgetting because of limited fine-grained visual perception and insufficient modeling of long-tail noise. In this paper, we present Xuanwu VL-2B as a case study of how general multimodal models can be developed into an industrial-grade foundation model for content ecosystems. The model adopts a compact InternViT-300M + MLP + Qwen3 1.7B architecture, balancing fine-grained visual perception, language-semantic alignment, and deployment cost within an approximately 2B-parameter budget. To balance business specialization with the retention of general capabilities, we developed a data iteration and curation mechanism and trained the model through a progressive three-stage pipeline: pre-training, mid-training, and post-training. Ablation studies and offline business evaluations show that Xuanwu VL-2B achieves an average score of 67.90 across seven OpenCompass multimodal metrics (vs. 64.27 for InternVL 3.5 2B), an average recall of 94.38% over seven independent business moderation tasks, and a weighted overall recall of 82.82% on policy-violating text in challenging adversarial OCR scenarios, outperforming Gemini-2.5-Pro (76.72%). These results show that, under a limited parameter budget, Xuanwu VL-2B achieves a practical balance among business alignment, visual perception, general capability retention, and deployment cost.
