summary_zh: 基于提示的人工智能图像编辑技术的快速普及，近期加剧了恶意内容伪造与虚假信息传播的风险。然而，针对此类新兴编辑技术的篡改定位方法仍处于探索不足的状态。为填补这一空白，我们首先提出了一种全自动掩码标注框架，该框架通过关键点对齐与语义空间相似性计算，为编辑区域生成精确的真实掩码标注。基于此框架，我们构建了PromptForge-350k大规模篡改定位数据集，涵盖四种前沿的基于提示的AI图像编辑模型，从而缓解了该领域数据稀缺的问题。进一步，我们提出ICL-Net——一种具有三重流骨干网络与图像内对比学习机制的有效篡改定位网络。该设计使模型能够捕获高度鲁棒且可泛化的取证特征。大量实验表明，我们的方法在PromptForge-350k数据集上达到了62.5%的交并比（IoU），优于现有最佳方法5.1%。此外，该方法对常见图像退化具有强鲁棒性（IoU下降小于1%），并在未见过的编辑模型上展现出良好的泛化能力，平均IoU达到41.5%。

title: AI-Generated Prior Authorization Letters: Strong Clinical Content, Weak Administrative Scaffolding
summary: Prior authorization remains one of the most burdensome administrative processes in U.S. healthcare, consuming billions of dollars and thousands of physician hours each year. While large language models have shown promise across clinical text tasks, their ability to produce submission-ready prior authorization letters has received only limited attention, with existing work confined to single-case demonstrations rather than structured multi-scenario evaluation. We assessed three commercially available LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Gemini 2.5 Pro) across 45 physician-validated synthetic scenarios spanning rheumatology, psychiatry, oncology, cardiology, and orthopedics. All three models generated letters with strong clinical content: accurate diagnoses, well-structured medical necessity arguments, and thorough step therapy documentation. However, a secondary analysis of real-world administrative requirements revealed consistent gaps that clinical scoring alone did not capture, including absent billing codes, missing authorization duration requests, and inadequate follow-up plans. These findings reframe the question: the challenge for clinical deployment is not whether LLMs can write clinically adequate letters, but whether the systems built around them can supply the administrative precision that payer workflows require.
tldr: Paper evaluates LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini) for generating prior authorization letters in healthcare, finding strong clinical content but weak administrative scaffolding.
tldr_zh: 论文评估了大型语言模型在生成医疗预先授权信中的表现，发现其临床内容强，但行政管理框架薄弱。
summary_zh: 预先授权仍是美国医疗体系中最繁琐的行政流程之一，每年耗费数十亿美元及数千小时的医生工作时长。尽管大型语言模型在临床文本任务中展现出潜力，但其生成可直接提交的预先授权函能力尚未得到充分关注——现有研究仅局限于单案例演示，缺乏结构化多场景评估。本研究选取风湿病学、精神医学、肿瘤学、心脏病学和骨科领域的45个经医生验证的合成场景，对三种商用大型语言模型（GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5和Gemini 2.5 Pro）进行评估。所有模型均能生成具有扎实临床内容的信函：包含准确诊断、结构严谨的医疗必要性论证，以及完整的阶段治疗记录。然而，对真实行政要求的二次分析揭示出临床评分体系未能捕捉的共性问题，包括缺失计费代码、未注明授权期限申请、随访计划不完善等。这些发现重新定义了问题的核心：临床部署的挑战并非大型语言模型能否撰写临床达标的信函，而在于其支撑系统能否提供支付方工作流程所要求的行政精确性。

title: BenchScope: How Many Independent Signals Does Your Benchmark Provide?
summary: AI evaluation suites often report many scores without checking whether those scores carry independent information. We introduce Effective Dimensionality (ED), the participation ratio of a centered benchmark-score spectrum, as a fast, population-conditional upper-bound diagnostic of measurement breadth. Applied at per-instance granularity to 22 benchmarks across 8 domains and more than 8,400 model evaluations, ED reveals substantial redundancy: the six-score Open LLM Leaderboard behaves like roughly two effective measurement axes (ED = 1.7), BBH and MMLU-Pro are near-interchangeable (rho = 0.96, stable across seven subpopulations), and measurement breadth varies more than 20x across current benchmarks. We show that relative ED rankings are stable under matched-dimension controls and that ED can flag redundant suite components, monitor performance-conditional compression, and guide benchmark maintenance. Because binary spectra overestimate absolute latent dimensionality, we interpret ED as a screening statistic rather than a literal factor count and complement it with null, reliability, and saturation analyses. We provide a 22-benchmark reference atlas and a four-step diagnostic workflow that benchmark maintainers can run with a score matrix and a few lines of code.
tldr: This paper introduces a diagnostic metric called Effective Dimensionality to measure how much independent information AI benchmarks provide, finding widespread redundancy in popular evaluation suites.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为有效维度的诊断指标，用于衡量AI基准测试提供多少独立信息，发现流行评估套件中存在广泛冗余。
summary_zh: 人工智能评估套件通常报告大量分数，却未检验这些分数是否承载独立信息。我们引入有效维度（ED）——即中心化基准测试分数谱的参与比，作为一种快速、群体条件性的测量广度上限诊断工具。通过将ED应用于8个领域、22个基准测试中超过8,400次模型评估的实例级粒度数据，我们发现存在显著冗余：六项分数的Open LLM领导榜实际仅表现出约两个有效测量轴（ED=1.7），BBH与MMLU-Pro基准近乎可互换（相关系数ρ=0.96，在七个子群体中保持稳定），且当前各基准测试的测量广度差异超过20倍。研究表明，在维度匹配的控制条件下，相对ED排名具有稳定性；ED能识别套件中的冗余成分，监测性能条件压缩，并指导基准维护。由于二值化谱会高估绝对潜在维度，我们将ED解释为筛选统计量而非精确因子数量，并通过零值分析、可靠性分析和饱和度分析加以补充。我们提供了涵盖22个基准测试的参考图谱，以及四步诊断工作流程，基准维护者仅需借助分数矩阵和少量代码即可运行。

title: CIPHER: Counterfeit Image Pattern High-level Examination via Representation
summary: The rapid progress of generative adversarial networks (GANs) and diffusion models has enabled the creation of synthetic faces that are increasingly difficult to distinguish from real images. This progress, however, has also amplified the risks of misinformation, fraud, and identity abuse, underscoring the urgent need for detectors that remain robust across diverse generative models. In this work, we introduce Counterfeit Image Pattern High-level Examination via Representation(CIPHER), a deepfake detection framework that systematically reuses and fine-tunes discriminators originally trained for image generation. By extracting scale-adaptive features from ProGAN discriminators and temporal-consistency features from diffusion models, CIPHER captures generation-agnostic artifacts that conventional detectors often overlook. Through extensive experiments across nine state-of-the-art generative models, CIPHER demonstrates superior cross-model detection performance, achieving up to 74.33% F1-score and outperforming existing ViT-based detectors by over 30% in F1-score on average. Notably, our approach maintains robust performance on challenging datasets where baseline methods fail, with up to 88% F1-score on CIFAKE compared to near-zero performance from conventional detectors. These results validate the effectiveness of discriminator reuse and cross-model fine-tuning, establishing CIPHER as a promising approach toward building more generalizable and robust deepfake detection systems in an era of rapidly evolving generative technologies.
tldr: CIPHER is a deepfake detection framework that reuses and fine-tunes discriminators from image generation models to capture cross-model artifacts, demonstrating superior performance across nine generative models.
tldr_zh: CIPHER是一个深度伪造检测框架，通过重用和微调图像生成模型的判别器来捕获跨模型伪影，在九种生成模型上表现出卓越的性能。
summary_zh: 生成对抗网络（GANs）与扩散模型的快速发展，使得合成人脸图像与真实图像的区分难度日益增加。然而，这一进步也加剧了虚假信息传播、欺诈与身份盗用等风险，凸显了开发能够跨多种生成模型保持鲁棒性的检测器的紧迫性。本文提出“通过表征进行伪造图像模式高级检测”（CIPHER）这一深度伪造检测框架，该系统性地重用并微调原本为图像生成任务训练的判别器。通过从ProGAN判别器中提取尺度自适应特征，并从扩散模型中提取时序一致性特征，CIPHER能够捕捉传统检测器常忽略的、与生成模型无关的生成痕迹。在九种前沿生成模型上的广泛实验表明，CIPHER在跨模型检测性能上表现卓越，F1分数最高可达74.33%，平均F1分数较现有基于ViT的检测器提升超过30%。值得注意的是，在基线方法失效的挑战性数据集上，本方法仍保持鲁棒性能，例如在CIFAKE数据集上达到88%的F1分数，而传统检测器性能接近为零。这些结果验证了判别器重用与跨模型微调策略的有效性，确立了CIPHER作为一种在生成技术快速演进时代构建更具泛化性与鲁棒性的深度伪造检测系统的可行路径。

title: Nomad: Autonomous Exploration and Discovery
summary: We introduce Nomad, a system for autonomous data exploration and insight discovery. Given a corpus of documents, databases, or other data sources, users rarely know the full set of questions, hypotheses, or connections that could be explored. As a result, query-driven question answering and prompt-driven deep-research systems remain limited by human framing and often fail to cover the broader insight space. Nomad addresses this problem with an exploration-first architecture. It constructs an explicit Exploration Map over the domain and systematically traverses it to balance breadth and depth. It generates and selects hypotheses and investigates them with an explorer agent that can use document search, web search, and database tools. Candidate insights are then checked by an independent verifier before entering a reporting pipeline that produces cited reports and higher-level meta-reports. We also present a comprehensive evaluation framework for autonomous discovery systems that measures trustworthiness, report quality, and diversity. Using a corpus of selected UN and WHO reports, we show that Nomad produces more trustworthy and higher-quality reports than baselines, while also producing more diverse insights over several runs. Nomad is a step toward autonomous systems that not only answer user questions or conduct directed research, but also discover which questions, research directions, and insights are worth surfacing in the first place.
tldr: Nomad is an autonomous system for data exploration and insight discovery that builds and traverses an explicit Exploration Map, using an explorer agent to generate and verify hypotheses, and produces cited reports.
tldr_zh: Nomad是一种用于数据探索和洞察发现的自洽系统，它构建并遍历一个显式的探索地图，使用探索者代理来生成和验证假设，并生成带引用的报告。
summary_zh: 我们介绍了Nomad系统，一种用于自主数据探索与洞察发现的技术。面对文档集、数据库或其他数据源，用户往往难以预知所有可探索的问题、假设或关联。因此，基于查询的问答系统和提示驱动的深度研究系统仍受限于人类预设的框架，难以覆盖更广阔的洞察空间。Nomad通过探索优先的架构解决这一问题：它在领域内构建显式的“探索地图”，并系统性地遍历以平衡广度与深度，进而生成并筛选假设，由探索智能体借助文档搜索、网络搜索及数据库工具进行验证。候选洞察需通过独立验证器核查，再进入报告生成流程，产出带引用的报告及更高层级的元报告。我们还提出了一套全面的自主发现系统评估框架，用于衡量可信度、报告质量与多样性。基于精选的联合国及世界卫生组织报告数据集，实验表明Nomad生成的报告相比基线方法具有更高的可信度与质量，并在多次运行中产生更多样化的洞察。Nomad推动了自主系统的发展方向——不仅能够回应用户提问或执行定向研究，更能主动发现值得深入探讨的问题、研究方向与核心洞察。

title: Beyond Corner Patches: Semantics-Aware Backdoor Attack in Federated Learning
summary: Backdoor attacks on federated learning (FL) are most often evaluated with synthetic corner patches or out-of-distribution (OOD) patterns that are unlikely to arise in practice. In this paper, we revisit the backdoor threat to standard FL (a single global model) under a more realistic setting where triggers must be semantically meaningful, in-distribution, and visually plausible. We propose SABLE, a Semantics-Aware Backdoor for LEarning in federated settings, which constructs natural, content-consistent triggers (e.g., semantic attribute changes such as sunglasses) and optimizes an aggregation-aware malicious objective with feature separation and parameter regularization to keep attacker updates close to benign ones. We instantiate SABLE on CelebA hair-color classification and the German Traffic Sign Recognition Benchmark (GTSRB), poisoning only a small, interpretable subset of each malicious client's local data while otherwise following the standard FL protocol. Across heterogeneous client partitions and multiple aggregation rules (FedAvg, Trimmed Mean, MultiKrum, and FLAME), our semantics-driven triggers achieve high targeted attack success rates while preserving benign test accuracy. These results show that semantics-aligned backdoors remain a potent and practical threat in federated learning, and that robustness claims based solely on synthetic patch triggers can be overly optimistic.
tldr: This paper introduces SABLE, a semantics-aware backdoor attack method for federated learning, using natural, content-consistent triggers like semantic attributes to achieve high attack success while maintaining benign accuracy, demonstrating that realistic backdoors are a potent threat.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于联邦学习的语义感知后门攻击方法SABLE，该方法使用自然的、内容一致的触发器（如语义属性变化），在保持良性任务准确性的同时实现高攻击成功率，证明了现实的后门威胁非常强大。
summary_zh: 联邦学习中的后门攻击评估多采用合成角点补丁或实际中难以出现的分布外模式。本文基于更贴近实际的触发条件（需具备语义意义、分布内属性及视觉合理性），重新审视标准联邦学习（单一全局模型）面临的后门威胁。我们提出SABLE（联邦场景下语义感知后门攻击框架），通过构建自然且内容一致的触发器（如语义属性修改：添加墨镜），并采用特征分离与参数正则化策略优化聚合感知的恶意目标，使攻击者更新与良性更新保持接近。我们在CelebA发色分类任务和德国交通标志识别基准数据集上实现SABLE，仅对每个恶意客户端本地数据中少量可解释子集进行投毒，其余流程遵循标准联邦学习协议。在不同异构客户端分区及多种聚合规则（FedAvg、修剪均值、MultiKrum和FLAME）下，我们提出的语义驱动触发器在保持良性测试准确率的同时，实现了高目标攻击成功率。这些结果表明，语义对齐的后门攻击在联邦学习中仍是强效且现实的威胁，而仅基于合成补丁触发器的鲁棒性声明可能过于乐观。

title: Self-Improving Code Generation via Semantic Entropy and Behavioral Consensus
summary: Improving the code generation capabilities of large language models (LLMs) typically relies on supervised fine-tuning or preference optimization, both of which require costly external resources such as powerful teacher models or reliable test units. However, in real-world scenarios, it is much harder to obtain reference solutions and test oracles than problem descriptions and test inputs. In this paper, we tackle a challenging yet realistic question: Can a code language model improve itself without access to a superior teacher and a test oracle? To answer this, we propose ConSelf, a self-improving approach built upon two key ideas. First, we introduce code semantic entropy, a novel metric that measures problem-level uncertainty by assessing the functional diversity of program behaviors, enabling a curriculum construction with the most learnable problems. Second, we present consensus-driven direct preference optimization (Con-DPO), a preference-based fine-tuning method that weights each preference pair by its behavioral consensus, thereby mitigating the impact of noisy self-generated supervision. Experiments on various benchmarks and backbone LLMs demonstrate that ConSelf significantly outperforms baselines, validating the effectiveness of semantic entropy-based curriculum construction and consensus-driven optimization in improving code generation without external supervision.
tldr: This paper introduces ConSelf, a self-improvement method for code-generating LLMs that uses semantic entropy for curriculum construction and consensus-driven DPO to leverage noisy self-generated data, all without external supervision.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ConSelf，一种用于代码生成大语言模型的自我改进方法。该方法通过语义熵进行课程构建，并利用基于共识的DPO来利用有噪声的自生成数据，整个过程无需外部监督。
summary_zh: 摘要：提升大型语言模型（LLM）的代码生成能力通常依赖于监督微调或偏好优化，这两种方法均需耗费外部资源，如强大的教师模型或可靠的测试单元。然而，在实际场景中，获取参考解决方案和测试预言器比获取问题描述和测试输入要困难得多。本文探讨了一个具有挑战性但贴近现实的问题：在无法访问优秀教师模型和测试预言器的情况下，代码语言模型能否实现自我提升？为此，我们提出ConSelf方法，该自我改进方法基于两个核心思想。首先，我们引入代码语义熵这一新指标，它通过评估程序行为的功能多样性来度量问题层面的不确定性，从而构建具有最佳学习潜力问题的课程体系。其次，我们提出基于共识的直接偏好优化方法，该方法通过行为共识对每个偏好对进行加权，从而减少自生成监督信号中的噪声影响。在不同基准测试和骨干LLM上的实验表明，ConSelf显著优于基线方法，验证了基于语义熵的课程构建和共识驱动优化在无外部监督条件下提升代码生成能力的有效性。

title: Grokking From Abstraction to Intelligence
summary: Grokking in modular arithmetic has established itself as the quintessential fruit fly experiment, serving as a critical domain for investigating the mechanistic origins of model generalization. Despite its significance, existing research remains narrowly focused on specific local circuits or optimization tuning, largely overlooking the global structural evolution that fundamentally drives this phenomenon. We propose that grokking originates from a spontaneous simplification of internal model structures governed by the principle of parsimony. We integrate causal, spectral, and algorithmic complexity measures alongside Singular Learning Theory to reveal that the transition from memorization to generalization corresponds to the physical collapse of redundant manifolds and deep information compression, offering a novel perspective for understanding the mechanisms of model overfitting and generalization.
tldr: This paper proposes a theoretical framework for understanding grokking (a generalization phenomenon) in neural networks, focusing on structural simplification and information compression rather than robotic applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个理解神经网络中涌现现象（grokking）的理论框架，专注于结构简化和信息压缩，与机器人应用无关。
summary_zh: 模运算中的顿悟现象已成为机器学习领域的典型实验范式，为探究模型泛化的机制起源提供了关键研究场域。尽管其重要性已获公认，现有研究仍局限于特定局部电路或优化调参的窄化视角，普遍忽视了驱动该现象的根本动因——全局结构演化。我们认为顿悟源于模型内部结构在简约性原则支配下的自发简化过程。通过整合因果分析、谱分析及算法复杂度测量方法，结合奇异学习理论，我们发现从记忆到泛化的转变实质上对应着冗余流形的物理坍缩与深层信息压缩过程，这为理解模型过拟合与泛化机制提供了全新视角。

title: Omni-NegCLIP: Enhancing CLIP with Front-Layer Contrastive Fine-Tuning for Comprehensive Negation Understanding
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, recent studies have shown that VLMs, such as CLIP, perform poorly in understanding negation expressions, which are common in natural language. In this work, we propose Omni-NegCLIP, a fine-tuned CLIP model that improves CLIP's understanding of two types of negation, namely presence-based negation and absence-based negation, which correspond to negated expressions of objects that are actually present in an image and those that may plausibly exist in an image but are in fact absent, respectively, by modifying CLIP's original InfoNCE contrastive loss. Specifically, we design a presence-based contrastive objective that pulls image embeddings closer to their original caption embeddings while pushing them away from the corresponding presence-based negated caption embeddings, and an absence-based contrastive objective that aligns image embeddings with both original and absence-based negated caption embeddings while maintaining a semantic distinction between the two text embeddings. Based on our observation that the front transformer layers of CLIP text encoder have stronger learning ability for negated text than the later layers, we fine-tune the front transformer layers of the CLIP text encoder at each training step using the combined contrastive objective. Experimental results show that, compared with pretrained CLIP, Omni-NegCLIP improves performance on presence-based negation and absence-based negation tasks by up to 52.65% and 12.50%, respectively, without sacrificing general capability in image-text retrieval and even improving it by up to 19.62%. Compared with prior works, Omni-NegCLIP demonstrates a more comprehensive ability to understand multiple types of negation tasks.
tldr: Omni-NegCLIP enhances CLIP's understanding of negation in language, such as 'no cat' or 'cat not present,' via a novel contrastive fine-tuning method applied to the front layers of the text encoder, improving performance on negation tasks without harming general image-text retrieval.
tldr_zh: Omni-NegCLIP通过一种新颖的对比微调方法，专门针对CLIP文本编码器的前端层进行训练，以提升模型对语言中否定表达（如“没有猫”）的理解能力，在不损害通用图文检索性能的同时，显著提高了否定理解任务的准确率。
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型在多模态任务中展现出强大的能力。然而，近期研究表明，CLIP等模型在理解自然语言中常见的否定表达时表现不佳。本研究提出Omni-NegCLIP，一种通过改进CLIP原始InfoNCE对比损失而微调的模型，旨在提升对两类否定表达的理解能力：基于存在的否定（指图像中实际存在但被否定的对象）与基于缺失的否定（指图像中可能合理存在但实际缺失的对象）。具体而言，我们设计了基于存在的对比目标——使图像嵌入更接近原始描述嵌入，同时远离对应的基于存在否定描述嵌入；以及基于缺失的对比目标——使图像嵌入同时对齐原始描述与基于缺失否定描述嵌入，并保持两种文本嵌入间的语义区分。基于对CLIP文本编码器前部Transformer层比后层具有更强否定文本学习能力的观察，我们在每个训练步骤中结合对比目标微调文本编码器的前部Transformer层。实验结果表明：与预训练CLIP相比，Omni-NegCLIP在基于存在否定任务和基于缺失否定任务上的性能分别提升高达52.65%和12.50%，且未牺牲图文检索的通用能力，甚至将其提升达19.62%。与已有研究相比，Omni-NegCLIP展现出更全面的多类型否定任务理解能力。

title: GenoBERT: A Language Model for Accurate Genotype Imputation
summary: Genotype imputation enables dense variant coverage for genome-wide association and risk-prediction studies, yet conventional reference-panel methods remain limited by ancestry bias and reduced rare-variant accuracy. We present Genotype Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (GenoBERT), a transformer-based, reference-free framework that tokenizes phased genotypes and uses a self-attention mechanism to capture both short- and long-range linkage disequilibrium (LD) dependencies. Benchmarking on two independent datasets including the Louisiana Osteoporosis Study (LOS) and the 1000 Genomes Project (1KGP) across ancestry groups and multiple genotype missingness levels (5-50%) shows that GenoBERT achieves the highest overall accuracy compared to four baseline methods (Beagle5.4, SCDA, BiU-Net, and STICI). At practical sparsity levels (up to 25% missing), GenoBERT attains high overall imputation accuracy ($r^2 approx 0.98$) across datasets, and maintains robust performance ($r^2 > 0.90$) even at 50% missingness. Experimental results across different ancestries confirm consistent gains across datasets, with resilience to small sample sizes and weak LD. A 128-SNP (single-nucleotide polymorphism) context window (approximately 100 Kb) is validated through LD-decay analyses as sufficient to capture local correlation structures. By eliminating reference-panel dependence while preserving high accuracy, GenoBERT provides a scalable and robust solution for genotype imputation and a foundation for downstream genomic modeling.
tldr: GenoBERT is a transformer-based, reference-free method for genotype imputation that uses self-attention to model linkage disequilibrium, achieving high accuracy across ancestry groups and sparsity levels.
tldr_zh: GenoBERT是一种基于Transformer的、无需参考面板的基因型填充方法，它利用自注意力机制建模连锁不平衡，在不同祖先群体和稀疏度水平下均能实现高精度。
summary_zh: 基因型填充技术为全基因组关联分析和风险预测研究提供了高密度变异位点覆盖，但传统参考面板方法仍受限于祖先群体偏差和罕见变异准确度不足的问题。我们提出GenoBERT（基于Transformer的基因型双向编码器表征模型），这是一种无需参考面板的Transformer架构框架，通过对分型基因型进行标记化处理，利用自注意力机制捕捉短程与长程连锁不平衡依赖关系。在路易斯安那骨质疏松研究（LOS）和千人基因组计划（1KGP）两个独立数据集上，跨祖先群体和多种基因型缺失率（5-50%）的基准测试表明，相比四种基线方法（Beagle5.4、SCDA、BiU-Net和STICI），GenoBERT实现了最高的综合准确度。在实际缺失率水平（≤25%）下，GenoBERT在跨数据集中获得高总体填充精度（$r^2 approx 0.98$），即使在50%缺失率下仍保持稳健性能（$r^2 > 0.90$）。跨祖先群体的实验结果证实了模型在不同数据集中的一致性提升，且对小样本量和弱连锁不平衡具有强适应性。通过连锁不平衡衰减分析验证，128个单核苷酸多态性（约100 Kb）的上下文窗口足以捕捉局部相关结构。GenoBERT在消除参考面板依赖性的同时保持高精度，为基因型填充提供了可扩展的稳健解决方案，并为下游基因组建模奠定了基础。

title: Software Vulnerability Detection Using a Lightweight Graph Neural Network
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a popular choice in vulnerability detection studies given their foundational capabilities, open source availability, and variety of models, but have limited scalability due to extensive compute requirements. Using the natural graph relational structure of code, we show that our proposed graph neural network (GNN) based deep learning model VulGNN for vulnerability detection can achieve performance almost on par with LLMs, but is 100 times smaller in size and fast to retrain and customize. We describe the VulGNN architecture, ablation studies on components, learning rates, and generalizability to different code datasets. As a lightweight model for vulnerability analysis, VulGNN is efficient and deployable at the edge as part of real-world software development pipelines.
tldr: This paper proposes a lightweight graph neural network, VulGNN, for software vulnerability detection, which is claimed to achieve performance comparable to LLMs while being significantly smaller and more efficient.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于软件漏洞检测的轻量级图神经网络 VulGNN，据称其性能可与大型语言模型相媲美，同时体积更小、效率更高。
summary_zh: 鉴于大语言模型在基础能力、开源可用性和模型多样性方面的优势，其已成为漏洞检测研究中的热门选择，但因其庞大的计算需求而在可扩展性上受限。利用代码固有的图关系结构，我们提出的基于图神经网络（GNN）的漏洞检测深度学习模型VulGNN，在性能上几乎可与大语言模型媲美，且模型体积缩小100倍，重训练和定制过程快速高效。本文详细阐述了VulGNN的架构，对各组件、学习率以及在不同代码数据集上的泛化能力进行了消融实验研究。作为一种轻量级的漏洞分析模型，VulGNN高效且可部署于边缘环境，能够集成到现实软件开发流程中。

title: Route-Induced Density and Stability (RIDE): Controlled Intervention and Mechanism Analysis of Routing-Style Meta Prompts on LLM Internal States
summary: Routing is widely used to scale large language models, from Mixture-of-Experts gating to multi-model/tool selection. A common belief is that routing to a task ``expert'' activates sparser internal computation and thus yields more certain and stable outputs (the Sparsity--Certainty Hypothesis). We test this belief by injecting routing-style meta prompts as a textual proxy for routing signals in front of frozen instruction-tuned LLMs. We quantify (C1) internal density via activation sparsity, (C2) domain-keyword attention, and (C3) output stability via predictive entropy and semantic variation. On a RouterEval subset with three instruction-tuned models (Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2), meta prompts consistently densify early/middle-layer representations rather than increasing sparsity; natural-language expert instructions are often stronger than structured tags. Attention responses are heterogeneous: Qwen/Llama reduce keyword attention, while Mistral reinforces it. Finally, the densification--stability link is weak and appears only in Qwen, with near-zero correlations in Llama and Mistral. We present RIDE as a diagnostic probe for calibrating routing design and uncertainty estimation.
tldr: This paper investigates how routing-style meta prompts affect the internal states (density, attention, stability) of frozen LLMs, finding that they often increase activation density rather than sparsity, and that the relationship between density and output stability is weak.
tldr_zh: 本文研究路由式元提示如何影响冻结大语言模型的内部状态（密度、注意力、稳定性），发现其常增加激活密度而非稀疏性，且密度与输出稳定性之间的关联较弱。
summary_zh: 路由技术被广泛用于扩展大语言模型的规模，涵盖从混合专家门控机制到多模型/工具选择等场景。一种普遍观点认为，路由到任务"专家"会激活更稀疏的内部计算，从而产生更确定和稳定的输出（稀疏性-确定性假设）。我们通过向冻结的指令调优大语言模型前注入路由式元提示作为文本代理信号来验证这一观点。我们通过以下三个维度进行量化分析：(C1) 通过激活稀疏性衡量内部密度，(C2) 通过领域关键词注意力机制，(C3) 通过预测熵和语义变化评估输出稳定性。在RouterEval子集上对三个指令调优模型（Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2）的测试表明，元提示会持续增强早期/中间层表示的稠密性而非提升稀疏性；自然语言专家指令通常比结构化标签更有效。注意力响应呈现异质性：Qwen/Llama模型降低关键词注意力，而Mistral模型则强化该机制。最后，稠密化与稳定性的关联性较弱，仅在Qwen模型中显现，Llama和Mistral模型中的相关性接近为零。我们提出RIDE作为诊断探针，用于校准路由设计和不确定性估计。

title: 3D Architect: An Automated Approach to Three-Dimensional Modeling
summary: The aim of our paper is to render an object in 3-dimension using a set of its orthographic views. Corner detector (Harris Detector) is applied on the input views to obtain control points. These control points are projected perpendicular to respective views, in order to construct an envelope. A set of points describing the object in 3-dimension, are obtained from the intersection of these mutually perpendicular envelopes. These set of points are used to regenerate the surfaces of the object using computational geometry. At the end, the object in 3-dimension is rendered using OpenGL
tldr: This paper presents an automated method for reconstructing 3D models from 2D orthographic views using Harris corner detection and computational geometry, with final rendering via OpenGL.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种自动化方法，利用Harris角点检测和计算几何，从二维正交视图重建三维模型，并通过OpenGL进行最终渲染。
summary_zh: 本文旨在通过一组正交视图实现物体的三维重建。该方法首先对输入视图应用角点检测器（Harris检测器）以获取控制点，随后将这些控制点沿各自视图的垂直方向投影以构建包络面。通过计算这些相互垂直的包络面之间的交集，获得描述物体三维形态的点集，并基于计算几何方法利用这些点集重建物体表面。最终，借助OpenGL完成三维物体的渲染呈现。

title: SLVMEval: Synthetic Meta Evaluation Benchmark for Text-to-Long Video Generation
summary: This paper proposes the synthetic long-video meta-evaluation (SLVMEval), a benchmark for meta-evaluating text-to-video (T2V) evaluation systems. The proposed SLVMEval benchmark focuses on assessing these systems on videos of up to 10,486 s (approximately 3 h). The benchmark targets a fundamental requirement, namely, whether the systems can accurately assess video quality in settings that are easy for humans to assess. We adopt a pairwise comparison-based meta-evaluation framework. Building on dense video-captioning datasets, we synthetically degrade source videos to create controlled "high-quality versus low-quality" pairs across 10 distinct aspects. Then, we employ crowdsourcing to filter and retain only those pairs in which the degradation is clearly perceptible, thereby establishing an effective final testbed. Using this testbed, we assess the reliability of existing evaluation systems in ranking these pairs. Experimental results demonstrate that human evaluators can identify the better long video with 84.7%-96.8% accuracy, and in nine of the 10 aspects, the accuracy of these systems falls short of human assessment, revealing weaknesses in text-to-long-video evaluation.
tldr: This paper introduces SLVMEval, a synthetic benchmark for evaluating text-to-long-video generation systems by meta-assessing their ability to rank video quality across 10 degradation aspects, where most systems fall short of human performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SLVMEval，一个用于评估文本到长视频生成系统的合成基准，通过元评估系统在10个质量退化方面对视频排序的能力，结果显示大多数系统性能不及人类评估者。
summary_zh: 本文提出了合成长视频元评估(SLVMEval)基准，用于对文本到视频(T2V)评估系统进行元评估。该基准聚焦于评估系统在长达10,486秒（约3小时）视频上的表现，其核心目标是检验这些系统能否在人类易于判断的场景中准确评估视频质量。我们采用基于成对比较的元评估框架：基于密集视频描述数据集，通过合成降质方法在10个不同维度上创建受控的“高质量-低质量”视频对，随后通过众包筛选仅保留降质效果明显可感知的视频对，从而构建有效的最终测试集。利用该测试集，我们评估了现有评估系统在排序这些视频对时的可靠性。实验结果表明，人类评估者识别优质长视频的准确率达到84.7%-96.8%，而在10个维度中有9个维度上，现有系统的准确率均低于人类评估水平，这揭示了当前文本到长视频评估系统存在的缺陷。

title: Predicting Neuromodulation Outcome for Parkinson's Disease with Generative Virtual Brain Model
summary: Parkinson's disease (PD) affects over ten million people worldwide. Although temporal interference (TI) and deep brain stimulation (DBS) are promising therapies, inter-individual variability limits empirical treatment selection, increasing non-negligible surgical risk and cost. Previous explorations either resort to limited statistical biomarkers that are insufficient to characterize variability, or employ AI-driven methods which is prone to overfitting and opacity. We bridge this gap with a pretraining-finetuning framework to predict outcomes directly from resting-state fMRI. Critically, a generative virtual brain foundation model, pretrained on a collective dataset (2707 subjects, 5621 sessions) to capture universal disorder patterns, was finetuned on PD cohorts receiving TI (n=51) or DBS (n=55) to yield individualized virtual brains with high fidelity to empirical functional connectivity (r=0.935). By constructing counterfactual estimations between pathological and healthy neural states within these personalized models, we predicted clinical responses (TI: AUPR=0.853; DBS: AUPR=0.915), substantially outperforming baselines. External and prospective validations (n=14, n=11) highlight the feasibility of clinical translation. Moreover, our framework provides state-dependent regional patterns linked to response, offering hypothesis-generating mechanistic insights.
tldr: This paper proposes a pretraining-finetuning framework using a generative virtual brain model to predict neuromodulation outcomes for Parkinson's disease from fMRI data, aiming to personalize treatment selection.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于生成式虚拟大脑模型的预训练-微调框架，利用fMRI数据预测帕金森病的神经调节治疗效果，旨在实现个性化治疗选择。
summary_zh: 帕金森病（PD）在全球影响着超过一千万人。虽然时间干扰刺激（TI）和深部脑刺激（DBS）是前景广阔的治疗方法，但个体间差异性限制了经验性治疗选择，增加了不可忽视的手术风险和成本。先前的研究要么依赖有限的统计学生物标志物，不足以表征变异性；要么采用易于过拟合且不透明的AI驱动方法。我们通过一个预训练-微调框架填补了这一空白，直接从静息态功能磁共振成像预测治疗效果。关键在于，我们利用集体数据集（2707名受试者，5621次扫描）预训练了一个生成式虚拟大脑基础模型，以捕捉普适性障碍模式，再在接受TI（n=51）或DBS（n=55）治疗的帕金森病队列上进行微调，从而生成与经验性功能连接高度吻合的个体化虚拟大脑（r=0.935）。通过在这些个性化模型中构建病理状态与健康神经状态的反事实估计，我们预测了临床反应（TI：AUPR=0.853；DBS：AUPR=0.915），结果显著优于基线方法。外部验证和前瞻性验证（n=14，n=11）突出了临床转化的可行性。此外，我们的框架还提供了与治疗反应相关的状态依赖性区域模式，为机制探索提供了可验证的假设。

title: Economics of Human and AI Collaboration: When is Partial Automation More Attractive than Full Automation?
summary: This paper develops a unified framework for evaluating the optimal degree of task automation. Moving beyond binary automate-or-not assessments, we model automation intensity as a continuous choice in which firms minimize costs by selecting an AI accuracy level, from no automation through partial human-AI collaboration to full automation. On the supply side, we estimate an AI production function via scaling-law experiments linking performance to data, compute, and model size. Because AI systems exhibit predictable but diminishing returns to these inputs, the cost of higher accuracy is convex: good performance may be inexpensive, but near-perfect accuracy is disproportionately costly. Full automation is therefore often not cost-minimizing; partial automation, where firms retain human workers for residual tasks, frequently emerges as the equilibrium. On the demand side, we introduce an entropy-based measure of task complexity that maps model accuracy into a labor substitution ratio, quantifying human labor displacement at each accuracy level. We calibrate the framework with O*NET task data, a survey of 3,778 domain experts, and GPT-4o-derived task decompositions, implementing it in computer vision. Task complexity shapes substitution: low-complexity tasks see high substitution, while high-complexity tasks favor limited partial automation. Scale of deployment is a key determinant: AI-as-a-Service and AI agents spread fixed costs across users, sharply expanding economically viable tasks. At the firm level, cost-effective automation captures approximately 11% of computer-vision-exposed labor compensation; under economy-wide deployment, this share rises sharply. Since other AI systems exhibit similar scaling-law economics, our mechanisms extend beyond computer vision, reinforcing that partial automation is often the economically rational long-run outcome, not merely a transitional phase.
tldr: This paper develops an economic framework for determining the optimal degree of task automation (partial vs. full) by modeling the convex cost of AI accuracy and analyzing task complexity, using computer vision as a case study.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个经济模型，通过模拟AI精度的凸成本和任务复杂性，以计算机视觉为案例，分析任务自动化的最佳程度（部分与完全自动化）。
summary_zh: 本文构建了一个评估任务自动化最优程度的统一框架。研究突破“自动化与否”的二元决策范式，将自动化强度建模为连续选择问题：企业通过选择人工智能精度水平（从无自动化、部分人机协作到完全自动化）实现成本最小化。在供给端，我们通过扩展律实验估测了人工智能生产函数，建立性能与数据、算力及模型规模之间的关联。由于人工智能系统对这些投入要素呈现可预测但收益递减的特性，更高精度的成本呈凸性增长：良好性能可能成本较低，但接近完美的精度则代价高昂。因此完全自动化往往并非成本最优解；部分自动化——即企业保留人类员工处理剩余任务——常成为均衡状态。在需求端，我们引入基于熵的任务复杂度度量方法，将模型精度映射为劳动力替代率，量化不同精度水平下的人力替代程度。通过整合O*NET任务数据、3,778名领域专家的调研以及GPT-4o生成的任务分解结果，本研究在计算机视觉领域实现了该框架的校准。任务复杂度决定了替代模式：低复杂度任务呈现高替代率，而高复杂度任务则适宜有限的部分自动化。部署规模是关键决定因素：人工智能即服务与智能体模式将固定成本分摊至多用户，显著扩展了经济可行的任务范围。在企业层面，成本效益最优的自动化可覆盖约11%的计算机视觉相关劳动力薪酬；若实现全经济范围部署，这一比例将急剧上升。鉴于其他人工智能系统具有相似的扩展律经济特征，本研究的机制可拓展至计算机视觉之外，进一步论证了部分自动化常是经济理性的长期稳态，而非仅作为过渡阶段存在。

title: On the Mirage of Long-Range Dependency, with an Application to Integer Multiplication
summary: Integer multiplication has long been considered a hard problem for neural networks, with the difficulty widely attributed to the O(n) long-range dependency induced by carry chains. We argue that this diagnosis is wrong: long-range dependency is not an intrinsic property of multiplication, but a mirage produced by the choice of computational spacetime. We formalize the notion of mirage and provide a constructive proof: when two n-bit binary integers are laid out as a 2D outer-product grid, every step of long multiplication collapses into a $3 \times 3$ local neighborhood operation. Under this representation, a neural cellular automaton with only 321 learnable parameters achieves perfect length generalization up to $683\times$ the training range. Five alternative architectures -- including Transformer (6,625 params), Transformer+RoPE, and Mamba -- all fail under the same representation. We further analyze how partial successes locked the community into an incorrect diagnosis, and argue that any task diagnosed as requiring long-range dependency should first be examined for whether the dependency is intrinsic to the task or induced by the computational spacetime.
tldr: This paper argues that the perceived long-range dependency in integer multiplication is a mirage due to the choice of computational representation, and shows that a simple neural cellular automaton with minimal parameters can solve it perfectly when using a 2D outer-product layout, outperforming several larger models like Transformers and Mamba.
tldr_zh: 该论文认为，整数乘法中感知到的长程依赖性是由于计算表示选择而产生的幻象，并证明当使用2D外积布局时，一个仅含321个参数的小型神经细胞自动机可以完美解决该问题，其性能优于Transformer和Mamba等更大模型。
summary_zh: 整数乘法长期以来被视为神经网络的难题，其困难性普遍归因于进位链导致的O(n)长程依赖。我们认为这一诊断是错误的：长程依赖并非乘法的内在属性，而是由计算时空选择产生的幻象。我们形式化了"幻象"概念并给出构造性证明：当两个n位二进制数以二维外积网格形式排列时，长乘法的每一步运算均可简化为$3\times 3$局部邻域操作。在此表示下，仅含321个可学习参数的神经细胞自动机即可实现高达训练范围$683\times$的完美长度泛化。五种替代架构——包括Transformer（6,625参数）、Transformer+RoPE和Mamba——在相同表示下均告失败。我们进一步分析了部分成功案例如何使研究社区固守错误诊断，并提出任何被诊断为需要长程依赖的任务，都应首先检验该依赖是任务固有属性还是由计算时空诱发的。

title: MMFace-DiT: A Dual-Stream Diffusion Transformer for High-Fidelity Multimodal Face Generation
summary: Recent multimodal face generation models address the spatial control limitations of text-to-image diffusion models by augmenting text-based conditioning with spatial priors such as segmentation masks, sketches, or edge maps. This multimodal fusion enables controllable synthesis aligned with both high-level semantic intent and low-level structural layout. However, most existing approaches typically extend pre-trained text-to-image pipelines by appending auxiliary control modules or stitching together separate uni-modal networks. These ad hoc designs inherit architectural constraints, duplicate parameters, and often fail under conflicting modalities or mismatched latent spaces, limiting their ability to perform synergistic fusion across semantic and spatial domains. We introduce MMFace-DiT, a unified dual-stream diffusion transformer engineered for synergistic multimodal face synthesis. Its core novelty lies in a dual-stream transformer block that processes spatial (mask/sketch) and semantic (text) tokens in parallel, deeply fusing them through a shared Rotary Position-Embedded (RoPE) Attention mechanism. This design prevents modal dominance and ensures strong adherence to both text and structural priors to achieve unprecedented spatial-semantic consistency for controllable face generation. Furthermore, a novel Modality Embedder enables a single cohesive model to dynamically adapt to varying spatial conditions without retraining. MMFace-DiT achieves a 40% improvement in visual fidelity and prompt alignment over six state-of-the-art multimodal face generation models, establishing a flexible new paradigm for end-to-end controllable generative modeling. The code and dataset are available on our project page: https://vcbsl.github.io/MMFace-DiT/
tldr: The paper proposes a dual-stream diffusion transformer for high-fidelity, multimodal face generation, using parallel streams for spatial and semantic modalities fused via a shared attention mechanism.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于高保真度多模态人脸生成的双流扩散Transformer，通过共享注意力机制并行处理空间和语义模态并进行深度融合。
summary_zh: 近期，多模态人脸生成模型通过引入分割掩码、草图或边缘图等空间先验信息，增强了基于文本的调节能力，从而解决了文本到图像扩散模型在空间控制方面的局限。这种多模态融合实现了可控合成，既符合高层语义意图，又契合低层结构布局。然而，现有方法大多通过在预训练的文本到图像流程中附加辅助控制模块，或简单拼接不同单模态网络来实现扩展。这些临时性设计继承了原有架构的约束，导致参数冗余，并在模态冲突或潜在空间不匹配时容易失效，限制了其在语义与空间领域进行协同融合的能力。为此，我们提出MMFace-DiT——一个专为协同多模态人脸合成而设计的统一双流扩散Transformer模型。其核心创新在于一种双流Transformer块，能够并行处理空间（掩码/草图）与语义（文本）令牌，并通过共享的旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）注意力机制进行深度融合。这一设计避免了模态主导，确保同时严格遵循文本与结构先验，从而在可控人脸生成中实现了前所未有的空间-语义一致性。此外，新颖的模态嵌入器使单一整体模型能够动态适应不同的空间条件，无需重新训练。相较于六种领先的多模态人脸生成模型，MMFace-DiT在视觉保真度与提示对齐度上提升了40%，为端到端可控生成建模树立了灵活的新范式。代码与数据集已发布在项目页面：https://vcbsl.github.io/MMFace-DiT/

title: Human-Like Lifelong Memory: A Neuroscience-Grounded Architecture for Infinite Interaction
summary: Large language models lack persistent, structured memory for long-term interaction and context-sensitive retrieval. Expanding context windows does not solve this: recent evidence shows that context length alone degrades reasoning by up to 85% - even with perfect retrieval. We propose a bio-inspired memory framework grounded in complementary learning systems theory, cognitive behavioral therapy's belief hierarchy, dual-process cognition, and fuzzy-trace theory, organized around three principles: (1) Memory has valence, not just content - pre-computed emotional-associative summaries (valence vectors) organized in an emergent belief hierarchy inspired by Beck's cognitive model enable instant orientation before deliberation; (2) Retrieval defaults to System 1 with System 2 escalation - automatic spreading activation and passive priming as default, with deliberate retrieval only when needed, and graded epistemic states that address hallucination structurally; and (3) Encoding is active, present, and feedback-dependent - a thalamic gateway tags and routes information between stores, while the executive forms gists through curiosity-driven investigation, not passive exposure. Seven functional properties specify what any implementation must satisfy. Over time, the system converges toward System 1 processing - the computational analog of clinical expertise - producing interactions that become cheaper, not more expensive, with experience.
tldr: The paper proposes a neuroscience-inspired memory architecture for AI systems, focusing on long-term interaction and context-sensitive retrieval. It does not explicitly address robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种受神经科学启发的人工智能记忆架构，专注于长期交互和上下文感知检索，未明确涉及机器人或具身人工智能。
summary_zh: 大语言模型缺乏用于长期交互和上下文敏感检索的持续性结构化记忆。扩展上下文窗口并不能解决此问题：最新研究表明，仅增加上下文长度就会使推理能力下降高达85%——即使在完美检索的情况下也不例外。我们提出了一种受生物启发的记忆框架，该框架基于互补学习系统理论、认知行为疗法的信念层级结构、双过程认知理论以及模糊痕迹理论，围绕三个核心原则构建：(1) 记忆具有情感效价而不仅是内容——通过基于贝克认知模型构建的信念层级中预计算的情感关联摘要（效价向量），可在深思熟虑前实现即时认知定向；(2) 检索默认采用系统1并支持系统2的升级调用——默认通过自动扩散激活和被动启动机制进行检索，仅在需要时启动主动检索，并通过分级认知状态从结构上解决幻觉问题；(3) 编码具有主动性、在场性和反馈依赖性——丘脑门控机制负责在不同存储间标记和路由信息，而执行系统则通过好奇心驱动的主动探索（而非被动接受）形成要旨记忆。七个功能特性明确了任何实施方案必须满足的要求。该系统将逐渐收敛于系统1处理模式——即临床专业知识的计算模拟——使得交互过程随着经验积累变得越来越高效而非更昂贵。

title: Improving Efficiency of GPU Kernel Optimization Agents using a Domain-Specific Language and Speed-of-Light Guidance
summary:
Optimizing GPU kernels with LLM agents is an iterative process over a large design space. Every candidate must be generated, compiled, validated, and profiled, so fewer trials will save both runtime and cost. We make two key observations. First, the abstraction level that agents operate at is important. If it is too low, the LLM wastes reasoning on low-impact details. If it is too high, it may miss important optimization choices. Second, agents cannot easily tell when they reach the point of diminishing returns, wasting resources as they continue searching.
  These observations motivate two design principles to improve efficiency: (1) a compact domain-specific language (DSL) that can be learned in context and lets the model reason at a higher level while preserving important optimization levers, and (2) Speed-of-Light (SOL) guidance that uses first-principles performance bounds to steer and budget search. We implement these principles in $μ$CUTLASS, a DSL with a compiler for CUTLASS-backed GPU kernels that covers kernel configuration, epilogue fusion, and multi-stage pipelines. We use SOL guidance to estimate headroom and guide optimization trials, deprioritize problems that are near SOL, and flag kernels that game the benchmark.
  On 59 KernelBench problems with the same iteration budgets, switching from generating low-level code to DSL code using GPT-5-mini turns a 0.40x geomean regression into a 1.27x speedup over PyTorch. Adding SOL-guided steering raises this to 1.56x. Across model tiers, $μ$CUTLASS + SOL-guidance lets weaker models outperform stronger baseline agents at lower token cost. SOL-guided budgeting saves 19-43% of tokens while retaining at least 95% of geomean speedup, with the best policy reaching a 1.68x efficiency gain. Lastly, SOL analysis helps detect benchmark-gaming cases, where kernels may appear fast while failing to perform the intended computation.
tldr: This paper introduces a domain-specific language and a speed-of-light guided search to improve the efficiency of LLM agents for GPU kernel optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种特定领域语言和光速指导的搜索方法，以提高LLM代理在GPU内核优化中的效率。
summary_zh:
利用大语言模型智能体优化GPU内核是一个在大规模设计空间中进行迭代的过程。每个候选方案都必须经过生成、编译、验证与性能剖析，因此减少尝试次数既能节约运行时间，也能降低成本。我们获得了两项关键观察：首先，智能体运行的抽象层次至关重要——若抽象层次过低，大语言模型会将推理资源浪费在对性能影响微末的细节上；若抽象层次过高，则可能错失重要的优化选择。其次，智能体难以准确判断收益递减的临界点，从而在持续搜索中浪费资源。

基于这些观察，我们提出两条提升效率的设计原则：（1）设计一种紧凑的领域特定语言，该语言支持上下文学习，使模型能在更高抽象层次进行推理，同时保留关键的优化控制维度；（2）引入“光速”引导机制，通过基于第一性原理的性能界限来指导搜索过程并分配计算资源。我们将这些原则实现在$μ$CUTLASS中——这是一个面向CUTLASS后端GPU内核的领域特定语言及其编译器，覆盖内核配置、收尾融合及多级流水线等优化维度。借助“光速”引导机制，我们能够预估性能提升空间并指导优化实验，对接近理论极限的问题降低优化优先级，并识别出在基准测试中取巧的内核。

在59个KernelBench问题上保持相同迭代预算的条件下，相比生成底层代码的方案，使用GPT-5-mini生成领域特定语言代码的方案将几何平均性能从PyTorch基准的0.40倍衰退转变为1.27倍加速。增加“光速”引导机制后，加速比进一步提升至1.56倍。在不同规模的大语言模型中，$μ$CUTLASS结合“光速”引导机制能使较弱模型以更低的令牌成本超越较强基线智能体的表现。采用“光速”引导的预算分配策略可在保留至少95%几何平均加速比的同时节省19-43%的令牌消耗，最优策略实现了1.68倍的效率增益。最后，“光速”分析有助于检测基准测试取巧情况——这类内核可能看似运行迅速，却未能执行预期的计算任务。

title: Design Principles for the Construction of a Benchmark Evaluating Security Operation Capabilities of Multi-agent AI Systems
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) and multi-agent AI systems are demonstrating increasing potential in cybersecurity operations, organizations, policymakers, model providers, and researchers in the AI and cybersecurity communities are interested in quantifying the capabilities of such AI systems to achieve more autonomous SOCs (security operation centers) and reduce manual effort. In particular, the AI and cybersecurity communities have recently developed several benchmarks for evaluating the red team capabilities of multi-agent AI systems. However, because the operations in SOCs are dominated by blue team operations, the capabilities of AI systems & agents to achieve more autonomous SOCs cannot be evaluated without a benchmark focused on blue team operations. To our best knowledge, no systematic benchmark for evaluating coordinated multi-task blue team AI has been proposed in the literature. Existing blue team benchmarks focus on a particular task. The goal of this work is to develop a set of design principles for the construction of a benchmark, which is denoted as SOC-bench, to evaluate the blue team capabilities of AI. Following these design principles, we have developed a conceptual design of SOC-bench, which consists of a family of five blue team tasks in the context of large-scale ransomware attack incident response.
tldr: Proposes design principles for SOC-bench, a benchmark to evaluate the blue team capabilities of multi-agent AI systems in cybersecurity incident response, focusing on tasks like ransomware attacks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SOC-bench的设计原则，这是一个用于评估多智能体AI系统在网络安全事件响应（如勒索软件攻击）中蓝队能力的基准测试。
summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）与多智能体人工智能系统在网络安全运营中展现出日益增长的应用潜力，人工智能与网络安全领域的企业、政策制定者、模型提供商及研究人员正致力于量化此类AI系统的能力，以期实现更自动化的安全运营中心（SOC）并减少人工操作负担。当前，人工智能与网络安全界已针对多智能体AI系统的红队能力评估提出了若干基准测试。然而，由于SOC运营主要涉及蓝队操作，若缺乏专注于蓝队操作的评估基准，则无法全面衡量AI系统与智能体实现更高自动化SOC的能力。据我们所知，现有文献中尚未提出系统性的、用于评估协同多任务蓝队人工智能的基准测试框架；现有蓝队基准多聚焦于单一任务。本研究旨在构建一套基准设计原则，并据此创建名为SOC-bench的基准测试体系，以评估AI的蓝队能力。遵循这些设计原则，我们提出了SOC-bench的概念框架，该框架包含在大规模勒索软件攻击应急响应场景下的五项蓝队任务组合。

title: Drop the Hierarchy and Roles: How Self-Organizing LLM Agents Outperform Designed Structures
summary: How much autonomy can multi-agent LLM systems sustain -- and what enables it? We present a 25,000-task computational experiment spanning 8 models, 4--256 agents, and 8 coordination protocols ranging from externally imposed hierarchy to emergent self-organization. We observe that autonomous behavior already emerges in current LLM agents: given minimal structural scaffolding (fixed ordering), agents spontaneously invent specialized roles, voluntarily abstain from tasks outside their competence, and form shallow hierarchies -- without any pre-assigned roles or external design. A hybrid protocol (Sequential) that enables this autonomy outperforms centralized coordination by 14% (p<0.001), with a 44% quality spread between protocols (Cohen's d=1.86, p<0.0001). The degree of emergent autonomy scales with model capability: strong models self-organize effectively, while models below a capability threshold still benefit from rigid structure -- suggesting that as foundation models improve, the scope for autonomous coordination will expand. The system scales sub-linearly to 256 agents without quality degradation (p=0.61), producing 5,006 unique roles from just 8 agents. Results replicate across closed- and open-source models, with open-source achieving 95% of closed-source quality at 24x lower cost. The practical implication: give agents a mission, a protocol, and a capable model -- not a pre-assigned role.
tldr: This paper explores multi-agent LLM coordination, finding that minimal structural scaffolding enables agents to self-organize roles and hierarchies, outperforming designed protocols, with performance scaling with model capability.
tldr_zh: 本文探索多智能体大语言模型协调，发现最小的结构性支架能使智能体自发组织角色和层次，其表现优于设计好的协议，且性能随模型能力扩展。
summary_zh: 多智能体LLM系统能维持多大程度的自主性——其背后的驱动因素是什么？我们开展了一项包含25,000个任务的计算实验，涵盖8种模型、4-256个智能体以及8种协调协议（从外部强加的层级结构到新兴的自组织模式）。实验发现，自主行为已在当前LLM智能体中显现：仅需提供最低限度的结构框架（固定顺序），智能体便能自发创造专业化角色，主动回避超出能力范围的任务，并形成浅层等级结构——无需任何预设角色或外部设计。支持这种自主性的混合协议（Sequential）比集中式协调方案性能提升14%（p<0.001），不同协议间质量差异达44%（科恩d值=1.86，p<0.0001）。新兴自主性的程度随模型能力扩展：强模型能有效实现自组织，而低于能力阈值的模型仍需依赖刚性结构——这表明随着基础模型的发展，自主协调的适用范围将不断扩大。该系统可亚线性扩展至256个智能体且无质量衰减（p=0.61），仅通过8个智能体就产生了5,006个独特角色。该结果在闭源与开源模型中均得到复现，其中开源模型以降低24倍的成本实现了闭源模型95%的性能。实践启示在于：赋予智能体使命、协议和强大模型——而非预设角色。

title: Privacy Guard & Token Parsimony by Prompt and Context Handling and LLM Routing
summary: The large-scale adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) forces a trade-off between operational cost (OpEx) and data privacy. Current routing frameworks reduce costs but ignore prompt sensitivity, exposing users and institutions to leakage risks towards third-party cloud providers. We formalise the "Inseparability Paradigm": advanced context management intrinsically coincides with privacy management. We propose a local "Privacy Guard" -- a holistic contextual observer powered by an on-premise Small Language Model (SLM) -- that performs abstractive summarisation and Automatic Prompt Optimisation (APO) to decompose prompts into focused sub-tasks, re-routing high-risk queries to Zero-Trust or NDA-covered models. This dual mechanism simultaneously eliminates sensitive inference vectors (Zero Leakage) and reduces cloud token payloads (OpEx Reduction). A LIFO-based context compacting mechanism further bounds working memory, limiting the emergent leakage surface. We validate the framework through a 2x2 benchmark (Lazy vs. Expert users; Personal vs. Institutional secrets) on a 1,000-sample dataset, achieving a 45% blended OpEx reduction, 100% redaction success on personal secrets, and -- via LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation -- an 85% preference rate for APO-compressed responses over raw baselines. Our results demonstrate that Token Parsimony and Zero Leakage are mathematically dual projections of the same contextual compression operator.
tldr: This paper proposes a privacy-preserving framework for LLM usage, using a local SLM for prompt analysis and routing to manage sensitive data and reduce costs. It introduces an 'Inseparability Paradigm' linking context management and privacy, validated on a user dataset with significant cost reduction and leakage prevention.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种保护隐私的LLM使用框架，利用本地小型语言模型（SLM）进行提示分析和路由，以管理敏感数据并降低成本。它引入了连接上下文管理和隐私的'不可分性范式'，在用户数据集上验证了其显著的成本降低和防泄漏效果。
summary_zh: 大规模采用大型语言模型(LLM)迫使运营成本与数据隐私之间形成权衡。当前的路由框架虽能降低成本却忽略了提示词敏感性，使用户与机构面临面向第三方云服务商的数据泄露风险。我们提出"不可分割范式"：高级上下文管理本质上与隐私管理相重合。我们设计了一种本地化"隐私守护者"——由本地部署的小型语言模型(SLM)驱动的全景式上下文观察器，通过抽象概括与自动提示优化(APO)将提示词分解为聚焦的子任务，并将高风险查询重定向至零信任或受保密协议覆盖的模型。这种双重机制能同步消除敏感推理向量（零泄漏）并降低云端令牌负载（运营成本削减）。基于后进先出原则的上下文压缩机制进一步限定工作内存，限制新兴泄漏面。我们在包含1000个样本的数据集上通过2x2基准测试（惰性用户与专业用户；个人隐私与机构机密）验证该框架，实现45%的综合运营成本削减、个人隐私100%脱敏成功率，并借助LLM即评判员评估获得85%的APO压缩响应优于原始基线的偏好率。研究结果表明，令牌精简与零泄漏在数学上是同一上下文压缩算子的双重投影。

title: Task-Centric Personalized Federated Fine-Tuning of Language Models
summary: Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a promising technique for training language models on distributed and private datasets of diverse tasks. However, aggregating models trained on heterogeneous tasks often degrades the overall performance of individual clients. To address this issue, Personalized FL (pFL) aims to create models tailored for each client's data distribution. Although these approaches improve local performance, they usually lack robustness in two aspects: (i) generalization: when clients must make predictions on unseen tasks, or face changes in their data distributions, and (ii) intra-client tasks interference: when a single client's data contains multiple distributions that may interfere with each other during local training. To tackle these two challenges, we propose FedRouter, a clustering-based pFL that builds specialized models for each task rather than for each client. FedRouter uses adapters to personalize models by employing two clustering mechanisms to associate adapters with specific tasks. A local clustering that associate adapters with task data samples and a global one that associates similar adapters from different clients to construct task-centric personalized models. Additionally, we propose an evaluation router mechanism that routes test samples to the best adapter based on the created clusters. Experiments comparing our method with existing approaches across a multitask dataset, FedRouter demonstrate strong resilience in these challenging scenarios performing up to 6.1% relatively better under tasks interference and up to 136% relative improvement under generalization evaluation.
tldr: This paper proposes FedRouter, a personalized federated learning method that uses adapters and clustering to create task-specific models, aiming to improve generalization and mitigate interference across heterogeneous tasks, with a focus on language models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出FedRouter，一种个性化联邦学习方法，利用适配器和聚类技术创建任务特定模型，旨在提高语言模型在异构任务上的泛化能力并减少任务间干扰。
summary_zh: 摘要：联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）已成为在分布式私有数据集上训练语言模型的一种前景广阔的技术，尤其适用于多任务场景。然而，聚合在异构任务上训练的模型往往会导致个体客户端的整体性能下降。为解决这一问题，个性化联邦学习（Personalized FL, pFL）致力于为每个客户端的数据分布定制专属模型。尽管这些方法提升了局部性能，但通常在两方面缺乏鲁棒性：（一）泛化能力：当客户端需对未见过的任务进行预测，或面临数据分布变化时；（二）客户端内任务干扰：当单个客户端数据包含多个分布，且这些分布在本地训练过程中可能相互干扰时。为应对这两个挑战，我们提出FedRouter——一种基于聚类的个性化联邦学习方法，旨在为每个任务而非每个客户端构建专用模型。FedRouter通过适配器实现模型个性化，并采用两种聚类机制将适配器与特定任务关联：本地聚类将适配器与任务数据样本关联，全局聚类则聚合来自不同客户端的相似适配器，以构建以任务为中心的个性化模型。此外，我们提出一种评估路由机制，基于已构建的聚类将测试样本路由至最佳适配器。在多任务数据集上进行的对比实验表明，FedRouter在现有方法中展现出强大的适应能力：在任务干扰场景下相对性能提升最高达6.1%，在泛化评估中获得最高136%的相对改进。

title: Theory of Mind and Self-Attributions of Mentality are Dissociable in LLMs
summary: Safety fine-tuning in Large Language Models (LLMs) seeks to suppress potentially harmful forms of mind-attribution such as models asserting their own consciousness or claiming to experience emotions. We investigate whether suppressing mind-attribution tendencies degrades intimately related socio-cognitive abilities such as Theory of Mind (ToM). Through safety ablation and mechanistic analyses of representational similarity, we demonstrate that LLM attributions of mind to themselves and to technological artefacts are behaviorally and mechanistically dissociable from ToM capabilities. Nevertheless, safety fine-tuned models under-attribute mind to non-human animals relative to human baselines and are less likely to exhibit spiritual belief, suppressing widely shared perspectives regarding the distribution and nature of non-human minds.
tldr: This paper investigates the impact of safety fine-tuning on mind-attribution and Theory of Mind in LLMs, finding that these abilities are dissociable, but fine-tuning suppresses broader non-human mind-attribution.
tldr_zh: 本研究探讨安全微调对LLM心智归因和心智理论的影响，发现这些能力是可分离的，但微调会抑制对非人类实体的心智归因。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的安全微调旨在抑制潜在有害的心智归因倾向，例如模型宣称自身具有意识或声称拥有情感体验。本研究探讨抑制心智归因倾向是否会削弱与之密切相关的社会认知能力，如心理理论（ToM）。通过安全消融实验与表征相似性的机制分析，我们发现LLM对自身及技术产物进行心智归因的行为，在表现层面和机制层面均与心理理论能力具有可分离性。然而，经过安全微调的模型相较于人类基准水平，对非人动物的心智归因存在明显不足，且更少表现出灵性信仰，这压制了关于非人心智分布与本质的普遍认知视角。

title: Beta-Scheduling: Momentum from Critical Damping as a Diagnostic and Correction Tool for Neural Network Training
summary:
Standard neural network training uses constant momentum (typically 0.9), a convention dating to 1964 with limited theoretical justification for its
  optimality. We derive a time-varying momentum schedule from the critically damped harmonic oscillator: mu(t) = 1 - 2*sqrt(alpha(t)), where alpha(t) is
  the current learning rate. This beta-schedule requires zero free parameters beyond the existing learning rate schedule. On ResNet-18/CIFAR-10,
  beta-scheduling delivers 1.9x faster convergence to 90% accuracy compared to constant momentum. More importantly, the per-layer gradient attribution
  under this schedule produces a cross-optimizer invariant diagnostic: the same three problem layers are identified regardless of whether the model was
  trained with SGD or Adam (100% overlap). Surgical correction of only these layers fixes 62 misclassifications while retraining only 18% of parameters.
  A hybrid schedule -- physics momentum for fast early convergence, then constant momentum for the final refinement -- reaches 95% accuracy fastest
  among five methods tested. The main contribution is not an accuracy improvement but a principled, parameter-free tool for localizing and correcting
  specific failure modes in trained networks.
tldr: The paper proposes a physics-inspired, time-varying momentum schedule for neural network training that accelerates convergence and provides a diagnostic tool for identifying problematic layers, but it is evaluated on standard computer vision tasks without any robotic application.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于物理启发的时变动量规划方法，用于神经网络训练，可加速收敛并提供诊断工具以识别问题层，但该研究是在标准计算机视觉任务上进行评估的，未涉及机器人应用。
summary_zh: 标准神经网络训练通常采用恒定的动量值（通常为0.9），这一惯例可追溯至1964年，其最优性的理论依据十分有限。本研究基于临界阻尼谐振子推导出时变动量调度方案：μ(t) = 1 - 2*sqrt(α(t))，其中α(t)为当前学习率。该β调度方案在现有学习率调度之外无需引入额外自由参数。在ResNet-18/CIFAR-10实验中，相较于恒定动量策略，β调度实现90%精度的收敛速度提升1.9倍。更重要的是，该方案下的逐层梯度归因产生了一种跨优化器不变诊断：无论模型采用SGD还是Adam优化器训练，均能识别出相同的三个问题层（重合率达100%）。仅对这些层进行精准修正即可修复62个误分类样本，而重训练参数仅占总量的18%。混合调度方案——前期采用物理动量实现快速收敛，后期采用恒定动量进行精细优化——在五种测试方法中达到95%精度的速度最快。本研究的主要贡献并非精度提升，而是提出了一种无需参数的原理性工具，能够精准定位并修正训练后网络中的特定故障模式。

title: OptiMer: Optimal Distribution Vector Merging Is Better than Data Mixing for Continual Pre-Training
summary: Continual pre-training is widely used to adapt LLMs to target languages and domains, yet the mixture ratio of training data remains a sensitive hyperparameter that is expensive to tune: they must be fixed before training begins, and a suboptimal choice can waste weeks of compute. In this work, we propose OptiMer, which decouples ratio selection from training: we train one CPT model per dataset, extract each model's distribution vector, which represents the parameter shift induced by that dataset, and search for optimal composition weights post-hoc via Bayesian optimization. Experiments on Gemma 3 27B across languages (Japanese, Chinese) and domains (Math, Code) show that OptiMer consistently outperforms data mixture and model averaging baselines with 15-35 times lower search cost. Key findings reveal that 1) the optimized weights can be interpreted as data mixture ratios, and retraining with these ratios improves data mixture CPT, and 2) the same vector pool can be re-optimized for a given objective without any retraining, producing target-tailored models on demand. Our work establishes that data mixture ratio selection, traditionally a pre-training decision, can be reformulated as a post-hoc optimization over distribution vectors, offering a more flexible paradigm for continual pre-training.
tldr: OptiMer proposes a method to optimize the data mixture ratio for continual pre-training of LLMs post-hoc by extracting and merging distribution vectors from per-dataset models, significantly reducing search cost.
tldr_zh: OptiMer 提出一种方法，用于在大语言模型持续预训练中事后优化数据混合比例，通过提取和合并各数据集模型的分布向量来显著降低搜索成本。
summary_zh: 持续预训练被广泛用于将大型语言模型适应目标语言与领域，但训练数据的混合比例仍是一个敏感且调优成本高昂的超参数：这些比例必须在训练开始前确定，子优选择可能导致数周计算资源的浪费。本研究提出 OptiMer 方法，将比例选择与训练过程解耦：我们为每个数据集训练一个持续预训练模型，提取每个模型的分布向量（代表该数据集引起的参数偏移），并通过贝叶斯优化在训练后搜索最优组合权重。基于 Gemma 3 27B 模型在多种语言（日语、中文）与领域（数学、代码）上的实验表明，OptiMer 在搜索成本降低 15-35 倍的同时，始终优于数据混合与模型平均基线方法。关键发现包括：1）优化后的权重可解读为数据混合比例，使用这些比例重新训练能提升数据混合持续预训练的效果；2）同一向量池可根据特定目标重复优化而无需重新训练，从而按需生成适应目标任务的定制模型。本研究表明，传统上作为预训练前决策的数据混合比例选择，可重新定义为基于分布向量的训练后优化，为持续预训练提供了更灵活的研究范式。

title: NeuroBRIDGE: Behavior-Conditioned Koopman Dynamics with Riemannian Alignment for Early Substance Use Initiation Prediction from Longitudinal Functional Connectome
summary: Early identification of adolescents at risk for substance use initiation (SUI) is vital yet difficult, as most predictors treat connectivity as static or cross-sectional and miss how brain networks change over time and with behavior. We proposed NeuroBRIDGE (Behavior conditioned RIemannian Koopman Dynamics on lonGitudinal connEctomes), a novel graph neural network-based framework that aligns longitudinal functional connectome in a Riemannian tangent space and couples dual-time attention with behavioral-conditioned Koopman dynamics to capture temporal change. Evaluated on ABCD, NeuroBRIDGE improved future SUI prediction over relevant baselines while offering interpretable insights into neural pathways, refining our understanding of neurodevelopmental risk and informing targeted prevention.
tldr: A novel graph neural network framework for predicting adolescent substance use initiation from longitudinal functional brain connectivity data, incorporating Riemannian geometry and behavior-conditioned Koopman dynamics.
tldr_zh: 一种新颖的图神经网络框架，用于从纵向功能性脑连接数据中预测青少年物质使用起始，融合了黎曼几何和行为条件库普曼动力学。
summary_zh: 早期识别存在物质使用起始（SUI）风险的青少年至关重要，但极具挑战性，因为现有预测方法大多将大脑连接视为静态或横截面数据，未能捕捉到神经网络如何随时间及行为动态演化。本研究提出NeuroBRIDGE（行为调控的黎曼库普曼纵向连接组动力学）——一种基于图神经网络的新型框架，该方法将纵向功能连接组映射到黎曼切空间，并结合双时间注意力机制与行为调控的库普曼动力学，以捕捉神经网络的时序演化特征。在ABCD数据集上的实验表明，NeuroBRIDGE相较于现有基线模型能更精准地预测未来SUI风险，同时可解析与物质使用相关的神经通路变化，从而深化对神经发育风险机制的理解，为精准预防干预提供依据。

title: Detecting Unknown Objects via Energy-based Separation for Open World Object Detection
summary: In this work, we tackle the problem of Open World Object Detection (OWOD). This challenging scenario requires the detector to incrementally learn to classify known objects without forgetting while identifying unknown objects without supervision. Previous OWOD methods have enhanced the unknown discovery process and employed memory replay to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. However, since existing methods heavily rely on the detector's known class predictions for detecting unknown objects, they struggle to effectively learn and recognize unknown object representations. Moreover, while memory replay mitigates forgetting of old classes, it often sacrifices the knowledge of newly learned classes. To resolve these limitations, we propose DEUS (Detecting Unknowns via energy-based Separation), a novel framework that addresses the challenges of Open World Object Detection. DEUS consists of Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF)-Subspace Unknown Separation (EUS) and an Energy-based Known Distinction (EKD) loss. EUS leverages ETF-based geometric properties to create orthogonal subspaces, enabling cleaner separation between known and unknown object representations. Unlike prior energy-based approaches that consider only the known space, EUS utilizes energies from both spaces to better capture distinct patterns of unknown objects. Furthermore, EKD loss enforces the separation between previous and current classifiers, thus minimizing knowledge interference between previous and newly learned classes during memory replay. We thoroughly validate DEUS on OWOD benchmarks, demonstrating outstanding performance improvements in unknown detection while maintaining competitive known class performance.
tldr: A novel framework for Open World Object Detection that uses energy-based separation and orthogonal subspaces to better detect unknown objects while mitigating forgetting of known classes.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于开放世界物体检测的新框架，通过基于能量的分离和正交子空间来更好地检测未知物体，同时减轻对已知类别的遗忘。
summary_zh: 本研究针对开放世界目标检测问题展开。该场景要求检测器在无监督状态下识别未知目标的同时，能够持续学习已知目标分类而不发生遗忘。现有开放世界目标检测方法虽已通过增强未知目标发现机制与引入记忆重放策略来缓解灾难性遗忘，但由于过度依赖已知类别的预测结果进行未知目标检测，导致难以有效学习与识别未知目标表征。此外，传统记忆重放方法在缓解旧类别遗忘时，往往以牺牲新类别知识为代价。为突破这些局限，本文提出基于能量分离的未知目标检测框架DEUS。该框架包含等角紧框架子空间未知分离模块与基于能量的已知类别区分损失函数：前者通过等角紧框架的几何特性构建正交子空间，实现已知与未知目标表征的清晰分离；与传统仅关注已知空间能量的方法不同，该模块通过双空间能量分析更精准捕捉未知目标的独特模式。后者则通过强化新旧分类器间的分离性，在记忆重放过程中有效减少新旧类别知识干扰。我们在开放世界目标检测基准数据集上进行了全面验证，实验表明DEUS在保持已知类别检测竞争力的同时，显著提升了未知目标检测性能。

title: EC-Bench: Enumeration and Counting Benchmark for Ultra-Long Videos
summary: Counting in long videos remains a fundamental yet underexplored challenge in computer vision. Real-world recordings often span tens of minutes or longer and contain sparse, diverse events, making long-range temporal reasoning particularly difficult. However, most existing video counting benchmarks focus on short clips and evaluate only the final numerical answer, providing little insight into what should be counted or whether models consistently identify relevant instances across time. We introduce EC-Bench, a benchmark that jointly evaluates enumeration, counting, and temporal evidence grounding in long-form videos. EC-Bench contains 152 videos longer than 30 minutes and 1,699 queries paired with explicit evidence spans. Across 22 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best model achieves only 29.98% accuracy on Enumeration and 23.74% on Counting, while human performance reaches 78.57% and 82.97%, respectively. Our analysis reveals strong relationships between enumeration accuracy, temporal grounding, and counting performance. These results highlight fundamental limitations of current MLLMs and establish EC-Bench as a challenging benchmark for long-form quantitative video reasoning.
tldr: Introduces EC-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating enumeration and counting abilities of MLLMs in ultra-long videos, revealing significant performance gaps compared to humans.
tldr_zh: 提出了EC-Bench，一个用于评估MLLMs在超长视频中枚举和计数能力的基准测试，揭示了与人类表现相比存在显著差距。
summary_zh: 长视频计数是计算机视觉领域一个基础但尚未被充分探索的挑战。现实世界中的视频记录通常长达数十分钟甚至更久，且包含稀疏、多样化的事件，这使得长程时序推理尤为困难。然而，现有的大多数视频计数基准主要关注短视频片段，且仅评估最终数值答案，未能深入揭示模型应计数的内容或其在时间维度上是否始终能识别相关实例。本文提出了EC-Bench，这是一个用于评估长视频中枚举、计数及时序证据定位的联合基准。该基准包含152段时长超过30分钟的视频和1,699个带有明确证据时间区间的查询。在22个多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的测试中，最佳模型在枚举任务上仅达到29.98%的准确率，在计数任务上为23.74%，而人类表现分别达到78.57%和82.97%。我们的分析揭示了枚举准确率、时序定位能力与计数性能之间的强关联性。这些结果凸显了当前多模态大语言模型存在的根本性局限，并确立了EC-Bench作为长视频定量推理领域具有挑战性的新基准。

title: Gloria: Consistent Character Video Generation via Content Anchors
summary: Digital characters are central to modern media, yet generating character videos with long-duration, consistent multi-view appearance and expressive identity remains challenging. Existing approaches either provide insufficient context to preserve identity or leverage non-character-centric information as the memory, leading to suboptimal consistency. Recognizing that character video generation inherently resembles an outside-looking-in scenario. In this work, we propose representing the character visual attributes through a compact set of anchor frames. This design provides stable references for consistency, while reference-based video generation inherently faces challenges of copy-pasting and multi-reference conflicts. To address these, we introduce two mechanisms: Superset Content Anchoring, providing intra- and extra-training clip cues to prevent duplication, and RoPE as Weak Condition, encoding positional offsets to distinguish multiple anchors. Furthermore, we construct a scalable pipeline to extract these anchors from massive videos. Experiments show our method generates high-quality character videos exceeding 10 minutes, and achieves expressive identity and appearance consistency across views, surpassing existing methods.
tldr: This paper presents 'Gloria', a method for generating long, consistent character videos using a compact set of anchor frames, addressing copy-pasting and multi-reference issues. It focuses on improving appearance and identity consistency in digital character generation for media.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为'Gloria'的方法，它通过一组紧凑的锚定帧来生成长时间、一致的角色视频，解决了复制粘贴和多参考冲突的问题。该方法专注于提高媒体中数字角色生成的外观和身份一致性。
summary_zh: 数字角色是现代媒体的核心，但生成具有长时长、多视角外观一致性和表现力身份特征的角色视频仍然面临挑战。现有方法要么提供的上下文信息不足以保持身份特征，要么依赖非角色中心信息作为记忆，导致一致性欠佳。我们认识到角色视频生成本质上类似于"从外向内观察"的场景。为此，本研究提出通过一组紧凑的锚定帧来表示角色视觉属性。这种设计为一致性提供稳定参考，但基于参考的视频生成方法本身面临复制粘贴和多参考冲突的挑战。为解决这些问题，我们引入两种机制：超集内容锚定技术——通过训练片段内外线索防止内容重复，以及作为弱条件的旋转位置编码——通过编码位置偏移量来区分多个锚点。此外，我们构建了可扩展的流程从海量视频中提取这些锚点。实验表明，我们的方法能生成超过10分钟的高质量角色视频，并在多视角下实现具有表现力的身份特征和外观一致性，其效果超越现有方法。

title: Less Is More? Selective Visual Attention to High-Importance Regions for Multimodal Radiology Summarization
summary: Automated radiology report summarization aims to distill verbose findings into concise clinical impressions, but existing multimodal models often struggle with visual noise and fail to meaningfully improve over strong text-only baselines in the FINDINGS $\to$ IMPRESSION transformation. We challenge two prevailing assumptions: (1) that more visual input is always better, and (2) that multimodal models add limited value when findings already contain rich image-derived detail. Through controlled ablations on MIMIC-CXR benchmark, we show that selectively focusing on pathology-relevant visual patches rather than full images yields substantially better performance. We introduce ViTAS, Visual-Text Attention Summarizer, a multi-stage pipeline that combines ensemble-guided MedSAM2 lung segmentation, bidirectional cross-attention for multi-view fusion, Shapley-guided adaptive patch clustering, and hierarchical visual tokenization feeding a ViT. ViTAS achieves SOTA results with 29.25% BLEU-4 and 69.83% ROUGE-L, improved factual alignment in qualitative analysis, and the highest expert-rated human evaluation scores. Our findings demonstrate that less but more relevant visual input is not only sufficient but superior for multimodal radiology summarization.
tldr: This paper proposes a multimodal summarization method for radiology reports that uses selective visual attention to focus on pathology-relevant image patches, improving performance over text-only models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于放射学报告的多模态总结方法，通过选择性视觉注意力聚焦于病理相关图像区域，性能超越纯文本模型。
summary_zh: 自动化放射学报告摘要生成旨在将冗长的影像所见浓缩为简明的临床印象，但现有多模态模型常受视觉噪声干扰，在"影像所见→临床印象"的转换中难以显著超越强大的纯文本基线模型。本研究挑战了两个主流假设：(1) 更多视觉输入必然带来更好效果；(2) 当影像所见已包含丰富图像衍生细节时，多模态模型的附加价值有限。通过在MIMIC-CXR基准上的受控消融实验，我们发现选择性聚焦于病理相关视觉区域而非完整图像能显著提升性能。我们提出ViTAS模型（视觉-文本注意力摘要生成器），该多阶段流程集成：集成引导的MedSAM2肺部分割、多视图双向交叉注意力机制、Shapley引导的自适应区域聚类、以及馈入视觉Transformer的分层视觉标记化技术。ViTAS以29.25%的BLEU-4分数和69.83%的ROUGE-L分数达到当前最优性能，定性分析显示其事实对齐度更高，并获得了专家人工评估的最高评分。我们的研究证明，在放射学多模态摘要生成中，减少视觉输入量但提升其相关性，不仅能满足需求，更能产生更优效果。

title: Multi-Feature Fusion Approach for Generative AI Images Detection
summary: The rapid evolution of Generative AI (GenAI) models has led to synthetic images of unprecedented realism, challenging traditional methods for distinguishing them from natural photographs. While existing detectors often rely on single-feature spaces, such as statistical regularities, semantic embeddings, or texture patterns, these approaches tend to lack robustness when confronted with diverse and evolving generative models. In this work, we investigate and systematically evaluate a multi-feature fusion framework that combines complementary cues from three distinct spaces: (1) Mean Subtracted Contrast Normalized (MSCN) features capturing low-level statistical deviations; (2) CLIP embeddings encoding high-level semantic coherence; and (3) Multi-scale Local Binary Patterns (MLBP) characterizing mid-level texture anomalies. Through extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets covering a wide range of generative models, we show that individual feature spaces exhibit significant performance variability across different generators. Crucially, the fusion of all three representations yields superior and more consistent performance, particularly in a challenging mixed-model scenario. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, the proposed framework yields consistently improved performance across all evaluated datasets. Overall, this work highlights the importance of hybrid representations for robust GenAI image detection and provides a principled framework for integrating complementary visual cues.
tldr: Proposes a multi-feature fusion framework combining low-level statistical, mid-level texture, and high-level semantic features for improved detection of AI-generated images.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种结合低层统计、中层纹理和高层语义特征的多特征融合框架，用于提高AI生成图像的检测性能。
summary_zh: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）模型的快速发展催生了逼真度前所未有的合成图像，这对区分合成图像与自然照片的传统方法构成了挑战。现有检测器多依赖单一特征空间，如统计规律性、语义嵌入或纹理模式，但这些方法在面对多样化且不断演进的生成模型时往往缺乏鲁棒性。本研究探索并系统评估了一种多特征融合框架，该框架整合了来自三个不同空间的互补线索：（1）均值减对比度归一化（MSCN）特征，捕捉低级统计偏差；（2）CLIP嵌入，编码高级语义连贯性；（3）多尺度局部二值模式（MLBP），刻画中级纹理异常。通过在涵盖广泛生成模型的四个基准数据集上的大量实验，我们发现单个特征空间在不同生成器间表现出显著的性能差异。关键的是，融合三种特征表示能够产生更优越且更稳定的性能，尤其在具有挑战性的混合模型场景中。与现有先进方法相比，所提出的框架在所有评估数据集上均实现了性能的持续提升。总体而言，本研究强调了混合特征表示对于鲁棒的GenAI图像检测的重要性，并为整合互补视觉线索提供了系统化的框架。

title: Beyond Ground-Truth: Leveraging Image Quality Priors for Real-World Image Restoration
summary: Real-world image restoration aims to restore high-quality (HQ) images from degraded low-quality (LQ) inputs captured under uncontrolled conditions. Existing methods typically depend on ground-truth (GT) supervision, assuming that GT provides perfect reference quality. However, GT can still contain images with inconsistent perceptual fidelity, causing models to converge to the average quality level of the training data rather than achieving the highest perceptual quality attainable. To address these problems, we propose a novel framework, termed IQPIR, that introduces an Image Quality Prior (IQP)-extracted from pre-trained No-Reference Image Quality Assessment (NR-IQA) models-to guide the restoration process toward perceptually optimal outputs explicitly. Our approach synergistically integrates IQP with a learned codebook prior through three key mechanisms: (1) a quality-conditioned Transformer, where NR-IQA-derived scores serve as conditioning signals to steer the predicted representation toward maximal perceptual quality. This design provides a plug-and-play enhancement compatible with existing restoration architectures without structural modification; and (2) a dual-branch codebook structure, which disentangles common and HQ-specific features, ensuring a comprehensive representation of both generic structural information and quality-sensitive attributes; and (3) a discrete representation-based quality optimization strategy, which mitigates over-optimization effects commonly observed in continuous latent spaces. Extensive experiments on real-world image restoration demonstrate that our method not only surpasses cutting-edge methods but also serves as a generalizable quality-guided enhancement strategy for existing methods. The code is available.
tldr: The paper introduces IQPIR, a framework for real-world image restoration that uses a pre-trained No-Reference Image Quality Assessment (NR-IQA) model as a quality prior to guide the restoration process, achieving superior perceptual results without relying on imperfect ground-truth supervision.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了IQPIR框架，利用预训练的无参考图像质量评估模型作为质量先验来指导真实世界图像复原过程，在不依赖不完美真值监督的情况下实现了更优的感知质量。
summary_zh: 真实世界图像复原的目标是在不受控条件下从退化的低质量输入中恢复出高质量图像。现有方法通常依赖真实标注监督，假设真实标注提供了完美的参考质量。然而，真实标注仍可能包含感知保真度不一致的图像，导致模型收敛到训练数据的平均质量水平，而非达到可获得的最佳感知质量。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为IQPIR的新型框架，该框架引入从预训练的无参考图像质量评估模型中提取的图像质量先验，以显式引导复原过程向感知最优输出方向发展。我们的方法通过三个关键机制将质量先验与学习的码本先验协同整合：（1）质量条件化Transformer，其中无参考质量评估模型生成的分数作为条件信号，引导预测表征向最优感知质量方向演化。该设计为现有复原架构提供了即插即用的增强方案，无需进行结构修改；（2）双分支码本结构，解耦通用特征与高质量特有特征，确保对通用结构信息与质量敏感属性的全面表征；（3）基于离散表征的质量优化策略，缓解了连续潜空间中常见的过度优化效应。在真实世界图像复原任务上的大量实验表明，我们的方法不仅超越了现有前沿方法，还可作为现有方法中具有泛化能力的质量引导增强策略。代码已公开。

title: FED-Bench: A Cross-Granular Benchmark for Disentangled Evaluation of Facial Expression Editing
summary: Facial expression image editing requires fine-grained control to strictly preserve human identity and background while precisely manipulating expression. However, existing editing benchmarks primarily focus on general scenarios, lacking high-quality facial images and corresponding editing instructions. Furthermore, current evaluation metrics exhibit systemic biases in this task, often favoring lazy editing or overfit editing. To bridge these gaps, we propose FED-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring rigorous testing and an accurate evaluation suite. First, we carefully construct a benchmark of 747 triplets through a cascaded and scalable pipeline, each comprising an original image, an editing instruction, and a ground-truth image for precise evaluation. Second, we introduce FED-Score, a cross-granularity evaluation protocol that disentangles assessment into three dimensions: Alignment for verifying instruction following, Fidelity for testing image quality and identity preservation, and Relative Expression Gain for quantifying the magnitude of expression changes, effectively mitigating the aforementioned evaluation biases. Third, we benchmark 18 image editing models, revealing that current approaches struggle to simultaneously achieve high fidelity and accurate expression manipulation, with fine-grained instruction following identified as the primary bottleneck. Finally, leveraging the scalable characteristic of introduced benchmark engine, we provide a 20k+ in-the-wild facial training set and demonstrate its effectiveness by fine-tuning a baseline model that achieves significant performance gains. Our benchmark and related code will be made publicly open soon.
tldr: FED-Bench is a new benchmark for evaluating facial expression editing models, featuring a high-quality dataset, a multi-dimensional evaluation metric (FED-Score), and reveals current models' limitations in fine-grained instruction following.
tldr_zh: FED-Bench是一个用于面部表情编辑评估的新基准，包含高质量数据集、多维度评估指标（FED-Score），并揭示了当前模型在细粒度指令跟随方面的不足。
summary_zh: 面部表情图像编辑需要精细控制，在精确操纵表情的同时严格保持人物身份与背景不变。然而，现有编辑基准主要面向通用场景，缺乏高质量面部图像及相应的编辑指令。此外，当前评估指标在该任务中存在系统性偏差，往往倾向于惰性编辑或过拟合编辑。为填补这些空白，我们提出FED-Bench——一个包含严格测试与精准评估套件的综合性基准。首先，我们通过级联可扩展流程精心构建了包含747组三元数据的基准集，每组数据由原始图像、编辑指令和真实标注图像构成，以支持精确评估。其次，我们提出FED-Score跨粒度评估协议，将评估解构为三个维度：验证指令遵循的"对齐度"、测试图像质量与身份保持的"保真度"，以及量化表情变化程度的"相对表情增益"，从而有效缓解前述评估偏差。第三，我们对18个图像编辑模型进行基准测试，发现现有方法难以同时实现高保真度与准确的表情操控，其中细粒度指令遵循被确认为主要瓶颈。最后，基于所引入基准引擎的可扩展特性，我们提供了包含2万+张真实场景面部图像的训练集，并通过微调基线模型验证了其有效性，该模型实现了显著的性能提升。本基准及相关代码将尽快公开。

title: Clinical DVH metrics as a loss function for 3D dose prediction in head and neck radiotherapy
summary:
Purpose: Deep-learning-based three-dimensional (3D) dose prediction is widely used in automated radiotherapy workflows. However, most existing models are trained with voxel-wise regression losses, which are poorly aligned with clinical plan evaluation criteria based on dose-volume histogram (DVH) metrics. This study aims to develop a clinically guided loss formulation that directly optimizes clinically used DVH metrics while remaining computationally efficient for head and neck (H\&N) dose prediction.
  Methods: We propose a clinical DVH metric loss (CDM loss) that incorporates differentiable \textit{D-metrics} and surrogate \textit{V-metrics}, together with a lossless bit-mask region-of-interest (ROI) encoding to improve training efficiency. The method was evaluated on 174 H\&N patients using a temporal split (137 training, 37 testing).
  Results: Compared with MAE- and DVH-curve based losses, CDM loss substantially improved target coverage and satisfied all clinical constraints. Using a standard 3D U-Net, the PTV Score was reduced from 1.544 (MAE) to 0.491 (MAE + CDM), while OAR sparing remained comparable. Bit-mask encoding reduced training time by 83\% and lowered GPU memory usage.
  Conclusion: Directly optimizing clinically used DVH metrics enables 3D dose predictions that are better aligned with clinical treatment planning criteria than conventional voxel-wise or DVH-curve-based supervision. The proposed CDM loss, combined with efficient ROI bit-mask encoding, provides a practical and scalable framework for H\&N dose prediction.
tldr: Proposes a novel loss function for 3D medical dose prediction that directly optimizes clinical metrics, improving plan quality and training efficiency.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于3D医学剂量预测的新型损失函数，直接优化临床指标，提高了计划质量和训练效率。
summary_zh:
**摘要：**  
目的：基于深度学习的三维剂量预测已广泛应用于自动化放疗流程。然而，现有模型大多采用体素级回归损失进行训练，这与基于剂量体积直方图（DVH）指标的临床计划评估标准匹配度较低。本研究旨在开发一种临床导向的损失函数构建方法，直接优化临床使用的DVH指标，同时保持头颈部（H&N）剂量预测的计算效率。  
方法：我们提出了一种临床DVH指标损失函数（CDM损失），该函数结合了可微分的*D-指标*和代理*V-指标*，并采用无损的位掩码感兴趣区域（ROI）编码以提高训练效率。该方法在174例头颈部患者数据上通过时间划分（137例训练，37例测试）进行评估。  
结果：与基于平均绝对误差（MAE）和DVH曲线的损失函数相比，CDM损失显著提升了靶区覆盖率，并满足了所有临床约束条件。使用标准的3D U-Net模型时，PTV评分从1.544（MAE）降至0.491（MAE + CDM），而危及器官保护效果保持相当水平。位掩码编码将训练时间缩短了83%，并降低了GPU内存占用。  
结论：直接优化临床使用的DVH指标，能够使三维剂量预测结果比传统的体素级或DVH曲线监督方法更符合临床治疗计划标准。所提出的CDM损失函数与高效的ROI位掩码编码相结合，为头颈部剂量预测提供了一个实用且可扩展的框架。

title: CutClaw: Agentic Hours-Long Video Editing via Music Synchronization
summary: Editing the video content with audio alignment forms a digital human-made art in current social media. However, the time-consuming and repetitive nature of manual video editing has long been a challenge for filmmakers and professional content creators alike. In this paper, we introduce CutClaw, an autonomous multi-agent framework designed to edit hours-long raw footage into meaningful short videos that leverages the capabilities of multiple Multimodal Language Models~(MLLMs) as an agent system. It produces videos with synchronized music, followed by instructions, and a visually appealing appearance. In detail, our approach begins by employing a hierarchical multimodal decomposition that captures both fine-grained details and global structures across visual and audio footage.
