Then, to ensure narrative consistency, a Playwriter Agent orchestrates the whole storytelling flow and structures the long-term narrative, anchoring visual scenes to musical shifts. Finally, to construct a short edited video, Editor and Reviewer Agents collaboratively optimize the final cut via selecting fine-grained visual content based on rigorous aesthetic and semantic criteria. We conduct detailed experiments to demonstrate that CutClaw significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in generating high-quality, rhythm-aligned videos. The code is available at: https://github.com/GVCLab/CutClaw.
tldr: CutClaw is an autonomous multi-agent framework using MLLMs to edit long raw footage into short, music-synchronized videos.
tldr_zh: CutClaw是一个利用多模态大语言模型作为智能体的自主多智能体框架，用于将长原始素材编辑成音乐同步的短视频。
summary_zh: 基于音频对齐的视频内容编辑已成为当前社交媒体中的一种数字艺术形式。然而，手工视频编辑的耗时性和重复性长期以来始终困扰着电影制作人和专业内容创作者。本文提出CutClaw——一个自主的多智能体框架，旨在将数小时长的原始素材编辑成有意义的短视频。该框架利用多个多模态语言模型作为智能体系统，能够生成音乐同步、指令跟随且视觉表现力强的视频作品。具体而言，我们的方法首先采用层次化多模态分解技术，同步捕捉视觉与音频素材中的细粒度细节与全局结构。随后，为保障叙事连贯性，编剧智能体通过将视觉场景与音乐转换节点锚定，统筹整体叙事流程并构建长程叙事结构。最后，编辑与审核智能体基于严格的美学与语义准则，通过协作筛选细粒度视觉内容，共同优化最终剪辑版本。详尽的实验结果表明，CutClaw在生成高质量节奏同步视频方面显著优于现有前沿基线方法。代码已发布于：https://github.com/GVCLab/CutClaw。

title: Unify-Agent: A Unified Multimodal Agent for World-Grounded Image Synthesis
summary: Unified multimodal models provide a natural and promising architecture for understanding diverse and complex real-world knowledge while generating high-quality images. However, they still rely primarily on frozen parametric knowledge, which makes them struggle with real-world image generation involving long-tail and knowledge-intensive concepts. Inspired by the broad success of agents on real-world tasks, we explore agentic modeling to address this limitation. Specifically, we present Unify-Agent, a unified multimodal agent for world-grounded image synthesis, which reframes image generation as an agentic pipeline consisting of prompt understanding, multimodal evidence searching, grounded recaptioning, and final synthesis. To train our model, we construct a tailored multimodal data pipeline and curate 143K high-quality agent trajectories for world-grounded image synthesis, enabling effective supervision over the full agentic generation process. We further introduce FactIP, a benchmark covering 12 categories of culturally significant and long-tail factual concepts that explicitly requires external knowledge grounding. Extensive experiments show that our proposed Unify-Agent substantially improves over its base unified model across diverse benchmarks and real world generation tasks, while approaching the world knowledge capabilities of the strongest closed-source models. As an early exploration of agent-based modeling for world-grounded image synthesis, our work highlights the value of tightly coupling reasoning, searching, and generation for reliable open-world agentic image synthesis.
tldr: The paper proposes Unify-Agent, an agentic pipeline for image synthesis that uses external knowledge grounding to improve generation of long-tail concepts, focusing on tasks like world-grounded image creation rather than robotics.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出Unify-Agent，一种用于图像合成的智能体流程，通过外部知识增强来改善长尾概念生成，主要关注基于世界知识的图像创建任务，而非机器人领域。
summary_zh: 统一多模态模型为理解和生成高质量图像提供了一种自然且有前景的架构，能够处理多样且复杂的现实世界知识。然而，它们仍主要依赖于冻结的参数化知识，这使得其在涉及长尾和知识密集型概念的现实世界图像生成任务中面临挑战。受智能体在现实任务中广泛成功的启发，我们探索了智能体建模以解决这一局限性。具体而言，我们提出了Unify-Agent，一个用于世界基础图像合成的统一多模态智能体，它将图像生成重新构建为一个智能体流程，包括提示理解、多模态证据检索、基础重描述和最终合成。为了训练模型，我们构建了一个专门的多模态数据流程，并收集了143K条高质量的世界基础图像合成智能体轨迹，从而对整个智能体生成过程进行有效监督。我们进一步引入了FactIP基准，该基准覆盖了12类具有文化意义和长尾特征的事实概念，明确要求外部知识基础。大量实验表明，我们提出的Unify-Agent在不同基准测试和现实世界生成任务中均显著优于其基础统一模型，同时接近了最强闭源模型的世界知识能力。作为基于智能体的世界基础图像合成建模的早期探索，我们的工作凸显了紧密耦合推理、搜索和生成对于可靠开放世界智能体图像合成的重要价值。

title: Emotion Diffusion Classifier with Adaptive Margin Discrepancy Training for Facial Expression Recognition
summary: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) is essential for human-machine interaction, as it enables machines to interpret human emotions and internal states from facial affective behaviors. Although deep learning has significantly advanced FER performance, most existing deep-learning-based FER methods rely heavily on discriminative classifiers for fast predictions. These models tend to learn shortcuts and are vulnerable to even minor distribution shifts. To address this issue, we adopt a conditional generative diffusion model and introduce the Emotion Diffusion Classifier (EmoDC) for FER, which demonstrates enhanced adversarial robustness. However, retraining EmoDC using standard strategies fails to penalize incorrect categorical descriptions, leading to suboptimal recognition performance. To improve EmoDC, we propose margin-based discrepancy training, which encourages accurate predictions when conditioned on correct categorical descriptions and penalizes predictions conditioned on mismatched ones. This method enforces a minimum margin between noise-prediction errors for correct and incorrect categories, thereby enhancing the model's discriminative capability. Nevertheless, using a fixed margin fails to account for the varying difficulty of noise prediction across different images, limiting its effectiveness. To overcome this limitation, we propose Adaptive Margin Discrepancy Training (AMDiT), which dynamically adjusts the margin for each sample. Extensive experiments show that AMDiT significantly improves the accuracy of EmoDC over the Base model with standard denoising diffusion training on the RAF-DB basic subset, the RAF-DB compound subset, SFEW-2.0, and AffectNet, in 100-step evaluations. Additionally, EmoDC outperforms state-of-the-art discriminative classifiers in terms of robustness against noise and blur.
tldr: This paper introduces the Emotion Diffusion Classifier (EmoDC) for Facial Expression Recognition, proposing an adaptive margin discrepancy training method to improve classification accuracy and robustness against noise and blur.
tldr_zh: 本文提出用于面部表情识别的情感扩散分类器，并引入自适应边界差异训练方法，以提高分类精度和对抗噪声与模糊的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 面部表情识别（FER）对于人机交互至关重要，它使机器能够通过面部情感行为解读人类的情绪和内在状态。尽管深度学习显著提升了FER的性能，但现有大多数基于深度学习的FER方法严重依赖判别式分类器以实现快速预测。这些模型往往倾向于学习捷径，并且即使面对微小的分布偏移也显得脆弱。为解决这一问题，我们采用条件生成扩散模型，并引入用于FER的情感扩散分类器（EmoDC），该模型展现出更强的对抗鲁棒性。然而，使用标准策略重新训练EmoDC未能有效惩罚错误的类别描述，导致识别性能不佳。为改进EmoDC，我们提出了基于边际的差异训练方法，该方法在基于正确类别描述进行条件生成时鼓励准确预测，同时惩罚基于错误类别描述的预测。这一方法在正确与错误类别的噪声预测误差之间强制执行最小边际，从而增强了模型的判别能力。然而，使用固定边际未能考虑到不同图像在噪声预测难度上的差异，限制了其有效性。为克服这一局限，我们提出了自适应边际差异训练（AMDiT），该方法能动态调整每个样本的边际。大量实验表明，在RAF-DB基础子集、RAF-DB复合子集、SFEW-2.0和AffectNet数据集上，通过100步评估，AMDiT显著提升了EmoDC在基于标准去噪扩散训练的基准模型上的准确率。此外，EmoDC在对抗噪声和模糊的鲁棒性方面优于当前最先进的判别式分类器。

title: Transmittance-Guided Structure-Texture Decomposition for Nighttime Image Dehazing
summary: Nighttime images captured under hazy conditions suffer from severe quality degradation, including low visibility, color distortion, and reduced contrast, caused by the combined effects of atmospheric scattering, absorption by suspended particles, and non-uniform illumination from artificial light sources. While existing nighttime dehazing methods have achieved partial success, they typically address only a subset of these issues, such as glow suppression or brightness enhancement, without jointly tackling the full spectrum of degradation factors. In this paper, we propose a two-stage nighttime image dehazing framework that integrates transmittance correction with structure-texture layered optimization. In the first stage, we introduce a novel transmittance correction method that establishes boundary-constrained initial transmittance maps and subsequently applies region-adaptive compensation and normalization based on whether image regions correspond to light source areas. A quadratic Gaussian filtering scheme operating in the YUV color space is employed to estimate the spatially varying atmospheric light map. The corrected transmittance map and atmospheric light map are then used in conjunction with an improved nighttime imaging model to produce the initial dehazed image. In the second stage, we propose a STAR-YUV decomposition model that separates the dehazed image into structure and texture layers within the YUV color space. Gamma correction and MSRCR-based color restoration are applied to the structure layer for illumination compensation and color bias correction, while Laplacian-of-Gaussian filtering is applied to the texture layer for detail enhancement. A novel two-phase fusion strategy, comprising nonlinear Retinex-based fusion of the enhanced layers followed by linear blending with the initial dehazing result, yields the final output.
tldr: This paper proposes a two-stage framework for nighttime image dehazing, which first corrects transmittance and atmospheric light, and then decomposes the image for structure enhancement and texture detail recovery.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种夜间图像去雾的两阶段框架，首先校正透射率和大气光，然后对图像进行分解以实现结构增强和纹理细节恢复。
summary_zh: 在雾霾条件下拍摄的夜间图像会受到大气散射、悬浮颗粒吸收以及人造光源非均匀照明的综合影响，导致严重的质量退化，具体表现为可见度低、色彩失真和对比度下降。现有的夜间去雾方法虽已取得部分成效，但通常仅针对这些问题中的某一子集（如光晕抑制或亮度增强）进行处理，未能联合解决全范围的退化因素。本文提出了一种两阶段夜间图像去雾框架，将透射率校正与结构-纹理分层优化相结合。第一阶段，我们引入了一种新颖的透射率校正方法：首先建立边界约束的初始透射率图，随后根据图像区域是否对应光源区域进行区域自适应补偿和归一化处理。通过在YUV色彩空间中应用二次高斯滤波方案，估计空间变化的大气光图。校正后的透射率图与大气光图结合改进的夜间成像模型，生成初始去雾图像。第二阶段，我们提出STAR-YUV分解模型，将去雾图像在YUV色彩空间内分解为结构层和纹理层。对结构层采用伽马校正和基于MSRCR的色彩恢复进行光照补偿和色彩偏差校正，同时对纹理层应用拉普拉斯-高斯滤波以实现细节增强。通过新颖的两阶段融合策略——包括基于非线性Retinex的增强层融合及与初始去雾结果的线性混合——最终得到输出图像。

title: EarthEmbeddingExplorer: A Web Application for Cross-Modal Retrieval of Global Satellite Images
summary: While the Earth observation community has witnessed a surge in high-impact foundation models and global Earth embedding datasets, a significant barrier remains in translating these academic assets into freely accessible tools. This tutorial introduces EarthEmbeddingExplorer, an interactive web application designed to bridge this gap, transforming static research artifacts into dynamic, practical workflows for discovery. We will provide a comprehensive hands-on guide to the system, detailing its cloud-native software architecture, demonstrating cross-modal queries (natural language, visual, and geolocation), and showcasing how to derive scientific insights from retrieval results. By democratizing access to precomputed Earth embeddings, this tutorial empowers researchers to seamlessly transition from state-of-the-art models and data archives to real-world application and analysis. The web application is available at https://modelscope.ai/studios/Major-TOM/EarthEmbeddingExplorer.
tldr: This paper introduces a web application for cross-modal retrieval of satellite images, allowing users to query using natural language, visual examples, and geolocation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于卫星图像跨模态检索的Web应用程序，允许用户通过自然语言、视觉示例和地理位置进行查询。
summary_zh: 尽管地球观测领域已涌现出大量高影响力的基础模型与全球地球嵌入数据集，但如何将这些学术资产转化为可自由访问的工具仍存在显著障碍。本教程介绍EarthEmbeddingExplorer——一款旨在弥合此鸿沟的交互式网络应用程序，它将静态研究成果转化为动态实用的探索工作流。我们将提供该系统的完整实践指南，详细阐述其云原生软件架构，演示跨模态查询（自然语言、视觉与地理定位），并展示如何从检索结果中提取科学见解。通过对预计算地球嵌入数据实现普惠化访问，本教程助力研究者无缝衔接前沿模型、数据档案与真实世界的应用分析。该网络应用程序可通过https://modelscope.ai/studios/Major-TOM/EarthEmbeddingExplorer访问。

title: Seeing the Evidence, Missing the Answer: Tool-Guided Vision-Language Models on Visual Illusions
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit a systematic bias when confronted with classic optical illusions: they overwhelmingly predict the illusion as "real" regardless of whether the image has been counterfactually modified. We present a tool-guided inference framework for the DataCV 2026 Challenge (Tasks I and II) that addresses this failure mode without any model training. An off-the-shelf vision-language model is given access to a small set of generic image manipulation tools: line drawing, region cropping, side-by-side comparison, and channel isolation, together with an illusion-type-routing system prompt that prescribes which tools to invoke for each perceptual question category. Critically, every tool call produces a new, immutable image resource appended to a persistent registry, so the model can reference and compose any prior annotated view throughout its reasoning chain. Rather than hard-coding illusion-specific modules, this generic-tool-plus-routing design yields strong cross-structural generalization: performance remained consistent from the validation set to a test set containing structurally unfamiliar illusion variants (e.g., Mach Bands rotated from vertical to horizontal stacking). We further report three empirical observations that we believe warrant additional investigation: (i) a strong positive-detection bias likely rooted in imbalanced illusion training data, (ii) a striking dissociation between pixel-accurate spatial reasoning and logical inference over self-generated annotations, and (iii) pronounced sensitivity to image compression artifacts that compounds false positives.
tldr: This paper introduces a tool-guided inference framework for vision-language models to address their systematic bias in handling optical illusions, using generic image manipulation tools without training, but does not explicitly involve robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于视觉语言模型的工具引导推理框架，旨在解决其在处理光学幻觉时的系统性偏见，使用通用的图像处理工具而无需训练，但未明确涉及机器人或具身AI。
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型在处理经典光学幻觉图像时表现出一种系统性偏差：无论图像是否经过反事实修改，它们都倾向于将幻觉预测为"真实"。本文提出一种面向DataCV 2026挑战赛（任务一与任务二）的工具引导推理框架，该框架无需任何模型训练即可解决此类失效问题。我们为现成的视觉语言模型配备了一套通用图像处理工具集：线条绘制、区域裁剪、并排对比和通道分离，同时配合幻觉类型路由系统提示，该系统提示会为每个感知问题类别指定应调用的工具。关键在于，每次工具调用都会生成新的、不可变的图像资源并附加至持久化注册表中，使得模型在推理链中可随时引用和组合任何先前标注的视图。与硬编码特定幻觉处理模块不同，这种"通用工具+路由"的设计实现了强大的跨结构泛化能力：从验证集到包含结构未知幻觉变体（例如从垂直堆叠旋转为水平堆叠的马赫带）的测试集，模型性能保持稳定。我们进一步报告了三个值得深入研究的实证发现：（一）可能源于训练数据不平衡的强烈阳性检测偏差；（二）像素级空间推理与基于自生成标注的逻辑推断之间存在的显著分离现象；（三）对图像压缩伪影的敏感度会加剧假阳性结果。

title: A2BFR: Attribute-Aware Blind Face Restoration
summary: Blind face restoration (BFR) aims to recover high-quality facial images from degraded inputs, yet its inherently ill-posed nature leads to ambiguous and uncontrollable solutions. Recent diffusion-based BFR methods improve perceptual quality but remain uncontrollable, whereas text-guided face editing enables attribute manipulation without reliable restoration. To address these issues, we propose A$^2$BFR, an attribute-aware blind face restoration framework that unifies high-fidelity reconstruction with prompt-controllable generation. Built upon a Diffusion Transformer backbone with unified image-text cross-modal attention, A$^2$BFR jointly conditions the denoising trajectory on both degraded inputs and textual prompts. To inject semantic priors, we introduce attribute-aware learning, which supervises denoising latents using facial attribute embeddings extracted by an attribute-aware encoder. To further enhance prompt controllability, we introduce semantic dual-training, which leverages the pairwise attribute variations in our newly curated AttrFace-90K dataset to enforce attribute discrimination while preserving fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that A$^2$BFR achieves state-of-the-art performance in both restoration fidelity and instruction adherence, outperforming diffusion-based BFR baselines by -0.0467 LPIPS and +52.58% attribute accuracy, while enabling fine-grained, prompt-controllable restoration even under severe degradations.
tldr: This paper proposes A2BFR, an attribute-aware blind face restoration framework that uses a Diffusion Transformer and cross-modal attention to jointly condition on degraded inputs and textual prompts for high-fidelity, controllable face image restoration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了A2BFR，一种属性感知的盲脸复原框架，它基于扩散Transformer和跨模态注意力，联合以退化输入和文本提示为条件，实现高保真、可控的人脸图像复原。
summary_zh: 盲人脸恢复（BFR）旨在从质量退化的输入中恢复高质量的人脸图像，但其固有的不适定性导致解决方案存在模糊性和不可控性。当前基于扩散模型的BFR方法虽提升了感知质量，但仍缺乏可控性；而文本引导的人脸编辑虽能实现属性操控，却难以保证可靠的恢复效果。针对这些问题，我们提出A$^2$BFR——一种属性感知的盲人脸恢复框架，它将高保真重建与提示可控生成相结合。该框架以扩散Transformer为骨干网络，通过统一的图像-文本跨模态注意力机制，使去噪过程同时受退化输入和文本提示的双重约束。为注入语义先验，我们引入属性感知学习，利用属性感知编码器提取的面部属性嵌入对去噪隐变量进行监督。为进一步增强提示可控性，我们提出语义双训练策略，通过在新构建的AttrFace-90K数据集中利用成对属性差异，在保持保真度的同时强化属性判别能力。大量实验表明，A$^2$BFR在恢复保真度和指令遵循性方面均达到最先进水平，其LPIPS指标优于扩散基BFR基线0.0467，属性准确率提升52.58%，即使在严重退化条件下也能实现细粒度的提示可控恢复。

title: AA-Splat: Anti-Aliased Feed-forward Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (FF-3DGS) emerges as a fast and robust solution for sparse-view 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis (NVS). However, existing FF-3DGS methods are built on incorrect screen-space dilation filters, causing severe rendering artifacts when rendering at out-of-distribution sampling rates. We firstly propose an FF-3DGS model, called AA-Splat, to enable robust anti-aliased rendering at any resolution. AA-Splat utilizes an opacity-balanced band-limiting (OBBL) design, which combines two components: a 3D band-limiting post-filter integrates multi-view maximal frequency bounds into the feed-forward reconstruction pipeline, effectively band-limiting the resulting 3D scene representations and eliminating degenerate Gaussians; an Opacity Balancing (OB) to seamlessly integrate all pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives into the rendering process, compensating for the increased overlap between expanded Gaussian primitives. AA-Splat demonstrates drastic improvements with average 5.4$\sim$7.5dB PSNR gains on NVS performance over a state-of-the-art (SOTA) baseline, DepthSplat, at all resolutions, between $4\times$ and $1/4\times$. Code will be made available.
tldr: A method for improving anti-aliasing in feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for novel view synthesis, enabling robust rendering at any resolution with significant gains in image quality metrics.
tldr_zh: 一种用于改进前馈式3D高斯泼溅中抗锯齿的方法，可在任意分辨率下实现稳健渲染，并在图像质量指标上获得显著提升。
summary_zh: 前馈三维高斯喷洒（FF-3DGS）为稀疏视角三维重建和新视角合成（NVS）提供了一种快速且鲁棒的解决方案。然而，现有FF-3DGS方法基于不正确的屏幕空间扩张滤波器，在分布外采样率下渲染时会产生严重伪影。我们首次提出了一种名为AA-Splat的FF-3DGS模型，能够在任意分辨率下实现鲁棒的抗锯齿渲染。AA-Splat采用了一种不透明度平衡的带限设计，该设计包含两个核心组件：三维带限后滤波器将多视角最大频率约束整合到前馈重建流程中，有效对生成的三维场景表示进行带限处理并消除退化高斯分布；不透明度平衡模块则将所有像素对齐的高斯基元无缝集成到渲染过程中，补偿因扩展高斯基元间重叠度增加带来的影响。实验表明，AA-Splat在$4\times$至$1/4\times$的所有分辨率范围内，新视角合成性能相较当前最优基线方法DepthSplat实现了平均5.4$\sim$7.5dB的峰值信噪比提升。代码将公开提供。

title: FOSCU: Feasibility of Synthetic MRI Generation via Duo-Diffusion Models for Enhancement of 3D U-Nets in Hepatic Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation faces fundamental challenges including restricted access, costly annotation, and data shortage to clinical datasets through Picture Archiving and Communication Systems (PACS). These systemic barriers significantly impede the development of robust segmentation algorithms. To address these challenges, we propose FOSCU, which integrates Duo-Diffusion, a 3D latent diffusion model with ControlNet that simultaneously generates high-resolution, anatomically realistic synthetic MRI volumes and corresponding segmentation labels, and an enhanced 3D U-Net training pipeline. Duo-Diffusion employs segmentation-conditioned diffusion to ensure spatial consistency and precise anatomical detail in the generated data. Experimental evaluation on 720 abdominal MRI scans shows that models trained with combined real and synthetic data yield a mean Dice score gain of 0.67% over those using only real data, and achieve a 36.4% reduction in Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), reflecting enhanced image fidelity.
tldr: This paper proposes a method (FOSCU) using a 3D latent diffusion model (Duo-Diffusion) to generate synthetic MRI volumes and segmentation labels to augment medical image segmentation, improving Dice scores and FID in abdominal MRI scans.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法（FOSCU），使用三维潜在扩散模型（Duo-Diffusion）生成合成的MRI体积和分割标签，以增强医学图像分割任务，在腹部MRI扫描中提高了Dice分数并降低了FID。
summary_zh: 医学图像分割面临若干基础性挑战，包括通过影像归档与通信系统（PACS）获取临床数据受限、标注成本高昂以及数据短缺。这些系统性障碍严重制约了鲁棒分割算法的发展。为应对这些挑战，我们提出FOSCU框架，其核心整合了Duo-Diffusion模型与增强型3D U-Net训练流程。Duo-Diffusion是一种结合ControlNet的三维隐空间扩散模型，可同步生成高分辨率、解剖结构逼真的合成MRI体数据及其对应的分割标签。该模型采用分割条件引导的扩散机制，确保生成数据具有空间一致性与精确的解剖学细节。在720例腹部MRI扫描数据上的实验评估表明，采用真实与合成混合数据训练的模型相比仅使用真实数据的模型，平均Dice分数提升0.67%，同时Fréchet起始距离（FID）降低36.4%，反映出图像保真度的显著提升。

title: Monocular Building Height Estimation from PhiSat-2 Imagery: Dataset and Method
summary: Monocular building height estimation from optical imagery is important for urban morphology characterization but remains challenging due to ambiguous height cues, large inter-city variations in building morphology, and the long-tailed distribution of building heights. PhiSat-2 is a promising open-access data source for this task because of its global coverage, 4.75 m spatial resolution, and seven-band spectral observations, yet its potential has not been systematically evaluated. To address this gap, we construct a PhiSat-2-Height dataset (PHDataset) and propose a Two-Stream Ordinal Network (TSONet). PHDataset contains 9,475 co-registered image-label patch pairs from 26 cities worldwide. TSONet jointly models footprint segmentation and height estimation, and introduces a Cross-Stream Exchange Module (CSEM) and a Feature-Enhanced Bin Refinement (FEBR) module for footprint-aware feature interaction and ordinal height refinement. Experiments on PHDataset show that TSONet achieves the best overall performance, reducing MAE and RMSE by 13.2% and 9.7%, and improving IoU and F1-score by 14.0% and 10.1% over the strongest competing results. Ablation studies further verify the effectiveness of CSEM, FEBR, and the joint use of ordinal regression and footprint assistance. Additional analyses and patch-level comparison with publicly available building height products indicate that PhiSat-2 benefits monocular building height estimation through its balanced combination of building-relevant spatial detail and multispectral observations. Overall, this study confirms the potential of PhiSat-2 for monocular building height estimation and provides a dedicated dataset and an effective method for future research.
tldr: This paper introduces a new dataset (PHDataset) and a Two-Stream Ordinal Network (TSONet) for monocular building height estimation from satellite imagery, achieving state-of-the-art results on the new benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本研究为单目建筑物高度估计构建了一个新的卫星影像数据集（PHDataset）并提出了一种双流序数网络（TSONet），在该新基准上取得了最佳性能。
summary_zh: 单目光学影像的建筑高度估算对于城市形态表征具有重要意义，但由于高度线索模糊、城市间建筑形态差异显著及建筑高度分布的长尾特性，该任务仍面临挑战。PhiSat-2因其全球覆盖、4.75米空间分辨率及七波段光谱观测能力，成为该领域极具潜力的开源数据源，但其应用价值尚未得到系统评估。为此，本研究构建了PhiSat-2高度数据集（PHDataset），并提出了双流有序网络（TSONet）。PHDataset包含来自全球26个城市的9,475组配准后的影像-标签图斑对。TSONet同步建模建筑基底分割与高度估算，通过跨流交换模块（CSEM）和特征增强分级优化模块（FEBR）实现基底感知的特征交互与有序高度优化。在PHDataset上的实验表明，TSONet实现了最优综合性能，与最佳基线结果相比，平均绝对误差和均方根误差分别降低13.2%和9.7%，交并比与F1分数提升14.0%和10.1%。消融实验进一步验证了CSEM、FEBR以及有序回归与基底辅助联合策略的有效性。与公开建筑高度产品的对比分析表明，PhiSat-2通过兼顾建筑空间细节与多光谱观测的平衡特性，显著提升了单目建筑高度估算性能。本研究证实了PhiSat-2在单目建筑高度估算中的潜力，并为后续研究提供了专用数据集与有效方法。

title: CT-to-X-ray Distillation Under Tiny Paired Cohorts: An Evidence-Bounded Reproducible Pilot Study
summary: Chest X-ray and computed tomography (CT) provide complementary views of thoracic disease, yet most computer-aided diagnosis models are trained and deployed within a single imaging modality. The concrete question studied here is narrower and deployment-oriented: on a patient-level paired chest cohort, can CT act as training-only supervision for a binary disease versus non-disease X-ray classifier without requiring CT at inference time? We study this setting as a cross-modality teacher--student distillation problem and use JDCNet as an executable pilot scaffold rather than as a validated superior architecture. On the original patient-level paired split from a public paired chest imaging cohort, a stripped-down plain cross-modal logit-KD control attains the highest mean result on the four-image validation subset (0.875 accuracy and 0.714 macro-F1), whereas the full module-augmented JDCNet variant remains at 0.750 accuracy and 0.429 macro-F1. To test whether that ranking is a split artifact, we additionally run eight patient-level Monte Carlo resamples with same-case comparisons, stronger mechanism controls based on attention transfer and feature hints, and imbalance-sensitive analyses. Under this resampled protocol, late fusion attains the highest mean accuracy (0.885), same-modality distillation attains the highest mean macro-F1 (0.554) and balanced accuracy (0.660), the plain cross-modal control drops to 0.500 mean balanced accuracy, and neither attention transfer nor feature hints recover a robust cross-modality advantage. The contribution of this study is therefore not a validated CT-to-X-ray architecture, but a reproducible and evidence-bounded pilot protocol that makes the exact task definition, failure modes, ranking instability, and the minimum requirements for future credible CT-to-X-ray transfer claims explicit.
tldr: This paper explores CT-to-X-ray distillation for medical imaging diagnosis, focusing on cross-modality teacher-student distillation and reproducible pilot protocols, without direct application to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本论文研究用于医学影像诊断的CT到X射线蒸馏，专注于跨模态师生蒸馏和可重复的试点协议，与机器人或具身AI无直接关联。
summary_zh: 胸部X光与计算机断层扫描（CT）为胸部疾病提供了互补的视角，但大多数计算机辅助诊断模型仅在单一成像模态中进行训练与部署。本研究聚焦于一个更具体且面向实际应用的问题：在患者层面配对的胸部影像队列中，能否仅使用CT作为训练监督信号，构建一个二分类（疾病与非疾病）的X光分类器，且无需在推理阶段使用CT？我们将此问题视为跨模态师生蒸馏任务，并采用JDCNet作为可执行试点框架，而非已验证的优越架构。在公开配对胸部影像数据集原有的患者级别配对划分中，简化的纯跨模态对数知识蒸馏对照组在四张图像的验证子集上获得最高平均结果（准确率0.875，宏平均F1分数0.714），而完整模块增强的JDCNet变体仅达到0.750准确率与0.429宏平均F1分数。为验证该排序是否源于划分偏差，我们额外进行了八次患者级别的蒙特卡洛重采样实验，包含同病例对比、基于注意力迁移与特征提示的更强机制控制，以及针对不平衡数据的敏感性分析。在此重采样方案下，晚期融合获得最高平均准确率（0.885），同模态蒸馏获得最高平均宏平均F1分数（0.554）与平衡准确率（0.660），而纯跨模态对照组的平均平衡准确率降至0.500，且注意力迁移与特征提示均未能恢复稳定的跨模态优势。因此，本研究的贡献并非提出一种已验证的CT至X光迁移架构，而是建立了一套可复现且证据充分的试点方案，明确了任务定义、失效模式、排序不稳定性，以及未来可信的CT至X光迁移研究所需满足的最低要求。

title: LA-Sign: Looped Transformers with Geometry-aware Alignment for Skeleton-based Sign Language Recognition
summary: Skeleton-based isolated sign language recognition (ISLR) demands fine-grained understanding of articulated motion across multiple spatial scales, from subtle finger movements to global body dynamics. Existing approaches typically rely on deep feed-forward architectures, which increase model capacity but lack mechanisms for recurrent refinement and structured representation. We propose LA-Sign, a looped transformer framework with geometry-aware alignment for ISLR. Instead of stacking deeper layers, LA-Sign derives its depth from recurrence, repeatedly revisiting latent representations to progressively refine motion understanding under shared parameters. To further regularise this refinement process, we present a geometry-aware contrastive objective that projects skeletal and textual features into an adaptive hyperbolic space, encouraging multi-scale semantic organisation. We study three looping designs and multiple geometric manifolds, demonstrating that encoder-decoder looping combined with adaptive Poincare alignment yields the strongest performance. Extensive experiments on WLASL and MSASL benchmarks show that LA-Sign achieves state-of-the-art results while using fewer unique layers, highlighting the effectiveness of recurrent latent refinement and geometry-aware representation learning for sign language recognition.
tldr: The paper proposes a looped transformer framework with a geometry-aware contrastive objective for skeleton-based sign language recognition, focusing on recurrent refinement of motion understanding in hyperbolic spaces.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于基于骨架的孤立手语识别的循环Transformer框架，通过几何感知的对比目标在双曲空间中渐进细化运动理解。
summary_zh:
摘要：
基于骨架的孤立手语识别（ISLR）需要从细微的手指动作到整体身体动态，在多个空间尺度上实现对关节运动的精细理解。现有方法通常依赖深度前馈架构，这些架构虽提升了模型容量，却缺乏循环优化和结构化表征的机制。本文提出LA-Sign，一种用于ISLR的、具有几何感知对齐能力的循环Transformer框架。LA-Sign不再通过堆叠更深层来获取深度，而是通过循环机制衍生深度，在共享参数下反复访问潜在表征以逐步优化运动理解。为进一步规范这一优化过程，我们提出了一种几何感知对比学习目标，将骨架特征与文本特征映射到自适应双曲空间，促进多尺度语义组织。我们研究了三种循环设计及多种几何流形，证明编码器-解码器循环结构与自适应庞加莱对齐结合能实现最优性能。在WLASL和MSASL基准上的大量实验表明，LA-Sign在使用更少独立层数的同时取得了最先进的性能，凸显了循环潜在优化与几何感知表征学习在手语识别中的有效性。

title: Aligning Validation with Deployment: Target-Weighted Cross-Validation for Spatial Prediction
summary: Cross-validation (CV) is commonly used to estimate predictive risk when independent test data are unavailable. Its validity depends on the assumption that validation tasks are sampled from the same distribution as prediction tasks encountered during deployment. In spatial prediction and other settings with structured data, this assumption is frequently violated, leading to biased estimates of deployment risk. We propose Target-Weighted CV (TWCV), an estimator of deployment risk that accounts for discrepancies between validation and deployment task distributions, thus accounting for (1) covariate shift and (2) task-difficulty shift. We characterize prediction tasks by descriptors such as covariates and spatial configuration. TWCV assigns weights to validation losses such that the weighted empirical distribution of validation tasks matches the corresponding distribution over a target domain. The weights are obtained via calibration weighting, yielding an importance-weighted estimator that targets deployment risk. Since TWCV requires adequate coverage of the deployment distribution's support, we combine it with spatially buffered resampling that diversifies the task difficulty distribution. In a simulation study, conventional as well as spatial estimators exhibit substantial bias depending on sampling, whereas buffered TWCV remains approximately unbiased across scenarios. A case study in environmental pollution mapping further confirms that discrepancies between validation and deployment task distributions can affect performance assessment, and that buffered TWCV better reflects the prediction task over the target domain. These results establish task distribution mismatch as a primary source of CV bias in spatial prediction and show that calibration weighting combined with a suitable validation task generator provides a viable approach to estimating predictive risk under dataset shift.
tldr: Proposes Target-Weighted Cross-Validation (TWCV), a method for estimating predictive risk in spatial prediction that accounts for covariate and task-difficulty shifts between validation and deployment data.
tldr_zh: 提出目标加权交叉验证（TWCV），一种用于空间预测中估计预测风险的方法，该方法考虑了验证和部署数据之间的协变量和任务难度偏移。
summary_zh: 交叉验证（CV）常用于在独立测试数据不可得时估计预测风险。其有效性依赖于验证任务采样自与部署期间遇到的预测任务相同分布这一假设。在空间预测及其他具有结构化数据的场景中，这一假设常不成立，导致部署风险的估计出现偏差。我们提出目标加权交叉验证（TWCV）——一种能够考虑验证任务与部署任务分布差异的部署风险估计器，从而兼顾（1）协变量偏移与（2）任务难度偏移。我们通过协变量和空间配置等描述符来刻画预测任务。TWCV通过对验证损失赋予权重，使验证任务的加权经验分布与目标域上的对应分布相匹配。这些权重通过校准加权法获得，从而得到一个以部署风险为目标的加权估计量。由于TWCV要求充分覆盖部署分布的支持域，我们将其与空间缓冲区重采样方法相结合，以提升任务难度分布的多样性。在一项模拟研究中，传统估计器及空间估计器均因采样方式不同而表现出显著偏差，而带缓冲区的TWCV在所有场景中均保持近似无偏。一项环境污染制图的案例研究进一步证实，验证任务与部署任务分布之间的差异会影响性能评估，而带缓冲区的TWCV能更好地反映目标域上的预测任务。这些研究结果表明，任务分布不匹配是空间预测中交叉验证偏差的主要来源，同时也证明校准加权与恰当的验证任务生成器相结合，能够为数据集偏移下的预测风险估计提供可行方案。

title: Do covariates explain why these groups differ? The choice of reference group can reverse conclusions in the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition
summary: Scientists often want to explain why an outcome is different in two groups. For instance, differences in patient mortality rates across two hospitals could be due to differences in the patients themselves (covariates) or differences in medical care (outcomes given covariates). The Oaxaca--Blinder decomposition (OBD) is a standard tool to tease apart these factors. It is well known that the OBD requires choosing one of the groups as a reference, and the numerical answer can vary with the reference. To the best of our knowledge, there has not been a systematic investigation into whether the choice of OBD reference can yield different substantive conclusions and how common this issue is. In the present paper, we give existence proofs in real and simulated data that the OBD references can yield substantively different conclusions and that these differences are not entirely driven by model misspecification or small data. We prove that substantively different conclusions occur in up to half of the parameter space, but find these discrepancies rare in the real-data analyses we study. We explain this empirical rarity by examining how realistic data-generating processes can be biased towards parameters that do not change conclusions under the OBD.
tldr: This paper analyzes the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition, a statistical method for explaining group differences, and shows how the choice of reference group can lead to different substantive conclusions.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了用于解释群体差异的统计方法——Oaxaca-Blinder分解，并展示了参考组的选择如何导致不同的实质性结论。
summary_zh: 科学家们常常希望解释两个群体间的结果为何不同。例如，两家医院的患者死亡率差异可能源于患者自身特征（协变量）的差异，也可能源于医疗护理（给定协变量后的结果）的差异。Oaxaca--Blinder分解（OBD）是区分这些因素的标准工具。众所周知，OBD需要选择其中一个群体作为参照组，而数值结果会随参照组的选择而变化。据我们所知，目前尚未有系统研究探讨OBD参照组的选择是否会导致不同的实质性结论，以及该问题的普遍程度。本文通过真实数据和模拟数据的存在性证明，表明OBD参照组的选择可能产生实质性不同的结论，且这些差异不完全由模型设定错误或小样本数据所致。我们证明在高达一半的参数空间中会出现实质性不同的结论，但在所研究的真实数据分析中，这些矛盾却较为罕见。我们通过考察现实数据生成过程如何偏向于那些在OBD下不会改变结论的参数，解释了这种实证上的罕见性。

title: Think Anywhere in Code Generation
summary: Recent advances in reasoning Large Language Models (LLMs) have primarily relied on upfront thinking, where reasoning occurs before final answer. However, this approach suffers from critical limitations in code generation, where upfront thinking is often insufficient as problems' full complexity only reveals itself during code implementation. Moreover, it cannot adaptively allocate reasoning effort throughout the code generation process where difficulty varies significantly. In this paper, we propose Think-Anywhere, a novel reasoning mechanism that enables LLMs to invoke thinking on-demand at any token position during code generation. We achieve Think-Anywhere by first teaching LLMs to imitate the reasoning patterns through cold-start training, then leveraging outcome-based RL rewards to drive the model's autonomous exploration of when and where to invoke reasoning. Extensive experiments on four mainstream code generation benchmarks (i.e., LeetCode, LiveCodeBench, HumanEval, and MBPP) show that Think-Anywhere achieves state-of-the-art performance over both existing reasoning methods and recent post-training approaches, while demonstrating consistent generalization across diverse LLMs. Our analysis further reveals that Think-Anywhere enables the model to adaptively invoke reasoning at high-entropy positions, providing enhanced interpretability.
tldr: This paper introduces Think-Anywhere, a method for LLMs to perform on-demand reasoning at any point during code generation, achieving SOTA results on coding benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Think-Anywhere方法，使大语言模型能在代码生成过程中随时进行推理，在主流代码生成基准测试中取得了最优性能。
summary_zh: 近期大型语言模型在推理方面的进展主要依赖于前期思考，即在最终答案生成前进行推理。然而，这种方法在代码生成中存在明显缺陷，因为前期思考往往不足以应对问题在代码实现过程中才完全显现的复杂性。此外，它无法根据代码生成过程中显著变化的难度，自适应地分配推理资源。本文提出了一种名为“Think-Anywhere”的新型推理机制，使大型语言模型能在代码生成过程中的任意标记位置按需调用推理功能。我们通过冷启动训练教会模型模仿推理模式，再利用基于结果的强化学习奖励驱动模型自主探索何时何地调用推理，从而实现了Think-Anywhere机制。在四个主流代码生成基准测试（LeetCode、LiveCodeBench、HumanEval和MBPP）上的大量实验表明，该方法在性能上超越了现有推理方法和最新后训练技术，同时在不同大型语言模型上展现出稳定的泛化能力。进一步分析表明，Think-Anywhere能使模型在高熵值位置自适应地触发推理，从而提供更强的可解释性。

title: Real-Time Explanations for Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Interpretability is central for scientific machine learning, as understanding \emph{why} models make predictions enables hypothesis generation and validation. While tabular foundation models show strong performance, existing explanation methods like SHAP are computationally expensive, limiting interactive exploration. We introduce ShapPFN, a foundation model that integrates Shapley value regression directly into its architecture, producing both predictions and explanations in a single forward pass. On standard benchmarks, ShapPFN achieves competitive performance while producing high-fidelity explanations ($R^2$=0.96, cosine=0.99) over 1000\times faster than KernelSHAP (0.06s vs 610s). Our code is available at https://github.com/kunumi/ShapPFN
tldr: This paper introduces ShapPFN, a tabular foundation model that integrates Shapley value estimation into its architecture to provide real-time explanations alongside predictions, significantly speeding up the interpretability process.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ShapPFN，一个将沙普利值估计集成到架构中的表格基础模型，可同时提供预测和实时解释，极大加速了可解释性过程。
summary_zh: 可解释性是科学机器学习的核心，因为理解模型进行预测的深层原因能够促进假设生成与验证。尽管表格基础模型展现出强大的性能，但现有解释方法如SHAP的计算成本高昂，限制了交互式探索的可行性。我们提出ShapPFN基础模型，该架构将沙普利值回归直接集成到模型中，能在单次前向传播中同时生成预测与解释。在标准基准测试中，ShapPFN在保持竞争力的性能表现的同时，能以超过KernelSHAP千倍的速度（0.06秒对比610秒）生成高保真度解释（$R^2$=0.96，余弦相似度=0.99）。相关代码已发布于https://github.com/kunumi/ShapPFN。

title: Task Scarcity and Label Leakage in Relational Transfer Learning
summary: Training relational foundation models requires learning representations that transfer across tasks, yet available supervision is typically limited to a small number of prediction targets per database. This task scarcity causes learned representations to encode task-specific shortcuts that degrade transfer even within the same schema, a problem we call label leakage. We study this using K-Space, a modular architecture combining frozen pretrained tabular encoders with a lightweight message-passing core. To suppress leakage, we introduce a gradient projection method that removes label-predictive directions from representation updates. On RelBench, this improves within-dataset transfer by +0.145 AUROC on average, often recovering near single-task performance. Our results suggest that limited task diversity, not just limited data, constrains relational foundation models.
tldr: This paper studies the problem of 'label leakage' in relational transfer learning, where limited task supervision leads to task-specific shortcuts in learned representations that harm generalization. It proposes a gradient projection method to suppress this leakage and improve within-database transfer performance for relational foundation models.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了关系迁移学习中的'标签泄漏'问题，即有限的任务监督导致学习到的表征包含任务特异性捷径，损害泛化能力。它提出了一种梯度投影方法来抑制这种泄漏，提高关系基础模型在数据库内部的迁移性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：
关系型基础模型的训练需要学习能跨任务迁移的表示，但现有监督通常仅限于每个数据库中的少量预测目标。这种任务稀缺性导致学习到的表示编码了任务特定的捷径，即使在相同模式内也会削弱迁移效果，这一问题我们称之为标签泄漏。我们通过K-Space架构对此进行研究，该模块化架构将预训练的冻结表格编码器与轻量级消息传递核心相结合。为抑制标签泄漏，我们引入了一种梯度投影方法，可从表示更新中消除标签预测方向。在RelBench基准测试中，该方法平均将数据集内部迁移性能提升+0.145 AUROC，常能恢复接近单任务性能的水平。研究结果表明，制约关系型基础模型的因素不仅是有限的数据量，任务多样性的不足同样构成关键限制。

title: Curvature-Guided LoRA: Steering in the pretrained NTK subspace
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA enable efficient adaptation of large pretrained models but often fall short of full fine-tuning performance. Existing approaches focus on aligning parameter updates, which only indirectly control model predictions. In this work, we introduce the prediction alignment problem, aiming to match the predictor obtained via PEFT to that of full fine-tuning at the level of outputs. We show that this objective naturally leads to a curvature-aware, second-order formulation, where optimal low-rank updates correspond to a Newton-like, curvature-whitened gradient. Based on this insight, we propose Curvature-Guided LoRA (CG-LoRA), which selects and scales adaptation directions using local curvature information. Our method is computationally efficient and avoids explicit second-order matrix construction. Preliminary experiments on standard natural language understanding benchmarks demonstrate improved performance and faster convergence compared to existing LoRA variants.
tldr: The paper introduces a curvature-aware LoRA variant for parameter-efficient fine-tuning that aligns model predictions to full fine-tuning performance, tested on NLP benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于参数高效微调的曲率感知LoRA变体，通过对齐模型预测实现全微调性能，并在自然语言理解基准上进行了测试。
summary_zh:
摘要：
参数高效微调方法（如LoRA）能够高效适配大型预训练模型，但往往难以达到完全微调的性能水平。现有方法主要关注参数更新的对齐，这仅能间接控制模型预测结果。本研究提出了预测对齐问题，旨在通过参数高效微调获得的预测器与完全微调在输出层面实现匹配。我们证明该目标自然导出了一个曲率感知的二阶优化公式，其中最优低秩更新对应于牛顿式曲率白化梯度。基于此发现，我们提出曲率引导的LoRA方法（CG-LoRA），该方法利用局部曲率信息对适配方向进行选择和缩放。我们的计算框架具有高效性，且无需显式构建二阶矩阵。在标准自然语言理解基准上的初步实验表明，相较于现有LoRA变体，该方法实现了性能提升与更快的收敛速度。

title: Loss Gap Parity for Fairness in Heterogeneous Federated Learning
summary: While clients may join federated learning to improve performance on data they rarely observe locally, they often remain self-interested, expecting the global model to perform well on their own data. This motivates an objective that ensures all clients achieve a similar loss gap -the difference in performance between the global model and the best model they could train using only their local data-. To this end, we propose EAGLE, a novel federated learning algorithm that explicitly regularizes the global model to minimize disparities in loss gaps across clients. Our approach is particularly effective in heterogeneous settings, where the optimal local models of the clients may be misaligned. Unlike existing methods that encourage loss parity, potentially degrading performance for many clients, EAGLE targets fairness in relative improvements. We provide theoretical convergence guarantees for EAGLE under non-convex loss functions, and characterize how its iterates perform relative to the standard federated learning objective using a novel heterogeneity measure. Empirically, we demonstrate that EAGLE reduces the disparity in loss gaps among clients by prioritizing those furthest from their local optimal loss, while maintaining competitive utility in both convex and non-convex cases compared to strong baselines.
tldr: The paper proposes EAGLE, a novel federated learning algorithm that aims to ensure fairness among clients by minimizing disparities in the 'loss gap' (the difference between the global model's performance and the best local model's performance) rather than enforcing equal loss, particularly in heterogeneous data settings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的联邦学习算法EAGLE，该算法旨在通过最小化客户端间'损失差距'（全局模型性能与最佳本地模型性能之差）的差异来确保公平性，特别是在异构数据环境中，而不是强制实现相等的损失。
summary_zh: 尽管客户端加入联邦学习旨在提升其在本地罕见数据上的性能，但通常仍以自身利益为出发点，期望全局模型在其自身数据上表现优异。这促使我们设立一个目标，即确保所有客户端获得相似的损失差距——即全局模型与仅使用其本地数据可训练的最佳模型之间的性能差异。为此，我们提出EAGLE，一种新颖的联邦学习算法，该算法通过显式正则化全局模型，以最小化客户端间损失差距的不均衡性。我们的方法在异构环境下尤为有效，因为在这种环境下，客户端的最优本地模型可能存在错位。与现有方法不同——那些方法鼓励损失平等，却可能导致许多客户端的性能下降——EAGLE聚焦于相对改进的公平性。我们在非凸损失函数下为EAGLE提供了理论收敛保证，并利用一种新颖的异质性度量，描述了其迭代过程相对于标准联邦学习目标的表现。实证研究表明，通过优先考虑那些距离其本地最优损失最远的客户端，EAGLE能有效减少客户端间损失差距的差异，同时在凸和非凸情境下，与强基准模型相比，保持具有竞争力的实用性能。

title: AMShortcut: An Inference- and Training-Efficient Inverse Design Model for Amorphous Materials
summary: Amorphous materials are solids that lack long-range atomic order but possess complex short- and medium-range order. Unlike crystalline materials that can be described by unit cells containing few up to hundreds of atoms, amorphous materials require larger simulation cells with at least hundreds or often thousands of atoms. Inverse design of amorphous materials with probabilistic generative models aims to generate the atomic positions and elements of amorphous materials given a set of desired properties. It has emerged as a promising approach for facilitating the application of amorphous materials in domains such as energy storage and thermal management. In this paper, we introduce AMShortcut, an inference- and training-efficient probabilistic generative model for amorphous materials. AMShortcut enables accurate inference of diverse short- and medium-range structures in amorphous materials with only a few sampling steps, mitigating the need for an excessive number of sampling steps that hinders inference efficiency. AMShortcut can be trained once with all relevant properties and perform inference conditioned on arbitrary combinations of desired properties, mitigating the need for training one model for each combination. Experiments on three amorphous materials datasets with diverse structures and properties demonstrate that AMShortcut achieves its design goals.
tldr: This paper introduces AMShortcut, a probabilistic generative model for the inverse design of amorphous materials, focusing on efficient inference and training to generate atomic structures from desired material properties.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AMShortcut，一种用于非晶材料逆向设计的概率生成模型，专注于高效推理和训练，以根据所需材料属性生成原子结构。
summary_zh: 非晶态材料是缺乏长程原子有序性但具有复杂中短程有序结构的固体。与仅需数至数百个原子即可描述晶胞的晶体材料不同，非晶材料需要包含至少数百甚至数千个原子的更大规模模拟体系。基于概率生成模型的非晶材料逆向设计方法，旨在根据目标物性集合生成相应的原子位置与元素排布，已成为推动非晶材料在能源存储与热管理等领域应用的前沿研究方向。本文提出AMShortcut——一种推理高效且训练经济的非晶材料概率生成模型。该模型仅需少数采样步骤即可精确推断非晶材料中多样化的中短程结构，有效克服了传统方法因采样步骤过多导致的推理效率瓶颈。AMShortcut通过一次训练即可涵盖所有相关物性，并能在任意目标物性组合条件下进行推理，无需针对不同物性组合重复训练模型。在三个具有不同结构与物性的非晶材料数据集上的实验验证表明，AMShortcut成功实现了其设计目标。

title: Multimodal Machine Learning for Early Prediction of Metastasis in a Swedish Multi-Cancer Cohort
summary: Multimodal Machine Learning offers a holistic view of a patient's status, integrating structured and unstructured data from electronic health records (EHR). We propose a framework to predict metastasis risk one month prior to diagnosis, using six months of clinical history from EHR data. Data from four cancer cohorts collected at Karolinska University Hospital (Stockholm, Sweden) were analyzed: breast (n = 743), colon (n = 387), lung (n = 870), and prostate (n = 1890). The dataset included demographics, comorbidities, laboratory results, medications, and clinical text. We compared traditional and deep learning classifiers across single modalities and multimodal combinations, using various fusion strategies and a Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model for Individual Prognosis Or Diagnosis (TRIPOD) 2a design, with an 80-20 development-validation split to ensure a rigorous, repeatable evaluation. Performance was evaluated using AUROC, AUPRC, F1 score, sensitivity, and specificity. We then employed a multimodal adaptation of SHAP to analyze the classifiers' reasoning. Intermediate fusion achieved the highest F1 scores on breast (0.845), colon (0.786), and prostate cancer (0.845), demonstrating strong predictive performance. For lung cancer, the intermediate fusion achieved an F1 score of 0.819, while the text-only model achieved the highest, with an F1 score of 0.829. Deep learning classifiers consistently outperformed traditional models. Colon cancer, the smallest cohort, had the lowest performance, highlighting the importance of sufficient training data. SHAP analysis showed that the relative importance of modalities varied across cancer types. Fusion strategies offer distinct strengths and weaknesses. Intermediate fusion consistently delivered the best results, but strategy choices should align with data characteristics and organizational needs.
tldr: The paper proposes a multimodal machine learning framework for predicting cancer metastasis risk using electronic health records, with no connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用电子健康记录预测癌症转移风险的多模态机器学习框架，与机器人学或具身智能无关。
summary_zh: 多模态机器学习通过整合电子健康记录（EHR）中的结构化与非结构化数据，为患者状态提供整体性视角。本研究提出一个框架，利用EHR中六个月的临床病史数据，在诊断前一个月预测转移风险。分析数据来自卡罗林斯卡大学医院（瑞典斯德哥尔摩）收集的四个癌症队列：乳腺癌（n=743）、结肠癌（n=387）、肺癌（n=870）和前列腺癌（n=1890）。数据集涵盖人口统计学特征、合并症、实验室结果、用药记录及临床文本。我们采用单模态与多模态组合方式，比较了传统机器学习与深度学习分类器的性能，并运用多种融合策略及符合TRIPOD 2a标准的透明报告框架，通过80-20的开发-验证分割确保严谨可重复的评估。性能指标包括AUROC、AUPRC、F1分数、敏感性与特异性。进一步采用多模态适配的SHAP方法解析分类器的决策逻辑。中间融合策略在乳腺癌（0.845）、结肠癌（0.786）和前列腺癌（0.845）中获得最高F1分数，展现出强劲的预测性能；在肺癌中，中间融合的F1分数为0.819，而纯文本模型达到最高值0.829。深度学习分类器始终优于传统模型。样本量最小的结肠癌队列性能最低，凸显了充足训练数据的重要性。SHAP分析表明，不同模态的相对重要性因癌症类型而异。各类融合策略各有优劣：中间融合整体表现最佳，但策略选择仍需结合数据特征与临床需求。

title: One-for-All: A Lightweight Stabilized and Parameter-Efficient Pre-trained LLM for Time Series Forecasting
summary: We address the challenge of adapting pre-trained Large Language Models (LLMs) for multivariate time-series analysis, where their deployment is often hindered by prohibitive computational and memory demands. Our solution, One-for-All, introduces Gaussian Rank-Stabilized Low-Rank Adapters (rsLoRA) to enable parameter-efficient fine-tuning of frozen LLMs. While inspired by LoRA, rsLoRA introduces a mathematically grounded rank-stabilization mechanism that enables provable gradient stability at low ranks a novel contribution absent in prior PEFT methods. Our framework injects trainable rank decomposition matrices (rank 16) into positional embeddings and output layers, while keeping self-attention weights fixed. This design reduces trainable parameters by 6.8$\times$ (vs. TimesNet), 21$\times$ (vs. GPT4TS), and 11.8$\times$ (vs. TIME-LLM), while achieving a 168-1,776$\times$ smaller memory footprint (2.2MiB vs. 340MiB-4.18GiB in SOTA models). Rigorous evaluation across six time-series tasks demonstrates that One-for-All achieves state-of-the-art efficiency-accuracy trade-offs: 5.5$\times$ higher parameter efficiency (MSE=5.50) than TimesNet and 21$\times$ better than GPT4TS, while matching their forecasting accuracy (MSE=0.33). The framework's stability is validated through consistent performance across diverse horizons (96-720 steps) and datasets (ETT, Weather, M3, M4), with 98.3% fewer parameters than conventional transformers. These advances enable deployment on edge devices for healthcare, finance, and environmental monitoring without compromising performance.
tldr: Proposes One-for-All, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method using rank-stabilized Low-Rank Adapters (rsLoRA) to adapt pre-trained LLMs for multivariate time-series forecasting, achieving high efficiency and accuracy.
tldr_zh: 提出了One-for-All，一种使用秩稳定低秩适配器（rsLoRA）的参数高效微调方法，将预训练大语言模型用于多元时间序列预测，实现了高效率和准确性。
summary_zh: 本文针对将预训练大语言模型（LLMs）适配于多元时间序列分析时所面临的挑战展开研究，该场景下模型部署常因极高的计算与内存需求而受阻。我们提出的解决方案——One-for-All框架，通过引入高斯秩稳定化低秩适配器（rsLoRA），实现了对冻结大语言模型的高效参数微调。尽管受LoRA启发，但rsLoRA提出了一种基于数学理论的秩稳定机制，能够在低秩条件下实现可证明的梯度稳定性，这是现有参数高效微调方法中尚未涉及的新贡献。该框架将可训练的秩分解矩阵（秩为16）注入位置嵌入和输出层，同时保持自注意力权重固定。此设计使可训练参数分别减少至TimesNet的1/6.8、GPT4TS的1/21和TIME-LLM的1/11.8，同时内存占用缩小168-1,776倍（2.2MiB对比当前最优模型的340MiB-4.18GiB）。在六项时间序列任务上的严格评估表明，One-for-All实现了最优的效率-精度平衡：其参数效率比TimesNet高5.5倍（MSE=5.50），比GPT4TS高21倍，同时保持与它们相当的预测精度（MSE=0.33）。该框架的稳定性通过在多种预测步长（96-720步）和数据集（ETT、Weather、M3、M4）上的一致性能得到验证，其参数量比传统Transformer模型减少98.3%。这些进展使得该框架能够在医疗健康、金融和环境监测等边缘设备上部署，且无需牺牲性能。

title: HyperKKL: Learning KKL Observers for Non-Autonomous Nonlinear Systems via Hypernetwork-Based Input Conditioning
summary: Kazantzis-Kravaris/Luenberger (KKL) observers are a class of state observers for nonlinear systems that rely on an injective map to transform the nonlinear dynamics into a stable quasi-linear latent space, from where the state estimate is obtained in the original coordinates via a left inverse of the transformation map. Current learning-based methods for these maps are designed exclusively for autonomous systems and do not generalize well to controlled or non-autonomous systems. In this paper, we propose two learning-based designs of neural KKL observers for non-autonomous systems whose dynamics are influenced by exogenous inputs. To this end, a hypernetwork-based framework ($HyperKKL$) is proposed with two input-conditioning strategies. First, an augmented observer approach ($HyperKKL_{obs}$) adds input-dependent corrections to the latent observer dynamics while retaining static transformation maps. Second, a dynamic observer approach ($HyperKKL_{dyn}$) employs a hypernetwork to generate encoder and decoder weights that are input-dependent, yielding time-varying transformation maps. We derive a theoretical worst-case bound on the state estimation error. Numerical evaluations on four nonlinear benchmark systems show that input conditioning yields consistent improvements in estimation accuracy over static autonomous maps, with an average symmetric mean absolute percentage error (SMAPE) reduction of 29% across all non-zero input regimes.
tldr: The paper introduces HyperKKL, a hypernetwork-based framework for learning KKL observers for non-autonomous nonlinear systems with two input-conditioning strategies, improving state estimation accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了HyperKKL，一种基于超网络的框架，用于学习非自主非线性系统的KKL观测器，采用两种输入调节策略，提高了状态估计的准确性。
summary_zh: Kazantzis-Kravaris/Luenberger (KKL) 观测器是一类针对非线性系统的状态观测器，其通过单射映射将非线性动力学转换至稳定的拟线性隐空间，再借助变换映射的左逆从该隐空间获取原始坐标下的状态估计值。当前基于学习方法的这类映射仅适用于自治系统，难以推广至受控或非自治系统。本文针对受外生输入影响动力学的非自治系统，提出了两种基于学习的神经KKL观测器设计。为此，我们提出了一个基于超网络的框架（HyperKKL），并采用两种输入条件化策略：首先，增强观测器方法（HyperKKL_obs）在保持静态变换映射的同时，对隐空间观测器动力学施加输入依赖性修正；其次，动态观测器方法（HyperKKL_dyn）利用超网络生成输入依赖的编码器与解码器权重，从而得到时变变换映射。我们推导了状态估计误差的理论最坏情况上界。在四个非线性基准系统上的数值实验表明，相较于静态自治映射，输入条件化策略能持续提升估计精度，在所有非零输入工况下平均对称平均绝对百分比误差（SMAPE）降低了29%。

title: Nonnegative Matrix Factorization in the Component-Wise L1 Norm for Sparse Data
summary: Nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF) approximates a nonnegative matrix, $X$, by the product of two nonnegative factors, $WH$, where $W$ has $r$ columns and $H$ has $r$ rows. In this paper, we consider NMF using the component-wise L1 norm as the error measure (L1-NMF), which is suited for data corrupted by heavy-tailed noise, such as Laplace noise or salt and pepper noise, or in the presence of outliers. Our first contribution is an NP-hardness proof for L1-NMF, even when $r=1$, in contrast to the standard NMF that uses least squares. Our second contribution is to show that L1-NMF strongly enforces sparsity in the factors for sparse input matrices, thereby favoring interpretability. However, if the data is affected by false zeros, too sparse solutions might degrade the model. Our third contribution is a new, more general, L1-NMF model for sparse data, dubbed weighted L1-NMF (wL1-NMF), where the sparsity of the factorization is controlled by adding a penalization parameter to the entries of $WH$ associated with zeros in the data. The fourth contribution is a new coordinate descent (CD) approach for wL1-NMF, denoted as sparse CD (sCD), where each subproblem is solved by a weighted median algorithm. To the best of our knowledge, sCD is the first algorithm for L1-NMF whose complexity scales with the number of nonzero entries in the data, making it efficient in handling large-scale, sparse data. We perform extensive numerical experiments on synthetic and real-world data to show the effectiveness of our new proposed model (wL1-NMF) and algorithm (sCD).
tldr: This paper proposes a novel nonnegative matrix factorization method using the L1 norm to handle sparse data with heavy-tailed noise and outliers, introducing a weighted variant and an efficient algorithm for large-scale sparse data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于L1范数的非负矩阵分解方法，用于处理稀疏数据和异常值，并引入加权变体及高效算法，以处理大规模稀疏数据集。
summary_zh: 非负矩阵分解（NMF）通过两个非负因子矩阵 $WH$ 的乘积来近似一个非负矩阵 $X$，其中 $W$ 有 $r$ 列，$H$ 有 $r$ 行。本文研究了以分量L1范数作为误差度量（L1-NMF）的NMF，该方法适用于受重尾噪声（如拉普拉斯噪声或椒盐噪声）污染的或存在异常值的数据。我们的第一个贡献在于证明了L1-NMF即使在 $r=1$ 时也属于NP难题，这与使用最小二乘法的标准NMF形成对比。第二个贡献是证明了L1-NMF对稀疏输入矩阵能强烈增强因子的稀疏性，从而提升模型的可解释性。然而，如果数据受虚假零值影响，过度稀疏的分解可能降低模型性能。我们的第三个贡献是提出了一种新的、更通用的针对稀疏数据的L1-NMF模型——加权L1-NMF（wL1-NMF），该模型通过对与数据中零值对应的 $WH$ 条目施加惩罚参数来控制分解的稀疏度。第四个贡献是提出了一种针对wL1-NMF的坐标下降法（CD），称为稀疏坐标下降法（sCD），其中每个子问题通过加权中位数算法求解。据我们所知，sCD是首个计算复杂度随数据中非零条目数量线性增长的L1-NMF算法，可高效处理大规模稀疏数据。我们在合成数据和真实数据上进行了大量数值实验，验证了新模型（wL1-NMF）与算法（sCD）的有效性。

title: The Geometry of Polynomial Group Convolutional Neural Networks
summary: We study polynomial group convolutional neural networks (PGCNNs) for an arbitrary finite group $G$. In particular, we introduce a new mathematical framework for PGCNNs using the language of graded group algebras. This framework yields two natural parametrizations of the architecture, based on Hadamard and Kronecker products, related by a linear map. We compute the dimension of the associated neuromanifold, verifying that it depends only on the number of layers and the size of the group. We also describe the general fiber of the Kronecker parametrization up to the regular group action and rescaling, and conjecture the analogous description for the Hadamard parametrization. Our conjecture is supported by explicit computations for small groups and shallow networks.
tldr: This paper presents a mathematical framework for analyzing polynomial group convolutional neural networks, focusing on their architecture parametrization and the dimension of the associated neuromanifold.
tldr_zh: 本文为多项式群卷积神经网络提出了一个数学框架，重点研究其架构参数化和相关神经流形的维度。
summary_zh: 我们研究针对任意有限群$G$的多项式群卷积神经网络（PGCNNs）。特别地，我们引入了一种新的基于分次群代数语言的PGCNNs数学框架。该框架通过哈达玛积和克罗内克积构建了两种自然的参数化表示，两者之间通过线性映射相互关联。我们计算了对应的神经流形维度，并验证该维度仅取决于网络层数和群的大小。此外，我们描述了克罗内克参数化在正则群作用和缩放变换下的广义纤维结构，并对哈达玛参数化提出了类似的描述猜想。通过针对小群和浅层网络的具体计算，我们的猜想得到了支持。

title: Genetic algorithms for multi-omic feature selection: a comparative study in cancer survival analysis
summary: Multi-omic datasets offer opportunities for improved biomarker discovery in cancer research, but their high dimensionality and limited sample sizes make identifying compact and effective biomarker panels challenging. Feature selection in large-scale omics can be efficiently addressed by combining machine learning with genetic algorithms, which naturally support multi-objective optimization of predictive accuracy and biomarker set size. However, genetic algorithms remain relatively underexplored for multi-omic feature selection, where most approaches concatenate all layers into a single feature space. To address this limitation, we introduce Sweeping*, a multi-view, multi-objective algorithm alternating between single- and multi-view optimization. It employs a nested single-view multi-objective optimizer, and for this study we use the genetic algorithm NSGA3-CHS. It first identifies informative biomarkers within each layer, then jointly evaluates cross-layer interactions; these multi-omic solutions guide the next single-view search. Through repeated sweeps, the algorithm progressively identifies compact biomarker panels capturing cross-modal complementary signals. We benchmark five Sweeping* strategies, including hierarchical and concatenation-based variants, using survival prediction on three TCGA cohorts. Each strategy jointly optimizes predictive accuracy and set size, measured via the concordance index and root-leanness. Overall performance and estimation error are assessed through cross hypervolume and Pareto delta under 5-fold cross-validation. Our results show that Sweeping* can improve the accuracy-complexity trade-off when sufficient survival signal is present and that integrating omic layers can enhance survival prediction beyond clinical-only models, although benefits remain cohort-dependent.
tldr: The paper introduces Sweeping*, a multi-view, multi-objective genetic algorithm for feature selection in multi-omic cancer survival prediction, benchmarking it against other strategies using TCGA cohorts.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Sweeping*，一种用于多组学癌症生存预测中特征选择的多视角、多目标遗传算法，并使用TCGA队列对其与其他策略进行了基准测试。
summary_zh: 多组学数据集为癌症研究中的生物标志物发现提供了新的机遇，但其高维性与有限的样本量使得识别紧凑且有效的生物标志物组合面临挑战。通过将机器学习与遗传算法相结合，可以高效处理大规模组学数据中的特征选择问题，该方法天然支持预测准确性与生物标志物集规模的多目标优化。然而，遗传算法在多组学特征选择中应用仍相对不足，现有方法大多将所有数据层简单拼接为单一特征空间。为突破这一局限，我们提出Sweeping*算法——一种交替进行单视图与多视图优化的多视角多目标算法。该算法采用嵌套式单视图多目标优化器，本研究选用遗传算法NSGA3-CHS作为核心组件。其首先在各组学层内筛选信息性生物标志物，随后联合评估跨层交互作用，并利用这些多组学解指导下一轮单视图搜索。通过反复扫描，算法逐步识别出能够捕捉跨模态互补信号的紧凑型生物标志物组合。我们在三个TCGA队列的生存预测任务中，系统评估了包括分层式与拼接式变体在内的五种Sweeping*策略。所有策略均通过一致性指数与根精简度指标，同步优化预测准确性与特征集规模。采用交叉超体积与帕累托增量指标，通过五折交叉验证评估整体性能与估计误差。研究结果表明，在存在足够生存信号时，Sweeping*能够优化准确性与复杂度的平衡；尽管效果存在队列依赖性，但整合多组学数据层可提升单纯临床模型的生存预测能力。

title: Sampling at intermediate temperatures is optimal for training large language models in protein structure prediction
summary: We investigate the parameter space of transformer models trained on protein sequence data using a statistical mechanics framework, sampling the loss landscape at varying temperatures by Langevin dynamics to characterize the low-loss manifold and understand the mechanisms underlying the superior performance of transformers in protein structure prediction. We find that, at variance with feedforward networks, the lack of a first--order--like transition in the loss of the transformer produces a range of intermediate temperatures with good learning properties. We show that the parameters of most layers are highly conserved at these temperatures if the dimension of the embedding is optimal, and we provide an operative way to find this dimension. Finally, we show that the attention matrix is more predictive of the contact maps of the protein at higher temperatures and for higher dimensions of the embedding than those optimal for learning.
tldr: The paper applies a statistical mechanics framework to analyze transformer training for protein structure prediction, finding that sampling at intermediate temperatures yields optimal learning and that the attention matrix can better predict protein contact maps.
tldr_zh: 该论文应用统计力学框架分析用于蛋白质结构预测的Transformer模型训练，发现中间温度采样能实现最佳学习效果，且其注意力矩阵对蛋白质接触图的预测性更强。
summary_zh: 我们基于统计力学框架，研究了在蛋白质序列数据上训练的Transformer模型的参数空间。通过朗之万动力学在不同温度下对损失函数进行采样，以刻画低损失流形的特征，并理解Transformer在蛋白质结构预测中表现出优越性能的内在机制。研究发现，与全连接网络不同，Transformer的损失函数缺乏类一级相变，这导致其存在一个具有良好学习特性的中间温度区间。我们证明，在嵌入维度最优的情况下，这些温度下大多数网络层的参数高度保守，并提出了确定该最优维度的操作方法。最后，我们发现相较于学习最优的嵌入维度，在更高温度及更大嵌入维度下，注意力矩阵对蛋白质接触图的预测能力更强。

title: Variational Graph Neural Networks for Uncertainty Quantification in Inverse Problems
summary:
The increasingly wide use of deep machine learning techniques in computational mechanics has significantly accelerated simulations of problems that were considered unapproachable just a few years ago. However, in critical applications such as Digital Twins for engineering or medicine, fast responses are not enough; reliable results must also be provided. In certain cases, traditional deterministic methods may not be optimal as they do not provide a measure of confidence in their predictions or results, especially in inverse problems where the solution may not be unique or the initial data may not be entirely reliable due to the presence of noise, for instance. Classic deep neural networks also lack a clear measure to quantify the uncertainty of their predictions. In this work, we present a variational graph neural network (VGNN) architecture that integrates variational layers into its architecture to model the probability distribution of weights. Unlike computationally expensive full Bayesian networks, our approach strategically introduces variational layers exclusively in the decoder, allowing us to estimate cognitive uncertainty and statistical uncertainty at a relatively lower cost.
  In this work, we validate the proposed methodology in two cases of solid mechanics: the identification of the value of the elastic modulus with nonlinear distribution in a 2D elastic problem and the location and quantification of the loads applied to a 3D hyperelastic beam, in both cases using only the displacement field of each test as input data. The results show that the model not only recovers the physical parameters with high precision, but also provides confidence intervals consistent with the physics of the problem, as well as being able to locate the position of the applied load and estimate its value, giving a confidence interval for that experiment.
tldr: This paper introduces a variational graph neural network (VGNN) for estimating uncertainty in computational mechanics inverse problems, validated on tasks like identifying elastic modulus and locating loads in 2D/3D solid mechanics problems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种变分图神经网络（VGNN），用于计算力学逆问题中的不确定性量化，并在识别弹性模量和定位载荷等2D/3D固体力学问题中进行了验证。
summary_zh:
深度学习技术在计算力学领域的日益广泛应用，显著加速了那些仅在几年前还被认为难以处理的模拟问题。然而，在工程或医学数字孪生等关键应用中，仅依靠快速响应是远远不够的，还必须提供可靠的结果。在某些情况下，传统的确定性方法可能并非最优选择，因为它们无法提供对预测结果可信度的度量，尤其是在逆向问题中，由于噪声存在等因素，解可能不唯一或初始数据可能不完全可靠。经典深度神经网络同样缺乏明确的机制来量化预测的不确定性。本研究提出了一种变分图神经网络架构，通过在结构中引入变分层来建模权重的概率分布。与计算成本高昂的完全贝叶斯网络不同，我们的方法策略性地仅在解码器中引入变分层，从而能以相对较低的成本同时估计认知不确定性与统计不确定性。

在本研究中，我们通过两个固体力学案例验证了所提出的方法：在二维弹性问题中识别非线性分布的弹性模量值，以及通过三维超弹性梁的位移场数据确定载荷作用位置与量值。实验结果表明，该模型不仅能够高精度恢复物理参数，还能给出与问题物理特性相符的置信区间，同时准确定位外加载荷位置并估算其数值，为每个实验提供相应的置信区间。

title: Why not to use Cosine Similarity between Label Representations
summary: Cosine similarity is often used to measure the similarity of vectors. These vectors might be the representations of neural network models. However, it is not guaranteed that cosine similarity of model representations will tell us anything about model behaviour. In this paper we show that when using a softmax classifier, be it an image classifier or an autoregressive language model, measuring the cosine similarity between label representations (called unembeddings in the paper) does not give any information on the probabilities assigned by the model. Specifically, we prove that for any softmax classifier model, given two label representations, it is possible to make another model which gives the same probabilities for all labels and inputs, but where the cosine similarity between the representations is now either 1 or -1. We give specific examples of models with very high or low cosine simlarity between representations and show how to we can make equivalent models where the cosine similarity is now -1 or 1. This translation ambiguity can be fixed by centering the label representations, however, labels with representations with low cosine similarity can still have high probability for the same inputs. Fixing the length of the representations still does not give a guarantee that high(or low) cosine similarity will give high(or low) probability to the labels for the same inputs. This means that when working with softmax classifiers, cosine similarity values between label representations should not be used to explain model probabilities.
tldr: This paper proves that the cosine similarity between label representations (unembeddings) in a softmax classifier (e.g., image or language models) provides no information about the model's output probabilities, as an equivalent model can be constructed with the similarity arbitrarily set to 1 or -1.
tldr_zh: 本文证明，对于softmax分类器，标签表示（解嵌入）之间的余弦相似度无法提供模型输出概率的任何信息，因为可以构造一个等价的模型，使其相似度任意变为1或-1。
summary_zh: 余弦相似度常被用于衡量向量间的相似性。这些向量可能是神经网络模型的表征。然而，模型表征的余弦相似度是否能反映模型行为并未得到保证。本文证明，当使用softmax分类器（无论是图像分类器还是自回归语言模型）时，测量标签表征（文中称为非嵌入向量）间的余弦相似度并不能提供关于模型分配概率的任何信息。具体而言，我们证明对于任意softmax分类器模型，给定两个标签表征，总可以构造另一个模型，使其对所有标签和输入保持完全相同的概率分布，但此时标签表征间的余弦相似度可被任意设置为1或-1。我们通过具体示例展示了具有极高或极低余弦相似度的表征模型，并演示如何构建与之等效但余弦相似度变为-1或1的模型。虽然通过中心化标签表征可以消除这种平移歧义，但表征间余弦相似度较低的标签仍可能对相同输入具有高概率。即使固定表征长度，仍无法保证高（或低）余弦相似度会使标签对相同输入具有高（或低）概率。这表明在处理softmax分类器时，不应基于标签表征间的余弦相似度来解释模型概率分布。

title: Survival In-Context: Prior-fitted In-context Learning Tabular Foundation Model for Survival Analysis
summary: Survival analysis is crucial for many medical applications but remains challenging for modern machine learning due to limited data, censoring, and the heterogeneity of tabular covariates. While the prior-fitted paradigm, which relies on pretraining models on large collections of synthetic datasets, has recently facilitated tabular foundation models for classification and regression, its suitability for time-to-event modeling remains unclear. We propose a flexible survival data generation framework that defines a rich survival prior with explicit control over covariates and time-event distributions. Building on this prior, we introduce Survival In-Context (SIC), a prior-fitted in-context learning model for survival analysis that is pretrained exclusively on synthetic data. SIC produces individualized survival prediction in a single forward pass, requiring no task-specific training or hyperparameter tuning. Across a broad evaluation on real-world survival datasets, SIC achieves competitive or superior performance compared to classical and deep survival models, particularly in medium-sized data regimes, highlighting the promise of prior-fitted foundation models for survival analysis. The code will be made available upon publication.
tldr: This paper proposes a survival analysis foundation model pretrained on synthetic tabular data using in-context learning, which achieves competitive performance on real-world medical datasets without task-specific training.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种在合成表格数据上预训练的生存分析基础模型，该模型使用上下文学习，在真实世界医学数据集上无需任务特定训练即可达到有竞争力的性能。
summary_zh: 生存分析对于许多医学应用至关重要，但由于数据有限、截尾现象以及表格协变量的异质性，其对现代机器学习仍具挑战性。虽然基于预训练模型的先验拟合范式最近在分类和回归任务上推动了表格基础模型的发展，但该方法在时间-事件建模中的适用性尚不明确。我们提出了一种灵活的生存数据生成框架，该框架定义了一个丰富的生存先验，并允许对协变量和时间-事件分布进行显式控制。基于此先验，我们提出了生存上下文学习模型，这是一种专为生存分析设计的先验拟合式上下文学习模型，完全通过合成数据进行预训练。该模型在单次前向传播中即可生成个体化生存预测，无需任务特定训练或超参数调优。在一系列真实世界生存数据集上的广泛评估中，该模型相较于经典和深度生存模型展现出竞争性乃至更优的性能，尤其在中等规模数据场景下表现突出，凸显了先验拟合基础模型在生存分析中的潜力。代码将在论文发表后公开提供。

title: From Big Data to Fast Data: Towards High-Quality Datasets for Machine Learning Applications from Closed-Loop Data Collection
summary:
The increasing capabilities of machine learning models, such as vision-language and multimodal language models, are placing growing demands on data in automotive systems engineering, making the quality and relevance of collected data enablers for the development and validation of such systems. Traditional Big Data approaches focus on large-scale data collection and offline processing, while Smart Data approaches improve data selection strategies but still rely on centralized and offline post-processing.
  This paper introduces the concept of Fast Data for automotive systems engineering. The approach shifts data selection and recording onto the vehicle as the data source. By enabling real-time, context-aware decisions on whether and which data should be recorded, data collection can be directly aligned with data quality objectives and collection strategies within a closed-loop. This results in datasets with higher relevance, improved coverage of critical scenarios, and increased information density, while at the same time reducing irrelevant data and associated costs. The proposed approach provides a structured foundation for designing data collection strategies that are aligned with the needs of modern machine learning algorithms. It supports efficient data acquisition and contributes to scalable and cost-effective ML development processes in automotive systems engineering.
tldr: The paper proposes a 'Fast Data' approach for automotive systems engineering, shifting data selection and recording to the vehicle for real-time, context-aware, closed-loop data collection to improve dataset quality and relevance for ML models.
tldr_zh: 本文针对汽车系统工程提出了一种'快速数据'方法，将数据选择和记录移至车辆端，实现实时、上下文感知的闭环数据采集，以提高机器学习模型数据集的质量和相关性。
summary_zh:
摘要：
随着视觉语言模型、多模态语言模型等机器学习模型能力的不断提升，汽车系统工程领域对数据的需求日益增长，这使得采集数据的质量与相关性成为此类系统开发与验证的关键推动因素。传统的大数据方法侧重于大规模数据采集与离线处理，而智能数据方法虽改进了数据选择策略，仍依赖于集中式离线的后处理机制。  
本文提出面向汽车系统工程的快速数据概念。该方法将数据选择与记录功能转移至作为数据源的车辆端，通过实时、上下文感知的决策机制判断何时以及何种数据需要被记录，从而使数据采集能够与数据质量目标和闭环内的采集策略直接对齐。这不仅能生成更具相关性、更好覆盖关键场景且信息密度更高的数据集，同时还能减少无关数据及其相关成本。所提出的方法为设计符合现代机器学习算法需求的数据采集策略提供了结构化基础，有助于实现高效的数据获取，并推动汽车系统工程中可扩展、高性价比的机器学习开发流程。

title: Forecast collapse of transformer-based models under squared loss in financial time series
summary: We study trajectory forecasting under squared loss for time series with weak conditional structure, using highly expressive prediction models. Building on the classical characterization of squared-loss risk minimization, we emphasize regimes in which the conditional expectation of future trajectories is effectively degenerate, leading to trivial Bayes-optimal predictors (flat for prices and zero for returns in standard financial settings).  In this regime, increased model expressivity does not improve predictive accuracy but instead introduces spurious trajectory fluctuations around the optimal predictor. These fluctuations arise from the reuse of noise and result in increased prediction variance without any reduction in bias.  This provides a process-level explanation for the degradation of Transformerbased forecasts on financial time series.  We complement these theoretical results with numerical experiments on high-frequency EUR/USD exchange rate data, analyzing the distribution of trajectory-level forecasting errors. The results show that Transformer-based models yield larger errors than a simple linear benchmark on a large majority of forecasting windows, consistent with the variance-driven mechanism identified by the theory.
tldr: This paper analyzes the failure of Transformer-based models for forecasting financial time series, showing that increased model expressivity leads to spurious fluctuations and higher error variance when the underlying data's conditional structure is weak.
tldr_zh: 该论文分析了Transformer模型在金融时间序列预测中的失败原因，表明当数据条件结构较弱时，模型表达能力的增强会导致虚假波动和更高的预测误差方差。
summary_zh: 摘要：本文针对弱条件结构的时间序列，在平方损失下研究轨迹预测问题，并采用高表达能力预测模型。基于平方损失风险最小化的经典理论框架，我们重点考察了未来轨迹条件期望实际上退化的情况，这导致贝叶斯最优预测器变得平凡（在标准金融场景中，价格预测趋于平坦，收益率预测趋于零）。在此状态下，模型表达能力的提升并不能改善预测精度，反而会围绕最优预测器引入虚假的轨迹波动。这些波动源于对噪声的重复利用，导致预测方差增加而偏差并未减少。这为Transformer模型在金融时间序列预测中性能下降的现象提供了过程层面的理论解释。我们通过对高频欧元/美元汇率数据进行数值实验，分析了轨迹层面预测误差的分布情况，以补充理论结果。实验表明，在绝大多数预测窗口上，基于Transformer模型的预测误差均大于简单线性基准模型，这与理论揭示的方差驱动机制相一致。

title: mtslearn: Machine Learning in Python for Medical Time Series
summary: Medical time-series data captures the dynamic progression of patient conditions, playing a vital role in modern clinical decision support systems. However, real-world clinical data is highly heterogeneous and inconsistently formatted. Furthermore, existing machine learning tools often have steep learning curves and fragmented workflows. Consequently, a significant gap remains between cutting-edge AI technologies and clinical application. To address this, we introduce mtslearn, an end-to-end integrated toolkit specifically designed for medical time-series data. First, the framework provides a unified data interface that automates the parsing and alignment of wide, long, and flat data formats. This design significantly reduces data cleaning overhead. Building on this, mtslearn provides a complete pipeline from data reading and feature engineering to model training and result visualization. Furthermore, it offers flexible interfaces for custom algorithms. Through a modular design, mtslearn simplifies complex data engineering tasks into a few lines of code. This significantly lowers the barrier to entry for clinicians with limited programming experience, empowering them to focus more on exploring medical hypotheses and accelerating the translation of advanced algorithms into real-world clinical practice. mtslearn is publicly available at https://github.com/PKUDigitalHealth/mtslearn.
tldr: mtslearn is a Python toolkit for end-to-end machine learning on medical time-series data, offering a unified data interface and modular pipeline to simplify clinical application of AI.
tldr_zh: mtslearn 是一个用于医学时间序列数据的端到端机器学习 Python 工具包，提供统一的数据接口和模块化流程，以简化临床 AI 应用。
summary_zh: 医学时间序列数据能够捕捉患者病情的动态变化进程，在现代临床决策支持系统中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，现实世界中的临床数据往往高度异构且格式不统一。此外，现有机器学习工具通常存在学习曲线陡峭、工作流程碎片化的问题，导致前沿人工智能技术与临床应用之间仍存在显著差距。为此，我们推出了mtslearn——一个专门针对医学时间序列数据设计的端到端集成工具包。该框架首先提供统一的数据接口，能够自动解析并对齐宽表、长表及扁平化数据格式，极大降低了数据清洗负担。在此基础上，mtslearn构建了从数据读取、特征工程到模型训练与结果可视化的完整流程，同时提供灵活的自定义算法接口。通过模块化设计，mtslearn将复杂的数据工程任务简化为数行代码，显著降低了编程经验有限的临床医生的使用门槛，使其能够更专注于医学假设的探索，推动先进算法向真实临床实践的转化。mtslearn已在https://github.com/PKUDigitalHealth/mtslearn开源发布。

title: PRISM: PRIor from corpus Statistics for topic Modeling
summary:
Topic modeling seeks to uncover latent semantic structure in text, with LDA providing a foundational probabilistic framework. While recent methods often incorporate external knowledge (e.g., pre-trained embeddings), such reliance limits applicability in emerging or underexplored domains. We introduce \textbf{PRISM}, a corpus-intrinsic method that derives a Dirichlet parameter from word co-occurrence statistics to initialize LDA without altering its generative process. Experiments on text and single cell RNA-seq data show that PRISM improves topic coherence and interpretability, rivaling models that rely on external knowledge. These results underscore the value of corpus-driven initialization for topic modeling in resource-constrained settings.
  Code is available at: https://github.com/shaham-lab/PRISM.
tldr: PRISM is a new topic modeling method that initializes LDA using corpus-intrinsic word co-occurrence statistics, improving topic coherence without external knowledge.
tldr_zh: PRISM 是一种新的主题建模方法，利用语料库内部的词共现统计来初始化 LDA，无需外部知识即可提升主题的一致性和可解释性。
summary_zh:
主题建模旨在揭示文本中的潜在语义结构，其中LDA提供了一个基础的概率框架。尽管现有方法常引入外部知识（如预训练嵌入），但这种依赖性限制了其在新兴或未充分探索领域中的适用性。本文提出了一种基于语料内部分析的方法\textbf{PRISM}，该方法通过词汇共现统计推导狄利克雷参数来初始化LDA，而不改变其生成过程。在文本和单细胞RNA测序数据上的实验表明，PRISM提升了主题一致性和可解释性，其效果与依赖外部知识的模型相当。这些结果强调了在资源受限环境下，采用语料驱动初始化对主题建模的重要价值。
代码发布于：https://github.com/shaham-lab/PRISM。

title: Causality-inspired Federated Learning for Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Graphs
summary: Federated Graph Learning (FGL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for decentralized training of graph neural networks while preserving data privacy. However, existing FGL methods are predominantly designed for static graphs and rely on parameter averaging or distribution alignment, which implicitly assume that all features are equally transferable across clients, overlooking both the spatial and temporal heterogeneity and the presence of client-specific knowledge in real-world graphs. In this work, we identify that such assumptions create a vicious cycle of spurious representation entanglement, client-specific interference, and negative transfer, degrading generalization performance in Federated Learning over Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Graphs (FSTG). To address this issue, we propose a novel causality-inspired framework named SC-FSGL, which explicitly decouples transferable causal knowledge from client-specific noise through representation-level interventions. Specifically, we introduce a Conditional Separation Module that simulates soft interventions through client conditioned masks, enabling the disentanglement of invariant spatio-temporal causal factors from spurious signals and mitigating representation entanglement caused by client heterogeneity. In addition, we propose a Causal Codebook that clusters causal prototypes and aligns local representations via contrastive learning, promoting cross-client consistency and facilitating knowledge sharing across diverse spatio-temporal patterns. Experiments on five diverse heterogeneity Spatio-Temporal Graph (STG) datasets show that SC-FSGL outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
tldr: The paper proposes a causality-inspired framework for federated learning on dynamic spatio-temporal graphs, focusing on decoupling transferable knowledge from client-specific noise, but it does not address robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于动态时空图联邦学习的因果启发框架，专注于解耦可迁移知识与客户端特定噪声，但未涉及机器人或具身人工智能。
summary_zh: 联邦图学习（FGL）作为一种在保护数据隐私的同时实现图神经网络去中心化训练的强大范式已逐渐兴起。然而，现有FGL方法主要针对静态图设计，依赖于参数平均或分布对齐技术，其隐含假设所有特征在客户端间具有同等可迁移性，忽视了现实图数据中存在的时空异质性以及客户端特定知识。本研究指出，这种假设会引发虚假表征纠缠、客户端特定干扰与负迁移的恶性循环，从而降低联邦动态时空图学习（FSTG）的泛化性能。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种新颖的因果启发框架SC-FSGL，该框架通过表征层面的干预机制，将可迁移的因果知识与客户端特定噪声进行显式解耦。具体而言，我们设计了条件分离模块，通过客户端条件掩码模拟软干预，从而将不变的时空因果因子与虚假信号分离，并缓解客户端异质性导致的表征纠缠问题。此外，我们提出了因果码本机制，通过聚类因果原型并结合对比学习对齐局部表征，以增强跨客户端一致性，促进多样化时空模式间的知识共享。在五个具有显著异质性的时空图数据集上的实验表明，SC-FSGL超越了现有最优方法的性能表现。

title: Scaled Gradient Descent for Ill-Conditioned Low-Rank Matrix Recovery with Optimal Sampling Complexity
summary: The low-rank matrix recovery problem seeks to reconstruct an unknown $n_1 \times n_2$ rank-$r$ matrix from $m$ linear measurements, where $m\ll n_1n_2$. This problem has been extensively studied over the past few decades, leading to a variety of algorithms with solid theoretical guarantees. Among these, gradient descent based non-convex methods have become particularly popular due to their computational efficiency. However, these methods typically suffer from two key limitations: a sub-optimal sample complexity of $O((n_1 + n_2)r^2)$ and an iteration complexity of $O(κ\log(1/ε))$ to achieve $ε$-accuracy, resulting in slow convergence when the target matrix is ill-conditioned. Here, $κ$ denotes the condition number of the unknown matrix. Recent studies show that a preconditioned variant of GD, known as scaled gradient descent (ScaledGD), can significantly reduce the iteration complexity to $O(\log(1/ε))$. Nonetheless, its sample complexity remains sub-optimal at $O((n_1 + n_2)r^2)$. In contrast, a delicate virtual sequence technique demonstrates that the standard GD in the positive semidefinite (PSD) setting achieves the optimal sample complexity $O((n_1 + n_2)r)$, but converges more slowly with an iteration complexity $O(κ^2 \log(1/ε))$. In this paper, through a more refined analysis, we show that ScaledGD achieves both the optimal sample complexity $O((n_1 + n_2)r)$ and the improved iteration complexity $O(\log(1/ε))$. Notably, our results extend beyond the PSD setting to general low-rank matrix recovery problem. Numerical experiments further validate that ScaledGD accelerates convergence for ill-conditioned matrices with the optimal sampling complexity.
