tldr: This paper introduces a refined analysis of the ScaledGD algorithm, demonstrating it achieves optimal sample complexity and fast iteration complexity for ill-conditioned low-rank matrix recovery, extending beyond the PSD setting to general cases.
tldr_zh: 本文对ScaledGD算法进行了更精细的分析，证明其在条件数较差的低秩矩阵恢复问题上，不仅实现了最优的样本复杂度，还保持了快速的迭代复杂度，且结果适用于一般场景，超越了原有的PSD设定。
summary_zh: 低秩矩阵恢复问题旨在从$m$个线性测量值中重构一个未知的$n_1 \times n_2$秩为$r$的矩阵，其中$m\ll n_1n_2$。在过去的几十年中，该问题得到了广泛研究，催生了多种具有坚实理论保证的算法。其中，基于梯度下降的非凸方法因其计算效率而备受关注。然而，这些方法通常存在两个关键局限：其样本复杂度为次优的$O((n_1 + n_2)r^2)$，且达到$ε$精度的迭代复杂度为$O(κ\log(1/ε))$，导致目标矩阵条件数较差时收敛缓慢。此处$κ$表示未知矩阵的条件数。近期研究表明，梯度下降的一种预条件变体——缩放梯度下降法（ScaledGD）——可将迭代复杂度显著降低至$O(\log(1/ε))$，但其样本复杂度仍为次优的$O((n_1 + n_2)r^2)$。相比之下，一种精妙的虚拟序列技术证明，在半正定（PSD）场景下标准梯度下降法可实现最优样本复杂度$O((n_1 + n_2)r)$，但收敛速度较慢，迭代复杂度为$O(κ^2 \log(1/ε))$。本文通过更精细的分析，证明缩放梯度下降法同时达到最优样本复杂度$O((n_1 + n_2)r)$和改善后的迭代复杂度$O(\log(1/ε))$。值得注意的是，我们的研究结果不仅适用于半正定场景，还扩展至一般低秩矩阵恢复问题。数值实验进一步验证了缩放梯度下降法能在最优采样复杂度下加速条件数较差矩阵的收敛。

title: Real-Time Surrogate Modeling for Fast Transient Prediction in Inverter-Based Microgrids Using CNN and LightGBM
summary: Real-time monitoring of inverter-based microgrids is essential for stability, fault response, and operational decision-making. However, electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations, required to capture fast inverter dynamics, are computationally intensive and unsuitable for real-time applications. This paper presents a data-driven surrogate modeling framework for fast prediction of microgrid behavior using convolutional neural networks (CNN) and Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM). The models are trained on a high-fidelity EMT digital twin dataset of a microgrid with ten distributed generators under eleven operating and disturbance scenarios, including faults, noise, and communication delays. A sliding-window method is applied to predict important system variables, including voltage magnitude, frequency, total active power, and voltage dip. The results show that model performance changes depending on the type of variable being predicted. The CNN demonstrates high accuracy for time-dependent signals such as voltage, with an $R^2$ value of 0.84, whereas LightGBM shows better performance for structured and disturbance-related variables, achieving an $R^2$ of 0.999 for frequency and 0.75 for voltage dip. A combined CNN+LightGBM model delivers stable performance across all variables. Beyond accuracy, the surrogate models also provide major improvements in computational efficiency. LightGBM achieves more than $1000\times$ speedup and runs faster than real time, while the hybrid model achieves over $500\times$ speedup with near real-time performance. These findings show that data-driven surrogate models can effectively represent microgrid dynamics. They also support real-time and faster-than-real-time predictions. As a result, they are well-suited for applications such as monitoring, fault analysis, and control in inverter-based power systems.
tldr: This paper proposes a data-driven surrogate modeling framework using CNN and LightGBM to predict the fast transient behavior of inverter-based microgrids, enabling real-time monitoring and control applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种使用CNN和LightGBM的数据驱动代理建模框架，用于预测逆变器微电网的快速暂态行为，以实现实时监控和控制应用。
summary_zh: 基于逆变器的微电网实时监测对稳定性、故障响应和运行决策至关重要。然而，为捕捉逆变器快速动态特性所需的电磁暂态仿真计算量大，不适用于实时应用。本文提出了一种数据驱动的替代建模框架，利用卷积神经网络和轻量梯度提升机实现对微电网行为的快速预测。模型基于包含十台分布式发电机的微电网高保真电磁暂态数字孪生数据集进行训练，该数据集涵盖十一种运行与扰动场景，包括故障、噪声和通信延迟。采用滑动窗口方法对关键系统变量进行预测，包括电压幅值、频率、总有功功率和电压暂降。结果表明，模型性能随预测变量类型而变化：卷积神经网络在电压等时变信号预测中表现出较高精度（R²值为0.84），而轻量梯度提升机在结构化及扰动相关变量上表现更优，频率预测R²值达0.999，电压暂降预测R²值为0.75。融合卷积神经网络与轻量梯度提升机的组合模型在所有变量上均表现出稳定性能。除精度优势外，替代模型在计算效率上也有显著提升：轻量梯度提升机实现超1000倍加速且快于实时运行，混合模型达到超500倍加速并具备近实时性能。研究表明，数据驱动的替代模型能有效表征微电网动态特性，支持实时及超实时预测，适用于基于逆变器的电力系统监控、故障分析与控制等应用场景。

title: The Thiomi Dataset: A Large-Scale Multimodal Corpus for Low-Resource African Languages
summary: We present the Thiomi Dataset, a large-scale multimodal corpus spanning ten African languages across four language families: Swahili, Kikuyu, Kamba, Kimeru, Luo, Maasai, Kipsigis, Somali (East Africa); Wolof (West Africa); and Fulani (West/Central Africa). The dataset contains over 601,000 approved sentence-level text annotations and over 385,000 audio recordings across nine languages, collected through a dedicated community data collection platform involving over 100 contributors. The Thiomi platform collected data for nine languages; Swahili data was supplemented with existing Common Voice recordings. A multi-tier quality assurance pipeline achieves 86-100% text approval rates for the six primary languages. To validate the dataset's utility, we train and evaluate ASR, MT, and TTS models, establishing baselines across all ten languages. Our best ASR system achieves 3.24% WER on Swahili (Common Voice), reducing prior academic SOTA from 8.3% to 3.24% (5.1 percentage point absolute, 61% relative reduction), and 4.3% WER on Somali. The dataset will be published on HuggingFace. We describe the collection platform, quality assurance workflows, and baseline experiments, and discuss implications for African language technology infrastructure.
tldr: The Thiomi Dataset is a large-scale multimodal corpus for ten low-resource African languages, with text and audio data, used for ASR, MT, and TTS tasks.
tldr_zh: Thiomi 数据集是一个用于十种低资源非洲语言的大规模多模态语料库，包含文本和音频数据，用于自动语音识别、机器翻译和文本转语音任务。
summary_zh: 我们推出Thiomi数据集，这是一个涵盖四个语系、十种非洲语言的大规模多模态语料库，包括：斯瓦希里语、基库尤语、坎巴语、基梅鲁语、卢奥语、马赛语、基普西吉斯语、索马里语（东非）；沃洛夫语（西非）；以及富拉尼语（西非/中非）。该数据集包含超过601,000条经审核的句子级文本标注和超过385,000条九种语言的音频录音，通过一个由超过100名贡献者参与的社区数据收集平台采集完成。Thiomi平台收集了九种语言的数据；斯瓦希里语数据则通过补充现有Common Voice录音进行增强。采用多层级质量保障流程，六种主要语言的文本审核通过率达到86%-100%。为验证数据集的实用性，我们训练并评估了自动语音识别、机器翻译和文本转语音模型，为所有十种语言建立了性能基线。我们最优的自动语音识别系统在斯瓦希里语（Common Voice）上实现了3.24%的词错误率，将先前学术研究的最佳水平从8.3%提升至3.24%（绝对降低5.1个百分点，相对降低61%），在索马里语上达到4.3%的词错误率。该数据集将在HuggingFace平台公开发布。本文详细描述了数据收集平台、质量保障流程与基线实验，并探讨其对非洲语言技术基础设施建设的意义。

title: Robust and Consistent Ski Rental with Distributional Advice
summary:
The ski rental problem is a canonical model for online decision-making under uncertainty, capturing the fundamental trade-off between repeated rental costs and a one-time purchase. While classical algorithms focus on worst-case competitive ratios and recent "learning-augmented" methods leverage point-estimate predictions, neither approach fully exploits the richness of full distributional predictions while maintaining rigorous robustness guarantees. We address this gap by establishing a systematic framework that integrates distributional advice of unknown quality into both deterministic and randomized algorithms.
  For the deterministic setting, we formalize the problem under perfect distributional prediction and derive an efficient algorithm to compute the optimal threshold-buy day. We provide a rigorous performance analysis, identifying sufficient conditions on the predicted distribution under which the expected competitive ratio (ECR) matches the classic optimal randomized bound. To handle imperfect predictions, we propose the Clamp Policy, which restricts the buying threshold to a safe range controlled by a tunable parameter. We show that this policy is both robust, maintaining good performance even with large prediction errors, and consistent, approaching the optimal performance as predictions become accurate.
  For the randomized setting, we characterize the stopping distribution via a Water-Filling Algorithm, which optimizes expected cost while strictly satisfying robustness constraints. Experimental results across diverse distributions (Gaussian, geometric, and bi-modal) demonstrate that our framework improves consistency significantly over existing point-prediction baselines while maintaining comparable robustness.
tldr: The paper proposes a new framework for the ski rental problem that uses full distributional predictions to improve online decision-making, offering both robust and consistent performance guarantees under perfect and imperfect predictions.
tldr_zh: 该论文为滑雪租赁问题提出了一个新框架，利用完整的分布预测来改进在线决策，在完美和不完美预测下都提供了鲁棒且一致的性能保证。
summary_zh:
滑雪租赁问题是研究不确定性下在线决策的一个经典模型，它刻画了重复租赁成本与一次性购买之间的根本权衡。经典算法聚焦于最坏情形下的竞争比分析，而近期兴起的“学习增强”方法则利用点估计预测进行优化，但二者均未能充分利用完整分布预测的丰富信息，同时保持严格的鲁棒性保证。本文构建了一个系统性的框架，以弥补这一空白：该框架将未知质量的分布性建议融入确定性算法和随机化算法中。

在确定性场景下，我们首先在完美分布预测的假设下形式化该问题，并推导出计算最优阈值购买日的高效算法。通过严格的性能分析，我们识别出预测分布需满足的充分条件——在这些条件下，期望竞争比（ECR）能够达到经典最优随机化算法的理论界。针对预测不完美的情况，我们提出了钳位策略，该策略通过可调参数将购买阈值限制在安全区间内。我们证明该策略兼具鲁棒性和一致性：即使存在较大预测误差时仍能保持良好性能，并在预测趋近准确时逼近最优性能。

在随机化场景中，我们通过注水算法刻画了停止分布的特性，该算法在严格满足鲁棒性约束的同时优化了期望成本。基于多种分布（高斯分布、几何分布及双峰分布）的实验结果表明，相较于现有的点预测基线方法，我们的框架在保持相当鲁棒性的同时，显著提升了算法的一致性。

title: Dummy-Aware Weighted Attack (DAWA): Breaking the Safe Sink in Dummy Class Defenses
summary: Adversarial robustness evaluation faces a critical challenge as new defense paradigms emerge that can exploit limitations in existing assessment methods. This paper reveals that Dummy Classes-based defenses, which introduce an additional "dummy" class as a safety sink for adversarial examples, achieve significantly overestimated robustness under conventional evaluation strategies like AutoAttack. The fundamental limitation stems from these attacks' singular focus on misleading the true class label, which aligns perfectly with the defense mechanism--successful attacks are simply captured by the dummy class. To address this gap, we propose Dummy-Aware Weighted Attack (DAWA), a novel evaluation method that simultaneously targets both the true label and dummy label with adaptive weighting during adversarial example synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DAWA effectively breaks this defense paradigm, reducing the measured robustness of a leading Dummy Classes-based defense from 58.61% to 29.52% on CIFAR-10 under l_infty perturbation (epsilon=8/255). Our work provides a more reliable benchmark for evaluating this emerging class of defenses and highlights the need for continuous evolution of robustness assessment methodologies.
tldr: This paper introduces a new attack method (DAWA) to evaluate the robustness of Dummy Classes-based adversarial defenses, which are shown to be overestimated by conventional evaluation strategies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的攻击方法（DAWA），用于评估基于虚拟类的对抗性防御鲁棒性，这些防御在传统评估策略下被高估了。
summary_zh: 随着能够利用现有评估方法局限性的新防御范式出现，对抗鲁棒性评估面临关键挑战。本文揭示，基于虚拟类别的防御方法通过引入额外“虚拟”类别作为对抗样本的安全接收池，在AutoAttack等传统评估策略下会获得显著高估的鲁棒性。这一根本局限性源于此类攻击仅聚焦于误导真实类别标签的特性，而该特性恰好与防御机制完美契合——成功的攻击仅会被虚拟类别捕获。为填补这一评估空白，我们提出虚拟类别感知加权攻击（DAWA），这是一种在对抗样本合成过程中通过自适应权重同时针对真实标签和虚拟标签的新型评估方法。大量实验表明，DAWA能有效突破此类防御范式：在CIFAR-10数据集上，针对领先的基于虚拟类别的防御方法，在l_infty扰动（epsilon=8/255）条件下，DAWA将测得的鲁棒性从58.61%显著降低至29.52%。本研究为评估这类新兴防御范式提供了更可靠的基准，并强调了鲁棒性评估方法需要持续演进的重要性。

title: Realistic Market Impact Modeling for Reinforcement Learning Trading Environments
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for trading, yet most open-source backtesting environments assume negligible or fixed transaction costs, causing agents to learn trading behaviors that fail under realistic execution. We introduce three Gymnasium-compatible trading environments -- MACE (Market-Adjusted Cost Execution) stock trading, margin trading, and portfolio optimization -- that integrate nonlinear market impact models grounded in the Almgren-Chriss framework and the empirically validated square-root impact law. Each environment provides pluggable cost models, permanent impact tracking with exponential decay, and comprehensive trade-level logging. We evaluate five DRL algorithms (A2C, PPO, DDPG, SAC, TD3) on the NASDAQ-100, comparing a fixed 10 bps baseline against the AC model with Optuna-tuned hyperparameters. Our results show that (i) the cost model materially changes both absolute performance and the relative ranking of algorithms across all three environments; (ii) the AC model produces dramatically different trading behavior, e.g., daily costs dropping from $200k to $8k with turnover falling from 19% to 1%; (iii) hyperparameter optimization is essential for constraining pathological trading, with costs dropping up to 82%; and (iv) algorithm-cost model interactions are strongly environment-specific, e.g., DDPG's OOS Sharpe jumps from -2.1 to 0.3 under AC in margin trading while SAC's drops from -0.5 to -1.2. We release the full suite as an open-source extension to FinRL-Meta.
tldr: The paper introduces new Gymnasium-compatible trading environments with realistic market impact models, showing that the choice of cost model significantly affects DRL algorithm performance and trading behavior in financial applications.
tldr_zh: 该论文引入了具有真实市场影响模型的Gymnasium兼容交易环境，展示了成本模型的选择显著影响金融应用中深度强化学习算法的表现和交易行为。
summary_zh: 强化学习在交易领域展现出潜力，但大多数开源回测环境假设交易成本可忽略或固定，导致智能体在真实执行条件下难以维持所学的交易策略。本文提出三个与Gymnasium兼容的交易环境——MACE（市场调整成本执行）股票交易、保证金交易和投资组合优化——这些环境整合了基于Almgren-Chriss框架的非线性市场冲击模型，以及经过实证验证的平方根冲击定律。每个环境均提供可插拔的成本模型、具有指数衰减特性的永久冲击跟踪功能，以及完整的交易级日志记录。我们在纳斯达克100指数上评估了五种深度强化学习算法（A2C、PPO、DDPG、SAC、TD3），将固定10个基点的基准成本模型与通过Optuna超参数调优的AC模型进行对比。结果表明：（1）成本模型显著改变了所有三个环境中的绝对性能表现和算法相对排名；（2）AC模型产生了截然不同的交易行为，例如日交易成本从20万美元降至8千美元，换手率从19%下降至1%；（3）超参数优化对约束异常交易行为至关重要，最高可降低82%的成本；（4）算法与成本模型的交互具有强烈的环境特异性，例如在保证金交易中，DDPG算法的样本外夏普比率从-2.1跃升至0.3，而SAC算法的夏普比率则从-0.5下降至-1.2。我们将完整环境套件作为FinRL-Meta的开源扩展进行发布。

title: PolarQuant: Optimal Gaussian Weight Quantization via Hadamard Rotation for LLM Compression
summary: We present PolarQuant, a post-training weight quantization method for large language models (LLMs) that exploits the distributional structure of neural network weights to achieve near-lossless compression. PolarQuant operates in three stages: (1) block-wise normalization to the unit hypersphere, (2) Walsh-Hadamard rotation to transform coordinates into approximately Gaussian random variables, and (3) quantization with centroids matched to the Gaussian distribution. Our ablation reveals that Hadamard rotation alone accounts for 98% of the quality improvement, reducing Qwen3.5-9B perplexity from 6.90 (absmax Q5) to 6.40 (Delta = +0.03 from FP16), making it practically lossless without any calibration data. Furthermore, PolarQuant functions as an effective preprocessing step for downstream INT4 quantizers: PolarQuant Q5 dequantized and re-quantized by torchao INT4 achieves perplexity 6.56 versus 6.68 for direct absmax INT4, while maintaining 43.1 tok/s throughput at 6.5 GB VRAM. Code and models are publicly available.
tldr: PolarQuant is a novel post-training quantization method for LLMs that uses Walsh-Hadamard rotations to achieve near-lossless compression, significantly improving model efficiency without calibration data.
tldr_zh: PolarQuant是一种新颖的LLM后训练量化方法，通过Walsh-Hadamard旋转实现接近无损的压缩，显著提升模型效率，无需校准数据。
summary_zh: 本文提出PolarQuant——一种针对大语言模型的训练后权重量化方法，该方法通过利用神经网络权重的分布结构实现接近无损的压缩。PolarQuant包含三个阶段：（1）对单位超球面进行块级归一化，（2）通过沃尔什-哈达玛变换将坐标转换为近似高斯随机变量，（3）采用与高斯分布匹配的质心进行量化。消融实验表明，仅哈达玛变换就贡献了98%的质量提升，将Qwen3.5-9B的困惑度从6.90（absmax Q5）降低至6.40（较FP16仅增加0.03），在无需任何校准数据的情况下实现近乎无损的量化。此外，PolarQuant可作为下游INT4量化器的有效预处理步骤：经PolarQuant Q5反量化后通过torchao INT4重新量化的模型困惑度为6.56，而直接使用absmax INT4量化的困惑度为6.68，同时保持43.1 tok/s的推理速度与6.5 GB的显存占用。代码与模型已开源发布。

title: An Empirical Recipe for Universal Phone Recognition
summary: Phone recognition (PR) is a key enabler of multilingual and low-resource speech processing tasks, yet robust performance remains elusive. Highly performant English-focused models do not generalize across languages, while multilingual models underutilize pretrained representations. It also remains unclear how data scale, architecture, and training objective contribute to multilingual PR. We present PhoneticXEUS -- trained on large-scale multilingual data and achieving state-of-the-art performance on both multilingual (17.7% PFER) and accented English speech (10.6% PFER). Through controlled ablations with evaluations across 100+ languages under a unified scheme, we empirically establish our training recipe and quantify the impact of SSL representations, data scale, and loss objectives. In addition, we analyze error patterns across language families, accented speech, and articulatory features. All data and code are released openly.
tldr: The paper presents PhoneticXEUS, a state-of-the-art model for multilingual phone recognition, trained on large-scale data, and provides an empirical analysis of factors like SSL representations, data scale, and loss objectives impacting its performance across 100+ languages.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了PhoneticXEUS，一个在大规模多语言数据上训练、在超过100种语言上取得最先进性能的通用音素识别模型，并实证分析了SSL表示、数据规模和损失目标等因素的影响。
summary_zh:
摘要：
电话语音识别是推动多语言及低资源语音处理任务的关键技术，但其鲁棒性能始终难以实现。以英语为核心的高性能模型难以跨语言泛化，而多语言模型又未能充分利用预训练表征。同时，数据规模、模型架构与训练目标如何影响多语言电话语音识别仍不明确。我们提出PhoneticXEUS模型——该模型基于大规模多语言数据训练，在多语言识别（17.7% PFER）及带口音英语语音识别（10.6% PFER）上均达到当前最优性能。通过统一评估框架下对百余种语言进行的可控消融实验，我们实证确立了训练方案，并量化了自监督学习表征、数据规模与损失函数的影响。此外，我们还系统分析了跨语系、带口音语音及发音特征的错误模式。所有数据与代码均已开源发布。

title: Minimum Norm Interpolation via The Local Theory of Banach Spaces: The Role of $2$-Uniform Convexity
summary: The minimum-norm interpolator (MNI) framework has recently attracted considerable attention as a tool for understanding generalization in overparameterized models, such as neural networks. In this work, we study the MNI under a $2$-uniform convexity assumption, which is weaker than requiring the norm to be induced by an inner product, and it typically does not admit a closed-form solution. At a high level, we show that this condition yields an upper bound on the MNI bias in both linear and nonlinear models. We further show that this bound is sharp for overparameterized linear regression when the unit ball of the norm is in isotropic (or John's) position, and the covariates are isotropic, symmetric, i.i.d. sub-Gaussian, such as vectors with i.i.d. Bernoulli entries. Finally, under the same assumption on the covariates, we prove sharp generalization bounds for the $\ell_p$-MNI when $p \in \bigl(1 + C/\log d, 2\bigr]$. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to establish sharp bounds for non-Gaussian covariates in linear models when the norm is not induced by an inner product. This work is deeply inspired by classical works on $K$-convexity, and more modern work on the geometry of 2-uniform and isotropic convex bodies.
tldr: This theoretical paper analyzes the generalization properties of minimum-norm interpolators (MNI) in overparameterized models, establishing sharp bounds under 2-uniform convexity and non-Gaussian covariates.
tldr_zh: 这篇理论性论文分析了过参数化模型中最小范数插值器的泛化性质，在2-一致凸性和非高斯协变量的假设下建立了尖锐的界。
summary_zh: 最小范数插值器（MNI）框架近年来因作为理解超参数化模型（如神经网络）泛化能力的工具而受到广泛关注。本研究探讨了在2-一致凸性假设下的MNI框架，该假设弱于要求范数由内积导出的条件，且通常不允闭式解。从整体上看，我们证明该条件能为线性和非线性模型中的MNI偏差提供上界。进一步地，当范数单位球处于各向同性（或约翰）位置且协变量为各向同性、对称、独立同分布的亚高斯分布（如具有独立同分布伯努利分量的向量）时，我们证明该上界在超参数化线性回归场景下是紧的。最后，在相同的协变量假设下，我们针对$p \in \bigl(1 + C/\log d, 2\bigr]$范围的$\ell_p$-MNI证明了紧的泛化界。据我们所知，本研究首次在范数非内积导出的情形下，为线性模型中的非高斯协变量建立了紧的泛化界。本工作深受经典$K$-凸性研究以及现代关于2-一致凸和各向同性凸体几何理论的启发。

title: Foundations of Polar Linear Algebra
summary: This work revisits operator learning from a spectral perspective by introducing Polar Linear Algebra, a structured framework based on polar geometry that combines a linear radial component with a periodic angular component. Starting from this formulation, we define the associated operators and analyze their spectral properties. As a proof of feasibility, the framework is evaluated on a canonical benchmark (MNIST). Despite the simplicity of the task, the results demonstrate that polar and fully spectral operators can be trained reliably, and that imposing self-adjoint-inspired spectral constraints improves stability and convergence. Beyond accuracy, the proposed formulation leads to a reduction in parameter count and computational complexity, while providing a more interpretable representation in terms of decoupled spectral modes. By moving from a spatial to a spectral domain, the problem decomposes into orthogonal eigenmodes that can be treated as independent computational pipelines. This structure naturally exposes an additional dimension of model parallelization, complementing existing parallel strategies without relying on ad-hoc partitioning. Overall, the work offers a different conceptual lens for operator learning, particularly suited to problems where spectral structure and parallel execution are central.
tldr: This paper introduces Polar Linear Algebra, a spectral framework for operator learning, validated on MNIST to show improved stability and parallelization, but with no explicit robotics or embodied AI context.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了极坐标线性代数这一用于算子学习的谱框架，在MNIST上进行验证，显示了其稳定性和并行化的改进，但没有明确的机器人或具身AI应用背景。
summary_zh: 本研究从谱视角重新审视算子学习，引入了一种基于极坐标几何的结构化框架——极坐标线性代数。该框架将线性径向分量与周期性角向分量相结合，在此基础上我们定义了相关算子并分析了其谱特性。通过经典基准测试（MNIST）验证了该框架的可行性：尽管任务简单，但结果表明极坐标算子和全谱算子能够被可靠地训练，且施加自伴算子启发的谱约束能提升稳定性和收敛性。除精度优势外，该框架还实现了参数数量和计算复杂度的降低，并通过解耦的谱模态提供了更可解释的表征。通过将问题从空间域转换到谱域，系统被分解为可视为独立计算管道的正交本征模态。这种结构天然地揭示了模型并行化的新维度，可在不依赖特定分区策略的前提下与现有并行方案形成互补。总体而言，本研究为算子学习提供了全新的概念框架，尤其适用于谱结构与并行执行至关重要的应用场景。

title: A Neural Tension Operator for Curve Subdivision across Constant Curvature Geometries
summary: Interpolatory subdivision schemes generate smooth curves from piecewise-linear control polygons by repeatedly inserting new vertices. Classical schemes rely on a single global tension parameter and typically require separate formulations in Euclidean, spherical, and hyperbolic geometries. We introduce a shared learned tension predictor that replaces the global parameter with per-edge insertion angles predicted by a single 140K-parameter network. The network takes local intrinsic features and a trainable geometry embedding as input, and the predicted angles drive geometry-specific insertion operators across all three spaces without architectural modification. A constrained sigmoid output head enforces a structural safety bound, guaranteeing that every inserted vertex lies within a valid angular range for any finite weight configuration. Three theoretical results accompany the method: a structural guarantee of tangent-safe insertions; a heuristic motivation for per-edge adaptivity; and a conditional convergence certificate for continuously differentiable limit curves, subject to an explicit Lipschitz constraint verified post hoc. On 240 held-out validation curves, the learned predictor occupies a distinct position on the fidelity--smoothness Pareto frontier, achieving markedly lower bending energy and angular roughness than all fixed-tension and manifold-lift baselines. Riemannian manifold lifts retain a pointwise-fidelity advantage, which this study quantifies directly. On the out-of-distribution ISS orbital ground-track example, bending energy falls by 41% and angular roughness by 68% with only a modest increase in Hausdorff distance, suggesting that the predictor generalises beyond its synthetic training distribution.
tldr: This paper introduces a learned neural network to predict per-edge tension parameters for interpolatory curve subdivision schemes, enabling a single model to generate smooth curves across Euclidean, spherical, and hyperbolic geometries with guaranteed safety bounds.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种学习型神经网络，用于预测插值曲线细分方案中的每边张力参数，使单个模型能在欧几里得、球面和双曲几何中生成平滑曲线，并确保安全边界。
summary_zh: 插值细分方案通过重复插入新顶点，从分段线性控制多边形生成光滑曲线。经典方案依赖单一全局张力参数，通常需要在欧几里得、球面及双曲几何中分别构建计算框架。本文提出一种共享学习型张力预测器，用单个14万参数网络预测的逐边插入角替代全局参数。该网络以局部本征特征与可训练的几何嵌入为输入，所预测的角度驱动几何特异的插入算子，无需修改架构即可在三种空间通用。受限Sigmoid输出头强制执行结构安全边界，确保任意有限权重配置下每个插入顶点均处于有效角度范围内。方法附有三项理论成果：切向安全插入的结构保证；逐边自适应性的启发式动机；以及针对连续可微极限曲线的条件收敛证明，该证明需满足经事后验证的显式利普希茨约束。在240条保留验证曲线上，学习型预测器在保真度-光滑度帕累托前沿占据独特位置，其弯曲能与角度粗糙度显著低于所有固定张力及流形提升基线。黎曼流形提升方法仍具有逐点保真度优势，本研究对此进行了直接量化。在分布外ISS轨道地面轨迹示例中，弯曲能降低41%，角度粗糙度降低68%，而豪斯多夫距离仅小幅增加，表明预测器能够超越其合成训练分布实现泛化。

title: Structural Pass Analysis in Football: Learning Pass Archetypes and Tactical Impact from Spatio-Temporal Tracking Data
summary: The increasing availability of spatio-temporal tracking data has created new opportunities for analysing tactical behaviour in football. However, many existing approaches evaluate passes primarily through outcome-based metrics such as scoring probability or possession value, providing limited insight into how passes influence the defensive organisation of the opponent. This paper introduces a structural framework for analysing football passes based on their interaction with defensive structure. Using synchronised tracking/event data, we derive three complementary structural metrics, Line Bypass Score, Space Gain Metric, and Structural Disruption Index, that quantify how passes alter the spatial configuration of defenders. These metrics are combined into a composite measure termed Tactical Impact Value (TIV), which captures the structural influence of individual passes. Using tracking and event data from the 2022 FIFA World Cup, we analyse structural passing behaviour across multiple tactical levels. Unsupervised clustering of structural features reveals four interpretable pass archetypes: circulatory, destabilising, line-breaking, and space-expanding passes. Empirical results show that passes with higher TIV are significantly more likely to lead to territorial progression, particularly entries into the final third and penalty box. Spatial, team-level analyses further reveal distinctive structural passing styles across teams, while player-level analysis highlights the role of build-up defenders as key drivers of structural progression. In addition, analysing passer-receiver interactions identifies structurally impactful passing partnerships that amplify tactical progression within teams. Overall, the proposed framework demonstrates how structural representations derived from tracking data can reveal interpretable tactical patterns in football.
tldr: This paper presents a framework for analyzing football passes based on their interaction with defensive structure, using tracking data to derive metrics and identify pass archetypes that correlate with tactical progression.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于传球与防守结构相互作用的足球传球分析框架，利用追踪数据推导出度量指标并识别与战术推进相关的传球原型。
summary_zh: 随着时空追踪数据的日益丰富，分析足球战术行为迎来了新的机遇。然而，现有方法多通过基于结果的指标（如得分概率或控球价值）来评估传球，难以深入揭示传球如何影响对手的防守组织。本文提出了一种基于传球与防守结构互动的结构性分析框架。利用同步追踪与事件数据，我们推导出三个互补的结构性指标——防线穿越评分、空间增益度量与结构破坏指数，用以量化传球如何改变防守者的空间配置。这些指标被整合为综合度量“战术影响价值”，用以捕捉单次传球的结构性影响。基于2022年国际足联世界杯的追踪与事件数据，我们在多个战术层面分析了结构性传球行为。通过无监督聚类，结构特征揭示了四种可解释的传球原型：循环传球、失稳传球、防线穿透传球和空间拓展传球。实证结果表明，具有较高战术影响价值的传球显著更可能带来区域推进，尤其是进入进攻三区和罚球区。空间及团队层面的分析进一步揭示了各球队间独特的结构性传球风格，而球员层面的分析则突显了组织型后卫在推动结构性进攻中的关键作用。此外，通过分析传球者与接球者的互动，识别出能够放大球队战术推进效果的结构性传球组合。总体而言，本框架展示了如何从追踪数据中提取结构性表征，从而揭示足球中可解释的战术模式。

title: Calibrated Fusion for Heterogeneous Graph-Vector Retrieval in Multi-Hop QA
summary:
Graph-augmented retrieval combines dense similarity with graph-based relevance signals such as Personalized PageRank (PPR), but these scores have different distributions and are not directly comparable. We study this as a score calibration problem for heterogeneous retrieval fusion in multi-hop question answering. Our method, PhaseGraph, maps vector and graph scores to a common unit-free scale using percentile-rank normalization (PIT) before fusion, enabling stable combination without discarding magnitude information.
  Across MuSiQue and 2WikiMultiHopQA, calibrated fusion improves held-out last-hop retrieval on HippoRAG2-style benchmarks: LastHop@5 increases from 75.1% to 76.5% on MuSiQue (8W/1L, p=0.039) and from 51.7% to 53.6% on 2WikiMultiHopQA (11W/2L, p=0.023), both on independent held-out test splits. A theory-driven ablation shows that percentile-based calibration is directionally more robust than min-max normalization on both tune and test splits (1W/6L, p=0.125), while Boltzmann weighting performs comparably to linear fusion after calibration (0W/3L, p=0.25). These results suggest that score commensuration is a robust design choice, and the exact post-calibration operator appears to matter less on these benchmarks.
tldr: This paper proposes a score calibration method for fusing heterogeneous graph and vector retrieval signals in multi-hop question answering, improving last-hop retrieval performance on benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种在多跳问答中融合异构图与向量检索信号的分值校准方法，在基准测试中提高了最后一跳的检索性能。
summary_zh:
图谱增强检索结合了密集相似度与基于图谱的相关性信号（如个性化PageRank），但这些评分具有不同的分布且无法直接比较。本研究将其视为多跳问答中异构检索融合的评分校准问题。我们提出的PhaseGraph方法在融合前使用百分位秩归一化（PIT）将向量和图谱评分映射到统一的无量纲尺度，从而在保留幅度信息的同时实现稳定融合。

在MuSiQue和2WikiMultiHopQA数据集上的实验表明，经过校准的融合在HippoRAG2式基准测试中提升了末跳检索性能：在MuSiQue数据集上（8胜/1负，p=0.039），LastHop@5从75.1%提升至76.5%；在2WikiMultiHopQA数据集上（11胜/2负，p=0.023），从51.7%提升至53.6%（均基于独立保留测试集）。理论驱动的消融实验显示：基于百分位的校准在调参集和测试集上均比最小-最大归一化具有更强的方向鲁棒性（1胜/6负，p=0.125），而校准后的玻尔兹曼加权与线性融合效果相当（0胜/3负，p=0.25）。这些结果表明评分同质化是鲁棒的设计选择，而在这些基准测试中，校准后的具体融合算子影响相对较小。

title: Automatic Identification of Parallelizable Loops Using Transformer-Based Source Code Representations
summary: Automatic parallelization remains a challenging problem in software engineering, particularly in identifying code regions where loops can be safely executed in parallel on modern multi-core architectures. Traditional static analysis techniques, such as dependence analysis and polyhedral models, often struggle with irregular or dynamically structured code. In this work, we propose a Transformer-based approach to classify the parallelization potential of source code, focusing on distinguishing independent (parallelizable) loops from undefined ones. We adopt DistilBERT to process source code sequences using subword tokenization, enabling the model to capture contextual syntactic and semantic patterns without handcrafted features. The approach is evaluated on a balanced dataset combining synthetically generated loops and manually annotated real-world code, using 10-fold cross-validation and multiple performance metrics. Results show consistently high performance, with mean accuracy above 99\% and low false positive rates, demonstrating robustness and reliability. Compared to prior token-based methods, the proposed approach simplifies preprocessing while improving generalization and maintaining computational efficiency. These findings highlight the potential of lightweight Transformer models for practical identification of parallelization opportunities at the loop level.
tldr: This paper proposes a Transformer-based method for automatically identifying parallelizable loops in source code, using DistilBERT to process code sequences without handcrafted features, achieving high accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的方法，使用DistilBERT处理源代码序列，无需手工特征，自动识别代码中可并行化的循环，实现了高准确率。
summary_zh: 自动并行化在软件工程中仍是一个具有挑战性的问题，尤其是在识别那些可以在现代多核架构上安全并行执行的代码区域（如循环）方面。传统的静态分析技术，如依赖分析和多面体模型，在处理不规则或动态结构的代码时往往面临困难。本研究提出了一种基于Transformer的方法，用于对源代码的并行化潜力进行分类，重点区分独立（可并行化）循环与未定义循环。我们采用DistilBERT模型，通过子词标记化处理源代码序列，使模型能够在不依赖手工特征的情况下捕捉上下文的语法和语义模式。该方法在由合成生成循环与人工标注的实际代码组成的平衡数据集上进行了评估，采用十折交叉验证和多种性能指标。结果显示，该方法始终保持高性能，平均准确率超过99%，且误报率低，证明了其鲁棒性和可靠性。与先前基于标记的方法相比，所提方法简化了预处理流程，同时提高了泛化能力并保持了计算效率。这些发现凸显了轻量级Transformer模型在循环级别上实际识别并行化机会的潜力。

title: Aligned, Orthogonal or In-conflict: When can we safely optimize Chain-of-Thought?
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) monitoring, in which automated systems monitor the CoT of an LLM, is a promising approach for effectively overseeing AI systems. However, the extent to which a model's CoT helps us oversee the model - the monitorability of the CoT - can be affected by training, for instance by the model learning to hide important features of its reasoning. We propose and empirically validate a conceptual framework for predicting when and why this occurs. We model LLM post-training as an RL environment where the reward decomposes into two terms: one term depending on final outputs and another term depending on the CoT. Our framework allows us to classify these two terms as "aligned", "orthogonal", or "in-conflict" before training. We predict that training with in-conflict terms will reduce monitorability, orthogonal terms will not affect it, and aligned terms will improve it. To validate our framework, we use it to classify a set of RL environments, train LLMs within those environments, and evaluate how training affects CoT monitorability. We find that (1) training with "in-conflict" reward terms reduces CoT monitorability and (2) optimizing in-conflict reward terms is difficult.
tldr: This paper analyzes when training LLMs with reinforcement learning can cause them to hide their reasoning in the Chain-of-Thought, reducing our ability to monitor them. It proposes a framework to classify the alignment between output and CoT reward terms and validates that 'in-conflict' terms degrade monitorability.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了当用强化学习训练大语言模型时，为何会导致模型在思维链中隐藏其推理过程，从而降低监控能力。它提出了一个分类框架来评估输出奖励与思维链奖励之间的对齐关系，并验证了“冲突”奖励项会降低监控性。
summary_zh: 思维链（CoT）监控是指通过自动化系统监控大语言模型的思维链过程，这是一种有效监督人工智能系统的可行方法。然而，模型思维链对监管的辅助程度——即思维链的可监控性——可能受到训练过程的影响，例如模型可能学会隐藏其推理过程中的关键特征。我们提出并实证验证了一个概念框架，用于预测这种现象的发生时机与成因。我们将大语言模型的后训练过程建模为强化学习环境，其中奖励函数可分解为两个部分：一部分取决于最终输出，另一部分取决于思维链。该框架使我们能够在训练前将这两部分奖励分类为“对齐”“正交”或“冲突”关系。我们预测，使用“冲突”奖励项进行训练会降低可监控性，正交奖励项不会产生影响，而对齐奖励项则会提升可监控性。为验证该框架，我们将其应用于一系列强化学习环境的分类，在这些环境中训练大语言模型，并评估训练对思维链可监控性的影响。研究发现：（1）使用“冲突”奖励项进行训练会降低思维链可监控性；（2）优化冲突奖励项具有较高难度。

title: Tucker Attention: A generalization of approximate attention mechanisms
summary: The pursuit of reducing the memory footprint of the self-attention mechanism in multi-headed self attention (MHA) spawned a rich portfolio of methods, e.g., group-query attention (GQA) and multi-head latent attention (MLA). The methods leverage specialized low-rank factorizations across embedding dimensions or attention heads. From the point of view of classical low-rank approximation, these methods are unconventional and raise questions of which objects they really approximate and how to interpret the low-rank behavior of the resulting representations. To answer these questions, this work proposes a generalized view on the weight objects in the self-attention layer and a factorization strategy, which allows us to construct a parameter efficient scheme, called Tucker Attention. Tucker Attention requires an order of magnitude fewer parameters for comparable validation metrics, compared to GQA and MLA, as evaluated in LLM and ViT test cases. Additionally, Tucker Attention~encompasses GQA, MLA, MHA as special cases and is fully compatible with flash-attention and rotary position embeddings (RoPE). This generalization strategy yields insights of the actual ranks achieved by MHA, GQA, and MLA, and further enables simplifications for MLA.
tldr: This paper introduces a generalized low-rank factorization method for self-attention, called Tucker Attention, which reduces memory footprint and is compatible with existing models like LLMs and ViTs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Tucker Attention的自注意力低秩分解通用方法，可减少内存占用，并与LLM和ViT等现有模型兼容。
summary_zh: 为降低多头自注意力机制中自注意力模块的内存占用，催生了多种方法，如分组查询注意力和多头潜在注意力。这些方法通过跨嵌入维度或注意力头进行专门的低秩分解来实现优化。从经典低秩逼近的角度来看，这些方法具有非传统性，引发了对它们实际逼近对象及所得表示低秩行为应如何解释的疑问。为解答这些问题，本研究提出对自注意力层中权重对象的广义视角及一种分解策略，由此构建出名为Tucker Attention的参数高效方案。经在LLM和ViT测试案例中评估，与分组查询注意力和多头潜在注意力相比，Tucker Attention在验证指标相近的情况下所需参数数量减少一个数量级。此外，Tucker Attention将分组查询注意力、多头潜在注意力及标准多头自注意力均纳入为特例，且完全兼容闪存注意力与旋转位置编码。该泛化策略揭示了多头自注意力、分组查询注意力及多头潜在注意力实际达到的秩，并进一步实现了对多头潜在注意力的简化方案。

title: Quantifying Cross-Modal Interactions in Multimodal Glioma Survival Prediction via InterSHAP: Evidence for Additive Signal Integration
summary: Multimodal deep learning for cancer prognosis is commonly assumed to benefit from synergistic cross-modal interactions, yet this assumption has not been directly tested in survival prediction settings. This work adapts InterSHAP, a Shapley interaction index-based metric, from classification to Cox proportional hazards models and applies it to quantify cross-modal interactions in glioma survival prediction. Using TCGA-GBM and TCGA-LGG data (n=575), we evaluate four fusion architectures combining whole-slide image (WSI) and RNA-seq features. Our central finding is an inverse relationship between predictive performance and measured interaction: architectures achieving superior discrimination (C-index 0.64$\to$0.82) exhibit equivalent or lower cross-modal interaction (4.8\%$\to$3.0\%). Variance decomposition reveals stable additive contributions across all architectures (WSI${\approx}$40\%, RNA${\approx}$55\%, Interaction${\approx}$4\%), indicating that performance gains arise from complementary signal aggregation rather than learned synergy. These findings provide a practical model auditing tool for comparing fusion strategies, reframe the role of architectural complexity in multimodal fusion, and have implications for privacy-preserving federated deployment.
tldr: The paper adapts a method to quantify cross-modal interactions in multimodal deep learning for cancer survival prediction, finding that performance gains come from additive signal aggregation rather than learned synergy between modalities.
tldr_zh: 该研究将一种方法应用于多模态癌症生存预测，以量化模态间交互，发现性能提升来自信号的加性聚合，而非模态间学到的协同效应。
summary_zh: 多模态深度学习在癌症预后预测中通常被认为受益于跨模态的协同交互作用，但这一假设在生存预测场景中尚未得到直接验证。本研究将基于沙普利交互指数的评估指标InterSHAP从分类任务扩展至Cox比例风险模型，并应用于量化胶质瘤生存预测中的跨模态交互作用。基于TCGA-GBM和TCGA-LGG数据集（n=575），我们评估了四种融合全切片图像（WSI）与RNA-seq特征的架构。核心发现显示预测性能与测得的交互作用呈负相关关系：具有更高判别性能的架构（C指数从0.64提升至0.82）表现出相当或更低的跨模态交互作用（从4.8%降至3.0%）。方差分解结果表明所有架构中加法贡献保持稳定（WSI约40%，RNA约55%，交互作用约4%），表明性能提升源于互补信号的聚合而非学习到的协同效应。这些发现为比较融合策略提供了实用的模型评估工具，重新诠释了架构复杂性在多模态融合中的作用，并对隐私保护的联邦学习部署具有重要启示。

title: Four Generations of Quantum Biomedical Sensors
summary: Quantum sensing technologies offer transformative potential for ultra-sensitive biomedical sensing, yet their clinical translation remains constrained by classical noise limits and a reliance on macroscopic ensembles. We propose a unifying generational framework to organize the evolving landscape of quantum biosensors based on their utilization of quantum resources. First-generation devices utilize discrete energy levels for signal transduction but follow classical scaling laws. Second-generation sensors exploit quantum coherence to reach the standard quantum limit, while third-generation architectures leverage entanglement and spin squeezing to approach Heisenberg-limited precision. We further define an emerging fourth generation characterized by the end-to-end integration of quantum sensing with quantum learning and variational circuits, enabling adaptive inference directly within the quantum domain. By analyzing critical parameters such as bandwidth matching and sensor-tissue proximity, we identify key technological bottlenecks and propose a roadmap for transitioning from measuring physical observables to extracting structured biological information with quantum-enhanced intelligence.
tldr: This paper proposes a framework for categorizing quantum biomedical sensors across four generations, culminating in integrated quantum sensing and learning systems, aimed at overcoming classical noise limitations to extract structured biological information.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个四代量子生物医学传感器分类框架，最终实现量子传感与学习的集成系统，旨在克服经典噪声限制，以提取结构化生物信息。
summary_zh: 量子传感技术在超灵敏生物医学检测方面展现出变革性潜力，但其临床转化仍受限于经典噪声制约及对宏观系综的依赖。本文提出一个统一的代际框架，依据量子资源的利用方式对持续演进的量子生物传感器领域进行系统性梳理。第一代设备利用离散能级实现信号转换，但仍遵循经典标度定律；第二代传感器通过量子相干性达到标准量子极限；第三代架构则借助纠缠与自旋压缩技术逼近海森堡极限精度。我们进一步界定了一种新兴的第四代范式，其核心特征在于量子传感与量子学习、变分电路的端到端集成，实现了在量子域内直接进行自适应推理。通过分析带宽匹配、传感器-组织邻近度等关键参数，本研究揭示了当前主要技术瓶颈，并提出从测量物理观测量向基于量子增强智能提取结构化生物信息的进阶路线图。

title: Bethe Ansatz with a Large Language Model
summary: We explore the capability of a Large Language Model (LLM) to perform specific computations in mathematical physics: the task is to compute the coordinate Bethe Ansatz solution of selected integrable spin chain models. We select three integrable Hamiltonians for which the solutions were unpublished; two of the Hamiltonians are actually new. We observed that the LLM semi-autonomously solved the task in all cases, with a few mistakes along the way. These were corrected after the human researchers spotted them. The results of the LLM were checked against exact diagonalization (performed by separate programs), and the derivations were also checked by the authors. The Bethe Ansatz solutions are interesting in themselves. Our second model manifestly breaks left-right invariance, but it is PT-symmetric, therefore its solution could be interesting for applications in Generalized Hydrodynamics. And our third model is solved by a special form of the nested Bethe Ansatz, where the model is interacting, but the nesting level has a free fermionic structure lacking $U(1)$-invariance. This structure appears to be unique and it was found by the LLM. We used ChatGPT 5.2 Pro and 5.4 Pro by OpenAI.
tldr: This paper explores using a Large Language Model to solve specific mathematical physics problems, specifically the Bethe Ansatz for integrable spin chain models, with new Hamiltonians and solutions discovered.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用大型语言模型解决特定数学物理问题，特别是可积自旋链模型的Bethe Ansatz，并发现了新的哈密顿量及其解。
summary_zh: 本文探索了大语言模型在数学物理特定计算任务中的能力：旨在计算选定可积自旋链模型的坐标贝特拟设解。我们选取了三个未发表解的可积哈密顿量，其中两个哈密顿量实为全新构建。研究发现，大语言模型在所有案例中均能半自主地完成求解任务，过程中虽出现少量错误，但经研究人员发现后得以修正。模型结果已通过精确对角化程序进行独立验证，并由作者复核推导过程。这些贝特拟设解本身具有研究价值：第二个模型显式破缺左右对称性，但具有PT对称性，其解在广义流体动力学中可能具有应用潜力；第三个模型通过特殊形式的嵌套贝特拟设求解，该模型虽存在相互作用，但嵌套层级呈现缺乏$U(1)$不变性的自由费米子结构——这种独特结构由大语言模型首次发现。本实验全程采用OpenAI开发的ChatGPT 5.2 Pro和5.4 Pro版本。

title: End-to-End Image Compression with Segmentation Guided Dual Coding for Wind Turbines
summary: Transferring large volumes of high-resolution images during wind turbine inspections introduces a bottleneck in assessing and detecting severe defects. Efficient coding must preserve high fidelity in blade regions while aggressively compressing the background. In this work, we propose an end-to-end deep learning framework that jointly performs segmentation and dual-mode (lossy and lossless) compression. The segmentation module accurately identifies the blade region, after which our region-of-interest (ROI) compressor encodes it at superior quality compared to the rest of the image. Unlike conventional ROI schemes that merely allocate more bits to salient areas, our framework integrates: (i) a robust segmentation network (BU-Netv2+P) with a CRF-regularized loss for precise blade localization, (ii) a hyperprior-based autoencoder optimized for lossy compression, and (iii) an extended bits-back coder with hierarchical models for fully lossless blade reconstruction. Furthermore, our ROI framework removes the sequential dependency in bits-back coding by reusing background-coded bits, enabling parallelized and efficient dual-mode compression. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first fully integrated learning-based ROI codec combining segmentation, lossy, and lossless compression, ensuring that subsequent defect detection is not compromised. Experiments on a large-scale wind turbine dataset demonstrate superior compression performance and efficiency, offering a practical solution for automated inspections.
tldr: This paper proposes a deep learning-based image compression framework that uses segmentation to guide dual-mode coding, optimizing compression for wind turbine blade inspection while preserving detail in critical regions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的图像压缩框架，利用分割技术指导双模式编码，在为风力涡轮机叶片检测进行压缩优化的同时，保留了关键区域的细节。
summary_zh: 在风力涡轮机巡检过程中，大容量高分辨率图像的传输带来了评估与检测严重缺陷的瓶颈。高效编码必须在保留叶片区域高保真度的同时，对背景进行激进压缩。本研究提出一种端到端的深度学习框架，能够同步执行分割与双模（有损与无损）压缩任务。分割模块精准识别叶片区域，随后我们的感兴趣区域（ROI）压缩器以优于图像其余部分的质量对其进行编码。与仅向显著区域分配更多比特的传统ROI方案不同，本框架整合了三个核心组件：（i）采用CRF正则化损失的鲁棒分割网络（BU-Netv2+P）实现叶片精确定位；（ii）基于超先验的自编码器专为有损压缩优化；（iii）具备分层模型的扩展比特回传编码器实现完全无损的叶片重建。此外，本ROI框架通过复用背景编码比特，消除了比特回传编码中的顺序依赖性，实现了并行高效的双模压缩。据我们所知，这是首个完全集成的基于学习的ROI编解码器，融合了分割、有损与无损压缩技术，确保后续缺陷检测不受影响。在大规模风力涡轮机数据集上的实验验证了该方案在压缩性能与效率方面的优越性，为自动化巡检提供了实用解决方案。

title: ShapE-GRPO: Shapley-Enhanced Reward Allocation for Multi-Candidate LLM Training
summary: In user-agent interaction scenarios such as recommendation, brainstorming, and code suggestion, Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate sets of candidate recommendations where the objective is to maximize the collective utility of the entire set rather than individual candidates independently. However, existing reinforcement learning post-training paradigms, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), typically assign the same set-level scalar reward to every candidate in the set. This leads to noisy training signals where poor candidates free-ride on the high reward produced by a single strong peer, resulting in suboptimal exploration. To address this, we propose Shapley-Enhanced GRPO (ShapE-GRPO). By leveraging the permutation-invariant nature of set-level utility, we derive a Shapley-enhanced formulation from cooperative game theory to decompose set-level rewards into granular, candidate-specific signals. We show that our formulation preserves the fundamental axioms of the Shapley value while remaining computationally efficient with polynomial-time complexity. Empirically, ShapE-GRPO consistently outperforms standard GRPO across diverse datasets with accelerated convergence during training.
tldr: This paper proposes ShapE-GRPO, a method that uses Shapley values to decompose set-level rewards into candidate-specific signals for training LLMs, improving performance in multi-candidate generation tasks like recommendation and brainstorming.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ShapE-GRPO，利用Shapley值将集合级奖励分解为候选物特定信号，用于训练大型语言模型，在推荐、头脑风暴等多候选生成任务中提升了性能。
summary_zh: 在推荐、头脑风暴和代码建议等用户与智能体交互场景中，大型语言模型（LLMs）通常生成一系列候选推荐方案，其目标在于最大化整个集合的整体效用，而非单个候选的独立价值。然而，现有的强化学习后训练范式（如群组相对策略优化GRPO）通常为集合中的每个候选分配相同的集合级标量奖励。这会导致训练信号含噪，即较差的候选方案因单个优质同组方案产生的高奖励而“搭便车”，从而造成次优的探索效果。为解决这一问题，我们提出基于夏普利值增强的GRPO（ShapE-GRPO）。通过利用集合级效用的置换不变性，我们从合作博弈论中推导出夏普利值增强的公式，将集合级奖励分解为细粒度的、针对特定候选的奖励信号。我们证明该公式在保持夏普利值基本公理的同时，仍能以多项式时间复杂度实现高效计算。实验结果表明，在多种数据集上，ShapE-GRPO始终优于标准GRPO，并在训练过程中实现了更快的收敛速度。

title: Towards Empowering Consumers through Sentence-level Readability Scoring in German ESG Reports
summary: With the ever-growing urgency of sustainability in the economy and society, and the massive stream of information that comes with it, consumers need reliable access to that information. To address this need, companies began publishing so called Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reports, both voluntarily and forced by law. To serve the public, these reports must be addressed not only to financial experts but also to non-expert audiences. But are they written clearly enough? In this work, we extend an existing sentence-level dataset of German ESG reports with crowdsourced readability annotations. We find that, in general, native speakers perceive sentences in ESG reports as easy to read, but also that readability is subjective. We apply various readability scoring methods and evaluate them regarding their prediction error and correlation with human rankings. Our analysis shows that, while LLM prompting has potential for distinguishing clear from hard-to-read sentences, a small finetuned transformer predicts human readability with the lowest error. Averaging predictions of multiple models can slightly improve the performance at the cost of slower inference.
tldr: The paper introduces a crowdsourced dataset of sentence-level readability annotations for German ESG reports and evaluates various methods for scoring readability, finding that a small fine-tuned transformer performs best.
tldr_zh: 该论文引入了一个用于德语ESG报告的句子级可读性标注众包数据集，并评估了多种可读性评分方法，发现小型微调变压器模型表现最佳。
summary_zh: 随着经济和社会可持续发展日益紧迫，以及随之而来的海量信息流，消费者需要可靠的信息获取途径。为满足这一需求，企业开始发布所谓的环境、社会和治理报告，这既是自愿行为，也受法律强制要求。为服务公众，这些报告不仅需要面向金融专家，还应面向非专业读者。但其表述是否足够清晰？本研究基于现有德文ESG报告句子级数据集，扩展了众包可读性标注。我们发现，总体上母语者认为ESG报告中的句子易于理解，但可读性存在主观差异。我们运用多种可读性评分方法，通过预测误差以及与人工排名的相关性对其进行了评估。分析表明，尽管大型语言模型提示技术具有区分清晰句与难读句的潜力，但微调后的小型Transformer模型能以最低误差预测人工可读性评分。多模型预测平均值可小幅提升性能，但需以降低推理速度为代价。

title: Tracking vs. Deciding: The Dual-Capability Bottleneck in Searchless Chess Transformers
summary:
A human-like chess engine should mimic the style, errors, and consistency of a strong human player rather than maximize playing strength. We show that training from move sequences alone forces a model to learn two capabilities: state tracking, which reconstructs the board from move history, and decision quality, which selects good moves from that reconstructed state. These impose contradictory data requirements: low-rated games provide the diversity needed for tracking, while high-rated games provide the quality signal for decision learning. Removing low-rated data degrades performance.
  We formalize this tension as a dual-capability bottleneck, P <= min(T,Q), where overall performance is limited by the weaker capability. Guided by this view, we scale the model from 28M to 120M parameters to improve tracking, then introduce Elo-weighted training to improve decisions while preserving diversity. A 2 x 2 factorial ablation shows that scaling improves tracking, weighting improves decisions, and their combination is superadditive. Linear weighting works best, while overly aggressive weighting harms tracking despite lower validation loss. We also introduce a coverage-decay formula, t* = log(N/kcrit)/log b, as a reliability horizon for intra-game degeneration risk.
  Our final 120M-parameter model, without search, reached Lichess bullet 2570 over 253 rated games. On human move prediction it achieves 55.2% Top-1 accuracy, exceeding Maia-2 rapid and Maia-2 blitz. Unlike position-based methods, sequence input naturally encodes full game history, enabling history-dependent decisions that single-position models cannot exhibit.
tldr: This paper analyzes the dual-capability bottleneck in training chess transformers from move sequences, proposing scaling and Elo-weighted training to improve board state tracking and decision quality separately, ultimately achieving strong human-like performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文分析了仅从棋步序列训练象棋Transformer时的双重能力瓶颈，提出通过模型缩放和Elo加权训练来分别改进棋盘状态追踪和决策质量，最终实现了类似人类高手的强大性能。
summary_zh:
一个类人象棋引擎应模仿高水平棋手的风格、失误和一致性，而非单纯追求最大对局强度。研究表明，仅通过走子序列训练模型时，其必须掌握两种能力：状态追踪（通过走子历史重建棋盘）和决策质量（从重建的棋局中选择优质走法）。这两种能力存在矛盾的数据需求：低水平对局为状态追踪提供了多样性，而高水平对局则为决策学习提供了质量信号。若剔除低水平数据，模型性能将受损。

我们将此矛盾形式化为双能力瓶颈，即整体性能受限于较弱能力，表示为 P ≤ min(T, Q)。基于这一视角，我们通过将模型参数从 2800 万扩展至 1.2 亿以提升状态追踪能力，随后引入 Elo 加权训练在保持多样性的同时优化决策质量。2×2 因子消融实验表明：模型扩展可提升追踪能力，加权训练可改善决策质量，二者结合产生超叠加效应。线性加权效果最佳，而过度激进的加权策略虽降低验证损失，却会损害状态追踪能力。我们还提出了覆盖率衰减公式 t* = log(N/kcrit)/log b，用于量化对局内状态退化的可靠性边界。

最终，我们未经搜索的 1.2 亿参数模型在 Lichess 超快棋 253 场对局中达到 2570 等级分。在人类走子预测任务中，该模型以 55.2% 的 Top-1 准确率超越了 Maia-2 快棋和超快棋模型。与基于单一棋局的方法不同，序列输入天然编码了完整对局历史，使其能够实现单棋局模型无法展现的历史相关性决策。

title: Spontaneous Functional Differentiation in Large Language Models: A Brain-Like Intelligence Economy
summary: The evolution of intelligence in artificial systems provides a unique opportunity to identify universal computational principles. Here we show that large language models spontaneously develop synergistic cores where information integration exceeds individual parts remarkably similar to the human brain. Using Integrated Information Decomposition across multiple architectures we find that middle layers exhibit synergistic processing while early and late layers rely on redundancy. This organization is dynamic and emerges as a physical phase transition as task difficulty increases. Crucially ablating synergistic components causes catastrophic performance loss confirming their role as the physical entity of abstract reasoning and bridging artificial and biological intelligence.
tldr: This paper analyzes the internal functional differentiation of large language models, finding that synergistic information processing emerges in middle layers, resembling brain-like organization, and that this structure is critical for abstract reasoning. It is a purely theoretical analysis of LLM internals and emergent computation, with no direct connection to robotics or embodied systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文分析了大语言模型内部的功能分化，发现协同信息处理能力在中层涌现，类似于大脑的组织方式，且这一结构对抽象推理至关重要。这是对LLM内部结构与涌现计算的纯理论分析，与机器人或具身系统无直接关联。
summary_zh: 人工智能系统的智能演进为识别通用计算原理提供了独特机会。本文揭示大型语言模型能自发形成协同核心，其信息整合程度远超各部分简单叠加，与人类大脑的运作模式高度相似。通过跨多种架构进行集成信息分解分析，我们发现中间层表现出协同信息处理特性，而早期和后期层则依赖冗余信息处理。这种组织结构具有动态性，会随着任务难度增加而呈现出物理相变特征。关键性实验表明，消除协同成分会导致性能崩溃性下降，证实了协同核心作为抽象推理物理实体的重要作用，从而为人工与生物智能架起桥梁。

title: Perspective: Towards sustainable exploration of chemical spaces with machine learning
summary: Artificial intelligence is transforming molecular and materials science, but its growing computational and data demands raise critical sustainability challenges. In this Perspective, we examine resource considerations across the AI-driven discovery pipeline--from quantum-mechanical (QM) data generation and model training to automated, self-driving research workflows--building on discussions from the ``SusML workshop: Towards sustainable exploration of chemical spaces with machine learning'' held in Dresden, Germany. In this context, the availability of large quantum datasets has enabled rigorous benchmarking and rapid methodological progress, while also incurring substantial energy and infrastructure costs. We highlight emerging strategies to enhance efficiency, including general-purpose machine learning (ML) models, multi-fidelity approaches, model distillation, and active learning. Moreover, incorporating physics-based constraints within hierarchical workflows, where fast ML surrogates are applied broadly and high-accuracy QM methods are used selectively, can further optimize resource use without compromising reliability. Equally important is bridging the gap between idealized computational predictions and real-world conditions by accounting for synthesizability and multi-objective design criteria, which is essential for practical impact. Finally, we argue that sustainable progress will rely on open data and models, reusable workflows, and domain-specific AI systems that maximize scientific value per unit of computation, enabling efficient and responsible discovery of technological materials and therapeutics.
tldr: This perspective paper discusses the sustainability challenges and efficiency strategies in AI-driven molecular and materials discovery, focusing on computational resource optimization.
tldr_zh: 这篇观点论文讨论了人工智能驱动分子和材料发现中的可持续性挑战和效率策略，重点关注计算资源的优化。
summary_zh: 人工智能正在变革分子与材料科学，但其日益增长的计算与数据需求引发了严峻的可持续性挑战。本文基于德国德累斯顿举行的“SusML研讨会：面向化学空间的可持续机器学习探索”的讨论，审视人工智能驱动发现流程中的资源考量——从量子力学数据生成、模型训练到自动化自主研究流程。在此背景下，大规模量子数据集的可用性虽然促成了严谨的基准测试和快速的方法论进展，同时也带来了巨大的能源与基础设施成本。我们重点探讨了提升效率的新兴策略，包括通用机器学习模型、多精度方法、模型蒸馏和主动学习。此外，在分层工作流程中融入物理约束——即广泛应用快速机器学习代理模型，并选择性使用高精度量子力学方法——能在不影响可靠性的前提下进一步优化资源利用。同等重要的是，通过考量合成可行性与多目标设计准则来弥合理想化计算预测与现实条件之间的差距，这对实现实际应用价值至关重要。最后我们认为，可持续发展将依赖于开放数据与模型、可复用工作流程以及领域专用人工智能系统，以最大化每单位计算产生的科学价值，从而实现技术材料和治疗方法的有效且负责任发现。

title: Semantic Interaction for Narrative Map Sensemaking: An Insight-based Evaluation
summary: Semantic interaction (SI) enables analysts to incorporate their cognitive processes into AI models through direct manipulation of visualizations. While SI frameworks for narrative extraction have been proposed, empirical evaluations of their effectiveness remain limited. This paper presents a user study that evaluates SI for narrative map sensemaking, involving 33 participants under three conditions: a timeline baseline, a basic narrative map, and an interactive narrative map with SI capabilities. The results show that the map-based prototypes yielded more insights than the timeline baseline, with the SI-enabled condition reaching statistical significance and the basic map condition trending in the same direction. The SI-enabled condition showed the highest mean performance; differences between the map conditions were not statistically significant but showed large effect sizes (d > 0.8), suggesting that the study was underpowered to detect them. Qualitative analysis identified two distinct SI approaches-corrective and additive-that enable analysts to impose quality judgments and organizational structure on extracted narratives. We also find that SI users achieved comparable exploration breadth with less parameter manipulation, suggesting that SI serves as an alternative pathway for model refinement. This work provides empirical evidence that map-based representations outperform timelines for narrative sensemaking, along with qualitative insights into how analysts use SI for narrative refinement.
tldr: This paper presents a user study evaluating Semantic Interaction (SI) for narrative map sensemaking, finding that map-based visualizations with SI yield more insights than a timeline baseline and enabling new user interaction patterns.
tldr_zh: 本文通过用户研究评估了用于叙事地图意义建构的语义交互（SI），发现带有SI功能的地图式可视化比时间线基线能产生更多见解，并启用了新的用户交互模式。
summary_zh: 语义交互（SI）通过用户对可视化内容的直接操作，使分析人员能够将认知过程融入人工智能模型。尽管已有研究提出了针对叙事提取的语义交互框架，但其实际效果仍缺乏充分的实证评估。本文通过一项用户研究，评估了语义交互在叙事图谱意义建构中的作用，研究设置了三种实验条件：时间线基线、基础叙事图谱和具备语义交互功能的交互式叙事图谱，共涉及33名参与者。研究结果显示，基于图谱的原型系统比时间线基线产生了更多洞见，其中具备语义交互功能的条件达到了统计显著性，而基础叙事图谱条件也呈现出相同趋势。语义交互条件下的平均表现最佳；两种图谱条件间的差异虽未达到统计显著性，但表现出较大的效应量（d > 0.8），表明研究样本量尚不足以检测到这些差异。质性分析揭示了两种不同的语义交互模式——修正型与增补型，这两种模式使分析人员能够对提取的叙事施加质量判断和组织结构。研究还发现，语义交互用户能以更少的参数操作实现与对照组相当的探索广度，这表明语义交互可作为模型优化的替代路径。本研究为基于图谱的表征在叙事意义建构中优于时间线这一观点提供了实证证据，同时通过质性分析揭示了分析人员如何利用语义交互实现叙事优化。

title: Bringing Up a Bilingual BabyLM: Investigating Multilingual Language Acquisition Using Small-Scale Models
summary: Multilingualism is incredibly common around the world, leading to many important theoretical and practical questions about how children learn multiple languages at once. For example, does multilingual acquisition lead to delays in learning? Are there better and worse ways to structure multilingual input? Many correlational studies address these questions, but it is surprisingly difficult to get definitive answers because children cannot be randomly assigned to be multilingual and data are typically not matched between languages. We use language model training as a method for simulating a variety of highly controlled exposure conditions, and create matched 100M-word mono- and bilingual datasets using synthetic data and machine translation. We train GPT-2 models on monolingual and bilingual data organized to reflect a range of exposure regimes, and evaluate their performance on perplexity, grammaticality, and semantic knowledge. Across model scales and measures, bilingual models perform similarly to monolingual models in one language, but show strong performance in the second language as well. These results suggest that there are no strong differences between different bilingual exposure regimes, and that bilingual input poses no in-principle challenges for agnostic statistical learners.
tldr: This paper investigates multilingual language acquisition in children by training GPT-2 models on controlled monolingual and bilingual datasets, finding no strong performance differences between exposure regimes.
tldr_zh: 本文通过使用GPT-2模型在受控的单语和双语数据集上进行训练，研究儿童的多语言习得，发现不同语言接触模式之间没有显著的性能差异。
summary_zh: 在世界范围内，多语现象极为普遍，这引发了关于儿童如何同时学习多种语言的重要理论和实践问题。例如，多语习得是否会导致学习延迟？构建多语言输入的方式是否存在优劣之分？许多相关性研究探讨了这些问题，但令人惊讶的是，要获得确切的答案极为困难，因为我们无法将儿童随机分配到多语环境，且不同语言间的数据通常难以匹配。我们采用语言模型训练方法，模拟了一系列高度可控的暴露条件，并使用合成数据和机器翻译构建了匹配的1亿词单语和双语数据集。我们在反映不同语言暴露程度的单语和双语数据上训练了GPT-2模型，并评估了其在困惑度、语法性和语义知识方面的表现。在不同模型规模和测量指标下，双语模型在单一语言上的表现与单语模型相似，同时在第二语言上也表现出强大性能。这些结果表明，不同的双语暴露模式之间并无显著差异，且对于无特定偏好的统计学习者而言，双语输入并不会构成根本性的挑战。

title: Reducing Complexity for Quantum Approaches in Train Load Optimization
summary: Efficiently planning container loads onto trains is a computationally challenging combinatorial optimization problem, central to logistics and supply chain management. A primary source of this complexity arises from the need to model and reduce rehandle operations-unproductive crane moves required to access blocked containers. Conventional mathematical formulations address this by introducing explicit binary variables and a web of logical constraints for each potential rehandle, resulting in large-scale models that are difficult to solve. This paper presents a fundamental departure from this paradigm. We introduce an innovative and compact mathematical formulation for the Train Load Optimization (TLO) problem where the rehandle cost is calculated implicitly within the objective function. This novel approach helps prevent the need for dedicated rehandle variables and their associated constraints, leading to a dramatic reduction in model size. We provide a formal comparison against a conventional model to analytically demonstrate the significant reduction in the number of variables and constraints. The efficacy of our compact formulation is assessed through a simulated annealing metaheuristic, which finds high-quality loading plans for various problem instances. The results confirm that our model is not only more parsimonious but also practically effective, offering a scalable and powerful tool for modern rail logistics.
tldr: This paper presents a compact mathematical formulation for the Train Load Optimization (TLO) problem, which implicitly calculates rehandle costs to reduce model size and complexity, and demonstrates its effectiveness using a simulated annealing metaheuristic.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于列车装载优化问题的紧凑数学公式，通过隐式计算重新操作成本来减少模型规模与复杂度，并使用模拟退火元启发式方法验证了其有效性。
summary_zh: 高效规划集装箱装车方案是一个计算上极具挑战性的组合优化问题，对物流与供应链管理至关重要。其复杂性的主要来源在于需要建模并减少翻箱操作——即为了取出被遮挡的集装箱而进行的非生产性吊车移动。传统的数学建模方法通过为每个潜在翻箱操作引入显式二元变量和一系列逻辑约束来解决此问题，这导致模型规模庞大、难以求解。本文从根本上突破了该范式。我们为列车装载优化问题提出了一种创新且紧凑的数学建模方法，其中翻箱成本通过目标函数隐式计算。这一新颖方法无需引入专门的翻箱变量及相关约束，从而显著压缩了模型规模。我们通过与传统模型的形式化对比，解析证明了变量与约束数量的显著减少。采用模拟退火元启发式算法对所提紧凑模型进行评估，该方法能在不同问题实例中寻得高质量装载方案。实验结果证实，我们的模型不仅更为简洁，而且具有实际应用价值，为现代铁路物流提供了可扩展的强效工具。

title: ELT-Bench-Verified: Benchmark Quality Issues Underestimate AI Agent Capabilities
summary:
Constructing Extract-Load-Transform (ELT) pipelines is a labor-intensive data engineering task and a high-impact target for AI automation. On ELT-Bench, the first benchmark for end-to-end ELT pipeline construction, AI agents initially showed low success rates, suggesting they lacked practical utility.
  We revisit these results and identify two factors causing a substantial underestimation of agent capabilities. First, re-evaluating ELT-Bench with upgraded large language models reveals that the extraction and loading stage is largely solved, while transformation performance improves significantly. Second, we develop an Auditor-Corrector methodology that combines scalable LLM-driven root-cause analysis with rigorous human validation (inter-annotator agreement Fleiss' kappa = 0.85) to audit benchmark quality. Applying this to ELT-Bench uncovers that most failed transformation tasks contain benchmark-attributable errors -- including rigid evaluation scripts, ambiguous specifications, and incorrect ground truth -- that penalize correct agent outputs.
  Based on these findings, we construct ELT-Bench-Verified, a revised benchmark with refined evaluation logic and corrected ground truth. Re-evaluating on this version yields significant improvement attributable entirely to benchmark correction. Our results show that both rapid model improvement and benchmark quality issues contributed to underestimating agent capabilities. More broadly, our findings echo observations of pervasive annotation errors in text-to-SQL benchmarks, suggesting quality issues are systemic in data engineering evaluation. Systematic quality auditing should be standard practice for complex agentic tasks. We release ELT-Bench-Verified to provide a more reliable foundation for progress in AI-driven data engineering automation.
tldr: This paper identifies and corrects benchmark quality issues in ELT-Bench, revealing that these issues and rapid model improvement had previously underestimated AI agent capabilities for automated data engineering tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文发现并纠正了ELT-Bench的基准质量问题，揭示了这些问题和模型快速进步曾导致AI代理在数据工程自动化任务上的能力被低估。
summary_zh:
构建抽取-加载-转换（ELT）流水线是一项劳动密集型的数据工程任务，也是人工智能自动化的重要目标。在首个端到端ELT流水线构建基准测试ELT-Bench上，智能体最初表现出的成功率较低，表明其缺乏实际应用价值。  
我们重新审视这些结果，发现导致智能体能力被严重低估的两个因素。首先，使用升级后的大型语言模型重新评估ELT-Bench显示，抽取与加载阶段已基本解决，而转换阶段的性能显著提升。其次，我们开发了一种审计校正方法，该方法结合了可扩展的LLM驱动根因分析与严格的人工验证（评估者间一致性Fleiss' kappa = 0.85），以审计基准测试质量。将此方法应用于ELT-Bench发现，大多数失败的转换任务存在基准测试可归因的错误——包括僵化的评估脚本、模糊的规范以及错误的标准答案——这些错误导致正确智能体输出被误判。  
基于这些发现，我们构建了ELT-Bench-Verified，这是一个经过修订的基准测试版本，其评估逻辑得到优化且标准答案已修正。在此版本上重新评估显示，性能提升完全归因于基准测试的修正。我们的结果表明，模型快速进步与基准测试质量问题共同导致了智能体能力被低估。更广泛而言，我们的发现呼应了文本到SQL基准测试中普遍存在的标注错误现象，表明数据工程评估中存在系统性质量问题。对于复杂的智能体任务，系统化的质量审计应成为标准实践。我们发布ELT-Bench-Verified，旨在为人工智能驱动的数据工程自动化进展提供更可靠的基础。

title: Deep Learning-Based Anomaly Detection in Spacecraft Telemetry on Edge Devices
summary: Spacecraft anomaly detection is critical for mission safety, yet deploying sophisticated models on-board presents significant challenges due to hardware constraints. This paper investigates three approaches for spacecraft telemetry anomaly detection -- forecasting & threshold, direct classification, and image classification -- and optimizes them for edge deployment using multi-objective neural architecture optimization on the European Space Agency Anomaly Dataset. Our baseline experiments demonstrate that forecasting & threshold achieves superior detection performance (92.7% Corrected Event-wise F0.5-score (CEF0.5)) [1] compared to alternatives. Through Pareto-optimal architecture optimization, we dramatically reduced computational requirements while maintaining capabilities -- the optimized forecasting & threshold model preserved 88.8% CEF0.5 while reducing RAM usage by 97.1% to just 59 KB and operations by 99.4%. Analysis of deployment viability shows our optimized models require just 0.36-6.25% of CubeSat RAM, making on-board anomaly detection practical even on highly constrained hardware. This research demonstrates that sophisticated anomaly detection capabilities can be successfully deployed within spacecraft edge computing constraints, providing near-instantaneous detection without exceeding hardware limitations or compromising mission safety.
tldr: This paper focuses on optimizing deep learning models for anomaly detection in spacecraft telemetry to run on resource-constrained edge devices, demonstrating significant reductions in computational requirements.
tldr_zh: 本文研究优化用于航天器遥测异常检测的深度学习模型，使其能在资源受限的边缘设备上运行，大幅降低了计算资源需求。
summary_zh: 航天器异常检测对任务安全至关重要，但受硬件限制，在星载设备上部署复杂模型面临巨大挑战。本文研究了航天器遥测异常检测的三种方法——预测与阈值法、直接分类法和图像分类法，并基于欧洲空间局异常数据集，采用多目标神经架构优化技术对其进行边缘部署优化。基线实验表明，预测与阈值法取得了最优检测性能（校正事件级F0.5分数达92.7%），优于其他方案。通过帕累托最优架构优化，我们在保持检测能力的同时大幅降低了计算需求：优化后的预测与阈值模型在维持88.8%校正事件级F0.5分数的前提下，将内存占用减少97.1%至仅59KB，计算操作量降低99.4%。部署可行性分析表明，优化后模型仅需占用立方星0.36-6.25%的内存空间，使得在高度受限的硬件上实现星载异常检测成为可能。本研究证明，在航天器边缘计算约束下成功部署先进的异常检测能力是可行的，既能提供近实时检测，又不会突破硬件限制或影响任务安全。

title: Rigorous Explanations for Tree Ensembles
summary: Tree ensembles (TEs) find a multitude of practical applications. They represent one of the most general and accurate classes of machine learning methods. While they are typically quite concise in representation, their operation remains inscrutable to human decision makers. One solution to build trust in the operation of TEs is to automatically identify explanations for the predictions made. Evidently, we can only achieve trust using explanations, if those explanations are rigorous, that is truly reflect properties of the underlying predictor they explain This paper investigates the computation of rigorously-defined, logically-sound explanations for the concrete case of two well-known examples of tree ensembles, namely random forests and boosted trees.
tldr: This paper develops methods for computing rigorous, logically-sound explanations for the predictions of tree ensembles (random forests and boosted trees) to enhance trust and interpretability.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了为树集成模型（如随机森林和提升树）的计算生成严格、逻辑上合理的解释，以增强对其预测的信任和可解释性。
summary_zh: 树集成模型（TEs）在诸多实际应用中得到了广泛运用，代表了机器学习方法中最通用且最准确的类别之一。尽管它们在表示上通常较为简洁，但其运行机制对人类决策者而言仍难以理解。为了增强对树集成模型运作的信任度，一种方法是自动为其预测结果生成解释性说明。显然，只有当这些解释严谨可靠，即真实反映所解释底层预测器的特性时，我们才能通过解释建立起可信度。本文针对树集成模型的两个经典实例——随机森林和提升树，探讨了如何计算严格定义、逻辑完备的解释性说明。

title: Real-Time Band-Grouped Vocal Denoising Using Sigmoid-Driven Ideal Ratio Masking
summary: Real-time, deep learning-based vocal denoising has seen significant progress over the past few years, demonstrating the capability of artificial intelligence in preserving the naturalness of the voice while increasing the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). However, many deep learning approaches have high amounts of latency and require long frames of context, making them difficult to configure for live applications. To address these challenges, we propose a sigmoid-driven ideal ratio mask trained with a spectral loss to encourage an increased SNR and maximized perceptual quality of the voice. The proposed model uses a band-grouped encoder-decoder architecture with frequency attention and achieves a total latency of less than 10,ms, with PESQ-WB improvements of 0.21 on stationary noise and 0.12 on nonstationary noise.
tldr: This paper proposes a low-latency, deep learning-based method for real-time vocal denoising using a sigmoid-driven ideal ratio mask and a band-grouped architecture.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种低延迟的深度学习方法，用于实时语音去噪，采用了Sigmoid驱动的理想比值掩码和频带分组架构。
summary_zh: 近年来，基于深度学习的实时语音降噪技术取得了显著进展，展现了人工智能在提升信噪比的同时保持语音自然度的能力。然而，许多深度学习方法存在高延迟且需要长上下文帧的问题，难以在实时应用中部署。针对这些挑战，我们提出一种基于sigmoid激活的理想比值掩膜模型，该模型通过谱损失函数训练以提升信噪比并最大化语音感知质量。所提出的模型采用频带分组的编码器-解码器架构，结合频率注意力机制，实现了低于10毫秒的总延迟，并在平稳噪声和非平稳噪声环境下分别取得了0.21和0.12的PESQ-WB指标提升。

title: Sima AIunty: Caste Audit in LLM-Driven Matchmaking
summary: Social and personal decisions in relational domains such as matchmaking are deeply entwined with cultural norms and historical hierarchies, and can potentially be shaped by algorithmic and AI-mediated assessments of compatibility, acceptance, and stability. In South Asian contexts, caste remains a central aspect of marital decision-making, yet little is known about how contemporary large language models (LLMs) reproduce or disrupt caste-based stratification in such settings. In this work, we conduct a controlled audit of caste bias in LLM-mediated matchmaking evaluations using real-world matrimonial profiles. We vary caste identity across Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, Shudra, and Dalit, and income across five buckets, and evaluate five LLM families (GPT, Gemini, Llama, Qwen, and BharatGPT). Models are prompted to assess profiles along dimensions of social acceptance, marital stability, and cultural compatibility. Our analysis reveals consistent hierarchical patterns across models: same-caste matches are rated most favorably, with average ratings up to 25% higher (on a 10-point scale) than inter-caste matches, which are further ordered according to traditional caste hierarchy. These findings highlight how existing caste hierarchies are reproduced in LLM decision-making and underscore the need for culturally grounded evaluation and intervention strategies in AI systems deployed in socially sensitive domains, where such systems risk reinforcing historical forms of exclusion.
tldr: The paper audits caste bias in LLM-mediated matchmaking evaluations, revealing that models consistently reproduce existing caste hierarchies by rating same-caste matches more favorably.
tldr_zh: 本文审计了LLM在婚介评估中的种姓偏见，发现模型通过更青睐同种姓匹配，持续复制现有的种姓等级制度。
summary_zh: 在婚配等关系领域，社会与个人决策深受文化规范和历史等级制度的影响，并可能被算法及人工智能对兼容性、接纳度与稳定性的评估所形塑。在南亚语境中，种姓仍是婚姻决策的核心要素，但当代大语言模型如何在此类情境中复制或打破基于种姓的阶层分化，目前尚不明确。本研究利用真实世界婚介资料，对大语言模型在婚配评估中的种姓偏见进行受控审计。我们通过改变婆罗门、刹帝利、吠舍、首陀罗和达利特种姓身份，以及五个收入层级，评估了五大模型系列（GPT、Gemini、Llama、Qwen和BharatGPT）。研究通过提示模型从社会接纳度、婚姻稳定性和文化兼容性三个维度评估个人资料，发现所有模型均呈现一致的等级模式：同种姓匹配获得最高评分（在10分制量表中平均评分最高可超出跨种姓匹配25%），而跨种姓匹配的评分则依据传统种姓等级进一步排序。这些发现揭示了现有种姓等级制度如何在大语言模型决策中被复制，并强调在涉及社会敏感领域的人工智能系统中，需建立基于文化的评估与干预策略——此类系统若未经审慎设计，将可能强化历史性的排斥机制。

title: Monodense Deep Neural Model for Determining Item Price Elasticity
summary:
Item Price Elasticity is used to quantify the responsiveness of consumer demand to changes in item prices, enabling businesses to create pricing strategies and optimize revenue management. Sectors such as store retail, e-commerce, and consumer goods rely on elasticity information derived from historical sales and pricing data. This elasticity provides an understanding of purchasing behavior across different items, consumer discount sensitivity, and demand elastic departments. This information is particularly valuable for competitive markets and resource-constrained businesses decision making which aims to maximize profitability and market share. Price elasticity also uncovers historical shifts in consumer responsiveness over time. In this paper, we model item-level price elasticity using large-scale transactional datasets, by proposing a novel elasticity estimation framework which has the capability to work in an absence of treatment control setting. We test this framework by using Machine learning based algorithms listed below, including our newly proposed Monodense deep neural network.
  (1) Monodense-DL network -- Hybrid neural network architecture combining embedding, dense, and Monodense layers (2) DML -- Double machine learning setting using regression models (3) LGBM -- Light Gradient Boosting Model
  We evaluate our model on multi-category retail data spanning millions of transactions using a back testing framework. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our proposed neural network model within the framework compared to other prevalent ML based methods listed above.
tldr: Proposes a novel deep learning framework (Monodense) for estimating item price elasticity from transactional data, without requiring treatment-control data, and shows it outperforms other ML methods.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个新的深度学习框架（Monodense），用于从交易数据中估计商品价格弹性，无需处理-控制数据，并证明其优于其他机器学习方法。
summary_zh:
商品价格弹性用于量化消费者需求对商品价格变动的敏感程度，使企业能够制定定价策略并优化收益管理。商店零售、电子商务和消费品等行业依赖于从历史销售和定价数据中推导出的弹性信息。这种弹性有助于理解不同商品的购买行为、消费者折扣敏感性以及需求弹性部门。这些信息对于竞争激烈的市场和资源有限的企业决策尤为宝贵，其目标在于最大化利润和市场份额。价格弹性还能揭示消费者敏感度随时间变化的历史趋势。本文利用大规模交易数据集，通过提出一种新颖的弹性估计框架，对商品级价格弹性进行建模，该框架能够在缺乏处理对照设定的条件下运行。我们采用以下基于机器学习的算法测试该框架，包括我们新提出的Monodense深度神经网络：
（1）Monodense-DL网络——结合嵌入层、稠密层和Monodense层的混合神经网络架构；
（2）DML——使用回归模型的双重机器学习设定；
（3）LGBM——轻量梯度提升模型。
我们通过回溯测试框架，在涵盖数百万交易的多品类零售数据上评估模型。实验结果表明，与上述其他主流机器学习方法相比，我们提出的神经网络模型在该框架中表现更优。

title: MemRerank: Preference Memory for Personalized Product Reranking
summary: LLM-based shopping agents increasingly rely on long purchase histories and multi-turn interactions for personalization, yet naively appending raw history to prompts is often ineffective due to noise, length, and relevance mismatch. We propose MemRerank, a preference memory framework that distills user purchase history into concise, query-independent signals for personalized product reranking. To study this problem, we build an end-to-end benchmark and evaluation framework centered on an LLM-based \textbf{1-in-5} selection task, which measures both memory quality and downstream reranking utility. We further train the memory extractor with reinforcement learning (RL), using downstream reranking performance as supervision. Experiments with two LLM-based rerankers show that MemRerank consistently outperforms no-memory, raw-history, and off-the-shelf memory baselines, yielding up to \textbf{+10.61} absolute points in 1-in-5 accuracy. These results suggest that explicit preference memory is a practical and effective building block for personalization in agentic e-commerce systems.
tldr: The paper proposes MemRerank, a preference memory framework that distills user purchase history for personalized product reranking in e-commerce, using RL to train the memory extractor.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 MemRerank，一个偏好记忆框架，用于电子商务中的个性化产品重排序，它通过强化学习训练记忆提取器来提炼用户购买历史。
summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的购物代理日益依赖长期购买历史和多轮交互实现个性化推荐，但将原始历史记录直接附加到提示中常因信息噪声、长度问题及相关性错配而效果不佳。我们提出MemRerank——一种偏好记忆框架，可将用户购买历史提炼为独立于查询的简洁信号，用于个性化商品重排序。为研究此问题，我们构建了以基于大语言模型的\textbf{五选一}任务为核心的端到端基准评估框架，该框架可同时衡量记忆质量与下游重排序效用。我们进一步通过强化学习训练记忆提取器，并以下游重排序性能作为监督信号。在两种基于大语言模型的重排序器上的实验表明，MemRerank在五选一准确率上持续超越无记忆、原始历史及现成记忆基线方法，最高可提升\textbf{10.61}个绝对百分点。这些结果表明，显式偏好记忆是电商代理系统中实现个性化推荐的有效且实用的构建模块。

title: Improving Ensemble Forecasts of Abnormally Deflecting Tropical Cyclones with Fused Atmosphere-Ocean-Terrain Data
summary: Deep learning-based tropical cyclone (TC) forecasting methods have demonstrated significant potential and application advantages, as they feature much lower computational cost and faster operation speed than numerical weather prediction models. However, existing deep learning methods still have key limitations: they can only process a single type of sequential trajectory data or homogeneous meteorological variables, and fail to achieve accurate forecasting of abnormal deflected TCs. To address these challenges, we present two groundbreaking contributions. First, we have constructed a multimodal and multi-source dataset named AOT-TCs for TC forecasting in the Northwest Pacific basin. As the first dataset of its kind, it innovatively integrates heterogeneous variables from the atmosphere, ocean, and land, thus obtaining a comprehensive and information-rich meteorological dataset. Second, based on the AOT-TCs dataset, we propose a forecasting model that can handle both normal and abnormally deflected TCs. This is the first TC forecasting model to adopt an explicit atmosphere-ocean-terrain coupling architecture, enabling it to effectively capture complex interactions across physical domains. Extensive experiments on all TC cases in the Northwest Pacific from 2017 to 2024 show that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance in TC forecasting: it not only significantly improves the forecasting accuracy of normal TCs but also breaks through the technical bottleneck in forecasting abnormally deflected TCs.
tldr: The paper proposes a multimodal deep learning model and dataset for forecasting tropical cyclone trajectories, focusing on handling abnormal deflections by integrating atmospheric, oceanic, and terrain data. It reports state-of-the-art results for the Northwest Pacific basin.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于热带气旋轨迹预测的多模态深度学习模型和数据集，通过融合大气、海洋和陆地数据来预测异常偏转的气旋，并在西北太平洋区域取得了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 基于深度学习的台风预测方法因其远低于数值天气预报模型的计算成本和更快的运算速度，已展现出显著潜力与应用优势。然而，现有深度学习方法仍存在关键局限：仅能处理单一类型的时序轨迹数据或同质气象变量，且无法实现异常偏转台风的精准预测。为应对这些挑战，我们提出两项突破性贡献。首先，我们构建了面向西北太平洋流域台风预测的多模态多源数据集AOT-TCs，该数据集首次创新性地融合大气、海洋与陆地的多源异质变量，从而获得全面且信息丰富的气象数据。其次，基于AOT-TCs数据集，我们提出了能够同时处理正常与异常偏转台风的预测模型。这是首个采用显式大气-海洋-地形耦合架构的台风预测模型，使其能有效捕捉跨物理域的复杂相互作用。通过对2017至2024年西北太平洋全部台风案例的广泛实验表明，我们的模型在台风预测中达到了领先性能：不仅显著提升正常台风的预测精度，更在异常偏转台风预测中实现了技术瓶颈的突破。

title: Towards Automatic Soccer Commentary Generation with Knowledge-Enhanced Visual Reasoning
summary: Soccer commentary plays a crucial role in enhancing the soccer game viewing experience for audiences. Previous studies in automatic soccer commentary generation typically adopt an end-to-end method to generate anonymous live text commentary. Such generated commentary is insufficient in the context of real-world live televised commentary, as it contains anonymous entities, context-dependent errors and lacks statistical insights of the game events. To bridge the gap, we propose GameSight, a two-stage model to address soccer commentary generation as a knowledge-enhanced visual reasoning task, enabling live-televised-like knowledgeable commentary with accurate reference to entities (players and teams). GameSight starts by performing visual reasoning to align anonymous entities with fine-grained visual and contextual analysis. Subsequently, the entity-aligned commentary is refined with knowledge by incorporating external historical statistics and iteratively updated internal game state information. Consequently, GameSight improves the player alignment accuracy by 18.5% on SN-Caption-test-align dataset compared to Gemini 2.5-pro. Combined with further knowledge enhancement, GameSight outperforms in segment-level accuracy and commentary quality, as well as game-level contextual relevance and structural composition. We believe that our work paves the way for a more informative and engaging human-centric experience with the AI sports application. Demo Page: https://gamesight2025.github.io/gamesight2025
tldr: This paper presents GameSight, a two-stage model for generating knowledgeable, entity-specific soccer commentary by performing visual reasoning to align anonymous entities and incorporating external historical statistics and game state information.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GameSight，一个两阶段模型，通过视觉推理对齐匿名实体并整合外部历史统计数据和游戏状态信息，以生成具有知识性、实体明确的足球解说。
