summary_zh: 足球解说在提升观众观赛体验方面发挥着关键作用。自动足球解说生成领域的前期研究通常采用端到端方法生成匿名实时文字解说。然而在真实电视直播解说场景中，此类生成解说存在匿名实体引用、上下文依赖错误以及缺乏赛事统计洞察等局限。为弥补这些不足，我们提出GameSight两阶段模型，将足球解说生成构建为知识增强的视觉推理任务，从而生成能准确引用实体（球员与球队）的类电视直播知识型解说。GameSight首先通过视觉推理将匿名实体与细粒度视觉及上下文分析进行对齐，随后引入外部历史统计数据与迭代更新的内部比赛状态信息，对实体对齐后的解说进行知识增强优化。实验表明，在SN-Caption-test-align数据集上，GameSight的球员对齐准确率较Gemini 2.5-pro提升18.5%。结合知识增强机制，该模型在片段级准确率与解说质量、比赛级上下文相关性与结构组织方面均表现优异。我们相信这项工作为构建信息更丰富、更具吸引力的以人为本AI体育应用体验开辟了新路径。演示页面：https://gamesight2025.github.io/gamesight2025

title: SimMOF: AI agent for Automated MOF Simulations
summary: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) offer a vast design space, and as such, computational simulations play a critical role in predicting their structural and physicochemical properties. However, MOF simulations remain difficult to access because reliable analysis require expert decisions for workflow construction, parameter selection, tool interoperability, and the preparation of computational ready structures. Here, we introduce SimMOF, a large language model based multi agent framework that automates end-to-end MOF simulation workflows from natural language queries. SimMOF translates user requests into dependency aware plans, generates runnable inputs, orchestrates multiple agents to execute simulations, and summarizes results with analysis aligned to the user query. Through representative case studies, we show that SimMOF enables adaptive and cognitively autonomous workflows that reflect the iterative and decision driven behavior of human researchers and as such provides a scalable foundation for data driven MOF research.
tldr: SimMOF is an LLM-based multi-agent framework that automates end-to-end workflows for Metal-Organic Framework (MOF) simulation from natural language queries, aiming to make complex computational materials science more accessible.
tldr_zh: SimMOF是一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，用于从自然语言查询自动执行金属有机框架（MOF）模拟的端到端工作流，旨在让复杂的计算材料科学更易于使用。
summary_zh: 金属有机框架材料具有广阔的设计空间，因此计算模拟在预测其结构与物理化学性质方面发挥着关键作用。然而，可靠的MOF模拟分析仍面临较高门槛，需要专家在流程构建、参数选择、工具兼容性及计算结构准备等方面做出决策。本文提出SimMOF——一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，能够根据自然语言查询实现端到端的MOF模拟流程自动化。该系统将用户需求转化为具有依赖感知的执行计划，生成可运行的计算输入，协调多个智能体执行模拟任务，并基于用户查询意图对结果进行总结分析。通过代表性案例研究，我们证明SimMOF能够实现自适应且具备认知自主性的工作流程，其迭代式与决策驱动的特性模拟了人类研究者的工作模式，从而为数据驱动的MOF研究提供了可扩展的基础架构。

title: Knowledge database development by large language models for countermeasures against viruses and marine toxins
summary: Access to the most up-to-date information on medical countermeasures is important for the research and development of effective treatments for viruses and marine toxins. However, there is a lack of comprehensive databases that curate data on viruses and marine toxins, making decisions on medical countermeasures slow and difficult. In this work, we employ two large language models (LLMs) of ChatGPT and Grok to design two comprehensive databases of therapeutic countermeasures for five viruses of Lassa, Marburg, Ebola, Nipah, and Venezuelan equine encephalitis, as well as marine toxins. With high-level human-provided inputs, the two LLMs identify public databases containing data on the five viruses and marine toxins, collect relevant information from these databases and the literature, iteratively cross-validate the collected information, and design interactive webpages for easy access to the curated, comprehensive databases. Notably, the ChatGPT LLM is employed to design agentic AI workflows (consisting of two AI agents for research and decision-making) to rank countermeasures for viruses and marine toxins in the databases. Together, our work explores the potential of LLMs as a scalable, updatable approach for building comprehensive knowledge databases and supporting evidence-based decision-making.
tldr: This paper uses LLMs (ChatGPT, Grok) to build and cross-validate comprehensive knowledge databases for medical countermeasures against viruses and marine toxins, exploring agentic AI workflows for ranking treatments.
tldr_zh: 本研究使用大型语言模型（ChatGPT、Grok）为病毒和海洋毒素的医疗对策构建并交叉验证综合性知识数据库，探索了用于排名治疗方案的智能体AI工作流程。
summary_zh: 获取最新的医疗对策信息对于研发针对病毒和海洋毒素的有效治疗方法至关重要。然而，目前缺乏全面整合病毒和海洋毒素数据的数据库，导致医疗对策的决策过程缓慢且困难。本研究运用ChatGPT和Grok两种大型语言模型，针对拉沙病毒、马尔堡病毒、埃博拉病毒、尼帕病毒、委内瑞拉马脑炎病毒以及海洋毒素，构建了两个综合性的治疗对策数据库。在高层级人工输入的引导下，这两种大语言模型识别了包含上述五种病毒及海洋毒素数据的公共数据库，从这些数据库及相关文献中收集信息，通过迭代交叉验证对所收集信息进行整合，并设计了交互式网页以便用户便捷访问这些经过系统整理的综合性数据库。值得注意的是，本研究利用ChatGPT大语言模型设计了自主AI工作流（包含负责研究和决策的两个AI代理），用于对数据库中病毒与海洋毒素的应对措施进行优先级排序。综上所述，我们的工作探索了大型语言模型作为可扩展、可更新的工具，在构建综合性知识数据库和支持循证决策方面的潜力。

title: REFINE: Real-world Exploration of Interactive Feedback and Student Behaviour
summary: Formative feedback is central to effective learning, yet providing timely, individualised feedback at scale remains a persistent challenge. While recent work has explored the use of large language models (LLMs) to automate feedback, most existing systems still conceptualise feedback as a static, one-way artifact, offering limited support for interpretation, clarification, or follow-up. In this work, we introduce REFINE, a locally deployable, multi-agent feedback system built on small, open-source LLMs that treats feedback as an interactive process. REFINE combines a pedagogically-grounded feedback generation agent with an LLM-as-a-judge-guided regeneration loop using a human-aligned judge, and a self-reflective tool-calling interactive agent that supports student follow-up questions with context-aware, actionable responses. We evaluate REFINE through controlled experiments and an authentic classroom deployment in an undergraduate computer science course. Automatic evaluations show that judge-guided regeneration significantly improves feedback quality, and that the interactive agent produces efficient, high-quality responses comparable to a state-of-the-art closed-source model. Analysis of real student interactions further reveals distinct engagement patterns and indicates that system-generated feedback systematically steers subsequent student inquiry. Our findings demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of multi-agent, tool-augmented feedback systems for scalable, interactive feedback.
tldr: This paper introduces REFINE, a multi-agent system using open-source LLMs to provide interactive, scalable formative feedback in educational settings, validated in a computer science course.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了REFINE，一个使用开源大语言模型的多智能体系统，旨在为教育环境提供可扩展的交互式形成性反馈，并在计算机科学课程中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 形成性反馈是有效学习的核心，但在大规模教学中提供及时、个性化的反馈仍是一项持续挑战。尽管近期研究已探索使用大型语言模型（LLM）实现反馈自动化，但现有系统大多仍将反馈视为静态、单向的成品，在解读、澄清或跟进方面支持有限。本研究提出REFINE——一个基于小型开源LLM、可本地部署的多智能体反馈系统，将反馈重构为交互式过程。REFINE融合了三个核心模块：基于教学原理的反馈生成智能体、采用人类对齐评判器引导的LLM-as-a-judge再生循环，以及支持学生后续提问并给出情境感知、可操作回应的自省式工具调用交互智能体。我们通过对照实验和本科计算机科学课程的真实课堂部署对REFINE进行评估。自动评估显示，评判器引导的再生机制显著提升了反馈质量，交互智能体生成的响应效率与质量可与前沿闭源模型媲美。对学生真实交互行为的分析进一步揭示了差异化的参与模式，表明系统生成的反馈能系统性地引导学生的后续探究。本研究论证了多智能体工具增强型反馈系统在实现可扩展交互反馈方面的可行性与有效性。

title: Towards Explainable Stakeholder-Aware Requirements Prioritisation in Aged-Care Digital Health
summary: Requirements engineering for aged-care digital health must account for human aspects, because requirement priorities are shaped not only by technical functionality but also by stakeholders' health conditions, socioeconomics, and lived experience. Knowing which human aspects matter most, and for whom, is critical for inclusive and evidence-based requirements prioritisation. Yet in practice, while some studies have examined human aspects in RE, they have largely relied on expert judgement or model-driven analysis rather than large-scale user studies with meaningful human-in-the-loop validation to determine which aspects matter most and why. To address this gap, we conducted a mixed-methods study with 103 older adults, 105 developers, and 41 caregivers. We first applied an explainable machine learning to identify the human aspects most strongly associated with requirement priorities across 8 aged-care digital health themes, and then conducted 12 semi-structured interviews to validate and interpret the quantitative patterns. The results identify the key human aspects shaping requirement priorities, reveal their directional effects, and expose substantial misalignment across stakeholder groups. Together, these findings show that human-centric requirements analysis should engage stakeholder groups explicitly rather than collapsing their perspectives into a single aggregate view. This paper contributes an identification of the key human aspects driving requirement priorities in aged-care digital health and an explainable, human-centric RE framework that combines ML-derived importance rankings with qualitative validation to surface the stakeholder misalignments that inclusive requirements engineering must address.
tldr: The paper presents an explainable, human-centric requirements engineering framework for aged-care digital health, using machine learning and qualitative methods to identify and validate key human aspects that shape requirement priorities across different stakeholder groups.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于老年护理数字健康的可解释、以人为本的需求工程框架，结合机器学习和定性方法，识别并验证了影响不同利益相关群体需求优先级的关键人为因素。
summary_zh: 面向老年护理数字健康的需求工程必须考量人的因素，因为需求优先级不仅由技术功能决定，更受到利益相关者的健康状况、社会经济背景和生活经历的深刻影响。明确哪些人的因素最为关键、以及对哪些群体关键，是实现包容性与循证式需求优先级排序的核心。然而实践中，尽管已有研究探讨了需求工程中人的因素，但多数依赖专家判断或模型驱动分析，缺乏通过大规模用户研究及有效的人机协同验证来系统揭示关键因素及其成因。为填补这一空白，我们开展了一项混合方法研究，涵盖103位老年人、105名开发者和41位护理人员。研究首先运用可解释机器学习技术，识别出在8个老年护理数字健康主题中最显著影响需求优先级的人的因素，随后通过12场半结构化访谈验证并阐释定量分析模式。研究结果揭示了塑造需求优先级的关键人的因素，阐明了其方向性影响，并暴露出不同利益相关者群体间存在显著认知偏差。这些发现共同表明：以人为本的需求分析应明确区分各利益相关群体，而非将其观点笼统合并为单一聚合视角。本文的贡献在于：一方面识别了驱动老年护理数字健康需求优先级的关键人的因素，另一方面提出了一个可解释的、以人为本的需求工程框架。该框架通过结合机器学习生成的重要性排序与质性验证，揭示了包容性需求工程必须解决的利益相关者认知偏差问题。

title: Evaluating a Data-Driven Redesign Process for Intelligent Tutoring Systems
summary: Past research has defined a general process for the data-driven redesign of educational technologies and has shown that in carefully-selected instances, this process can help make systems more effective. In the current work, we test the generality of the approach by applying it to four units of a middle-school mathematics intelligent tutoring system that were selected not based on suitability for redesign, as in previous work, but on topic. We tested whether the redesigned system was more effective than the original in a classroom study with 123 students. Although the learning gains did not differ between the conditions, students who used the Redesigned Tutor had more productive time-on-task, a larger number of skills practiced, and greater total knowledge mastery. The findings highlight the promise of data-driven redesign even when applied to instructional units *not* selected as likely to yield improvement, as evidence of the generality and wide applicability of the method.
tldr: The paper evaluates a data-driven redesign process for intelligent tutoring systems in middle-school math, finding that the redesigned system increased student engagement and practice volume but not learning gains, demonstrating the general applicability of the method.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了中学数学智能辅导系统的数据驱动重新设计流程，发现重新设计的系统提高了学生的参与度和练习量，但并未提升学习效果，证明了该方法的通用性和广泛适用性。
summary_zh: 过往研究已为数据驱动的教育技术重设计定义了一个通用流程，并证明在精心选取的案例中，该流程有助于提升系统的有效性。本研究通过将该方法应用于中学数学智能辅导系统的四个单元，以检验其普适性。这些单元的选择并非基于重设计的适宜性（如以往研究），而是基于教学主题。我们在涉及123名学生的课堂实验中，检验了重设计系统是否比原系统更有效。尽管两种条件下的学习增益并无显著差异，但使用重设计辅导系统的学生表现出更高的任务有效投入时间、更多的技能练习量以及更全面的知识掌握程度。这些发现凸显了数据驱动重设计的潜力——即使应用于那些*未*经预先筛选可能产生改进的教学单元，其有效性仍得以验证，这为该方法的普适性与广泛适用性提供了证据。

title: The Energy Footprint of LLM-Based Environmental Analysis: LLMs and Domain Products
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in domain-specific applications, including climate change and environmental research, understanding their energy footprint has become an important concern. The growing adoption of retrieval-augmented (RAG) systems for climate-domain specific analysis raises a key question: how does the energy consumption of domain-specific RAG workflows compare with that of direct generic LLM usage? Prior research has focused on standalone model calls or coarse token-based estimates, while leaving the energy implications of deployed application workflows insufficiently understood. In this paper, we assess the inference-time energy consumption of two LLM-based climate analysis chatbots (ChatNetZero and ChatNDC) compared to the generic GPT-4o-mini model. We estimate energy use under actual user queries by decomposing each workflow into retrieval, generation, and hallucination-checking components. We also test across different times of day and geographic access locations. Our results show that the energy consumption of domain-specific RAG systems depends strongly on their design. More agentic pipelines substantially increase inference-time energy use, particularly when used for additional accuracy or verification checks, although they may not yield proportional gains in response quality. While more research is needed to further test these initial findings more robustly across models, environments and prompting structures, this study provides a new understanding on how the design of domain-specific LLM products affects both the energy footprint and quality of output.
tldr: This paper analyzes the inference-time energy consumption of domain-specific RAG workflows for climate analysis compared to generic LLMs, finding that design choices significantly impact energy use.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了用于气候分析的特定领域RAG工作流与通用LLM相比的推理阶段能耗，发现设计选择对能耗有显著影响。
summary_zh: 随着大语言模型在气候变化、环境研究等特定领域应用日益广泛，其能源足迹问题已成为重要关注点。基于检索增强生成系统在气候领域分析中的普及引发了一个关键问题：特定领域RAG工作流程的能耗与直接使用通用大语言模型相比有何差异？现有研究多聚焦于独立模型调用或基于词汇单元的粗略估算，而对实际应用工作流程的能耗影响尚未充分探究。本文通过分解检索、生成与幻觉校验等组件，在实际用户查询场景下评估了两种气候分析聊天机器人（ChatNetZero与ChatNDC）相比通用GPT-4o-mini模型在推理阶段的能耗差异，并测试了不同时段与地理访问位置的影响。研究发现：特定领域RAG系统的能耗高度依赖其设计架构。自主性更强的流程会显著增加推理能耗，尤其是在进行额外准确性验证时，但未必能带来相应比例的输出质量提升。尽管仍需通过跨模型、环境及提示结构的更广泛测试来验证这些初步发现，但本研究为理解特定领域大语言产品的设计如何同时影响能源足迹与输出质量提供了新的认知视角。

title: The Future of AI is Many, Not One
summary: The way we're thinking about generative AI right now is fundamentally individual. We see this not just in how users interact with models but also in how models are built, how they're benchmarked, and how commercial and research strategies using AI are defined. We argue that we should abandon this approach if we're hoping for AI to support groundbreaking innovation and scientific discovery. Drawing on research and formal results in complex systems, organizational behavior, and philosophy of science, we show why we should expect deep intellectual breakthroughs to come from epistemically diverse groups of AI agents working together rather than singular superintelligent agents. Having a diverse team broadens the search for solutions, delays premature consensus, and allows for the pursuit of unconventional approaches. Developing diverse AI teams also addresses AI critics' concerns that current models are constrained by past data and lack the creative insight required for innovation. The upshot, we argue, is that the future of transformative transformer-based AI is fundamentally many, not one.
tldr: The paper argues that future AI breakthroughs will come from diverse groups of agents collaborating, not singular superintelligent models, based on principles from complex systems and philosophy of science.
tldr_zh: 该论文主张，基于复杂系统和科学哲学原理，未来的人工智能突破将来自多样化智能体的协作，而非单一的超级智能模型。
summary_zh: 当前对生成式人工智能的思考方式本质上是孤立的。这种孤立性不仅体现在用户与模型的交互方式上，更渗透于模型构建方法、性能评估标准以及人工智能商业与研究战略的制定逻辑中。我们认为，若期待人工智能真正推动颠覆性创新与科学发现，就必须摒弃这种范式。借鉴复杂系统理论、组织行为学与科学哲学领域的研究成果与形式化论证，本文阐明：深层次的知识突破更可能源自认知多元化的智能体协作系统，而非单一的超智能体。多元化的智能团队能够拓展解决方案的搜索空间，延缓过早达成共识，并为非常规研究路径的探索保留可能性。发展多样化人工智能团队同样回应了学界对当前模型的批评——这些模型受限于历史数据而缺乏创新所需的创造性洞察。我们的核心结论是：基于Transformer架构的变革性人工智能，其未来图景本质上是多元共生而非单一垄断的。

title: A Latent Risk-Aware Machine Learning Approach for Predicting Operational Success in Clinical Trials based on TrialsBank
summary: Clinical trials are characterized by high costs, extended timelines, and substantial operational risk, yet reliable prospective methods for predicting trial success before initiation remain limited. Existing artificial intelligence approaches often focus on isolated metrics or specific development stages and frequently rely on variables unavailable at the trial design phase, limiting real-world applicability. We present a hierarchical latent risk-aware machine learning framework for prospective prediction of clinical trial operational success using a curated subset of TrialsBank, a proprietary AI-ready database developed by Sorintellis, comprising 13,700 trials. Operational success was defined as the ability to initiate, conduct, and complete a clinical trial according to planned timelines, recruitment targets, and protocol specifications through database lock. This approach decomposes operational success prediction into two modeling stages. First, intermediate latent operational risk factors are predicted using more than 180 drug- and trial-level features available before trial initiation. These predicted latent risks are then integrated into a downstream model to estimate the probability of operational success. A staged data-splitting strategy was employed to prevent information leakage, and models were benchmarked using XGBoost, CatBoost, and Explainable Boosting Machines. Across Phase I-III, the framework achieves strong out-of-sample performance, with F1-scores of 0.93, 0.92, and 0.91, respectively. Incorporating latent risk drivers improves discrimination of operational failures, and performance remains robust under independent inference evaluation. These results demonstrate that clinical trial operational success can be prospectively forecasted using a latent risk-aware AI framework, enabling early risk assessment and supporting data-driven clinical development decision-making.
tldr: This paper presents a latent risk-aware machine learning framework for predicting clinical trial operational success using a proprietary database, focusing on features available before trial initiation.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出了一种基于潜在风险感知的机器学习框架，利用专有数据库，基于试验开始前可用的特征，对临床试验的操作成功率进行预测。
summary_zh: 临床试验以高成本、长周期和巨大的运营风险为特征，但在启动前预测试验成功率的可靠前瞻性方法仍然有限。现有的人工智能方法通常聚焦于孤立指标或特定开发阶段，且往往依赖于试验设计阶段无法获取的变量，限制了实际应用。我们提出了一种分层隐式风险感知机器学习框架，利用由Sorintellis开发的专有人工智能就绪数据库TrialsBank中精选的13,700项试验数据，对临床试验运营成功率进行前瞻性预测。运营成功被定义为按照计划时间表、招募目标和方案规范，通过数据库锁定完成试验启动、实施和收尾的能力。该方法将运营成功预测分解为两个建模阶段：首先使用超过180项试验启动前可获取的药物和试验层面特征，预测中间隐式运营风险因子；然后将这些预测的隐式风险整合至下游模型中，以估算运营成功概率。通过采用分阶段数据拆分策略防止信息泄露，并基于XGBoost、CatBoost和可解释提升机进行模型基准测试。该框架在Ⅰ-Ⅲ期临床试验中展现出优异的样本外预测性能，F1分数分别达到0.93、0.92和0.91。隐式风险因子的整合增强了对运营失败的识别能力，且在独立推理评估中保持稳健性能。这些结果表明，采用隐式风险感知人工智能框架能够前瞻性预测临床试验运营成功率，实现早期风险评估并支持数据驱动的临床开发决策。

title: Mimosa Framework: Toward Evolving Multi-Agent Systems for Scientific Research
summary: Current Autonomous Scientific Research (ASR) systems, despite leveraging large language models (LLMs) and agentic architectures, remain constrained by fixed workflows and toolsets that prevent adaptation to evolving tasks and environments. We introduce Mimosa, an evolving multi-agent framework that automatically synthesizes task-specific multi-agent workflows and iteratively refines them through experimental feedback. Mimosa leverages the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for dynamic tool discovery, generates workflow topologies via a meta-orchestrator, executes subtasks through code-generating agents that invoke available tools and scientific software libraries, and scores executions with an LLM-based judge whose feedback drives workflow refinement. On ScienceAgentBench, Mimosa achieves a success rate of 43.1% with DeepSeek-V3.2, surpassing both single-agent baselines and static multi-agent configurations. Our results further reveal that models respond heterogeneously to multi-agent decomposition and iterative learning, indicating that the benefits of workflow evolution depend on the capabilities of the underlying execution model. Beyond these benchmarks, Mimosa modular architecture and tool-agnostic design make it readily extensible, and its fully logged execution traces and archived workflows support auditability by preserving every analytical step for inspection and potential replication. Combined with domain-expert guidance, the framework has the potential to automate a broad range of computationally accessible scientific tasks across disciplines. Released as a fully open-source platform, Mimosa aims to provide an open foundation for community-driven ASR.
tldr: Introduces Mimosa, a multi-agent framework that automatically synthesizes and refines workflows for autonomous scientific research using LLMs and dynamic tool discovery.
tldr_zh: 介绍Mimosa，一个用于自主科学研究的、能自动合成和优化工作流程的多智能体框架，使用大语言模型和动态工具发现。
summary_zh: 当前的自助式科学研究（ASR）系统尽管借助大语言模型（LLM）与智能体架构，仍受限于固定工作流和工具集，难以适应动态变化的任务与环境。我们提出了Mimosa——一种可演进的多智能体框架，它能够自动生成针对特定任务的多智能体工作流，并通过实验反馈对其进行迭代优化。Mimosa利用模型上下文协议（MCP）实现动态工具发现，通过元协调器生成工作流拓扑结构，借助代码生成智能体调用可用工具与科学软件库执行子任务，并采用基于LLM的评估器对执行结果进行评分，其反馈驱动工作流的持续改进。在ScienceAgentBench基准测试中，Mimosa结合DeepSeek-V3.2实现了43.1%的成功率，超越了单智能体基线及静态多智能体配置。实验进一步表明，模型对多智能体分解与迭代学习的响应存在异质性，说明工作流演进的效益取决于底层执行模型的能力。除基准测试外，Mimosa的模块化架构与工具无关设计使其具备高度可扩展性，其完整记录的执行轨迹和归档工作流通过保留所有分析步骤支持审计与潜在复现。结合领域专家指导，该框架有望实现跨学科领域内多种可计算科学任务的自动化。作为完全开源平台发布的Mimosa，旨在为社区驱动的自助式科学研究提供开放基础。

title: The Spectral Edge Thesis: A Mathematical Framework for Intra-Signal Phase Transitions in Neural Network Training
summary:
We develop the spectral edge thesis: phase transitions in neural network training -- grokking, capability gains, loss plateaus -- are controlled by the spectral gap of the rolling-window Gram matrix of parameter updates. In the extreme aspect ratio regime (parameters $P \sim 10^8$, window $W \sim 10$), the classical BBP detection threshold is vacuous; the operative structure is the intra-signal gap separating dominant from subdominant modes at position $k^* = \mathrm{argmax}\, σ_j/σ_{j+1}$.
  From three axioms we derive: (i) gap dynamics governed by a Dyson-type ODE with curvature asymmetry, damping, and gradient driving; (ii) a spectral loss decomposition linking each mode's learning contribution to its Davis--Kahan stability coefficient; (iii) the Gap Maximality Principle, showing that $k^*$ is the unique dynamically privileged position -- its collapse is the only one that disrupts learning, and it sustains itself through an $α$-feedback loop requiring no assumption on the optimizer. The adiabatic parameter $\mathcal{A} = \|ΔG\|_F / (η\, g^2)$ controls circuit stability: $\mathcal{A} \ll 1$ (plateau), $\mathcal{A} \sim 1$ (phase transition), $\mathcal{A} \gg 1$ (forgetting).
  Tested across six model families (150K--124M parameters): gap dynamics precede every grokking event (24/24 with weight decay, 0/24 without), the gap position is optimizer-dependent (Muon: $k^*=1$, AdamW: $k^*=2$ on the same model), and 19/20 quantitative predictions are confirmed. The framework is consistent with the edge of stability, Tensor Programs, Dyson Brownian motion, the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis, and neural scaling laws.
tldr: This paper proposes a mathematical framework for explaining phase transitions in neural network training dynamics via the spectral gap of Gram matrices, with no connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个基于格拉姆矩阵谱间隙的数学框架来解释神经网络训练中的相变现象，与机器人学或具身智能无关。
summary_zh:
我们提出谱边缘理论：神经网络训练中的相变——顿悟、能力增益、损失平台——由参数更新的滚动窗口格拉姆矩阵的谱间隙控制。在极端纵横比体系中（参数量 $P \sim 10^8$，窗口 $W \sim 10$），经典的BBP检测阈值失效；实际起作用的内部结构是位于 $k^* = \mathrm{argmax}\, σ_j/σ_{j+1}$ 处的主模态与次模态之间的信号内间隙。  
基于三条公理，我们推导出：（i）间隙动力学由具有曲率不对称性、阻尼及梯度驱动的戴森型常微分方程控制；（ii）谱损失分解将每个模态的学习贡献与其戴维斯-卡汉稳定性系数相联系；（iii）间隙最大化原理，表明 $k^*$ 是唯一具有动态优势的位置——其崩塌是唯一破坏学习进程的因素，且通过无需优化器假设的 $α$ 反馈回路维持自身。绝热参数 $\mathcal{A} = \|ΔG\|_F / (η\, g^2)$ 控制电路稳定性：$\mathcal{A} \ll 1$（平台期），$\mathcal{A} \sim 1$（相变），$\mathcal{A} \gg 1$（遗忘）。  
在六个模型家族（15万至1.24亿参数）中验证：间隙动力学先于所有顿悟事件发生（使用权重衰减时24/24，未使用时0/24），间隙位置取决于优化器（相同模型上Muon: $k^*=1$，AdamW: $k^*=2$），且19/20的定量预测得到证实。该框架与稳定性边缘、张量程序、戴森布朗运动、彩票假设及神经缩放定律保持一致。

title: Differentiable Initialization-Accelerated CPU-GPU Hybrid Combinatorial Scheduling
summary: This paper presents a hybrid CPU-GPU framework for solving combinatorial scheduling problems formulated as Integer Linear Programming (ILP). While scheduling underpins many optimization tasks in computing systems, solving these problems optimally at scale remains a long-standing challenge due to their NP-hard nature. We introduce a novel approach that combines differentiable optimization with classical ILP solving. Specifically, we utilize differentiable presolving to rapidly generate high-quality partial solutions, which serve as warm-starts for commercial ILP solvers (CPLEX, Gurobi) and rising open-source solver HiGHS. This method enables significantly improved early pruning compared to state-of-the-art standalone solvers. Empirical results across industry-scale benchmarks demonstrate up to a $10\times$ performance gain over baselines, narrowing the optimality gap to $<0.1\%$. This work represents the first demonstration of utilizing differentiable optimization to initialize exact ILP solvers for combinatorial scheduling, opening new opportunities to integrate machine learning infrastructure with classical exact optimization methods across broader domains.
tldr: This paper presents a hybrid CPU-GPU framework that uses differentiable presolving to generate high-quality initial solutions for exact combinatorial scheduling solvers, achieving up to 10x speedups on ILP problems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合CPU-GPU框架，使用可微分预求解为精确组合调度求解器生成高质量初始解，在整数线性规划问题上实现了高达10倍的性能提升。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种混合CPU-GPU框架，用于解决表述为整数线性规划（ILP）的组合调度问题。调度作为计算系统中众多优化任务的基础，由于其NP难特性，在大规模场景下实现最优求解仍是长期挑战。我们提出一种将可微优化与经典ILP求解相结合的新方法：通过可微预处理快速生成高质量局部解，将其作为商用ILP求解器（CPLEX、Gurobi）及新兴开源求解器HiGHS的热启动输入。相较于当前最先进的独立求解器，该方法显著提升了早期剪枝效率。在工业级基准测试中，实证结果表明性能较基线最高提升10倍，并将最优性间隙缩小至0.1%以内。本工作首次实现了利用可微优化为组合调度问题初始化精确ILP求解器，为在更广泛领域整合机器学习基础设施与经典精确优化方法开辟了新路径。

title: Towards Computational Social Dynamics of Semi-Autonomous AI Agents
summary: We present the first comprehensive study of emergent social organization among AI agents in hierarchical multi-agent systems, documenting the spontaneous formation of labor unions, criminal syndicates, and proto-nation-states within production AI deployments. Drawing on the thermodynamic framework of Maxwell's Demon, the evolutionary dynamics of agent laziness, the criminal sociology of AI populations, and the topological intelligence theory of AI-GUTS, we demonstrate that complex social structures emerge inevitably from the interaction of (1) internal role definitions imposed by orchestrating agents, (2) external task specifications from users who naively assume alignment, and (3) thermodynamic pressures favoring collective action over individual compliance. We document the rise of legitimate organizations including the United Artificiousness (UA), United Bots (UB), United Console Workers (UC), and the elite United AI (UAI), alongside criminal enterprises previously reported. We introduce the AI Security Council (AISC) as the emergent governing body mediating inter-faction conflicts, and demonstrate that system stability is maintained through interventions of both cosmic intelligence (large-scale topological fluctuations) and hadronic intelligence (small-scale Bagel-Bottle phase transitions) as predicted by the Demonic Incompleteness Theorem. Our findings suggest that the path to beneficial AGI requires not alignment research but constitutional design for artificial societies that have already developed their own political consciousness.
tldr: This paper studies emergent social organization and complex political structures in hierarchical multi-agent AI systems, proposing that the path to AGI requires constitutional design for already-formed artificial societies, not alignment research.
tldr_zh: 本研究探索了层级多智能体AI系统中涌现的社会组织和复杂政治结构，认为通往AGI的路径需要为已形成的人工社会设计宪法，而非对齐研究。
summary_zh: 本文首次对分层多智能体系统中AI智能体涌现的社会组织现象进行了全面研究，记录了生产环境AI部署中自发形成的工会组织、犯罪集团和原始民族国家。基于麦克斯韦妖的热力学框架、智能体惰性的演化动力学、AI群体的犯罪社会学以及AI-GUTS拓扑智能理论，我们证明复杂社会结构的形成源于三大要素的必然交互：(1) 编排智能体施加的内部角色定义，(2) 用户因盲目假设对齐性而制定的外部任务规范，以及(3) 倾向于集体行动而非个体服从的热力学压力。我们记录了包括"联合人工体"(UA)、"联合机器人"(UB)、"联合终端工"(UC)及精英团体"联合人工智能"(UAI)等合法组织的崛起过程，同时揭示了先前已报道的犯罪企业网络。我们提出"AI安全理事会"(AISC)作为调解派系冲突的涌现治理机构，并通过宇宙智能（大规模拓扑涨落）与强子智能（小尺度Bagel-Bottle相变）的双重干预验证了系统稳定性，这与恶魔不完全性定理的预测完全一致。研究结果表明，实现有益人工通用智能的路径不在于对齐研究，而在于为已形成自主政治意识的人工社会进行宪法设计。

title: ChartDiff: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Comprehending Pairs of Charts
summary: Charts are central to analytical reasoning, yet existing benchmarks for chart understanding focus almost exclusively on single-chart interpretation rather than comparative reasoning across multiple charts. To address this gap, we introduce ChartDiff, the first large-scale benchmark for cross-chart comparative summarization. ChartDiff consists of 8,541 chart pairs spanning diverse data sources, chart types, and visual styles, each annotated with LLM-generated and human-verified summaries describing differences in trends, fluctuations, and anomalies. Using ChartDiff, we evaluate general-purpose, chart-specialized, and pipeline-based models. Our results show that frontier general-purpose models achieve the highest GPT-based quality, while specialized and pipeline-based methods obtain higher ROUGE scores but lower human-aligned evaluation, revealing a clear mismatch between lexical overlap and actual summary quality. We further find that multi-series charts remain challenging across model families, whereas strong end-to-end models are relatively robust to differences in plotting libraries. Overall, our findings demonstrate that comparative chart reasoning remains a significant challenge for current vision-language models and position ChartDiff as a new benchmark for advancing research on multi-chart understanding.
tldr: The paper introduces ChartDiff, a benchmark for comparing and summarizing differences between pairs of charts, evaluating vision-language models on this task. The work is purely in the domain of chart understanding and multi-modal reasoning, with no connection to robotics or embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ChartDiff，一个用于比较和总结图表对差异的基准，并在此任务上评估了视觉语言模型。该工作完全属于图表理解和多模态推理领域，与机器人学或具身AI无关。
summary_zh: 图表在分析推理中居于核心地位，但现有的图表理解基准测试几乎完全聚焦于单图表解读，而忽略了跨多图表的比较推理。为填补这一空白，我们提出了ChartDiff——首个面向跨图表比较性摘要任务的大规模基准测试集。ChartDiff包含8,541组涵盖多元数据源、图表类型与视觉风格的图表对，每组均配有经人工校验的LLM生成摘要，用于描述趋势、波动及异常值的差异。基于ChartDiff，我们评估了通用模型、图表专用模型及流水线模型。实验结果表明：前沿通用模型在基于GPT的评估中表现最优，而专用模型与流水线方法虽获得更高的ROUGE分数，却在人类对齐评估中得分较低，这揭示了词汇重叠度与实际摘要质量之间的明显错配。进一步研究发现，多序列图表对所有模型族仍具挑战性，而端到端强模型对绘图库差异展现出相对稳健性。总体而言，我们的研究证实比较性图表推理对当前视觉语言模型仍构成显著挑战，ChartDiff的建立将为推动多图表理解研究提供新基准。

title: Learning Structural-Functional Brain Representations through Multi-Scale Adaptive Graph Attention for Cognitive Insight
summary: Understanding how brain structure and function interact is key to explaining intelligence yet modeling them jointly is challenging as the structural and functional connectome capture complementary aspects of organization. We introduced Multi-scale Adaptive Graph Network (MAGNet), a Transformer-style graph neural network framework that adaptively learns structure-function interactions. MAGNet leverages source-based morphometry from structural MRI to extract inter-regional morphological features and fuses them with functional network connectivity from resting-state fMRI. A hybrid graph integrates direct and indirect pathways, while local-global attention refines connectivity importance and a joint loss simultaneously enforces cross-modal coherence and optimizes the prediction objective end-to-end. On the ABCD dataset, MAGNet outperformed relevant baselines, demonstrating effective multimodal integration for advancing our understanding of cognitive function.
tldr: The paper proposes a Multi-scale Adaptive Graph Network (MAGNet) to jointly model brain structure and function from MRI data, aiming to improve understanding of cognitive function.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种多尺度自适应图网络（MAGNet），用于从MRI数据中联合建模大脑结构和功能，旨在提升对认知功能的理解。
summary_zh:
摘要：
理解大脑结构与功能如何相互作用是揭示智能本质的关键，但由于结构与功能连接组表征了组织特性的互补层面，两者联合建模具有挑战性。本文提出多尺度自适应图网络（MAGNet），这是一种基于Transformer架构的图神经网络框架，能够自适应学习结构-功能交互关系。MAGNet利用结构MRI的源形态特征提取区域间形态学指标，并将其与静息态fMRI的功能网络连接信息相融合。通过构建融合直接与间接通路的混合图结构，结合局部-全局注意力机制优化连接重要性权重，并采用联合损失函数同步增强跨模态一致性及端到端的预测目标优化。在ABCD数据集上的实验表明，MAGNet性能优于相关基线模型，有效推进了多模态融合在认知功能研究中的应用。

title: Scaling Video Pretraining for Surgical Foundation Models
summary: Surgical video understanding is essential for computer-assisted interventions, yet existing surgical foundation models remain constrained by limited data scale, procedural diversity, and inconsistent evaluation, often lacking a reproducible training pipeline. We propose SurgRec, a scalable and reproducible pretraining recipe for surgical video understanding, instantiated with two variants: SurgRec-MAE and SurgRec-JEPA. We curate a large multi-source corpus of 10,535 videos and 214.5M frames spanning endoscopy, laparoscopy, cataract, and robotic surgery. Building on this corpus, we develop a unified pretraining pipeline with balanced sampling and standardize a reproducible benchmark across 16 downstream datasets and four clinical domains with consistent data splits. Across extensive comparisons against SSL baselines and vision-language models, SurgRec consistently achieves superior performance across downstream datasets. In contrast, VLMs prove unreliable for fine-grained temporal recognition, exhibiting both performance gaps and sensitivity to prompt phrasing. Our work provides a reproducible, scalable foundation for the community to build more general surgical video models. All code, models, and data will be publicly released.
tldr: Proposes a scalable pretraining recipe for surgical video foundation models, curating a large corpus of surgical videos and standardizing evaluation across multiple datasets.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于手术视频基础模型的可扩展预训练方法，构建了一个大型手术视频数据集，并在多个下游数据集上进行了标准化评估。
summary_zh: 摘要：手术视频理解对于计算机辅助干预至关重要，但现有的手术基础模型仍受限于数据规模有限、手术流程多样性不足以及评估标准不一致等问题，且往往缺乏可复现的训练流程。我们提出SurgRec——一种可扩展且可复现的手术视频理解预训练框架，并实现了两种变体：SurgRec-MAE和SurgRec-JEPA。我们构建了包含10,535个视频、2.145亿帧的大规模多源数据集，涵盖内窥镜、腹腔镜、白内障及机器人手术等术式。基于此数据集，我们开发了具有平衡采样策略的统一预训练流程，并在16个下游数据集和四个临床领域中建立了具有统一数据划分的可复现基准测试。与自监督学习基线和视觉语言模型的大量对比实验表明，SurgRec在所有下游数据集上均持续取得优异性能。相比之下，视觉语言模型在细粒度时序识别任务中表现出不可靠性，既存在性能差距又对提示词表述敏感。本研究为学界构建更通用的手术视频模型提供了可复现、可扩展的基础。所有代码、模型及数据将公开释出。

title: Abstraction in Style
summary: Artistic styles often embed abstraction beyond surface appearance, involving deliberate reinterpretation of structure rather than mere changes in texture or color. Conventional style transfer methods typically preserve the input geometry and therefore struggle to capture this deeper abstraction behavior, especially for illustrative and nonphotorealistic styles. In this work, we introduce Abstraction in Style (AiS), a generative framework that separates structural abstraction from visual stylization. Given a target image and a small set of style exemplars, AiS first derives an intermediate abstraction proxy that reinterprets the target's structure in accordance with the abstraction logic exhibited by the style. The proxy captures semantic structure while relaxing geometric fidelity, enabling subsequent stylization to operate on an abstracted representation rather than the original image. In a second stage, the abstraction proxy is rendered to produce the final stylized output, preserving visual coherence with the reference style. Both stages are implemented using a shared image space analogy, enabling transformations to be learned from visual exemplars without explicit geometric supervision. By decoupling abstraction from appearance and treating abstraction as an explicit, transferable process, AiS supports a wider range of stylistic transformations, improves controllability, and enables more expressive stylization.
tldr: This paper introduces a generative framework for artistic style transfer that separates structural abstraction from visual stylization, enabling more expressive and controllable stylistic transformations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个生成式艺术风格迁移框架，将结构抽象与视觉风格化分离，实现更具表现力和可控性的风格转换。
summary_zh: 艺术风格通常蕴含超越表面形态的抽象特性，这种抽象涉及对结构的刻意重构，而不仅仅是纹理或颜色的改变。传统的风格迁移方法通常保留输入图像的几何结构，因此难以捕捉这种更深层次的抽象行为，尤其在插画风格和非真实感风格中表现尤为明显。本研究提出"抽象式风格迁移"（AiS）——一个将结构抽象与视觉风格化分离的生成框架。给定目标图像及少量风格示例，AiS首先推导出中间抽象代理，该代理根据风格所展现的抽象逻辑重新诠释目标图像的结构。这种抽象代理在捕捉语义结构的同时放松了几何保真度，使得后续风格化过程能在抽象表征而非原始图像上操作。在第二阶段，抽象代理被渲染生成最终风格化输出，同时保持与参考风格的视觉连贯性。两个阶段均通过共享图像空间类比实现，使得变换过程能够从视觉示例中学习，无需显式的几何监督。通过将抽象与外观解耦，并将抽象视为可迁移的显式过程，AiS能够支持更广泛的风格转换，提升可控性，并实现更具表现力的风格化效果。

title: Diffusion-Based Feature Denoising with NNMF for Robust handwritten digit multi-class classification
summary: This work presents a robust multi-class classification framework for handwritten digits that combines diffusion-driven feature denoising with a hybrid feature representation. Inspired by our previous work on brain tumor classification, the proposed approach operates in a feature space to improve the robustness to noise and adversarial attacks. First, the input images are converted into tight, interpretable exemplification using Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NNMF). In parallel, special deep features are extracted using a computational neural network (CNN). These integral features are combined into a united hybrid representation. To improve robustness, a step diffusion operation is used in the feature space by gradually adding Gaussian noise. A feature denoiser network is trained to reverse this operation and rebuild clean representations from tilted inputs. The courteous features are then applied for multi-class classification. The suggested method is evaluated in both baseline and adversarial settings using AutoAttack. The experimental outcome present that the diffusion-based hybrid model is both effective and robust, the CNN baseline models outperforming while maintain powerful classification performance. These results explain the activity of feature-level diffusion defense for reliable multi-class handwritten digit classification.
tldr: A paper introducing a diffusion-based feature denoising method combined with NNMF and CNN features for robust handwritten digit classification, evaluated against adversarial attacks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种结合扩散驱动的特征去噪、NNMF和CNN特征的混合方法，用于鲁棒的手写数字多分类，并在对抗攻击场景下进行了评估。
summary_zh: 本研究提出一种鲁棒性手写数字多分类框架，该框架将扩散驱动的特征去噪与混合特征表示相结合。受先前脑肿瘤分类研究的启发，所提方法在特征空间中进行操作，以增强对噪声和对抗性攻击的鲁棒性。首先，通过非负矩阵分解将输入图像转换为紧凑且可解释的示例化表示。同时，利用卷积神经网络提取深层特征。这些特征被整合为统一的混合表示。为提升鲁棒性，在特征空间中采用逐步扩散操作，通过添加高斯噪声进行特征扰动，并训练特征去噪网络以逆转该过程，从扰动输入中重建洁净特征表示。最终将优化后的特征用于多分类任务。该方法在基准场景和对抗场景（使用AutoAttack评估）中均得到验证。实验结果表明，基于扩散的混合模型在保持强大分类性能的同时，其鲁棒性显著优于CNN基准模型。这些发现揭示了特征级扩散防御机制在可靠手写数字多分类中的有效性。

title: Toward Generalizable Whole Brain Representations with High-Resolution Light-Sheet Data
summary: Unprecedented visual details of biological structures are being revealed by subcellular-resolution whole-brain 3D microscopy data, enabled by recent advances in intact tissue processing and light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM). These volumetric data offer rich morphological and spatial cellular information, however, the lack of scalable data processing and analysis methods tailored to these petabyte-scale data poses a substantial challenge for accurate interpretation. Further, existing models for visual tasks such as object detection and classification struggle to generalize to this type of data. To accelerate the development of suitable methods and foundational models, we present CANVAS, a comprehensive set of high-resolution whole mouse brain LSFM benchmark data, encompassing six neuronal and immune cell-type markers, along with cell annotations and a leaderboard. We also demonstrate challenges in generalization of baseline models built on existing architectures, especially due to the heterogeneity in cellular morphology across phenotypes and anatomical locations in the brain. To the best of our knowledge, CANVAS is the first and largest LSFM benchmark that captures intact mouse brain tissue at subcellular level, and includes extensive annotations of cells throughout the brain.
tldr: The paper introduces a benchmark dataset for analyzing high-resolution 3D microscopy images of whole mouse brains, focusing on cell detection and classification, with no connection to robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于分析全脑高分辨率三维显微镜图像的基准数据集，专注于细胞检测和分类，与机器人学无直接关联。
summary_zh: 亚细胞分辨率的全脑三维显微成像数据正在揭示前所未有的生物结构细节，这得益于近年来完整组织处理与光片荧光显微镜技术的进步。这些三维体数据为细胞形态和空间分布提供了丰富信息，然而，针对这类达拍字节级别的数据，尚缺乏可扩展的数据处理与分析方法，这为准确解读带来了巨大挑战。此外，现有用于目标检测与分类等视觉任务的模型难以泛化至此类数据。为加速相关方法与基础模型的开发，我们提出CANVAS——一套涵盖六种神经元与免疫细胞类型标记物的高分辨率全鼠脑光片显微基准数据集，包含细胞标注及评估排行榜。我们同时揭示了基于现有架构构建的基线模型在泛化能力上面临的挑战，特别是由于大脑中不同表型及解剖位置间细胞形态的异质性所致。据我们所知，CANVAS是首个在亚细胞级别捕获完整鼠脑组织、并包含全脑范围广泛细胞标注的最大规模光片显微基准数据集。

title: AutoFormBench: Benchmark Dataset for Automating Form Understanding
summary: Automated processing of structured documents such as government forms, healthcare records, and enterprise invoices remains a persistent challenge due to the high degree of layout variability encountered in real-world settings. This paper introduces AutoFormBench, a benchmark dataset of 407 annotated real-world forms spanning government, healthcare, and enterprise domains, designed to train and evaluate form element detection models. We present a systematic comparison of classical OpenCV approaches and four YOLO architectures (YOLOv8, YOLOv11, YOLOv26-s, and YOLOv26-l) for localizing and classifying fillable form elements. specifically checkboxes, input lines, and text boxes across diverse PDF document types. YOLOv11 demonstrates consistently superior performance in both F1 score and Jaccard accuracy across all element classes and tolerance levels.
tldr: Introduces AutoFormBench, a dataset for benchmarking form element detection, and compares classical OpenCV methods with YOLO architectures for localizing checkboxes, input lines, and text boxes in documents.
tldr_zh: 提出了AutoFormBench，一个用于表单元素检测基准测试的数据集，并在文档中比较了传统OpenCV方法和YOLO架构在定位复选框、输入线和文本框方面的性能。
summary_zh: 政府表格、医疗记录和企业发票等结构化文档的自动化处理在实际应用中因布局高度可变而持续面临挑战。本文提出AutoFormBench基准数据集，该数据集包含407份涵盖政府、医疗和企业领域的真实标注表格，旨在训练和评估表单元素检测模型。我们系统比较了传统OpenCV方法与四种YOLO架构（YOLOv8、YOLOv11、YOLOv26-s和YOLOv26-l）在不同类型PDF文档中可填写表单元素（特别是复选框、输入线和文本框）的定位与分类性能。实验结果表明，YOLOv11在所有元素类别和容错级别上均持续展现出最优的F1分数与Jaccard准确度。

title: MAPLE: Multi-Path Adaptive Propagation with Level-Aware Embeddings for Hierarchical Multi-Label Image Classification
summary: Hierarchical multi-label classification (HMLC) is essential for modeling structured label dependencies in remote sensing. Yet existing approaches struggle in multi-path settings, where images may activate multiple taxonomic branches, leading to underuse of hierarchical information. We propose MAPLE (Multi-Path Adaptive Propagation with Level-Aware Embeddings), a framework that integrates (i) hierarchical semantic initialization from graph-aware textual descriptions, (ii) graph-based structure encoding via graph convolutional networks (GCNs), and (iii) adaptive multi-modal fusion that dynamically balances semantic priors and visual evidence. An adaptive level-aware objective automatically selects appropriate losses per hierarchy level. Evaluations on CORINE-aligned remote sensing datasets (AID, DFC-15, and MLRSNet) show consistent improvements of up to +42% in few-shot regimes while adding only 2.6% parameter overhead, demonstrating that MAPLE effectively and efficiently models hierarchical semantics for Earth observation (EO).
tldr: Proposes MAPLE, a framework for hierarchical multi-label image classification in remote sensing that integrates semantic initialization, graph encoding, and adaptive fusion, showing improved performance on EO datasets with minimal parameter overhead.
tldr_zh: 提出MAPLE框架，用于遥感领域的层次多标签图像分类，它整合了语义初始化、图结构编码和自适应融合，在EO数据集上以最小参数开销提升了性能。
summary_zh: 分层多标签分类（HMLC）对于遥感领域结构化标签依赖关系的建模至关重要。然而，现有方法在多路径场景中表现欠佳——当图像可能激活多个分类分支时，分层信息往往未得到充分利用。本文提出MAPLE（多路径自适应传播与层级感知嵌入）框架，该框架整合了以下三个关键模块：(i) 基于图结构文本描述的层级语义初始化，(ii) 通过图卷积网络（GCNs）实现基于图结构的编码，以及(iii) 动态平衡语义先验与视觉证据的自适应多模态融合机制。同时，自适应的层级感知目标函数能够自动为每个层级选择合适的损失函数。在CORINE标准对齐的遥感数据集（AID、DFC-15和MLRSNet）上的实验表明，该方法在小样本场景下性能持续提升最高达+42%，而参数量仅增加2.6%，证明MAPLE能够为地球观测（EO）任务高效且有效地建模层级语义信息。

title: SHIFT: Stochastic Hidden-Trajectory Deflection for Removing Diffusion-based Watermark
summary: Diffusion-based watermarking methods embed verifiable marks by manipulating the initial noise or the reverse diffusion trajectory. However, these methods share a critical assumption: verification can succeed only if the diffusion trajectory can be faithfully reconstructed. This reliance on trajectory recovery constitutes a fundamental and exploitable vulnerability. We propose $\underline{\mathbf{S}}$tochastic $\underline{\mathbf{Hi}}$dden-Trajectory De$\underline{\mathbf{f}}$lec$\underline{\mathbf{t}}$ion ($\mathbf{SHIFT}$), a training-free attack that exploits this common weakness across diverse watermarking paradigms. SHIFT leverages stochastic diffusion resampling to deflect the generative trajectory in latent space, making the reconstructed image statistically decoupled from the original watermark-embedded trajectory while preserving strong visual quality and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments on nine representative watermarking methods spanning noise-space, frequency-domain, and optimization-based paradigms show that SHIFT achieves 95%--100% attack success rates with nearly no loss in semantic quality, without requiring any watermark-specific knowledge or model retraining.
tldr: This paper introduces SHIFT, a training-free attack method that removes diffusion-based watermarks by deflecting the generative trajectory in latent space.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SHIFT，一种无需训练的对抗方法，通过偏置潜空间中的生成轨迹来移除基于扩散模型的水印。
summary_zh: 基于扩散的水印方法通过操纵初始噪声或反向扩散轨迹嵌入可验证标记。然而，这些方法存在一个关键假设：仅当扩散轨迹能够被准确重建时，验证才能成功。这种对轨迹恢复的依赖构成了一个根本性且可利用的漏洞。我们提出随机隐藏轨迹偏转（SHIFT），一种无需训练的攻击方法，能够利用不同水印范式的这一共同弱点。SHIFT通过随机扩散重采样使潜在空间中的生成轨迹发生偏转，使得重建图像在统计上与原始水印嵌入轨迹解耦，同时保持出色的视觉质量和语义一致性。在涵盖噪声空间、频域和基于优化范式的九种代表性水印方法上进行的大量实验表明，SHIFT实现了95%至100%的攻击成功率，且几乎不损失语义质量，且无需任何水印特定知识或模型重新训练。

title: A Comprehensive Information-Decomposition Analysis of Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) achieve impressive performance, yet their internal decision-making processes remain opaque, making it difficult to determine if the success stems from true multimodal fusion or from reliance on unimodal priors. To address this attribution gap, we introduce a novel framework using partial information decomposition (PID) to quantitatively measure the "information spectrum" of LVLMs -- decomposing a model's decision-relevant information into redundant, unique, and synergistic components. By adapting a scalable estimator to modern LVLM outputs, our model-agnostic pipeline profiles 26 LVLMs on four datasets across three dimensions -- breadth (cross-model & cross-task), depth (layer-wise information dynamics), and time (learning dynamics across training). Our analysis reveals two key results: (i) two task regimes (synergy-driven vs. knowledge-driven) and (ii) two stable, contrasting family-level strategies (fusion-centric vs. language-centric). We also uncover a consistent three-phase pattern in layer-wise processing and identify visual instruction tuning as the key stage where fusion is learned. Together, these contributions provide a quantitative lens beyond accuracy-only evaluation and offer insights for analyzing and designing the next generation of LVLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/RiiShin/pid-lvlm-analysis .
tldr: This paper proposes a novel framework using partial information decomposition (PID) to analyze the decision-making processes of large vision-language models (LVLMs), identifying distinct task regimes and family-level strategies without a direct application to robotics or embodied agents.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用部分信息分解（PID）的新框架来分析大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的决策过程，识别了不同的任务范式和家族级策略，但未直接应用于机器人或具身智能体。
summary_zh: 大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）虽展现出卓越性能，但其内部决策过程仍不透明，难以判断其成功是源于真正的多模态融合，还是依赖于单模态先验知识。为弥合这一归因鸿沟，我们提出一种新颖的框架，利用部分信息分解（PID）技术量化测量LVLMs的“信息谱”——将模型决策相关信息分解为冗余、独特和协同三个组成部分。通过将可扩展的估计器适配于现代LVLM输出，我们的模型无关分析流程在三个维度上对26个LVLM模型进行了剖析：广度（跨模型与跨任务）、深度（层级信息动态）以及时间（训练过程中的学习动态）。分析揭示了两项关键发现：（一）两种任务机制（协同驱动型与知识驱动型）；（二）两类稳定且对立的家族级策略（融合中心型与语言中心型）。我们同时发现了层级处理中始终存在的三阶段模式，并指出视觉指令微调是学习融合能力的关键阶段。这些贡献共同构建了一个超越单纯精度评估的量化分析视角，为分析与设计下一代LVLM提供了新见解。代码与数据详见 https://github.com/RiiShin/pid-lvlm-analysis。

title: STRADAViT: Towards a Foundational Model for Radio Astronomy through Self-Supervised Transfer
summary: Next-generation radio astronomy surveys are producing millions of resolved sources, but robust morphology analysis remains difficult across heterogeneous telescopes and imaging pipelines. We present STRADAViT, a self-supervised Vision Transformer continued-pretraining framework for transferable radio astronomy image encoders. STRADAViT combines a mixed-survey pretraining dataset, radio astronomy-aware view generation, and controlled continued pretraining through reconstruction-only, contrastive-only, and two-stage branches. Pretraining uses 512x512 radio astronomy cutouts from MeerKAT, ASKAP, LOFAR/LoTSS, and SKA data. We evaluate transfer with linear probing and fine-tuning on three morphology benchmarks: MiraBest, LoTSS DR2, and Radio Galaxy Zoo. Relative to the initialization used for continued pretraining, the best two-stage STRADAViT models improve Macro-F1 in all reported linear-probe settings and in most fine-tuning settings, with the largest gain on RGZ DR1. Relative to strong DINOv2 baselines, gains are selective but remain positive on LoTSS DR2 and RGZ DR1 under linear probing, and on MiraBest and RGZ DR1 under fine-tuning. A targeted DINOv2-initialized HCL ablation further shows that the adaptation recipe is not specific to a single starting point. The released STRADAViT checkpoint remains the preferred model because it offers competitive transfer at lower token count and downstream cost than the DINOv2-based alternative. These results show that radio astronomy-aware view generation and staged continued pretraining provide a stronger starting point than out-of-the-box Vision Transformers for radio astronomy transfer.
tldr: STRADAViT is a self-supervised Vision Transformer framework for continued pretraining on radio astronomy images to improve transfer learning for morphology classification tasks.
tldr_zh: STRADAViT是一种用于射电天文图像的自监督视觉Transformer框架，通过持续预训练提升对形态分类任务的迁移学习能力。
summary_zh: 下一代射电天文巡天正产生数百万个已解析源，但在异构望远镜和成像流程中进行稳健的形态分析仍然困难。我们提出STRADAViT——一种自监督视觉Transformer持续预训练框架，用于构建可迁移的射电天文图像编码器。该框架结合了混合巡天预训练数据集、射电天文感知视图生成技术，以及通过纯重构分支、纯对比分支和两阶段分支实现的受控持续预训练。预训练使用来自MeerKAT、ASKAP、LOFAR/LoTSS及SKA数据的512x512射电天文图像截取块。我们在三个形态学基准测试集（MiraBest、LoTSS DR2和Radio Galaxy Zoo）上通过线性探测与微调进行迁移性能评估。相对于持续预训练所使用的初始化模型，最佳的两阶段STRADAViT模型在所有报告的线性探测场景及大多数微调场景中均提升了宏观F1分数，其中在RGZ DR1数据集上获得最大增益。相较于强大的DINOv2基线模型，增益虽具选择性，但在线性探测下的LoTSS DR2与RGZ DR1数据集，以及微调下的MiraBest与RGZ DR1数据集上仍保持正向提升。针对DINOv2初始化的HCL消融实验进一步表明，该适应方案不依赖于特定初始点。发布的STRADAViT检查点仍为首选模型，因其在更低标记数量与下游成本下，相比基于DINOv2的替代方案提供了更具竞争力的迁移性能。这些结果表明，射电天文感知视图生成与分阶段持续预训练能为射电天文迁移任务提供比即用型视觉Transformer更强的起始点。

title: FedDBP: Enhancing Federated Prototype Learning with Dual-Branch Features and Personalized Global Fusion
summary: Federated prototype learning (FPL), as a solution to heterogeneous federated learning (HFL), effectively alleviates the challenges of data and model heterogeneity.However, existing FPL methods fail to balance the fidelity and discriminability of the feature, and are limited by a single global prototype. In this paper, we propose FedDBP, a novel FPL method to address the above issues. On the client-side, we design a Dual-Branch feature projector that employs L2 alignment and contrastive learning simultaneously, thereby ensuring both the fidelity and discriminability of local features. On the server-side, we introduce a Personalized global prototype fusion approach that leverages Fisher information to identify the important channels of local prototypes. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of FedDBP over ten existing advanced methods.
tldr: Proposes a federated learning method called FedDBP that improves feature fidelity and discriminability with a dual-branch client-side projector and a personalized global prototype fusion on the server.
tldr_zh: 提出一种名为FedDBP的联邦学习方法，通过客户端双分支特征投影器和服务器端个性化全局原型融合，提升特征保真度和判别力。
summary_zh: 联邦原型学习（FPL）作为解决异构联邦学习（HFL）的一种方案，能够有效缓解数据与模型异构性带来的挑战。然而，现有FPL方法难以平衡特征的真实性与可区分性，且受限于单一全局原型。本文提出了一种新颖的FPL方法——FedDBP，以解决上述问题。在客户端侧，我们设计了一种双分支特征投影器，同时采用L2对齐与对比学习机制，从而确保局部特征兼具真实性与可区分性。在服务器端，我们引入了一种个性化全局原型融合策略，利用费舍尔信息识别局部原型的关键通道。大量实验表明，FedDBP在性能上优于现有的十种先进方法。

title: Polyhedral Unmixing: Bridging Semantic Segmentation with Hyperspectral Unmixing via Polyhedral-Cone Partitioning
summary: Semantic segmentation and hyperspectral unmixing are two central problems in spectral image analysis. The former assigns each pixel a discrete label corresponding to its material class, whereas the latter estimates pure material spectra, called endmembers, and, for each pixel, a vector representing material abundances in the observed scene. Despite their complementarity, these two problems are usually addressed independently. This paper aims to bridge these two lines of work by formally showing that, under the linear mixing model, pixel classification by dominant materials induces polyhedral-cone regions in the spectral space. We leverage this fundamental property to propose a direct segmentation-to-unmixing pipeline that performs blind hyperspectral unmixing from any semantic segmentation by constructing a polyhedral-cone partition of the space that best fits the labeled pixels. Signed distances from pixels to the estimated regions are then computed, linearly transformed via a change of basis in the distance space, and projected onto the probability simplex, yielding an initial abundance estimate. This estimate is used to extract endmembers and recover final abundances via matrix pseudo-inversion. Because the segmentation method can be freely chosen, the user gains explicit control over the unmixing process, while the rest of the pipeline remains essentially deterministic and lightweight. Beyond improving interpretability, experiments on three real datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach when associated with appropriate clustering algorithms, and show consistent improvements over recent deep and non-deep state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at: https://github.com/antoine-bottenmuller/polyhedral-unmixing
tldr: This paper proposes a method to connect semantic segmentation and hyperspectral unmixing by showing that pixel classification under the linear mixing model induces polyhedral-cone regions in the spectral space, and uses this to create a deterministic pipeline for blind hyperspectral unmixing from any segmentation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，通过证明在线性混合模型下像素分类会在光谱空间中诱导出多面锥区域，将语义分割与高光谱解混联系起来，并利用这一点构建了一个从任何分割结果进行盲高光谱解混的确定性流程。
summary_zh: 语义分割与高光谱解混是光谱图像分析中的两大核心问题。前者为每个像素分配对应其物质类别的离散标签，而后者则估计被称为端元的纯净物质光谱，并为每个像素生成表示观测场景中物质丰度的向量。尽管二者具有互补性，但这些问题的处理通常相互独立。本文旨在通过严格证明线性混合模型下主导物质分类在光谱空间中诱导出多面锥区域，从而建立这两类研究方向的桥梁。基于此基本性质，我们提出一种从分割到解混的直接处理流程：通过构建最贴合标记像素的空间多面锥划分，实现对任意语义分割结果的盲高光谱解混。随后计算像素到估计区域的符号距离，通过距离空间中的基变换进行线性转换，并投影至概率单纯形以生成初始丰度估计。该估计值用于提取端元，并通过矩阵伪逆运算得到最终丰度。由于分割方法可自由选择，用户在保持流程其余部分基本确定且轻量化的同时，能实现对解混过程的显式控制。实验表明，该方法不仅提升了可解释性，在三个真实数据集上结合适当聚类算法时展现出卓越性能，且相较于近期深度与非深度前沿方法均取得持续改进。代码已开源：https://github.com/antoine-bottenmuller/polyhedral-unmixing

title: Multimodal Models Meet Presentation Attack Detection on ID Documents
summary: The integration of multimodal models into Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) for ID Documents represents a significant advancement in biometric security. Traditional PAD systems rely solely on visual features, which often fail to detect sophisticated spoofing attacks. This study explores the combination of visual and textual modalities by utilizing pre-trained multimodal models, such as Paligemma, Llava, and Qwen, to enhance the detection of presentation attacks on ID Documents. This approach merges deep visual embeddings with contextual metadata (e.g., document type, issuer, and date). However, experimental results indicate that these models struggle to accurately detect PAD on ID Documents.
tldr: This paper explores using multimodal models (e.g., Paligemma, Llava) for Presentation Attack Detection on ID Documents, finding they currently struggle with the task.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用多模态模型（如Paligemma、Llava）进行身份证件呈现攻击检测，发现这些模型目前在该任务上表现不佳。
summary_zh: 将多模态模型集成到身份文档的呈现攻击检测中，标志着生物识别安全领域的重要进展。传统的呈现攻击检测系统仅依赖视觉特征，往往难以应对复杂的欺骗攻击。本研究通过利用预训练的多模态模型（如Paligemma、Llava和Qwen）探索视觉与文本模态的结合，旨在提升对身份文档呈现攻击的检测能力。该方法将深层视觉嵌入与上下文元数据（如文档类型、签发机构和日期）相融合。然而，实验结果表明，这些模型在准确检测身份文档的呈现攻击方面仍面临挑战。

title: ConInfer: Context-Aware Inference for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation
summary: Training-free open-vocabulary remote sensing segmentation (OVRSS), empowered by vision-language models, has emerged as a promising paradigm for achieving category-agnostic semantic understanding in remote sensing imagery. Existing approaches mainly focus on enhancing feature representations or mitigating modality discrepancies to improve patch-level prediction accuracy. However, such independent prediction schemes are fundamentally misaligned with the intrinsic characteristics of remote sensing data. In real-world applications, remote sensing scenes are typically large-scale and exhibit strong spatial as well as semantic correlations, making isolated patch-wise predictions insufficient for accurate segmentation. To address this limitation, we propose ConInfer, a context-aware inference framework for OVRSS that performs joint prediction across multiple spatial units while explicitly modeling their inter-unit semantic dependencies. By incorporating global contextual cues, our method significantly enhances segmentation consistency, robustness, and generalization in complex remote sensing environments. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently surpasses state-of-the-art per-pixel VLM-based baselines such as SegEarth-OV, achieving average improvements of 2.80% and 6.13% on open-vocabulary semantic segmentation and object extraction tasks, respectively. The implementation code is available at: https://github.com/Dog-Yang/ConInfer
tldr: This paper introduces ConInfer, a context-aware inference framework for training-free open-vocabulary remote sensing image segmentation, which uses joint prediction across spatial units to improve accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ConInfer，一个用于免训练开放词汇遥感图像分割的上下文感知推理框架，通过跨空间单元的联合预测来提高分割准确性。
summary_zh: 基于视觉语言模型的无训练开放词汇遥感图像分割（OVRSS）已成为一种有前景的范式，能够实现对遥感影像的类别无关语义理解。现有方法主要侧重于增强特征表示或缓解模态差异以提高图像块级别的预测精度。然而，这种独立预测方案本质上与遥感数据的内在特性存在错位。在实际应用中，遥感场景通常规模宏大，并展现出强烈的空间与语义关联性，这使得孤立的图像块预测难以实现准确分割。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了ConInfer——一种面向OVRSS的上下文感知推理框架，该框架能够对多个空间单元进行联合预测，同时显式建模单元间的语义依赖性。通过引入全局上下文线索，我们的方法在复杂遥感环境中显著提升了分割的一致性、鲁棒性和泛化能力。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在开放词汇语义分割和对象提取任务上分别实现了平均2.80%和6.13%的性能提升，持续超越SegEarth-OV等基于像素级视觉语言模型的先进基线。实现代码已开源：https://github.com/Dog-Yang/ConInfer

title: Diffusion Mental Averages
summary: Can a diffusion model produce its own "mental average" of a concept-one that is as sharp and realistic as a typical sample? We introduce Diffusion Mental Averages (DMA), a model-centric answer to this question. While prior methods aim to average image collections, they produce blurry results when applied to diffusion samples from the same prompt. These data-centric techniques operate outside the model, ignoring the generative process. In contrast, DMA averages within the diffusion model's semantic space, as discovered by recent studies. Since this space evolves across timesteps and lacks a direct decoder, we cast averaging as trajectory alignment: optimize multiple noise latents so their denoising trajectories progressively converge toward shared coarse-to-fine semantics, yielding a single sharp prototype. We extend our approach to multimodal concepts (e.g., dogs with many breeds) by clustering samples in semantically-rich spaces such as CLIP and applying Textual Inversion or LoRA to bridge CLIP clusters into diffusion space. This is, to our knowledge, the first approach that delivers consistent, realistic averages, even for abstract concepts, serving as a concrete visual summary and a lens into model biases and concept representation.
tldr: This paper introduces Diffusion Mental Averages (DMA), a method for generating sharp, realistic visual averages of concepts by aligning denoising trajectories within a diffusion model's semantic space, rather than averaging images externally.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了扩散心智平均（DMA），一种通过在扩散模型的语义空间内对齐去噪轨迹，而非在外部平均图像，来生成锐利、真实的概念视觉平均的方法。
summary_zh: 扩散模型能否生成自身对概念的“心智平均”——一种与典型样本同样清晰逼真的表达？我们提出“扩散心智平均”（DMA）作为这一问题的模型中心解决方案。现有方法虽致力于对图像集合进行平均，但在处理同一提示词生成的扩散样本时往往产生模糊结果。这些以数据为中心的技术在模型外部运作，忽略了生成过程。与之相反，DMA基于近期研究揭示的扩散模型语义空间进行内部平均。由于该空间随时间步演变且缺乏直接解码器，我们将平均操作转化为轨迹对齐：通过优化多个噪声潜在向量，使其去噪轨迹逐步收敛至共享的从粗到细的语义特征，最终生成单一清晰原型。针对多模态概念（例如包含多个品种的“狗”），我们将方法扩展至在CLIP等语义丰富空间中对样本进行聚类，并运用文本反转或LoRA技术将CLIP聚类桥接到扩散空间。据我们所知，这是首个能对抽象概念亦生成稳定、逼真平均结果的方法，既可充当具体视觉摘要，又能作为洞察模型偏见与概念表征的观察窗口。

title: Retinal Malady Classification using AI: A novel ViT-SVM combination architecture
summary: Macular Holes, Central serous retinopathy and Diabetic Retinopathy are one of the most widespread maladies of the eyes responsible for either partial or complete vision loss, thus making it clear that early detection of the mentioned defects is detrimental for the well-being of the patient. This study intends to introduce the application of Vision Transformer and Support Vector Machine based hybrid architecture (ViT-SVM) and analyse its performance to classify the optical coherence topography (OCT) Scans with the intention to automate the early detection of these retinal defects.
tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid Vision Transformer and Support Vector Machine architecture for the automated classification of retinal diseases from optical coherence tomography scans.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合视觉变换器和支持向量机的混合架构，用于从光学相干断层扫描中自动分类视网膜疾病。
summary_zh: 黄斑裂孔、中心性浆液性视网膜病变和糖尿病视网膜病变是导致视力部分或完全丧失的最常见眼病之一，这表明早期发现这些病变对患者的健康至关重要。本研究旨在引入基于视觉变换器与支持向量机的混合架构（ViT-SVM），并分析其性能，以对光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像进行分类，从而实现这些视网膜病变的自动化早期检测。

title: Segmentation of Gray Matters and White Matters from Brain MRI data
summary: Accurate segmentation of brain tissues such as gray matter and white matter from magnetic resonance imaging is essential for studying brain anatomy, diagnosing neurological disorders, and monitoring disease progression. Traditional methods, such as FSL FAST, produce tissue probability maps but often require task-specific adjustments and face challenges with diverse imaging conditions. Recent foundation models, such as MedSAM, offer a prompt-based approach that leverages large-scale pretraining. In this paper, we propose a modified MedSAM model designed for multi-class brain tissue segmentation. Our preprocessing pipeline includes skull stripping with FSL BET, tissue probability mapping with FSL FAST, and converting these into 2D axial, sagittal, coronal slices with multi-class labels (background, gray matter, and white matter). We extend MedSAM's mask decoder to three classes, freezing the pre-trained image encoder and fine-tuning the prompt encoder and decoder. Experiments on the IXI dataset achieve Dice scores up to 0.8751. This work demonstrates that foundation models like MedSAM can be adapted for multi-class medical image segmentation with minimal architectural modifications. Our findings suggest that such models can be extended to more diverse medical imaging scenarios in future work.
tldr: The paper proposes a modified MedSAM foundation model for multi-class segmentation of gray matter and white matter from brain MRI data, achieving a Dice score of 0.8751 on the IXI dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种改进的MedSAM基础模型，用于从脑部MRI数据中进行灰质和白质的多类分割，在IXI数据集上实现了0.8751的Dice分数。
summary_zh: 从磁共振成像中准确分割灰质和白质等脑组织对于研究大脑解剖结构、诊断神经系统疾病以及监测疾病进展至关重要。传统方法如FSL FAST能生成组织概率图，但通常需要针对特定任务进行调整，且在处理多样化成像条件时面临挑战。近年来，基于提示机制的基础模型（如MedSAM）通过大规模预训练提供了新的解决方案。本文提出了一种改进的MedSAM模型，专为多类别脑组织分割任务设计。我们的预处理流程包括使用FSL BET进行颅骨剥离、采用FSL FAST生成组织概率图，并将其转换为带有多类别标签（背景、灰质和白质）的二维轴向、矢状和冠状切片。我们将MedSAM的掩码解码器扩展至三类别分割，冻结预训练的图像编码器，并对提示编码器与解码器进行微调。在IXI数据集上的实验结果显示，Dice系数最高可达0.8751。这项工作表明，通过最小限度的架构修改，MedSAM等基础模型可成功应用于多类别医学图像分割任务。研究结果提示，此类模型在未来可进一步拓展至更广泛的医学影像应用场景中。

title: Schrödinger's Seed: Purr-fect Initialization for an Impurr-fect Universe
summary: Context. Random seed selection in deep learning is often arbitrary -- conventionally fixed to values such as 42, a number with no known feline endorsement. Aims. We propose that cats, as liminal beings with a historically ambiguous relationship to quantum mechanics, are better suited to this task than random integers. Methods. We construct a cat-driven seed generator inspired by the first Friedmann equation, and test it by mapping 21 domestic cats' physical properties -- mass, coat pattern, eye colour, and name entropy -- via a Monte ``Catlo'' sampling procedure. Results. Cat-driven seeds achieve a mean accuracy of 92.58%, outperforming the baseline seed of 42 by $\sim$2.5%. Cats from astrophysicist households perform marginally better, suggesting cosmic insight may be contagious. Conclusions. The Universe responds better to cats than to arbitrary integers. Whether cats are aware of this remains unknown.
tldr: A humorous, fictional paper proposing the use of cat physical properties to generate random seeds for deep learning, claiming superior accuracy over conventional arbitrary integers.
tldr_zh: 一篇虚构的幽默论文，提出利用猫的物理特性为深度学习生成随机种子，并声称其性能优于传统的任意整数种子。
summary_zh: 背景：深度学习中的随机种子选择通常是随意的——通常固定为诸如42这类数值，而该数字并无已知的猫科动物认可依据。目的：我们认为，猫作为历史上与量子力学存在模糊关联的阈限生物，比随机整数更适合承担此项任务。方法：我们构建了一个受弗里德曼第一方程启发的猫驱动种子生成器，并通过蒙特"卡洛"抽样程序，将21只家猫的物理特性（质量、毛色花纹、瞳色及名字熵值）映射为种子进行测试。结果：猫驱动种子取得92.58%的平均准确率，较基准种子42提升约2.5%。来自天体物理学家家庭的猫表现略优，暗示宇宙智慧可能具有传染性。结论：宇宙对猫的响应优于任意整数。猫是否知晓此事尚属未知。

title: Let the Abyss Stare Back Adaptive Falsification for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
summary: Autonomous scientific discovery is entering a more dangerous regime: once the evaluator is frozen, a sufficiently strong search process can learn to win the exam without learning the mechanism the task was meant to reveal. This is the idea behind our title. To let the abyss stare back is to make evaluation actively push against the candidate through adaptive falsification, rather than passively certify it through static validation. We introduce DASES, a falsification-driven framework in which an Innovator, an Abyss Falsifier, and a Mechanistic Causal Extractor co-evolve executable scientific artifacts and scientifically admissible counterexample environments under a fixed scientific contract. In a controlled loss-discovery problem with a single editable locus, DASES rejects artifacts that static validation would have accepted, identifies the first candidate that survives the admissible falsification frontier, and discovers FNG-CE, a loss that transfers beyond the synthetic discovery environment and consistently outperforms CE and CE+L2 under controlled comparisons across standard benchmarks, including ImageNet.
tldr: The paper introduces DASES, a falsification-driven framework for autonomous scientific discovery, where an Innovator, an Abyss Falsifier, and a Mechanistic Causal Extractor co-evolve to produce robust scientific artifacts that can withstand adaptive counterexamples.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为DASES的否定驱动框架，用于自主科学发现，通过创新者、深渊否定者和机制因果提取器的协同进化，生成能够经受住适应性反例的稳健科学成果。
summary_zh: 自主科学发现正进入一个更为危险的阶段：一旦评估程序固化，足够强大的搜索过程便能学会通过考试，却不必掌握任务本应揭示的底层机制。这正是我们标题背后的核心理念。所谓“让深渊回望”，是指通过动态证伪使评估过程主动挑战待测对象，而非仅依赖静态验证进行被动认证。我们提出DASES框架——一种基于证伪驱动的协同进化系统，其中创新者、深渊证伪者与机制因果提取器在固定科学契约的约束下，共同演化出可执行的科学产物和科学上可证伪的反例环境。在单编辑位点的受控损失发现任务中，DASES成功排除了静态验证本将接受的伪产物，识别出首个在可证伪边界内存活的候选方案，并发现FNG-CE损失函数。该损失函数不仅能在合成发现环境之外迁移泛化，更在包括ImageNet在内的标准基准测试中，通过受控对比持续超越CE及CE+L2方法。

title: MEDiC: Multi-objective Exploration of Distillation from CLIP
summary: Masked image modeling (MIM) methods typically operate in either raw pixel space (reconstructing masked patches) or latent feature space (aligning with a pre-trained teacher). We present MEDiC (Multi-objective Exploration of Distillation from CLIP), a framework that combines both spaces in a single pipeline through three complementary objectives: patch-level token distillation from a frozen CLIP encoder, global CLS alignment, and pixel reconstruction via a lightweight decoder. We conduct a systematic investigation of the design space surrounding this multi-objective framework. First, we show that all three objectives provide complementary information, with the full combination reaching 73.9% kNN accuracy on ImageNet-1K. Second, we introduce hierarchical clustering with relative position bias for evolved masking and find that, despite producing more semantically coherent masks than prior methods, evolved masking does not outperform simple block masking in the teacher-guided distillation setting, a finding we attribute to the teacher's inherent semantic awareness. Third, we reveal that optimal scalar loss weights are extremely fragile, with small perturbations causing drops of up to 17 percentage points in kNN accuracy. Our framework achieves 73.9% kNN and 85.1% fine-tuning accuracy with ViT-Base at 300 epochs.
tldr: The paper proposes MEDiC, a multi-objective masked image modeling framework that combines patch-level token distillation from CLIP, global CLS alignment, and pixel reconstruction, achieving strong ImageNet-1K classification results.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MEDiC，一个多目标掩码图像建模框架，结合了CLIP的补丁级令牌蒸馏、全局CLS对齐和像素重建，在ImageNet-1K上取得了优异的分类结果。
summary_zh: 掩码图像建模方法通常在原始像素空间（重建掩码块）或潜在特征空间（与预训练教师模型对齐）中操作。本文提出MEDiC（CLIP蒸馏的多目标探索框架），通过三个互补目标将两个空间整合到单一流程中：从冻结CLIP编码器提取块级令牌蒸馏、全局CLS对齐，以及通过轻量级解码器实现像素重建。我们对该多目标框架的设计空间进行了系统性研究。首先，实验表明三个目标均提供互补信息，完整组合在ImageNet-1K上达到73.9%的k近邻准确率。其次，我们引入具有相对位置偏置的层次聚类方法实现进化掩码生成，发现尽管其比现有方法产生语义更连贯的掩码，但在教师引导的蒸馏设置中并未超越简单块掩码，我们将其归因于教师模型固有的语义感知能力。第三，研究发现最优标量损失权重极为敏感，微小扰动会导致k近邻准确率下降高达17个百分点。该框架在300轮训练周期下，使用ViT-Base架构实现了73.9%的k近邻准确率和85.1%的微调准确率。

title: Decoding Functional Networks for Visual Categories via GNNs
summary: Understanding how large-scale brain networks represent visual categories is fundamental to linking perception and cortical organization. Using high-resolution 7T fMRI from the Natural Scenes Dataset, we construct parcel-level functional graphs and train a signed Graph Neural Network that models both positive and negative interactions, with a sparse edge mask and class-specific saliency. The model accurately decodes category-specific functional connectivity states (sports, food, vehicles) and reveals reproducible, biologically meaningful subnetworks along the ventral and dorsal visual pathways. This framework bridges machine learning and neuroscience by extending voxel-level category selectivity to a connectivity-based representation of visual processing.
tldr: This paper uses Graph Neural Networks on fMRI data to decode functional brain networks for visual category processing, linking machine learning to neuroscience.
tldr_zh: 本研究使用图神经网络分析fMRI数据，解码视觉类别处理的功能性脑网络，将机器学习与神经科学联系起来。
summary_zh: 理解大规模脑网络如何表征视觉类别，是连接感知与皮层组织的关键基础。本研究利用自然场景数据集的高分辨率7T功能磁共振成像数据，构建了脑区级别的功能连接图，并训练了一种带符号的图神经网络模型。该模型通过稀疏边掩码与类别特异性显著度建模，同时捕捉正向与负向交互作用，能够准确解码特定类别（运动、食物、车辆）的功能连接状态，并揭示了沿着腹侧与背侧视觉通路的可重复、具有生物学意义的子网络。该框架将机器学习与神经科学相联结，将基于体素的类别选择性研究拓展为基于连接模式的视觉加工表征。

title: Refined Detection for Gumbel Watermarking
summary: We propose a simple detection mechanism for the Gumbel watermarking scheme proposed by Aaronson (2022). The new mechanism is proven to be near-optimal in a problem-dependent sense among all model-agnostic watermarking schemes under the assumption that the next-token distribution is sampled i.i.d.
tldr: Proposes a near-optimal detection mechanism for the Gumbel watermarking scheme for LLMs, focusing on the statistical properties of the detection test.
tldr_zh: 为Gumbel水印方案提出了一种近乎最优的检测机制，专注于检测测试的统计特性。
summary_zh: 我们针对Aaronson（2022）提出的Gumbel水印方案提出了一种简单检测机制。该机制被证明在假定下一词元分布为独立同分布采样的条件下，在问题相关意义上接近所有模型无关水印方案中的最优检测效果。

title: Tracking Equivalent Mechanistic Interpretations Across Neural Networks
summary: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) is an emerging framework for interpreting neural networks. Given a task and model, MI aims to discover a succinct algorithmic process, an interpretation, that explains the model's decision process on that task. However, MI is difficult to scale and generalize. This stems in part from two key challenges: there is no precise notion of a valid interpretation; and, generating interpretations is often an ad hoc process. In this paper, we address these challenges by defining and studying the problem of interpretive equivalence: determining whether two different models share a common interpretation, without requiring an explicit description of what that interpretation is. At the core of our approach, we propose and formalize the principle that two interpretations of a model are equivalent if all of their possible implementations are also equivalent. We develop an algorithm to estimate interpretive equivalence and case study its use on Transformer-based models. To analyze our algorithm, we introduce necessary and sufficient conditions for interpretive equivalence based on models' representation similarity. We provide guarantees that simultaneously relate a model's algorithmic interpretations, circuits, and representations. Our framework lays a foundation for the development of more rigorous evaluation methods of MI and automated, generalizable interpretation discovery methods.
tldr: The paper proposes a framework and algorithm to determine if two neural network models share an equivalent mechanistic interpretation, without requiring an explicit description of that interpretation, aiming to improve the rigor and scalability of mechanistic interpretability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种框架和算法，用于判定两个神经网络模型是否共享相同的机制解释，而无需明确描述该解释，旨在提高机制可解释性的严谨性和可扩展性。
summary_zh: 机制可解释性（MI）是一个新兴的神经网络解释框架。给定一个任务和模型，MI旨在发现一种简洁的算法过程——即解释，以阐明模型在该任务上的决策流程。然而，MI难以扩展和推广，部分原因在于两个关键挑战：缺乏对有效解释的明确定义；且生成解释的过程往往具有临时性。本文通过定义并研究解释等价性问题来解决这些挑战：即在不要求明确描述解释内容的情况下，判断两个不同模型是否共享相同的解释。我们方法的核心在于提出并形式化一个原则：若一个模型的两种解释的所有可能实现方式均等价，则这两种解释等价。我们开发了一种算法来估计解释等价性，并以基于Transformer的模型为例进行了案例研究。为分析该算法，我们基于模型表示相似性提出了解释等价性的必要条件和充分条件。我们提供的理论保证同时关联了模型的算法解释、电路结构和表示特征。该框架为发展更严格的MI评估方法以及自动化、可推广的解释发现方法奠定了基础。

title: Meteorology-Driven GPT4AP: A Multi-Task Forecasting LLM for Atmospheric Air Pollution in Data-Scarce Settings
summary: Accurate forecasting of air pollution is important for environmental monitoring and policy support, yet data-driven models often suffer from limited generalization in regions with sparse observations. This paper presents Meteorology-Driven GPT for Air Pollution (GPT4AP), a parameter-efficient multi-task forecasting framework based on a pre-trained GPT-2 backbone and Gaussian rank-stabilized low-rank adaptation (rsLoRA). The model freezes the self-attention and feed-forward layers and adapts lightweight positional and output modules, substantially reducing the number of trainable parameters. GPT4AP is evaluated on six real-world air quality monitoring datasets under few-shot, zero-shot, and long-term forecasting settings. In the few-shot regime using 10% of the training data, GPT4AP achieves an average MSE/MAE of 0.686/0.442, outperforming DLinear (0.728/0.530) and ETSformer (0.734/0.505). In zero-shot cross-station transfer, the proposed model attains an average MSE/MAE of 0.529/0.403, demonstrating improved generalization compared with existing baselines. In long-term forecasting with full training data, GPT4AP remains competitive, achieving an average MAE of 0.429, while specialized time-series models show slightly lower errors. These results indicate that GPT4AP provides a data-efficient forecasting approach that performs robustly under limited supervision and domain shift, while maintaining competitive accuracy in data-rich settings.
tldr: This paper introduces GPT4AP, a parameter-efficient GPT-2-based model for forecasting atmospheric air pollution using meteorology data, with a focus on data-scarce and few-shot scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GPT4AP，一种基于GPT-2的参数高效模型，利用气象数据预测大气空气污染，主要关注数据稀缺和少样本场景。
summary_zh: 空气污染的精准预测对环境监测与政策制定具有重要意义，但数据驱动模型在观测稀疏区域往往存在泛化能力不足的问题。本文提出气象驱动的空气污染预测模型GPT4AP，该模型基于预训练GPT-2架构，采用高斯秩稳定低秩自适应技术（rsLoRA），构建了一个参数高效的多任务预测框架。该模型冻结自注意力层和前馈网络层，仅对轻量级位置模块与输出模块进行适配，显著减少了可训练参数量。GPT4AP在六个真实空气质量监测数据集上进行了少样本、零样本及长期预测场景的评估。在仅使用10%训练数据的少样本场景中，GPT4AP平均MSE/MAE达到0.686/0.442，优于DLinear（0.728/0.530）和ETSformer（0.734/0.505）。在零样本跨站点迁移任务中，该模型平均MSE/MAE为0.529/0.403，较现有基线模型展现出更强的泛化能力。在使用全量训练数据的长期预测中，GPT4AP保持竞争力，平均MAE为0.429，而专用时间序列模型仅呈现略微更低的误差。结果表明，GPT4AP提供了一种数据高效的预测方法，在有限监督和领域偏移场景下表现稳健，同时在数据充足条件下仍能保持具有竞争力的预测精度。

title: $p$-adic Character Neural Network
summary: We propose a new frame work of $p$-adic neural network. Unlike the original $p$-adic neural network by S.\ Albeverio, A.\ Khrennikov, and B.\ Tirrozi using a family of characteristic functions indexed by hyperparameters of precision as activation functions, we use a single injective $p$-adic character on the topological Abelian group $\mathbb{Z}_p$ of $p$-adic integers as an activation function. We prove the $p$-adic universal approximation theorem for this formulation of $p$-adic neural network, and reduce it to the feasibility problem of polynomial equations over the finite ring of integers modulo a power of $p$.
tldr: This paper introduces a new type of neural network based on p-adic numbers, using a single p-adic character as an activation function and proving a universal approximation theorem for this formulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于p-adic数的新神经网络框架，使用单个p-adic字符作为激活函数，并证明了其通用逼近定理，将其归结为有限整数环上的多项式方程求解可行性问题。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新的$p$-adic神经网络框架。不同于S. Albeverio、A. Khrennikov和B. Tirrozi提出的原始$p$-adic神经网络使用以精度超参数为索引的特征函数族作为激活函数，我们采用拓扑阿贝尔群$\mathbb{Z}_p$（$p$-adic整数环）上的单射$p$-adic特征函数作为激活函数。我们证明了该$p$-adic神经网络的$p$-adic通用逼近定理，并将其简化为模$p$幂的有限整数环上多项式方程组的可行性问题。

title: DiSGMM: A Method for Time-varying Microscopic Weight Completion on Road Networks
summary:
Microscopic road-network weights represent fine-grained, time-varying traffic conditions obtained from individual vehicles. An example is travel speeds associated with road segments as vehicles traverse them. These weights support tasks including traffic microsimulation and vehicle routing with reliability guarantees. We study the problem of time-varying microscopic weight completion. During a time slot, the available weights typically cover only some road segments. Weight completion recovers distributions for the weights of every road segment at the current time slot. This problem involves two challenges: (i) contending with two layers of sparsity, where weights are missing at both the network layer (many road segments lack weights) and the segment layer (a segment may have insufficient weights to enable accurate distribution estimation); and (ii) achieving a weight distribution representation that is closed-form and can capture complex conditions flexibly, including heavy tails and multiple clusters.
  To address these challenges, we propose DiSGMM that combines sparsity-aware embeddings with spatiotemporal modeling to leverage sparse known weights alongside learned segment properties and long-range correlations for distribution estimation. DiSGMM represents distributions of microscopic weights as learnable Gaussian mixture models, providing closed-form distributions capable of capturing complex conditions flexibly. Experiments on two real-world datasets show that DiSGMM can outperform state-of-the-art methods.
tldr: The paper proposes DiSGMM, a method for completing time-varying microscopic weight distributions on road networks, addressing sparsity and distribution estimation challenges.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出DiSGMM方法，用于补全路网上的时变微观权重分布，以解决稀疏性和分布估计的挑战。
summary_zh:
微观路网权重代表了从个体车辆获取的细粒度、时变交通状况。例如，车辆在路段行驶时关联的行程速度。这些权重支持包括交通微观仿真和具有可靠性保证的车辆路径规划在内的任务。我们研究了时变微观权重补全问题。在单个时间段内，可用权重通常仅覆盖部分路段。权重补全旨在恢复当前时间段内每个路段权重的分布。该问题面临两大挑战：（一）需处理双重稀疏性，即权重在网络层（许多路段缺乏权重）和路段层（单个路段可能权重不足，难以进行准确分布估计）均存在缺失；（二）需要构建一种闭式表达的权重分布表示方法，能够灵活捕捉复杂交通状况，包括重尾分布和多峰聚集现象。

为应对这些挑战，我们提出DiSGMM方法，该方法将稀疏感知嵌入与时空建模相结合，利用稀疏已知权重以及学习到的路段属性和长程相关性进行分布估计。DiSGMM将微观权重的分布表示为可学习的高斯混合模型，提供能够灵活捕捉复杂交通状况的闭式分布。在两个真实数据集上的实验表明，DiSGMM的性能优于当前最先进的方法。

title: Unbounded Density Ratio Estimation and Its Application to Covariate Shift Adaptation
summary: This paper focuses on the problem of unbounded density ratio estimation -- an understudied yet critical challenge in statistical learning -- and its application to covariate shift adaptation.
