Much of the existing literature assumes that the density ratio is either uniformly bounded or unbounded but known exactly. These conditions are often violated in practice, creating a gap between theoretical guarantees and real-world applicability. In contrast, this work directly addresses unbounded density ratios and integrates them into importance weighting for effective covariate shift adaptation. We propose a three-step estimation method that leverages unlabeled data from both the source and target distributions: (1) estimating a relative density ratio; (2) applying a truncation operation to control its unboundedness; and (3) transforming the truncated estimate back into the standard density ratio. The estimated density ratio is then employed as importance weights for regression under covariate shift. We establish rigorous, non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for both the proposed density ratio estimator and the resulting regression function estimator, demonstrating optimal or near-optimal convergence rates. Our findings offer new theoretical insights into density ratio estimation and learning under covariate shift, extending classical learning theory to more practical and challenging scenarios.
tldr: Proposes a method for estimating unbounded density ratios using unlabeled data, with a truncation step to handle unboundedness, and applies it for covariate shift adaptation in regression with theoretical guarantees.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种利用无标签数据估计无界密度比的方法，通过截断操作处理无界性，并应用于协变量偏移适应的回归问题，同时提供了理论保证。
summary_zh: 本文聚焦于无界密度比估计问题——这一统计学习中尚未充分研究但至关重要的挑战——及其在协变量偏移适应中的应用。现有文献大多假设密度比要么一致有界，要么虽无界但精确已知。这些条件在实践中常被违背，导致理论保证与现实应用之间存在差距。与此不同，本工作直接处理无界密度比，并将其整合到重要性加权中以实现有效的协变量偏移适应。我们提出一种三步估计方法，利用来自源分布和目标分布的无标签数据：(1) 估计相对密度比；(2) 应用截断操作以控制其无界性；(3) 将截断估计量转换回标准密度比。所估计的密度比随后被用作协变量偏移下回归的重要性权重。我们为提出的密度比估计量及由此得到的回归函数估计量建立了严格的非渐近收敛保证，证明了其达到最优或接近最优的收敛速度。我们的研究为密度比估计及协变量偏移下的学习提供了新的理论见解，将经典学习理论扩展到更实用且更具挑战性的场景中。

title: Disentangled Graph Prompting for Out-Of-Distribution Detection
summary: When testing data and training data come from different distributions, deep neural networks (DNNs) will face significant safety risks in practical applications. Therefore, out-of-distribution (OOD) detection techniques, which can identify OOD samples at test time and alert the system, are urgently needed. Existing graph OOD detection methods usually characterize fine-grained in-distribution (ID) patterns from multiple perspectives, and train end-to-end graph neural networks (GNNs) for prediction. However, due to the unavailability of OOD data during training, the absence of explicit supervision signals could lead to sub-optimal performance of end-to-end encoders. To address this issue, we follow the pre-training+prompting paradigm to utilize pre-trained GNN encoders, and propose Disentangled Graph Prompting (DGP), to capture fine-grained ID patterns with the help of ID graph labels. Specifically, we design two prompt generators that respectively generate class-specific and class-agnostic prompt graphs by modifying the edge weights of an input graph. We also design several effective losses to train the prompt generators and prevent trivial solutions. We conduct extensive experiments on ten datasets to demonstrate the superiority of our proposed DGP, which achieves a relative AUC improvement of 3.63% over the best graph OOD detection baseline. Ablation studies and hyper-parameter experiments further show the effectiveness of DGP. Code is available at https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/DGP.
tldr: This paper proposes Disentangled Graph Prompting (DGP), a pre-training and prompting method for improving out-of-distribution detection on graph-structured data using graph neural networks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种解构图提示（DGP）方法，通过预训练和提示范式，利用图标签信息改进图神经网络在分布外检测上的性能。
summary_zh: 当测试数据与训练数据来源不同分布时，深度神经网络在实际应用中会面临显著的安全风险。因此，亟需开发能够在测试时识别分布外样本并向系统发出警报的分布外检测技术。现有的图分布外检测方法通常从多视角刻画细粒度的分布内模式，并训练端到端的图神经网络进行预测。然而，由于训练过程中无法获取分布外数据，缺乏显式监督信号可能导致端到端编码器的性能欠佳。为解决这一问题，我们遵循预训练+提示调优范式，利用预训练的图神经网络编码器，并提出了解耦图提示方法，以借助分布内图标签捕获细粒度分布内模式。具体而言，我们设计了两种提示生成器，分别通过修改输入图的边权重来生成类特定与类无关的提示图。同时设计了多种有效损失函数来训练提示生成器并避免平凡解。我们在十个数据集上进行了大量实验，证明所提出的解耦图提示方法的优越性，其分布外检测性能相对最佳基线实现了3.63%的AUC提升。消融实验与超参数研究进一步验证了该方法的有效性。代码已开源：https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/DGP。

title: Central limit theorems for the outputs of fully convolutional neural networks with time series input
summary: Deep learning is widely deployed for time series learning tasks such as classification and forecasting. Despite the empirical successes, only little theory has been developed so far in the time series context. In this work, we prove that if the network inputs are generated from short-range dependent linear processes, the outputs of fully convolutional neural networks (FCNs) with global average pooling (GAP) are asymptotically Gaussian and the limit is attained if the length of the observed time series tends to infinity. The proof leverages existing tools from the theoretical time series literature. Based on our theory, we propose a generalization of the GAP layer by considering a global weighted pooling step with slowly varying, learnable coefficients.
tldr: This paper provides a theoretical proof that fully convolutional neural networks (FCNs) with global average pooling (GAP) produce asymptotically Gaussian outputs when trained on short-range dependent linear time series data.
tldr_zh: 该论文从理论上证明，当使用短程依赖的线性时间序列数据时，带有全局平均池化的全卷积神经网络的输出是渐近高斯的，并提出了一种基于可学习系数的广义加权池化层。
summary_zh: 深度学习被广泛应用于分类和预测等时间序列学习任务中。尽管取得了显著的经验成果，但目前在时间序列领域仅有少量理论发展。本研究证明，当网络输入由短程相关线性过程生成时，采用全局平均池化（GAP）的全卷积神经网络（FCN）输出具有渐近高斯性，且当观测时间序列长度趋于无穷时达到极限。该证明借鉴了理论时间序列文献中的现有工具。基于我们的理论，我们提出了一种全局加权池化层的扩展方案，通过采用具有缓慢变化、可学习系数的全局加权池化步骤来实现。

title: Capturing Multivariate Dependencies of EV Charging Events: From Parametric Copulas to Neural Density Estimation
summary: Accurate event-based modeling of electric vehicle (EV) charging is essential for grid reliability and smart-charging design. While traditional statistical methods capture marginal distributions, they often fail to model the complex, non-linear dependencies between charging variables, specifically arrival times, durations, and energy demand. This paper addresses this gap by introducing the first application of Vine copulas and Copula Density Neural Estimation framework (CODINE) to the EV domain. We evaluate these high-capacity dependence models across three diverse real-world datasets. Our results demonstrate that by explicitly focusing on modeling the joint dependence structure, Vine copulas and CODINE outperform established parametric families and remain highly competitive against state-of-the-art benchmarks like conditional Gaussian Mixture Model Networks. We show that these methods offer superior preservation of tail behaviors and correlation structures, providing a robust framework for synthetic charging event generation in varied infrastructure contexts.
tldr: This paper applies Vine copulas and a neural density estimation framework to model the complex dependencies between electric vehicle charging variables, demonstrating superior performance for synthetic event generation.
tldr_zh: 本文应用 Vine copulas 和神经密度估计框架来建模电动汽车充电变量之间的复杂依赖关系，在合成事件生成方面展现出优越性能。
summary_zh: 电动汽车（EV）充电的精准事件建模对于电网可靠性和智能充电设计至关重要。传统统计方法虽能捕捉边际分布，但往往难以模拟充电变量间复杂的非线性依赖关系，特别是到达时间、充电时长和能量需求之间的交互作用。本文首次将 Vine Copula 和 Copula 密度神经估计框架（CODINE）引入电动汽车领域，以弥补这一不足。我们在三个不同的真实世界数据集上评估了这些高容量依赖模型。结果表明，通过专注于对联合依赖结构进行建模，Vine Copula 和 CODINE 的表现超越了现有参数化模型族，并在与条件高斯混合模型网络等先进基准的比较中保持了高度竞争力。我们证明这些方法能更好地保留尾部行为和相关结构，为不同基础设施场景下的合成充电事件生成提供了稳健的框架。

title: Deep Learning-Assisted Improved Differential Fault Attacks on Lightweight Stream Ciphers
summary: Lightweight cryptographic primitives are widely deployed in resource-constraint environment, particularly in the Internet of Things (IoT) devices. Due to their public accessibility, these devices are vulnerable to physical attacks, especially fault attacks. Recently, deep learning-based cryptanalytic techniques have demonstrated promising results; however, their application to fault attacks remains limited, particularly for stream ciphers. In this work, we investigate the feasibility of deep learning assisted differential fault attack on three lightweight stream ciphers, namely ACORNv3, MORUSv2 and ATOM, under a relaxed fault model, where a single-bit bit-flipping fault is injected at an unknown location. We train multilayer perceptron (MLP) models to identify the fault locations. Experimental results show that the trained models achieve high identification accuracies of 0.999880, 0.999231 and 0.823568 for ACORNv3, MORUSv2 and ATOM, respectively, and outperform traditional signature-based methods. For the secret recovery process, we introduce a threshold-based method to optimize the number of fault injections required to recover the secret information. The results show that the initial state of ACORN can be recovered with 21 to 34 faults; while MORUS requires 213 to 248 faults, with at most 6 bits of guessing. Both attacks reduce the attack complexity compared to existing works. For ATOM, the results show that it possesses a higher security margin, as majority of state bits in the Non-linear Feedback Shift Register (NFSR) can only be recovered under a precise control model. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first experimental results of differential fault attacks on ATOM.
tldr: This paper uses deep learning (MLP models) to improve differential fault attacks on lightweight stream ciphers, evaluating them on three specific ciphers and showing improved efficiency over traditional methods.
tldr_zh: 本研究使用深度学习（MLP模型）来改进对轻量级流密码的差分故障攻击，评估了三种具体密码，并展示了相比传统方法更高的攻击效率。
summary_zh: 轻量级密码原语广泛应用于资源受限环境，特别是物联网设备中。由于其公开可访问性，这些设备易受物理攻击，尤其是故障攻击。近年来，基于深度学习的密码分析技术已展现出良好效果，但在故障攻击中的应用仍显不足，尤其针对流密码领域。本研究探索了在宽松故障模型下对三种轻量级流密码（ACORNv3、MORUSv2和ATOM）实施深度学习辅助差分故障攻击的可行性，该模型允许在未知位置注入单比特翻转故障。我们训练多层感知机（MLP）模型以识别故障位置，实验结果表明：训练后的模型对ACORNv3、MORUSv2和ATOM的识别准确率分别达到0.999880、0.999231和0.823568，性能优于传统基于特征的方法。在密钥恢复阶段，我们引入基于阈值的方法来优化恢复秘密信息所需的故障注入次数。结果显示：ACORN的初始状态可通过21至34次故障恢复；MORUS需213至248次故障并最多猜测6比特密钥；两种攻击均较现有方案降低了攻击复杂度。对于ATOM，研究表明其具有更高的安全裕度，非线性反馈移位寄存器中的大多数状态位仅能在精确控制模型下恢复。据我们所知，本研究首次提供了针对ATOM差分故障攻击的实验结果。

title: Finite-time analysis of Multi-timescale Stochastic Optimization Algorithms
summary: We present a finite-time analysis of two smoothed functional stochastic approximation algorithms for simulation-based optimization. The first is a two time-scale gradient-based method, while the second is a three time-scale Newton-based algorithm that estimates both the gradient and the Hessian of the objective function $J$. Both algorithms involve zeroth order estimates for the gradient/Hessian. Although the asymptotic convergence of these algorithms has been established in prior work, finite-time guarantees of two-timescale stochastic optimization algorithms in zeroth order settings have not been provided previously. For our Newton algorithm, we derive mean-squared error bounds for the Hessian estimator and establish a finite-time bound on $\min\limits_{0 \le m \le T} \mathbb{E}\| \nabla J(θ(m)) \|^2$, showing convergence to first-order stationary points. The analysis explicitly characterizes the interaction between multiple time-scales and the propagation of estimation errors. We further identify step-size choices that balance dominant error terms and achieve near-optimal convergence rates. We also provide corresponding finite-time guarantees for the gradient algorithm under the same framework. The theoretical results are further validated through experiments on the Continuous Mountain Car environment.
tldr: This paper presents a finite-time convergence analysis for two multi-timescale stochastic optimization algorithms (gradient and Newton-based) using zeroth-order estimates.
tldr_zh: 本文对两种使用零阶估计的多时间尺度随机优化算法（梯度法和牛顿法）进行了有限时间收敛性分析。
summary_zh: 本文针对两种基于仿真的光滑泛函随机逼近算法进行了有限时间分析。第一种是基于梯度的双时间尺度算法，第二种是基于牛顿法的三时间尺度算法，后者同时估计目标函数 $J$ 的梯度与海森矩阵。两种算法均采用零阶估计方法对梯度及海森矩阵进行估计。虽然已有研究证明了这些算法的渐近收敛性，但在零阶设定下，双时间尺度随机优化算法的有限时间收敛性保证尚未得到充分探讨。对于牛顿算法，我们推导了海森估计量的均方误差界，并建立了 $\min\limits_{0 \le m \le T} \mathbb{E}\| \nabla J(θ(m)) \|^2$ 的有限时间收敛界，证明其能够收敛至一阶稳定点。该分析明确刻画了多时间尺度间的交互作用与估计误差的传播机制。我们进一步给出了步长选择方案，以平衡主要误差项并实现接近最优的收敛速率。同时，我们在同一框架下为梯度算法提供了相应的有限时间收敛性保证。理论结果通过连续山地车环境中的实验得到了进一步验证。

title: LGFNet: Local-Global Fusion Network with Fidelity Gap Delta Learning for Multi-Source Aerodynamics
summary: The precise fusion of computational fluid dynamic (CFD) data, wind tunnel tests data, and flight tests data in aerodynamic area is essential for obtaining comprehensive knowledge of both localized flow structures and global aerodynamic trends across the entire flight envelope. However, existing methodologies often struggle to balance high-resolution local fidelity with wide-range global dependency, leading to either a loss of sharp discontinuities or an inability to capture long-range topological correlations. We propose Local-Global Fusion Network (LGFNet) for multi-scale feature decomposition to extract this dual-natured aerodynamic knowledge. To this end, LGFNet combines a spatial perception layer that integrates a sliding window mechanism with a relational reasoning layer based on self-attention, simultaneously reinforcing the continuity of fine-grained local features (e.g., shock waves) and capturing long-range flow information. Furthermore, the fidelity gap delta learning (FGDL) strategy is proposed to treat CFD data as a "low-frequency carrier" to explicitly approximate nonlinear discrepancies. This approach prevents unphysical smoothing while inheriting the foundational physical trends from the simulation baseline. Experiments demonstrate that LGFNet achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in both accuracy and uncertainty reduction across diverse aerodynamic scenarios.
tldr: Proposes a Local-Global Fusion Network (LGFNet) with a fidelity gap delta learning strategy for fusing multi-source aerodynamic data, aiming to balance local fidelity and global trends.
tldr_zh: 提出了局部-全局融合网络（LGFNet）及保真度差距增量学习策略，用于融合多源气动数据，旨在平衡局部高保真与全局趋势。
summary_zh: 空气动力学领域计算流体动力学（CFD）数据、风洞试验数据与飞行试验数据的精确融合，对于全面获取全飞行包线内局部流动结构与整体气动趋势的认知至关重要。然而，现有方法往往难以平衡高分辨率局部保真度与宽范围全局关联性，易导致尖锐不连续特征的丢失或长程拓扑关联的遗漏。本文提出局部-全局融合网络（LGFNet），通过多尺度特征分解机制提取这种双重特性的气动知识。该网络结合了集成滑动窗口机制的空间感知层与基于自注意力的关系推理层，在强化细粒度局部特征（如激波）连续性的同时，捕获长程流动信息。此外，所提出的保真度间隙增量学习（FGDL）策略将CFD数据视为"低频载体"，显式逼近非线性差异。该方法在继承仿真基线物理趋势的基础上，避免了非物理平滑现象。实验表明，LGFNet在多种气动场景中均实现了精度与不确定性降低的先进性能。

title: From Physics to Surrogate Intelligence: A Unified Electro-Thermo-Optimization Framework for TSV Networks
summary: High-density through-substrate vias (TSVs) enable 2.5D/3D heterogeneous integration but introduce significant signal-integrity and thermal-reliability challenges due to electrical coupling, insertion loss, and self-heating. Conventional full-wave finite-element method (FEM) simulations provide high accuracy but become computationally prohibitive for large design-space exploration. This work presents a scalable electro-thermal modeling and optimization framework that combines physics-informed analytical modeling, graph neural network (GNN) surrogates, and full-wave sign-off validation. A multi-conductor analytical model computes broadband S-parameters and effective anisotropic thermal conductivities of TSV arrays, achieving $5\%-10\%$ relative Frobenius error (RFE) across array sizes up to $15x15$. A physics-informed GNN surrogate (TSV-PhGNN), trained on analytical data and fine-tuned with HFSS simulations, generalizes to larger arrays with RFE below $2\%$ and nearly constant variance. The surrogate is integrated into a multi-objective Pareto optimization framework targeting reflection coefficient, insertion loss, worst-case crosstalk (NEXT/FEXT), and effective thermal conductivity. Millions of TSV configurations can be explored within minutes, enabling exhaustive layout and geometric optimization that would be infeasible using FEM alone. Final designs are validated with Ansys HFSS and Mechanical, showing strong agreement. The proposed framework enables rapid electro-thermal co-design of TSV arrays while reducing per-design evaluation time by more than six orders of magnitude.
tldr: This paper presents a scalable electro-thermal modeling and optimization framework using physics-informed GNN surrogates for the design of through-substrate via (TSV) networks in integrated circuits, drastically accelerating design exploration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于集成电路中硅通孔网络设计的可扩展电热建模与优化框架，该框架使用物理信息图神经网络代理，极大地加速了设计探索过程。
summary_zh: 高密度硅通孔（TSV）技术可实现2.5D/3D异构集成，但由于电气耦合、插入损耗和自热效应，也带来了显著的信号完整性与热可靠性挑战。传统的全波有限元法仿真精度高，但在大规模设计空间探索中计算成本过高。本文提出一种可扩展的电-热建模与优化框架，结合了物理信息解析建模、图神经网络代理模型和全波签核验证。通过多导体解析模型计算TSV阵列的宽带S参数和等效各向异性热导率，在15x15规模的阵列中相对弗罗贝尼乌斯误差保持在5%–10%范围内。基于物理信息的图神经网络代理模型（TSV-PhGNN）通过解析数据训练并辅以HFSS仿真微调，可推广至更大规模阵列，其相对弗罗贝尼乌斯误差低于2%且方差近乎恒定。该代理模型被集成到多目标帕累托优化框架中，以优化反射系数、插入损耗、最坏情况串扰（近端/远端串扰）和等效热导率为目标。该框架可在数分钟内探索数百万种TSV配置，实现传统有限元法难以完成的详尽布局与几何优化。最终设计经Ansys HFSS与Mechanical验证，结果高度吻合。所提出的框架能够实现TSV阵列的快速电-热协同设计，同时将单个设计的评估时间降低了六个数量级以上。

title: Biomimetic PINNs for Cell-Induced Phase Transitions: UQ-R3 Sampling with Causal Gating
summary: Nonconvex multi-well energies in cell-induced phase transitions give rise to sharp interfaces, fine-scale microstructures, and distance-dependent inter-cell coupling, all of which pose significant challenges for physics-informed learning. Existing methods often suffer from over-smoothing in near-field patterns. To address this, we propose biomimetic physics-informed neural networks (Bio-PINNs), a variational framework that encodes temporal causality into explicit spatial causality via a progressive distance gate. Furthermore, Bio-PINNs leverage a deformation-uncertainty proxy for the interfacial length scale to target microstructure-prone regions, providing a computationally efficient alternative to explicit second-derivative regularization. We provide theoretical guarantees for the resulting uncertainty-driven ``retain-resample-release" adaptive collocation strategy, which ensures persistent coverage under gating and establishing a quantitative near-to-far growth bound. Across single- and multi-cell benchmarks, diverse separations, and various regularization regimes, Bio-PINNs consistently recover sharp transition layers and tether morphologies, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art adaptive and ungated baselines.
tldr: The paper proposes a biomimetic physics-informed neural network framework for cell-induced phase transitions, focusing on addressing over-smoothing in near-field patterns through causal gating and uncertainty-driven adaptive sampling.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于细胞诱导相变的仿生物理信息神经网络框架，通过因果门控和不确定性驱动的自适应采样来解决近场模式中的过平滑问题。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
细胞诱导相变中的非凸多势阱能量会导致尖锐界面、细尺度微观结构以及依赖于距离的细胞间耦合，这些均对物理信息学习构成重大挑战。现有方法在近场模式中往往存在过度平滑的问题。为此，我们提出仿生物理信息神经网络（Bio-PINNs），这是一种通过渐进式距离门控将时间因果性编码为显式空间因果性的变分框架。此外，Bio-PINNs利用界面长度尺度的变形-不确定性代理来针对易产生微观结构的区域，为显式二阶导数正则化提供了一种计算高效的替代方案。我们为所提出的不确定性驱动“保留-重采样-释放”自适应配点策略提供了理论保证，该策略确保在门控下的持续覆盖，并建立了定量的近场至远场增长边界。在单细胞与多细胞基准测试、不同间距以及多种正则化机制下，Bio-PINNs均能稳定恢复尖锐的过渡层和束缚形态，显著优于当前最先进的自适应与非门控基线方法。

title: Adaptive Delayed-Update Cyclic Algorithm for Variational Inequalities
summary: Cyclic block coordinate methods are a fundamental class of first-order algorithms, widely used in practice for their simplicity and strong empirical performance. Yet, their theoretical behavior remains challenging to explain, and setting their step sizes -- beyond classical coordinate descent for minimization -- typically requires careful tuning or line-search machinery. In this work, we develop $\texttt{ADUCA}$ (Adaptive Delayed-Update Cyclic Algorithm), a cyclic algorithm addressing a broad class of Minty variational inequalities with monotone Lipschitz operators. $\texttt{ADUCA}$ is parameter-free: it requires no global or block-wise Lipschitz constants and uses no per-epoch line search, except at initialization. A key feature of the algorithm is using operator information delayed by a full cycle, which makes the algorithm compatible with parallel and distributed implementations, and attractive due to weakened synchronization requirements across blocks. We prove that $\texttt{ADUCA}$ attains (near) optimal global oracle complexity as a function of target error $ε>0,$ scaling with $1/ε$ for monotone operators, or with $\log^2(1/ε)$ for operators that are strongly monotone.
tldr: The paper proposes a parameter-free cyclic algorithm for variational inequalities with monotone operators, featuring delayed updates for parallel/distributed computation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种参数自由的循环算法，用于求解单调算子的变分不等式问题，其延迟更新机制便于并行与分布式计算。
summary_zh: 循环块坐标法是一类基础的一阶算法，因其简单性和强大的实证性能而在实践中广泛应用。然而，其理论行为仍难以解释，且步长设置——超越经典的最小化坐标下降法——通常需要仔细调参或线搜索机制。本研究开发了$\texttt{ADUCA}$（自适应延迟更新循环算法），该循环算法用于处理一类具有单调Lipschitz算子的Minty型变分不等式问题。$\texttt{ADUCA}$具有无参数特性：它不需要全局或分块Lipschitz常数，除初始化阶段外无需每轮线搜索。该算法的关键特点是使用了延迟一个完整周期的算子信息，这使得算法能够兼容并行和分布式实现，并因减弱了跨块同步需求而更具吸引力。我们证明，$\texttt{ADUCA}$在目标误差$ε>0$的函数上达到了（近似）最优的全局预言复杂度：对于单调算子其缩放为$1/ε$，对于强单调算子则缩放为$\log^2(1/ε)$。

title: How much of persistent homology is topology? A quantitative decomposition for spin model phase transitions
summary: Point-cloud persistent homology (PH) -- computing alpha or Rips complexes on spin-position point clouds -- has been widely applied to detect phase transitions in classical spin models since Donato et al. (2016), with subsequent studies attributing the detection to the topological content of the persistence diagram. We ask a simple question that has not been posed: what fraction of the PH signal is genuinely topological? We introduce f_topo, a quantitative decomposition that separates the density-driven and topological contributions to any PH statistic by comparing real spin configurations against density-matched shuffled null models. Across the 2D Ising model (system sizes L = 16-128, ten temperatures) and Potts models (q = 3, 5), we find that H_0 statistics -- total persistence, persistence entropy, feature count -- are 94-100% density-driven (f_topo < 0.07). The density-matched shuffled null detects T_c at the identical location and with comparable peak height as real configurations, showing that density alone is sufficient for phase transition detection. However, H_1 statistics are partially topological: the topological fraction grows with system size as delta(TP_{H_1}) ~ L^{0.53} and follows a finite-size scaling collapse delta(T, L) = L^{0.53} g(tL^{1/nu}) with collapse quality CV = 0.27. The longest persistence bar is strongly topological (f_topo > 1) and scales with the correlation length. A scale-resolved analysis reveals that the topological excess shifts from large-scale to small-scale features as L increases. We propose that the TDA-for-phase-transitions community adopt shuffled null models as standard practice, and that H_1 rather than H_0 statistics be used when genuine topological information is sought.
tldr: This paper presents a quantitative decomposition (f_topo) to separate density-driven and topological contributions in persistent homology signals from spin models, finding that most phase transition detection signals are density-driven rather than topological.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种量化分解方法（f_topo），用于分离自旋模型中持续同源性信号的密度驱动和拓扑贡献，发现大多数相变检测信号是密度驱动的，而非拓扑性的。
summary_zh: 点云持续同调（PH）——通过计算自旋位置点云上的阿尔法复形或里普斯复形——自Donato等人（2016）的研究以来，已被广泛应用于检测经典自旋模型中的相变，后续研究将这种检测能力归因于持续图的拓扑内容。我们提出一个尚未被探讨的简单问题：PH信号中究竟有多少比例是真正具有拓扑性的？我们引入f_topo这一量化分解方法，通过将真实自旋构型与密度匹配的随机重排零模型进行比较，分离出任何PH统计量中密度驱动与拓扑贡献的成分。在二维伊辛模型（系统尺寸L=16-128，十个温度）和波茨模型（q=3,5）中，我们发现H_0统计量（总持续值、持续熵、特征数量）有94-100%由密度驱动（f_topo<0.07）。密度匹配的随机重排零模型能够在与真实构型完全相同的位置检测到相变临界温度T_c，且峰值高度相当，表明仅凭密度信息就足以实现相变检测。然而，H_1统计量则具有部分拓扑性：其拓扑分数随系统尺寸增大呈δ(TP_{H_1})~L^{0.53}增长，并遵循有限尺寸标度坍缩规律δ(T,L)=L^{0.53}g(tL^{1/ν})，坍缩质量CV=0.27。最长的持续条形特征具有显著拓扑性（f_topo>1），且与关联长度标度相关。尺度分辨分析显示，随着L增大，拓扑超额贡献会从大尺度特征向小尺度特征转移。我们建议相变拓扑数据分析（TDA）领域将随机重排零模型作为标准实践工具，并在寻求真实拓扑信息时使用H_1而非H_0统计量。

title: Data-informed lifting line theory
summary: We present a data-driven framework that extends the predictive capability of classical lifting-line theory (LLT) to a wider aerodynamic regime by incorporating higher-fidelity aerodynamic data from panel method simulations. A neural network architecture with a convolutional layer followed by fully connected layers is developed, comprising two parallel subnetworks to separately process spanwise collocation points and global geometric/aerodynamic inputs such as angle of attack, chord, twist, airfoil distribution, and sweep. Among several configurations tested, this architecture is most effective in learning corrections to LLT outputs. The trained model captures higher-order three-dimensional effects in spanwise lift and drag distributions in regimes where LLT is inaccurate, such as low aspect ratios and high sweep, and generalizes well to wing configurations outside both the LLT regime and the training data range. The method retains LLT's computational efficiency, enabling integration into aerodynamic optimization loops and early-stage aircraft design studies. This approach offers a practical path for embedding high-fidelity corrections into low-order methods and may be extended to other aerodynamic prediction tasks, such as propeller performance.
tldr: This paper presents a data-driven enhancement of classical lifting-line theory for aerodynamics using neural networks, focusing on wing design and optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的方法，利用神经网络增强经典升力线理论，专注于机翼设计和优化。
summary_zh: 本文提出一种数据驱动框架，通过融合面元法模拟获得的高精度气动数据，将经典升力线理论（LLT）的预测能力拓展至更广泛的气动工况。研究构建了一种包含卷积层与全连接层的神经网络架构，采用两个并行子网络分别处理展向配置点数据以及全局几何/气动输入参数（如攻角、弦长、扭角、翼型分布和后掠角）。在多种测试构型中，该架构对于学习LLT输出的修正效果最为显著。训练后的模型在LLT失效工况（如低展弦比、高后掠角）下能准确捕捉展向升阻力分布的高阶三维效应，并对超出LLT适用范围及训练数据分布的机翼构型具有良好的泛化能力。该方法保持了LLT的计算效率，可集成至气动优化循环与飞机早期设计研究中。该技术为在低阶方法中嵌入高精度修正提供了可行路径，并可拓展至螺旋桨性能预测等其他气动预测任务。

title: From Astronomy to Astrology: Testing the Illusion of Zodiac-Based Personality Prediction with Machine Learning
summary: Astrology has long been used to interpret human personality, estimate compatibility, and guide social decision-making. Zodiac-based systems in particular remain culturally influential across much of the world, including in South Asian societies where astrological reasoning can shape marriage matching, naming conventions, ritual timing, and broader life planning. Despite this persistence, astrology has never established either a physically plausible mechanism or a statistically reliable predictive foundation. In this work, we examine zodiac-based personality prediction using a controlled machine-learning framework. We construct a synthetic dataset in which individuals are assigned zodiac signs and personality labels drawn from a shared pool of 100 broadly human traits. Each sign is associated with a subset of 10 common descriptors, intentionally overlapping with those assigned to other signs, thereby reproducing the ambiguity characteristic of practical astrological systems. We then train Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and neural-network classifiers to infer personality labels from zodiac-based features and nuisance covariates. Across all experiments, predictive performance remains at or near random expectation, while shuffled-label controls yield comparable accuracies. We argue that the apparent success of astrology arises not from measurable predictive structure, but from trait universality, category overlap, cognitive biases such as the Barnum effect and confirmation bias, and the interpretive flexibility of astrologers and pundits. We conclude that zodiac-based systems do not provide reliable information for predicting human behavior and instead function as culturally durable narrative frameworks. This paper is intended as a humorous academic exercise.
tldr: The paper uses machine learning to humorously debunk zodiac-based personality prediction, finding no predictive power beyond random chance and attributing astrology's perceived success to cognitive biases and trait universality.
tldr_zh: 该论文使用机器学习进行幽默地论证，指出星座性格预测没有预测能力，其表面的成功源于认知偏差和特质的普遍性。
summary_zh: 占星学长久以来被用于解读人类性格、评估兼容性以及指导社会决策。基于星座的预测体系尤其在全球多地的文化中具有影响力，包括南亚社会，其中占星逻辑常被用于婚姻匹配、命名习俗、仪式择时及更广泛的人生规划。尽管这种传统持续存在，占星学始终未能确立一个物理上可信的机制或统计上可靠的预测基础。本研究采用受控的机器学习框架检验基于星座的性格预测。我们构建了一个合成数据集，其中个体被分配星座标签和从100项广泛人类特征池中抽取的性格标签，每个星座与10个通用描述词的子集关联，这些描述词有意与其他星座的标签重叠，从而再现了实际占星体系中常见的模糊性特征。随后，我们训练逻辑回归、随机森林和神经网络分类器，尝试从星座特征及干扰协变量中推断性格标签。所有实验结果显示，预测性能始终处于或接近随机期望水平，而随机标签对照组也产生相似的准确度。我们认为，占星学表面上的成功并非源自可测量的预测结构，而是源于特质的普遍性、类别重叠、巴纳姆效应和确认偏误等认知偏差，以及占星师与评论者解读的灵活性。我们得出结论：基于星座的体系无法为预测人类行为提供可靠信息，其本质是文化上具有持久性的叙事框架。本文旨在进行一次幽默的学术探讨。

title: Transfer Learning in Bayesian Optimization for Aircraft Design
summary: The use of transfer learning within Bayesian optimization addresses the disadvantages of the so-called \textit{cold start} problem by using source data to aid in the optimization of a target problem. We present a method that leverages an ensemble of surrogate models using transfer learning and integrates it in a constrained Bayesian optimization framework. We identify challenges particular to aircraft design optimization related to heterogeneous design variables and constraints. We propose the use of a partial-least-squares dimension reduction algorithm to address design space heterogeneity, and a \textit{meta} data surrogate selection method to address constraint heterogeneity. Numerical benchmark problems and an aircraft conceptual design optimization problem are used to demonstrate the proposed methods. Results show significant improvement in convergence in early optimization iterations compared to standard Bayesian optimization, with improved prediction accuracy for both objective and constraint surrogate models.
tldr: Proposes a transfer learning method for Bayesian optimization using an ensemble of surrogate models to address the cold start problem, applied to heterogeneous design spaces in aircraft conceptual design optimization.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于贝叶斯优化的迁移学习方法，利用代理模型集成解决冷启动问题，并应用于飞机概念设计中的异构设计空间优化。
summary_zh: 在贝叶斯优化中应用迁移学习，通过利用源数据辅助目标问题的优化，能够有效缓解所谓的“冷启动”问题。本文提出一种方法，该方法采用集成代理模型结合迁移学习，并将其整合到约束贝叶斯优化框架中。我们识别出飞机设计优化中特有的挑战，这些挑战涉及异构设计变量和约束条件。为此，我们提出使用偏最小二乘降维算法应对设计空间异构性，并采用一种“元”数据代理选择方法处理约束异构性。通过数值基准测试和一个飞机概念设计优化问题对所提方法进行了验证。结果表明，与标准贝叶斯优化相比，所提方法在优化早期迭代中收敛性显著提升，且目标函数与约束代理模型的预测精度均得到改善。

title: \texttt{ReproMIA}: A Comprehensive Analysis of Model Reprogramming for Proactive Membership Inference Attacks
summary: The pervasive deployment of deep learning models across critical domains has concurrently intensified privacy concerns due to their inherent propensity for data memorization. While Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) serve as the gold standard for auditing these privacy vulnerabilities, conventional MIA paradigms are increasingly constrained by the prohibitive computational costs of shadow model training and a precipitous performance degradation under low False Positive Rate constraints. To overcome these challenges, we introduce a novel perspective by leveraging the principles of model reprogramming as an active signal amplifier for privacy leakage. Building upon this insight, we present \texttt{ReproMIA}, a unified and efficient proactive framework for membership inference. We rigorously substantiate, both theoretically and empirically, how our methodology proactively induces and magnifies latent privacy footprints embedded within the model's representations. We provide specialized instantiations of \texttt{ReproMIA} across diverse architectural paradigms, including LLMs, Diffusion Models, and Classification Models. Comprehensive experimental evaluations across more than ten benchmarks and a variety of model architectures demonstrate that \texttt{ReproMIA} consistently and substantially outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a transformative leap in performance specifically within low-FPR regimes, such as an average of 5.25\% AUC and 10.68\% TPR@1\%FPR increase over the runner-up for LLMs, as well as 3.70\% and 12.40\% respectively for Diffusion Models.
tldr: The paper introduces ReproMIA, a novel proactive membership inference attack framework that uses model reprogramming to amplify privacy leakage signals, achieving superior performance across diverse model architectures (LLMs, Diffusion Models, etc.) in low false-positive rate regimes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 ReproMIA 的新型主动成员推理攻击框架，该方法利用模型重编程来放大隐私泄露信号，在多种模型架构上实现了卓越的性能，尤其是在低误报率情况下。
summary_zh: 深度学习模型在关键领域的广泛部署，因其固有的数据记忆倾向而加剧了隐私担忧。虽然成员推断攻击（MIA）作为审计这些隐私漏洞的黄金标准，但传统的MIA范式日益受到影子模型训练过高计算成本以及低误报率约束下性能急剧下降的限制。为克服这些挑战，我们引入了一种新颖的视角，利用模型重编程原理作为隐私泄露的主动信号放大器。基于这一见解，我们提出了\texttt{ReproMIA}，一个统一且高效的前瞻性成员推断框架。我们从理论和实证两方面严格验证了该方法如何主动诱发并放大模型表征中潜在的隐私足迹。我们为\texttt{ReproMIA}在多种架构范式（包括大语言模型、扩散模型和分类模型）中提供了专门的实例化方案。在超过十个基准测试和多种模型架构上的综合实验评估表明，\texttt{ReproMIA}始终显著优于现有最先进的基线方法，特别是在低误报率场景下实现了性能的跨越式提升：例如，在大语言模型上，其平均AUC较次优方法提高5.25%，TPR@1\%FPR提高10.68%；在扩散模型上则分别提高3.70%和12.40%。

title: Symmetrizing Bregman Divergence on the Cone of Positive Definite Matrices: Which Mean to Use and Why
summary: This work uncovers variational principles behind symmetrizing the Bregman divergences induced by generic mirror maps over the cone of positive definite matrices. We show that computing the canonical means for this symmetrization can be posed as minimizing the desired symmetrized divergences over a set of mean functionals defined axiomatically to satisfy certain properties. For the forward symmetrization, we prove that the arithmetic mean over the primal space is canonical for any mirror map over the positive definite cone. For the reverse symmetrization, we show that the canonical mean is the arithmetic mean over the dual space, pulled back to the primal space. Applying this result to three common mirror maps used in practice, we show that the canonical means for reverse symmetrization, in those cases, turn out to be the arithmetic, log-Euclidean and harmonic means. Our results improve understanding of existing symmetrization practices in the literature, and can be seen as a navigational chart to help decide which mean to use when.
tldr: This paper analyzes the mathematical principles for symmetrizing Bregman divergences on positive definite matrices, identifying canonical means for different symmetrization schemes.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了在正定矩阵锥上对称化Bregman散度的数学原理，为不同的对称化方案确定了规范均值。
summary_zh: 本工作揭示了在正定矩阵锥上由通用镜像映射诱导的Bregman散度对称化背后的变分原理。我们证明，计算这种对称化对应的典范均值可转化为在一组满足特定公理化性质的均值泛函集合上，最小化目标对称化散度。对于正向对称化，我们证明原空间的算术均值是正定锥上任意镜像映射的典范选择。对于反向对称化，则表明典范均值是定义在对偶空间上的算术均值在原空间中的拉回映射。将这一结果应用于实践中常用的三种镜像映射时，我们证明反向对称化对应的典范均值分别为算术均值、对数欧几里得均值与调和均值。本研究深化了对现有文献中对称化实践的理解，其成果可视为指导实践中如何选择均值方法的导航图。
